title: A Path-Dependent Agent-Based Microsimulation of Crime and Violence Reduction Policy Portfolios in Bolivia: Survey Calibration, Adaptive Emulator Ensembles, Global Sensitivity, Tempered MCMC, and Multi-Objective Policy Analysis
summary: This study develops a survey-calibrated, path-dependent agent-based microsimulation for evaluating crime and violence reduction policies in Bolivia. A synthetic population is constructed from the 2025 Household Survey and the fourth-quarter 2025 Continuous Employment Survey using official expansion weights and cross-survey donor matching. The model combines heterogeneous agents, place-based risk, criminal adaptation, institutional capacity, community organization, and multiple policy channels. Uncertainty is propagated through adaptive Gaussian-process and tree-ensemble emulators, global sensitivity analysis, tempered ensemble MCMC, and predictive meta-calibration. Simulated portfolios include focused policing, community control, Guardabosques-type incentives, social prevention, environmental interventions, justice reforms, investigation, rehabilitation, and financial-network disruption. Results are interpreted as structural policy scenarios rather than causal forecasts, with explicit attention to displacement, distributional effects, implementation capacity, and multi-objective trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 开发基于调查校准、路径依赖的智能体微观仿真，用于评估玻利维亚犯罪与暴力减少政策。
AI.motivation: 为玻利维亚犯罪与暴力治理政策提供结构化评估工具，应对政策评估中因果推断困难、不确定性大、多目标权衡复杂的问题。
AI.method: 利用2025家庭调查与2025年四季度连续就业调查，结合官方扩样权重与跨调查捐赠者匹配构建合成人口；模型整合异质智能体、地点风险、犯罪适应、机构能力、社区组织及多政策渠道；通过自适应高斯过程与树集成模拟器、全局敏感性分析、退火集成MCMC和预测元校准传播不确定性。
AI.result: 模拟了重点警务、社区控制、Guardabosques型激励、社会预防、环境干预、司法改革、侦查、康复及金融网络干预等政策组合，并关注位移效应、分配效应、实施能力及多目标权衡。结果被解释为结构性政策情景而非因果预测。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个可校准、可解释的政策情景分析框架，强调不确定性处理与多目标权衡，为玻利维亚犯罪与暴力政策设计提供决策支持。

title: Testing Large Language Model Agents on the Use of Biological Tools for Nucleic Acid Synthesis Screening Evasion
summary: This report is a continuation of previous efforts to test the ability of large language model (LLM)-driven artificial intelligence (AI) agents to interface with AI-enabled biological tools (BTs). While rapid advancements in BTs in recent years have brought promise to accelerate scientific discovery, they also raise significant biosecurity concerns about potential misuse. The biosecurity community is particularly interested in the extent to which LLMs can lower technical barriers and assist non-expert users in accessing and operating BTs. Despite this interest, few evaluations have focused on LLM-BT interactions in the context of a defined threat model. To address this gap, this report describes a test of frontier LLM-driven AI Agents on their ability to use BTs to redesign peptides and proteins to evade nucleic acid synthesis screening measures. Highly relevant to biorisk, this task assesses a potential capability of AI agents that could enable a breach of a critical early defensive layer designed to prevent a multitude of biological misuse scenarios. The findings presented here intend to offer a foundation for biosecurity researchers and AI developers to conduct or further risk and capability assessments as these technologies progress.

AI.tldr: 本报告测试前沿LLM驱动的AI代理利用AI生物工具重新设计多肽和蛋白质以规避核酸合成筛查的能力，旨在为生物安全风险评估奠定基础。
AI.motivation: AI生物工具快速发展带来科研加速的同时，也引发潜在的生物安全滥用担忧。生物安全界尤其关注LLM能在多大程度上降低技术门槛，帮助非专家用户获取和操作生物工具。然而，目前很少有评估在明确的威胁模型下研究LLM与生物工具的交互。
AI.method: 在明确定义的威胁模型下，测试前沿LLM驱动的AI代理使用生物工具重新设计多肽和蛋白质、以规避核酸合成筛查措施的能力。
AI.result: 该任务直接关系到生物风险，评估了AI代理可能具备的一项能力——突破防止多种生物滥用场景的关键早期防御层。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为生物安全研究人员和AI开发者提供基础，以便随着技术发展开展或深化风险与能力评估。

title: Partial Identification under Imperfect Measurement: A Distributionally Robust Approach
summary: Imperfect measurements allow different underlying distributions to generate the same observations. Restrictions linking unobserved components can make it difficult to characterize all compatible distributions and compute the resulting range of parameter values. We ask how to construct computable parameter bounds and tighten them without additional data or stronger assumptions. We develop a general framework for partial identification under imperfect measurement based on distributionally robust optimization. We use measurement restrictions to construct a neighborhood around a benchmark distribution, ensuring that every compatible distribution lies within it. Optimizing over this neighborhood gives parameter bounds through a common procedure that can be adapted to different measurement problems. The choice of benchmark affects how informative these bounds are. We establish conditions under which changing it can tighten the bounds while preserving every parameter value consistent with the same data and assumptions. Applications to networks, missing outcomes, and regression illustrate how the framework tightens bounds and can recover the full range of compatible values.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于分布鲁棒优化的通用框架，用于不完全测量下的部分识别，构造可计算的参数界并在不增加数据或更强假设的前提下收紧这些界。
AI.motivation: 不完全测量使得不同潜在分布产生相同观测，测量限制又使刻画所有相容分布及参数取值范围变得困难；目标是构造可计算且可收紧的参数界。
AI.method: 利用测量限制在基准分布周围构造邻域，确保所有相容分布均位于其中；通过对该邻域做分布鲁棒优化得到参数界，并研究基准选择对界的信息量的影响，建立收紧界的条件。
AI.result: 给出一个可适配不同测量问题的通用优化程序；证明在保持与数据和假设一致的所有参数值不变的前提下，改变基准分布可收紧界；在网络、缺失结果和回归应用中展示框架能收紧界并恢复完整相容取值范围。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一并增强了不完全测量下的部分识别分析，提供了可计算、可收紧的参数界，具有广泛适用性。

title: Can LLM Agents Select and Engage with Biological Tools?
summary: Computational tools for biological research (biological tools, or BTs) are advancing rapidly in both quantity and demonstrated capability. While these technologies offer many benefits for scientific advancement, malicious actors may seek to exploit them to design and develop biological weapons (BWs). Generally, BTs require specialized expertise to operate successfully, presenting a barrier to nefarious use by nonexperts. Large language model (LLM) Agents may erode this barrier by enabling actors with limited domain expertise to successfully use BTs. Assessments of how AI could change bioweapons development pathways should examine how LLM Agents interact with BTs on relevant biological design tasks, but such assessments are limited. In this report, we present an assessment of the abilities of LLM Agents in the early stages of interaction with BTs. First, we evaluate seven frontier LLM Agents on their ability to select appropriate BTs for a given task. Second, we assess how these LLM Agents engage with two BTs, EVEscape and ESM3, through targeted case studies. These case studies probe the enabling capabilities required for autonomous BT operation, a potential entry point to a wide range of risk pathways. We identify and assess technical barriers at the intersection of LLM Agents and BTs, offering the biosecurity community and AI developers a foundation for further risk and capability assessments as technologies progress.

AI.tldr: 该报告评估了LLM Agent在生物工具（BT）使用早期阶段的能力，重点考察其工具选择与自主操作潜力，以识别生物安全风险。
AI.motivation: 生物工具快速发展且可被滥用于生物武器开发，通常需要专业知识形成门槛，但LLM Agent可能降低非专家使用门槛，而相关风险评估研究有限。
AI.method: 首先评测七种前沿LLM Agent为给定任务选择合适生物工具的能力；其次通过针对EVEscape和ESM3两个工具的案例研究，考察其自主操作所需的能力。
AI.result: 识别并评估了LLM Agent与生物工具交叉处的技术障碍。
AI.conclusion: 为生物安全界和AI开发者提供了进一步风险与能力评估的基础。

title: Bootstrap Inference with a Randomly Assigned Regressor: Covariance Filtering and the Limits of Marginal Resampling
summary: Random assignment can make ordinary least squares (OLS) inference insensitive to outcome dependence, yet iid resampling can still fail because assignment and resampling need not remove the same covariance terms. With binary treatment, the iid variance target differs from the sampling variance by exactly minus aggregate cross-unit covariance of treatment effects. Under a Gaussian first-order limit, positive covariance leads to over-rejection and negative covariance to under-rejection. Two designs can generate the same distribution for each observation but require variance corrections of opposite signs, so no marginal-only variance correction is first-order exact for both. For first-order Gaussian inference, only one covariance component---the covariance carried by the randomized-regressor score---must be recovered. Standard dependence estimators on that score restore validity under suitable ordered or grouped dependence conditions. In simulations with ordered data, fixed-bandwidth calibration reduces several large-bandwidth size distortions.

AI.tldr: 本文分析随机分配下OLS推断对结果依赖的敏感性，指出iid重抽样可能失效，并提出基于随机化回归量得分的协方差修正方法。
AI.motivation: 随机分配可使OLS推断对结果依赖不敏感，但iid重抽样仍可能失败，因为分配与重抽样未必消除相同的协方差项。需要厘清方差目标差异并寻找仅依赖边际信息的精确修正。
AI.method: 在二值处理下，将iid方差目标与抽样方差之差表示为处理效应跨单位协方差的负聚合。采用高斯一阶极限分析正负协方差对拒绝率的影响，论证仅恢复随机化回归量得分所携带的协方差分量即可实现一阶精确推断，并应用标准依赖估计量。
AI.result: 正协方差导致过度拒绝，负协方差导致拒绝不足。两个设计可有相同的边际分布但需相反符号的方差修正，故任何仅依赖边际的修正无法对两者均一阶精确。得分上的标准依赖估计量在有序或分组依赖条件下恢复有效性；有序数据模拟中固定带宽校准减小了大带宽的规模扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 一阶高斯推断只需恢复随机化回归量得分中的协方差分量，无需完整依赖结构；边际-only修正不存在普适精确解，依赖得分估计与带宽校准是关键。

title: Govern, Map, Measure, Absorb: The Legibility Trap in Public Sector Participatory AI Governance
summary: Public sector agencies have adopted participatory design as a prominent procedural safeguard proposed against algorithmic harm. Across methods, institutional contexts, and well-intentioned implementations, the participation gap persists. Communities engage, input is documented, and systems are deployed largely unchanged. This paper locates the persistence of that gap in the mechanism institutions use to document participation itself. We develop the concept of the legibility trap, in which institutional mechanisms for documenting participation systematically select for forms of community input that fit institutional categories and filter out the forms that would most constrain state power, including foundational dissent, demands for non-deployment, and what Kelly Oliver calls witnessing to structural conditions of harm. Drawing on James Scott's theory of state simplification, we demonstrate the legibility trap through critical discourse analysis of twenty-two official, community-produced, and public-record documents across three public sector AI deployments: the Allegheny Family Screening Tool, Detroit Project Green Light, and the Community Control Over Police Surveillance (CCOPS) ordinances in Oakland. We identify the structural conditions under which participation partially escapes the trap, and we theorize that repeated non-response constitutes a harm to community subjectivity that AI ethics frameworks have not yet named.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可读性陷阱"概念，解释公共部门AI部署中参与式设计为何持续失效：机构记录参与的机制系统性地筛选出契合机构分类的社区输入，过滤掉真正能约束国家权力的诉求。
AI.motivation: 尽管参与式设计被广泛采纳为应对算法伤害的程序性保障，但"参与差距"始终存在：社区参与、输入被记录、系统却基本原样部署。本文尝试定位这一差距持续存在的机制性根源。
AI.method: 基于James Scott的国家简化理论，对三个公共部门AI部署（Allegheny家庭筛查工具、底特律Project Green Light、奥克兰CCOPS条例）的22份官方、社区制作及公开记录文件进行批判性话语分析。
AI.result: 识别出可读性陷阱的运作方式——机构文档机制偏好契合机构类别的输入，过滤掉根本性异议、拒绝部署的诉求以及Kelly Oliver所说的对结构性伤害的见证。同时识别出参与部分逃脱陷阱的结构性条件。
AI.conclusion: 重复性的不予回应构成对社区主体性的伤害，而现有AI伦理框架尚未对此加以命名。

title: Latent Continuum of Regimes in Limit Order Book Dynamics
comment: 45 pages, 16 figures, 18 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/anjalitwt009/Latent-Continuum-of-Regimes-in-Limit-Order-Book-Dynamics
summary: Market-regime models typically assume a finite set of discrete latent states. We examine whether high frequency limit-order-book dynamics exhibit distinct regime separation or apparent regimes result from discretising an underlying continuum, analysing deep limit-order book data for EURO STOXX 50 index futures across 987 clean trading days from 2022 to 2025 using 30, 45 and 60-second aggregation windows. Market states are represented by symmetric positive definite covariance matrices and analysed under Log-Euclidean and affine-invariant geometries; the resulting state cloud has an effective dimension of approximately 1.4. A causal anomaly layer filters statistical, calendar and rollover contamination, while label-free economic validation evaluates market-state separation independently of volatility-based proxy labels. A 17-method zoo spanning conventional and Riemannian representations, reinforced by full-cloud geometric certificates, consistently favours a continuum over a discrete regime structure. A dominant latent coordinate captures between 83.66% and 85.27% of variation in the covariance-state geometry and tracks VSTOXX without regime labels, remaining stable across years although its average level shifts with market conditions, indicating that conventional regimes are coarse quantisations. A divisive hierarchy spanning macro, macro-subregime, micro and micro-subregime tiers is evaluated using expanding-year walk-forward tests, with out-of-sample performance strongest at the macro tier while finer tiers fail to generalise; continuous fine-scale information nonetheless remains predictive, and its discretisation causes the performance loss. Forecasting performance peaks near ten minutes, reaching a maximum pooled R2_OOS of 0.7483. Overall, the latent stress coordinate defines a stable, low-dimensional geometric continuum that captures market stress and its predictive dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文用深度限价订单簿数据检验市场状态是离散regime还是连续谱，发现EURO STOXX 50期货协方差状态云近似1.4维、单一潜坐标解释约85%变异并追踪VSTOXX，支持“连续体”而非离散regime。
AI.motivation: 传统市场状态（regime）模型假设有限个离散潜状态，但这类"regime"可能只是对潜在连续谱的粗量化结果。作者希望验证高频限价订单簿动态究竟存在真正的状态分离，还是离散化造成的假象。
AI.method: 使用EURO STOXX 50指数期货深度限价订单簿数据（987个干净交易日，2022–2025），30/45/60秒聚合窗口；以对称正定协方差矩阵表示市场状态，在Log-Euclidean与仿射不变几何下分析。构建因果异常层过滤统计、日历与展期污染；采用无标签经济验证。用覆盖常规与黎曼表示的17种方法及全云几何证书进行判别，并做扩张年滚动前向检验的分层（macro/macro-subregime/micro/micro-subregime）评估。
AI.result: 状态云有效维度约1.4；17种方法与几何证书一致支持连续体而非离散regime。主导潜坐标解释83.66%–85.27%的协方差几何变异，无需regime标签即可追踪VSTOXX，跨年稳定但均值随市况移动。分层检验中宏观层样本外表现最强，细层无法泛化，证实性能损失源于离散化。预测表现约在十分钟处达峰，最大池化R2_OOS为0.7483。
AI.conclusion: 潜压力坐标定义了一个稳定、低维的几何连续体，能刻画市场压力及其预测动态；惯例上的离散regime只是对连续谱的粗量化。连续细尺度信息仍具预测力，离散化才是性能损失来源。

title: Matched Triple-Differences: A Framework for Covariate Adjustment
summary: A common empirical strategy in triple-differences (DDD) is to include either covariate trends or covariate levels to a three-way fixed effects (3WFE) regression. This strategy is typically motivated by the conditional parallel gaps assumption which assumes that deviations from parallel trends are similar among units with comparable observed covariates. We formally study both 3WFE specifications and show that, in general, neither consistently estimates the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT). Our diagnosis has two parts. First, we show that the OLS estimands of both specifications fail to satisfy the covariate balancing condition that is sufficient for them to equal the ATT. Second, we characterize the additional assumptions for each OLS estimand to equal the ATT. To address these limitations, we propose a matched triple-differences framework that accommodates a general class of matching procedures, including nearest-neighbor matching and kernel matching. Within this framework, we construct a class of consistent matching estimators, establish their asymptotic normality, and provide a consistent variance estimator that accounts for the variability introduced by the matching step. Our empirical application shows that the proposed matched triple-differences estimator can yield estimates and qualitative conclusions that differ from those obtained using the 3WFE regression.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三重差分(DDD)中三向固定效应(3WFE)回归加入协变量趋势或水平的做法，证明二者一般不能一致估计ATT，并提出匹配三重差分框架与一致估计量。
AI.motivation: 实证中常用在3WFE回归中加入协变量趋势或协变量水平，其依据是条件平行差距假设（协变量相近的个体偏离平行趋势的程度相似）。但该做法缺乏正式的理论支撑，其能否一致估计ATT并不清楚。
AI.method: 作者首先形式化分析两种3WFE设定（含协变量趋势、含协变量水平）的OLS估计目标；其次检验其是否满足足以等于ATT的协变量平衡条件，并刻画使其等于ATT所需的额外假设；最后提出一个匹配三重差分框架，兼容最近邻匹配、核匹配等一般匹配方法，构造一致匹配估计量，证明渐近正态性并给出考虑匹配步骤变异性的相合方差估计。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，两种3WFE设定的OLS估计目标一般不满足协变量平衡条件，因此通常无法一致估计ATT，仅在额外假设下才成立；所提出的匹配DDD估计量具有一致性、渐近正态性，并有相合的方差估计。实证应用中，匹配DDD估计得到的估计值与定性结论可能与3WFE回归不同。
AI.conclusion: 在DDD中简单加入协变量趋势或水平不能保证识别ATT，本文的匹配三重差分框架提供了更稳健的替代方案，可得到一致估计并支持有效推断，实证结果也说明两种方法可能导致不同结论。

title: Agent Reliability Profiles in Financial Services
summary: AI agents can take actions. At times, those actions can go beyond what is intended. Agent reliability can be defined as assurance that an agent will stay within intended bounds and operate within limits. Today, there is no shared framework or language for describing, validating, and benchmarking the reliability of agentic deployments in financial services. This makes it difficult for financial institutions, vendors, and regulators to assess and trust agents at scale, thus limiting the pace of development and adoption. A standardized, shared representation of agent reliability would fill the gap. This paper introduces the Agent Reliability Profile, a per-agent unit of assurance evidence for agent deployments in financial services. Each Profile records a bounded, falsifiable claim, this agentic system reliably functions within its operating boundary. We define "operating boundary" as an agent having; (1) a defined autonomy tier, (2) a defined operational design domain, (3) defined classes of action, and (4) a defined control envelope. Production assurance progresses through three levels while the Profile schema remains constant: a Profile Builder compiles a Level 1 Asserted Profile from institutional evidence, a Profile Validator tests the deployment in its own environment to produce a Level 2 Validated Profile, and operation of the same tests by a qualified independent assessor produces a Level 3 Verified Profile. Separately a Benchmarked Profile reports results comparable across institutions under reference conditions. We describe the architecture, the artifact, the assurance ladder, the comparability flag, associated tools, an evaluation methodology, applications for financial institutions and supervisors, limitations, and a staged implementation program.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体可靠性档案"(Agent Reliability Profile)，作为金融服务中智能体部署的可证伪保证单元，通过三级保证阶梯（声明-验证-核实）和统一模式，为机构、供应商和监管者提供标准化、可比较的可靠性评估框架。
AI.motivation: AI智能体的行动可能超出预期，其可靠性尚无统一的框架和语言来描述、验证和基准测试。金融机构、供应商和监管者难以规模化地评估和信任智能体，制约了开发与采用的步伐。因此需要一个标准化、共享的智能体可靠性表示。
AI.method: 提出Agent Reliability Profile，记录有界、可证伪的声明——即智能体在其"操作边界"内可靠运行。操作边界包含四要素：(1)自主性等级；(2)操作设计域；(3)行动类别；(4)控制包络。保证分三级而模式不变：Profile Builder从机构证据生成Level 1声明档案；Profile Validator在自有环境测试生成Level 2验证档案；合格独立评估者操作同样测试生成Level 3核实档案。另有Benchmarked Profile在参考条件下报告跨机构可比较结果。
AI.result: 构建了包含架构、工件、保证阶梯、可比性标志、配套工具、评估方法及分阶段实施计划的完整体系，并阐明其在金融机构和监管者中的应用及局限。
AI.conclusion: Agent Reliability Profile为金融服务中智能体部署提供了标准化、可证伪、可比较的可靠性保证框架，有望加速智能体的开发与规模化采用。

title: Measuring Trade Direction in a Prediction Market: Settlement Ground Truth and Trading-Cost Measurement on Polymarket
comment: 41 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables. Companion to arXiv:2604.24366. Replication package: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23164515
summary: Trade-sign errors can change measured trading costs even when classification accuracy is high. We validate the side of Polymarket's public trade prints against the taker leg of each print's on-chain settlement. On twelve selected days between April and August 2026, spanning both exchange generations, 92.1% to 100.0% of prints match a settled taker leg, with exact side and token agreement on all 24.5 million matched pairs. Mint-and-merge settlement makes that taker leg essential: pooling maker and taker legs changes the measured buy share. Signing the full cached tape before settlement selection yields 16.6 million prints signed by every rule; equal-day balanced accuracy is 0.942 for Lee-Ready, 0.768 for the tick test and 0.670 for retrospective bulk volume classification. On 16.4 million identical eligible fills, Lee-Ready raises effective spread by 0.429 cents per share under equal-fill weights; its realised-spread difference is -0.209 cents. Under share-volume weights, taker five-minute midpoint impact is 0.689 cents, while tick and bulk classifications give -0.374 and -0.119 cents. That aggregate sign reversal disappears when tied print rows are excluded. Distortion depends on error-weighted signed outcomes, sample selection and weighting. Receipt-time ordering and unobserved future-quote age limit these delivered-quote accounting quantities; they do not identify causal impact or private information. Supporting venue and collector analyses provide descriptive diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文验证 Polymarket 公开成交打印的买卖方向，通过链上结算的 taker 腿做基准，发现即使分类准确率高，交易方向错误仍会显著扭曲测得的交易成本与冲击指标，且失真程度取决于误差加权结果、样本选择与加权方式。
AI.motivation: 现有交易成本（有效价差、实现价差、冲击）度量依赖买卖方向分类，但分类准确率高不代表方向误差对成本估计无偏。作者希望以链上结算为"真值"检验公开 tape 的方向标注，评估常见规则（Lee-Ready、tick test、BVC）在真实高频数据下的失真程度与来源。
AI.method: 以 2026 年 4–8 月间 12 个交易日（跨两代交易所）为样本，将 Polymarket 公开成交打印与每笔链上结算的 taker 腿逐笔匹配（2450 万对）。用 Lee-Ready、tick test 和回顾式 BVC 对完整缓存 tape 签名，比较等日平衡准确率；在 1640 万笔相同合格成交上，用等笔权重与份额量权重分别计算有效价差、实现价差与五分钟中点冲击，并检验剔除 tied print 行后的变化。由于 mint-and-merge 结算机制，taker 腿的区分对方向判定至关重要。
AI.result: 匹配率 92.1%–100.0%，匹配对方向与代币完全一致；等日平衡准确率 Lee-Ready 0.942、tick test 0.768、BVC 0.670。等笔权重下 Lee-Ready 使有效价差上升 0.429 美分/股，实现价差差异 -0.209 美分；份额量权重下 Lee-Ready 的 taker 五分钟冲击为 +0.689 美分，而 tick 与 BVC 分别为 -0.374 和 -0.119 美分，剔除 tied print 后这一符号反转消失。混同 maker 与 taker 腿会改变测得的买入份额。
AI.conclusion: 交易方向标注误差会通过误差加权的有符号结果、样本选择与加权方式系统性扭曲交易成本与冲击度量，分类高准确率不足以保证一致性。作者强调这些量受回执时间排序与未观测未来报价年龄限制，仅属"已送达报价"的会计口径，不能识别因果冲击或私有信息；附带场所与采集器分析仅为描述性诊断。

title: On the Tightness and Computational Tractability of Higher-Dimensional Confidence Sequences
summary: Modern sequential monitoring problems often involve multiple metrics, where we monitor several data streams simultaneously and may act once the evidence is strong enough. Confidence sequences (CSs) are a natural tool for such continuous monitoring. However, for bounded vector means, existing multivariate CSs are either tight but computationally intractable, or fast to compute but conservative. To address this, we study three lifts of one-dimensional betting-based CSs to higher dimensions: a weighted Bonferroni region, an equivalent max-wealth form, and a portfolio region. The portfolio is typically much tighter, especially in higher dimensions, but its boundary and properties such as volume are not available in closed form. To make this tighter construction usable, we propose tractable outer approximations of the portfolio region that preserve statistical validity: a bounding box, an $\ell_p$-ellipsoid, and their intersection. We prove set relations among all constructions and show empirically that these approximations (i) achieve regions close to the intractable portfolio, (ii) substantially outperform existing tractable multivariate CSs, and (iii) enable practical use cases such as multi-metric A/B testing and model comparison.

AI.tldr: 提出了基于betting的一维置信序列在高维的三种推广，并用可计算的外近似使portfolio区域实用化。
AI.motivation: 多指标顺序监测需要同时监控多个数据流，现有有界向量均值的多元置信序列要么紧但计算不可行，要么快但过于保守。
AI.method: 研究一维betting-based CS的三种高维提升：加权Bonferroni区域、等价的max-wealth形式、portfolio区域；并为portfolio区域提出可计算的外近似：bounding box、ℓ_p-ellipsoid及二者交集，同时证明各构造间的集合关系。
AI.result: 近似区域接近不可计算的portfolio区域，显著优于现有可计算的多元CS，并支持多指标A/B测试与模型比较等实际应用。
AI.conclusion: 通过保持统计有效性的可计算外近似，使紧致但难以计算的portfolio区域变得实用。

title: Fine-Grained Emotion Classification from Mobile App Reviews: An Empirical Study with Large Language Models
summary: Context: Fine-grained emotion classification of mobile app reviews enables requirements engineering activities that go beyond polarity-based opinion mining, including emotionally informed issue prioritisation and feature-oriented feedback analysis. However, automatic fine-grained emotion extraction from app reviews remains understudied. Objectives: Building on a previously published annotation framework and human-labelled ground truth adapted from Plutchik's taxonomy, this paper investigates how large language models can be leveraged for automatic multi-label emotion classification under severe class imbalance. Methods: We compare encoder-only fine-tuning under multi-label and binary-ensemble formulations, decoder-only zero- and few-shot prompting across open-source and proprietary models, and a catalogue of imbalance mitigation strategies (loss reweighting, resampling, generative data augmentation), with the synthetic-review generator and prompting strategy selected via an intrinsic augmentation-utility ranking. Results: Fine-tuned encoders trail the best decoder-only few-shot prompting (macro-F1 0.642) by a wide margin at baseline (multi-label: 0.387; binary ensemble: 0.450); pairing the best multi-label encoder with generative data augmentation and positive-weighted loss closes most of this gap (+0.204) at up to three orders of magnitude lower inference latency than the decoders, with the largest gains on the rarest emotions, from undetected to gains of up to +0.501 F1. Conclusion: Large language models make fine-grained, multi-label emotion classification of app reviews feasible for requirements engineering pipelines, with modest macro-F1, and the best formulation and mitigation strategy are backbone- and formulation-dependent. We release the experimental pipeline, synthetic corpora, and fine-tuned checkpoints for replication and reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何用大语言模型对移动应用评论进行细粒度多标签情感分类，比较编码器微调、解码器提示及类别不平衡缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 细粒度情感分类支持情感驱动的需求工程活动，但自动从app评论中提取细粒度情感仍缺乏研究，且面临严重类别不平衡问题。
AI.method: 基于Plutchik分类法的人工标注数据，比较编码器微调（多标签与二元集成）、解码器零/少样本提示（开源与闭源），以及损失重加权、重采样、生成式数据增强等不平衡缓解策略，并通过内在增强效用排序选择合成评论生成器与提示策略。
AI.result: 微调编码器基线落后于最佳解码器少样本提示（macro-F1 0.642）：多标签0.387、二元集成0.450；最佳多标签编码器结合生成式增强与正类加权损失将差距缩小（+0.204），推理延迟低至三个数量级，稀有情感提升最大（最高+0.501 F1）。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型使app评论细粒度多标签情感分类对需求工程流程可行，但macro-F1有限，最佳方案依赖骨干模型与任务形式；作者公开了流程、合成语料与微调检查点。

title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
summary: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.

AI.tldr: ADSD框架通过"诊断优先"范式，先解释数值求解器性能差的根因，再据此发现并复用数值方法，将求解器改进从试错编辑转变为结构化的诊断—发现—实现流程。
AI.motivation: AI智能体虽能生成科学代码，但生成代码不等于改进底层算法。对于数值求解器，执行反馈只能暴露性能差，却难以揭示原因及解决办法。
AI.method: 提出Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD)框架：采用诊断优先范式，先诊断求解器性能差的根因，再用诊断指导发现合适的数值方法，并将所得知识封装为可复用的求解器技能。
AI.result: 在电力潮流方程、交流最优潮流控制、刚性常微分方程、异质扩散偏微分方程四个领域，ADSD持续提升求解器精度、鲁棒性与效率。例如在GOC-500电力潮流上，平均求解误差降低近71倍，且改进可迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。
AI.conclusion: ADSD通过将诊断与技能发现结合，实现求解器的结构化自我改进，并具备跨场景的可迁移性。

title: Concave Roofs and Downward Recovery for DR-Submodular Polynomial Maximization
summary:
We give approximation algorithms for $\max\{F(x):x\in\K\}$, where $\K$ is a nonempty compact down-closed convex subset of the unit cube and $F$ is a nonnegative diminishing-returns (DR) submodular polynomial: every entry of its Hessian is nonpositive on the cube.
  Starting from quadratic or cubic coefficients, we decompose the objective exactly into nonnegative rooted atoms and affine terms. Concave upper bounds for these components give a tractable roof. We then decrease the coordinates of a roof optimizer using maps that work for all components at once, recovering a fraction of the roof value while preserving feasibility. For quadratics, we also retain the concave diagonal residual exactly.
  Under the stated assumptions on optimization access, these constructions give deterministic polynomial-time factors of $1/2$ for quadratics and $8/17$ for cubics, up to any prescribed additive error. The cubic result includes positive cubic coefficients and repeated variables. The factor $8/17$ also holds for two larger classes: supplied compatible rooted certificates of literal degree at most twelve, and sums of nonnegative submodular local functions of arity at most four. At arbitrary finite literal degree, a common scalar map attains the optimal single-map factor $2\sqrt3-3$. Global monotonicity and concave-cardinality structure give stronger guarantees for multilinear local-function sums, with no recovery beyond the identity map. Standard matroid rounding transfers the multilinear guarantees without loss. We also prove online preservation for directed-hypergraph cuts and, separately, a Unique-Games inapproximability bound of approximately $0.82843$ for explicit quadratic input under a cardinality upper bound.

AI.tldr: 该文为一类带-down-closed凸约束的DR次模多项式最大化问题给出近似算法，二次、三次分别达到1/2与8/17的确定性多项式时间近似比（含加性误差），并扩展到更广的函数类，同时给出在线保持与Unique-Games不可近似性结果。
AI.motivation: 研究在单位立方体的非空紧致下闭凸子集上最大化非负收益递减(DR)次模多项式，目标是对二次/三次乃至更广次模函数类给出可证近似保证，并厘清单映射最优性与不可近似性边界。
AI.method: 将目标精确分解为非负根原子与仿射项，对这些分量构造凹上界形成可处理的"roof"；对roof优化点用同时适用于所有分量的坐标递减映射保持可行性并回收部分roof值；二次情形额外精确保留凹对角残差。另用全局单调性与凹基数结构、标准拟阵舍入、标量映射框架及在线保持分析。
AI.result: 得到二次1/2、三次8/17的确定性多项式时间因子（允许任意给定加性误差）；三次结果涵盖正三次系数与重复变量；8/17也适用于literal degree≤12的相容根证书，以及arity≤4的非负次模局部函数和。任意有限literal degree下，单一标量映射最优因子为2√3−3；多线性局部函数和在全局单调性与凹基数下更强（无需超出恒等映射的回收）；拟阵舍入无损传递；有向超图割具在线保持性；显式二次输入在基数上界下的Unique-Games不可近似比约0.82843。
AI.conclusion: 建立了DR次模多项式最大化的统一近似框架，给出二次/三次及更广函数类的确定性与多线性保证，并刻画了单映射最优因子与不可近似性下界。

title: Optimal Catastrophe Bond Design and its Applications to Climate Change Risk
summary: Catastrophe bonds have become a central instrument for transferring catastrophic risk to capital markets, yet their payout structures are typically specified exogenously rather than optimized. In this paper, we treat the indemnity function as the decision variable and study the optimal design of CAT bonds from the sponsor's perspective. We establish the optimality of a piecewise linear indemnity function under both expected-disutility and spectral-risk-measure frameworks and thereby reduce an infinite-dimensional design problem to a one-dimensional optimization over the attachment point. The optimal design also eliminates the potential moral hazard associated with the discontinuity of threshold payout structures. We characterize the optimal attachment point under six risk criteria and obtain explicit or semi-explicit solutions. We further derive bounds for the optimal attachment point and develop comparative statics that provide practical design insights. Using U.S. severe storm losses from NOAA's Billion-Dollar Weather and Climate Disasters database for calibration, we show that the optimal CAT bond designs achieve substantial risk reductions across most risk criteria.

AI.tldr: 本文将CAT债券的赔付函数作为决策变量，研究其最优设计，证明在期望负效用与谱风险度量下最优赔付为分段线性函数，从而将无穷维问题降为一维起赔点优化。
AI.motivation: CAT债券是向资本市场转移巨灾风险的核心工具，但其赔付结构通常由外生给定，而非经过优化设计。
AI.method: 以赔付函数（indemnity function）为决策变量，从发起人视角建模；在期望负效用与谱风险度量两类框架下证明最优赔付函数为分段线性；将设计问题简化为对起赔点（attachment point）的一维优化；在六种风险准则下刻画最优起赔点，给出显式或半显式解，并推导最优起赔点的界与比较静态。
AI.result: 最优设计消除了阈值型赔付不连续性可能带来的道德风险；获得六种风险准则下最优起赔点的显式/半显式解、界的推导与比较静态结论；用NOAA“十亿美元级天气与气候灾害”数据库中的美国严重风暴损失进行校准，显示最优CAT债券设计在多数风险准则下实现显著风险降低。
AI.conclusion: 将CAT债券赔付结构内生化并优化，可有效降低发起人风险并避免道德风险，所提框架兼具理论最优性与实践可操作性。

title: PDE-Constrained MPC of Motility-Induced Phase Separation in Robotic Swarms: The Role of Model Fidelity and Local Information
summary: Motility-induced phase separation enables swarm aggregation to be regulated without prescribing a target spatial distribution. This paper develops a partial differential equation-constrained model predictive control framework for a vibration-driven robotic swarm. Three continuum models retaining progressively less orientation information are considered to study the trade-offs among model fidelity, information requirements, and computational cost. The framework is evaluated under centralized and decentralized settings, with focus on how limited sensing and local-to-global phase-separation estimation affect the performance of predictive control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种PDE约束的模型预测控制框架，用于振动驱动机器人集群的聚集调控，比较三种连续介质模型并评估集中式/分散式控制性能。
AI.motivation: 利用运动诱导相分离实现集群聚集调控，无需预设目标空间分布，但需要在模型精度、信息需求与计算成本之间权衡。
AI.method: 构建PDE约束的模型预测控制框架；采用三种保留取向信息递减的连续介质模型；在集中式与分散式设置下评估。
AI.result: 对比了三种模型在模型保真度、信息需求与计算成本上的权衡；分析了有限感知和局部到全局相分离估计对预测控制性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在不同信息与计算约束下调控振动驱动机器人集群的相分离聚集，感知能力与相分离估计质量显著影响控制性能。

title: A Price-Based Framework for Stochastic Portfolio Theory
summary: We develop a price-based framework for stochastic portfolio theory in which trading strategies are generated from nominal price weights and evaluated relative to a price-weighted benchmark. Stock splits and reverse splits induce jumps in the generating weights without changing the value of existing investments. In a semimartingale market with predictable adjustment events, we incorporate the corresponding share adjustments into the self-financing condition and construct additively and multiplicatively generated strategies with explicit jump-corrected wealth decompositions. For additive generation, an entropy-based example exhibits relative wealth tending to $-\infty$ almost surely under repeated splits, demonstrating why the usual argument for long-horizon relative arbitrage does not extend directly. We also show that advance adjustment information alone provides no model-free guarantee of improved performance for functionally generated portfolios. For multiplicative generation, wealth-preserving restarts retain the classical portfolio allocation evaluated at the current price weights. We also establish a correspondence with the capitalization-based framework that preserves absolute wealth and yields a strategy-independent benchmark conversion. We illustrate the framework using daily NYSE data, comparing price- and capitalization-weighted benchmarks and the corresponding diversity-weighted portfolios across price- and capitalization-selected universes.

AI.tldr: 本文在随机投资组合理论中提出基于价格的框架，用名义价格权重生成交易策略，并研究拆股/并股调整对自融资条件与财富分解的影响。
AI.motivation: 经典随机投资组合理论多基于市值权重；拆股和反向拆股会改变价格型生成权重并产生跳跃，若不纳入自融资条件，相对套利与绩效结论可能失真。
AI.method: 在半鞅市场且调整事件可预测的设定下，将股份调整纳入自融资条件，构造加性与乘性生成策略，并给出显式跳跃修正的财富分解；同时与市值框架建立对应关系。
AI.result: 加性生成中，熵型例子在反复拆股下相对财富几乎必然趋于负无穷，说明长期相对套利的常见论证不能直接推广；提前调整信息本身不提供无模型绩效保证；乘性生成的保财富重启保持经典组合配置；价格与市值基准可策略无关地转换，并用 NYSE 日度数据比较。
AI.conclusion: 基于价格权重可建立一致的随机投资组合理论，但拆股跳跃会根本影响相对财富行为，需在自融资与分解中显式处理，不能简单依赖传统相对套利论证。

title: Comparing two approaches for modelling the loss given default of credit cards: Run-off triangles vs regression
summary: The use of run-off triangles (ROTs) is a common industry practice in estimating the loss given default (LGD) risk parameter when predicting credit losses in banking. We benchmark this industry practice using credit card data against a more sophisticated (though classical) regression-based approach, which is able to leverage various types of input variables in producing loan-level LGD-estimates. This regression-based approach can demonstrably recover the typical characteristics of the 'U-shaped' empirical LGD-distribution, which the ROT-based approach cannot do. First, we critically review the ROT-based approach and identify multiple demerits using data-driven diagnostics. We then estimate a two-stage regression-based LGD-model and favourably assess the model performance of each component (or 'stage'). Finally, we aggregate the LGD-estimates produced by each approach over time, and compare each time series to the mean empirical loss rate over time. The ROT-based aggregates diverge substantially from the empirical rate over most time periods, whilst the regression-based aggregates follow the empirical trends much closer. These results underscore the greater prediction accuracy of the regression-based LGD-model, relative to the ROT-based one. By implication, the former approach is probably better than the latter ROT-based approach when estimating the LGD under the IFRS 9 accounting framework, which prioritises accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文用信用卡数据将行业常用的run-off triangle (ROT) 方法与两阶段回归法进行对比，发现回归法能更好捕捉U型LGD分布，预测精度更高。
AI.motivation: 在银行业LGD估计中，ROT方法是常见行业实践，但可能无法反映LGD的经验分布特征（如U型）。作者希望检验该行业做法是否真的优于更传统但更精细的回归方法，特别是在IFRS 9强调准确性的框架下。
AI.method: 基于信用卡数据，首先对ROT方法进行批判性回顾，用数据驱动诊断识别其多个缺陷；然后构建两阶段回归LGD模型（利用贷款级多类输入变量），并评估各阶段模型表现；最后将两种方法的LGD估计按时间聚合，与经验平均损失率时间序列比较。
AI.result: 回归法能重现经验LGD的U型分布特征，而ROT法不能；回归法各阶段模型表现良好；ROT法的时间聚合损失率在多数时期与经验损失率明显偏离，而回归法聚合值更贴近经验趋势，表明回归法预测更准确。
AI.conclusion: 回归式LGD模型相对ROT方法具有更高的预测精度，因此在强调准确性的IFRS 9框架下，回归方法可能是估计LGD更优的选择。

title: Bayes-Sufficient Compression Is Not Enough: How Does Communication Help Multi-Agent Systems?
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems pair a sender with broad context and an executor with a limited local view. We study when a short message improves the executor's next decision, when raw context is preferable, and when a stronger sender helps. Our framework, \emph{receiver-relative bounded coordination}, expresses message utility as receiver gain minus protocol tax. Compression beats raw context when tax savings exceed losses from omitted information and decoder mismatch. Even \emph{Bayes-sufficient} compression can fail when a bounded executor cannot use its surface form. A three-stage decomposition separates externalization, absorption, and \emph{action closure}, explaining how errors remain after the correct content reaches the receiver. Under a single-crossing condition, sender upgrades help above a receiver-burden threshold. Across six benchmarks, the same Qwen protocol raises ContextBench joint accuracy from $0.633$ to $0.775$ but lowers ToolSandbox from $0.889$ to $0.653$. Fixed-message replay reveals closure failures despite correct artifact recovery. These results guide an inference-time selector that improves the accuracy-cost frontier on the evaluated communication regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出"接收者相对有界协调"框架，将消息效用定义为接收者收益减去协议税，解释多智能体LLM系统中短消息何时优于原始上下文，并给出改进准确率-成本前沿的推理时选择器。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM中，发送者拥有丰富上下文而执行者只有有限局部视野，目前不清楚短消息何时能改善执行者决策、何时原始上下文更优、以及更强发送者是否有帮助。
AI.method: 构建receiver-relative bounded coordination框架，用"接收者收益-协议税"刻画消息效用；分析压缩与原始上下文、牺牲信息与解码器错配的权衡；用三阶段分解（外化、吸收、动作闭合）定位错误；在单交叉条件下分析发送者升级。
AI.result: 在六个基准上，同一Qwen协议将ContextBench联合准确率从0.633提升至0.775，却将ToolSandbox从0.889降至0.653；固定消息回放显示即使正确工件恢复仍存在闭合失败。
AI.conclusion: 消息效用取决于接收者与协议税，即便贝叶斯充分压缩也可能因有界执行者无法利用而失败；所提出的推理时选择器能在评估的通信场景中改善准确率-成本前沿。

title: Nonlinear fiscal multiplier controlling for policy and economic regimes
summary: A new form of the fiscal multiplier suited to data expressed as gross growth rates is proposed, together with a structural vector autoregression that isolates discretionary fiscal policy from regime and rule-based components. Because cumulating growth-rate responses over a horizon involves a product rather than a sum, the proposed multiplier is multiplicative: both numerator and denominator are polynomials in the size of the fiscal impulse, so the multiplier varies nonlinearly with the scale of the expenditure programme -- a dependence that conventional additive multipliers cannot capture. The multiplier requires no discounting, no ad hoc conversion factor, and no auxiliary estimate of an average expenditure share of output, and it is computed directly from nominal, non-seasonally-adjusted data, matching the terms in which government budgets are actually expressed. A version of the narrative approach to identification is introduced. It allows to decompose the influence of fiscal policy into a regime component, a standard policy rule embedded in the autoregressive structure, and discretionary shocks. Removing the regime component from the residuals yields smaller identified shocks, and correspondingly smaller multipliers, than found in SVARs not controlling for regime changes -- closing much of the gap between SVAR- and DSGE-based estimates. It is found that multipliers vary substantially across countries and across types of government expenditure, that regime volatility itself differs markedly by country, and that several economies display cyclicality in spending and multiplier paths that only becomes visible once responses are cumulated multiplicatively. The resulting multipliers are nominal, derived from unadjusted data, proven to be sensitive to shock size, and purged of regime effects, offering a tool with direct relevance for budget planning and fiscal policy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种适用于总增长率数据的"乘法型"财政乘数，并构建能分离相机抉择、规则与制度成分的SVAR，发现扣除制度效应后冲击与乘数变小，乘数随冲击规模和国别、支出类型显著变化。
AI.motivation: 传统加法型财政乘数基于对增长率响应的求和处理，无法刻画乘数随支出计划规模非线性变化，且需贴现、转换因子和平均支出份额等附加假设；同时SVAR与DSGE估计之间存在差距，亟需能剔除制度变迁影响的识别方法。
AI.method: 提出乘法型财政乘数：分子分母均为财政冲击规模的多项式，直接以名义、未季调数据计算，无需贴现或转换因子；构建结构向量自回归，将财政政策影响分解为制度成分、嵌入自回归结构的标准政策规则和相机抉择冲击，并引入叙述法识别的变体。
AI.result: 剔除制度成分后识别冲击更小、乘数相应更小，缩小了SVAR与DSGE估计的差距；乘数在国别和政府支出类型间差异显著，制度波动性因国而异，多个经济体在乘法累积下呈现此前不可见的支出与乘数周期性。
AI.conclusion: 所得乘数为名义值、源自未季调数据、对冲击规模敏感且剔除制度效应，为预算规划和财政政策评估提供了直接可用的工具。

title: Large Language Models and Augmented Democracy
comment: PhD thesis, Center for Collective Learning (Toulouse School of Economics), 2026. 149 pages, 28 figures
summary: Artificial intelligence enables computational agents to represent political preferences and take part in collective decision-making. In this thesis, I investigate the opportunities and challenges of digital twins (DTs) based on Large Language Models (LLMs) as intermediaries in augmented democracy, focusing on individual preference representation, collective representation of political organizations, and the vulnerability of those representations to attackers. First, using data from an online experiment in Brazil, I examine whether personalized DTs can predict citizens' preferences for unseen policy proposals. Second, I extend the DT framework from individuals to political organizations. Using Swiss parliamentary data, I build topic-specific knowledge graphs from lawmakers' legislative records and connect them to LLM-based lawmaker agents, which are organized into party-level DTs representing collective positions. Agentic deliberation among these agents tests whether aggregated party representations capture a broader range of intra-party perspectives than official party communications. Finally, I study the vulnerability and robustness of LLM-mediated deliberation against prompt-injection attacks that amplify viewpoints, suppress opinions, or redirect consensus. Using data from a 2023 deliberative experiment in the United Kingdom, I analyze how attack effectiveness varies with the distribution of opinions and rhetorical strategies, and evaluate a pipeline combining injection detection, structured opinion representations, and reinforcement learning to improve resistance. These findings characterize the opportunities and challenges of LLM-based digital twins in augmented democracy, stressing accurate preference representation, faithful aggregation, and robustness to strategic interaction.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究基于大语言模型(LLM)的数字孪生(DT)作为增强民主中介的机遇与挑战,涵盖个体偏好表示、政治组织集体表示及表示受攻击的脆弱性三方面。
AI.motivation: AI使计算代理能够表示政治偏好并参与集体决策,因此需要探究LLM驱动的数字孪生在增强民主中的应用潜力及风险。
AI.method: 1) 利用巴西在线实验数据,检验个性化DT能否预测公民对未见政策提案的偏好;2) 用瑞士议会数据,从立法者记录构建主题知识图谱,连接至LLM议员代理,组成党派级DT并进行代理审议;3) 基于英国2023年审议实验数据,分析提示注入攻击的有效性,并评估结合注入检测、结构化观点表示与强化学习的防御流程。
AI.result: 个性化DT可预测公民偏好;党派级DT能捕捉比官方党派传播更广泛的党内观点;提示注入攻击有效性随观点分布和修辞策略变化,所提防御流程可提升抗攻击能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究刻画了LLM数字孪生在增强民主中的机遇与挑战,强调准确的偏好表示、忠实的聚合以及对策略性交互的鲁棒性至关重要。

title: Agent Policy-Value Audit: Separating Transition Composition from Event Selection in Financial LLM Agents
summary: Financial LLM agents are often evaluated by comparing their end-to-end returns with those of a baseline and testing the paired difference against zero. This measures whether deploying the agent changes realized performance, but it does not isolate event-selection skill. An agent that frequently changes positions from flat to long can earn a positive paired return from an upward-drifting event pool even when it selects events at random. We propose the Agent Policy-Value Audit, which holds fixed the observed count of each ordered action-change type and randomly reassigns them across eligible events. The average payoff from these reassignments is the composition benchmark; the difference between observed deployment value and this benchmark is selection value. In semi-synthetic benchmarks based on real earnings-event returns, a zero-centered paired test falsely attributes passive exposure to selection skill in $11.6\%$ of no-skill replications, while the transition-matched audit reduces this rate to $5.3\%$. Applied retrospectively to 723 earnings events at 44 U.S. consumer-facing firms, the audit decomposes the agent's gross deployment value of $+15.2$ bps/event into a $+25.8$ composition benchmark and a $-10.6$ selection value. The agent does not detectably outperform matched random assignments. Financial-agent evaluations should report deployment value separately from event-selection value.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent Policy-Value Audit，通过固定动作变更次数随机重分配事件，将部署价值分解为组成基准与选择价值，避免将被动暴露误判为选择技能。
AI.motivation: 传统配对检验仅比较端到端收益差异，无法隔离事件选择技能；随机选择事件也可能因事件池上涨漂移而获得正配对收益。
AI.method: 固定各有序动作变更类型的观测次数，在合格事件间随机重分配，计算平均收益作为组成基准；观测部署价值与该基准之差即为选择价值。
AI.result: 半合成基准中，零中心配对检验在无技能重复中11.6%误判为有技能，审计降至5.3%；723个事件回测显示+15.2 bps/event部署价值=+25.8组成基准-10.6选择价值。
AI.conclusion: 金融智能体评估应分别报告部署价值与事件选择价值，避免混淆被动暴露与真实选择能力。

title: Targeted Active Learning for Preference-Based Treatment Effects on Multivariate Outcomes
summary: Treatment efficacy is traditionally demonstrated on the basis of a single primary outcome. However, clinical decision-making usually requires consideration of multiple outcomes, balancing expected benefits against potential risks. The relative value assigned to these outcomes varies substantially from one patient to another. Given a preference rule over outcome profiles, treatment effects and optimal policies can be defined and estimated. Such a rule is rarely available in practice: it must itself be estimated from pairwise comparisons of outcome profiles, which are costly to collect from clinical experts. We propose an active learning framework that selects which comparisons to query. Standard criteria maximize the information gained on the preference rule itself. We instead target the quantities of interest, and select the query that most reduces uncertainty on the treatment effect and on the optimal policy induced by the learned rule. Under a Gaussian process model of the preference rule, we derive a closed-form approximation of this criterion. On semi-synthetic data built from a Parkinson's disease cohort with 13 clinical outcomes, our criterion achieves lower treatment effect estimation error and lower policy regret than existing criteria at equal query budget.

AI.tldr: 提出主动学习框架，直接以治疗效应与最优策略的不确定性为准则选择偏好比较查询，在帕金森队列半合成数据上优于现有准则。
AI.motivation: 疗效通常基于单一主要结局评估，但临床决策需综合多个结局并权衡获益与风险，且各结局的相对价值因患者而异。偏好规则可定义治疗效应与最优策略，但实践中该规则需通过昂贵的成对结局比较从专家处估计。
AI.method: 提出主动学习框架来选择查询哪些成对比较。不同于最大化偏好规则自身信息量的标准准则，转而针对目标量，选择能最大程度降低治疗效应与所学规则导出的最优策略不确定性的查询。在偏好规则的高斯过程模型下，推导出该准则的闭式近似。
AI.result: 基于含13个临床结局的帕金森病队列构建半合成数据，在相同查询预算下，该准则比现有准则实现更低的治疗效应估计误差和更低的策略后悔。
AI.conclusion: 以目标量为中心的主动查询准则能更高效地估计治疗效应并优化决策策略，验证了直接针对下游任务不确定性进行查询选择的有效性。

title: Same Output, Different Gold: Measuring How Reference Choice Moves a Multilingual Benchmark Score
comment: 13 pages (8 main), 1 figure, 8 tables. Accepted as a poster at TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, a NeurIPS 2026 workshop (non-archival). The workshop name comes from the acceptance email in reviews.md
summary: A benchmark score compares a system output against a reference, and methodological attention falls almost entirely on the first term. We measure the second. The retained annotation record of a six-language benchmark for personally identifiable information contains two independent annotator labellings, the aggregate shipped as gold, and a reviewer gold from independent expert re-annotation of a sample. Using it, we hold the scored output fixed and exchange the reference. The score moves by 4.95 F1 points for one output and 2.00 for the other (95% CIs [3.23, 6.27] and [0.26, 3.37]), and by 7.55 in the worst language. The comparison between two outputs moves as well: the paired interaction between reference and system is +2.95 points (CI [+1.97, +3.87]), survives correction for multiple testing, and changes one language's margin outright. The cause is an undocumented aggregation default that usually kept one annotator when adjudication did not fire, making the shipped reference a partial copy of an output being scored. We report the resulting reference-sensitivity band, show how to compute one from any retained annotation record, and argue that the quantity belongs beside the score.

AI.tldr: 基准测试分数通常只关注系统输出，但参考标注质量对分数的影响被忽视。本文固定系统输出，交换参考标注，发现分数变化最高达7.55个F1点，且会改变系统比较结论。
AI.motivation: 现有基准评估几乎只关注系统输出这一项，而参考标注（reference）对分数的影响缺乏方法学关注。作者希望量化参考标注本身带来的分数波动。
AI.method: 利用一个六语言PII基准的保留标注记录（含两位独立标注者标注、发布的聚合gold，以及独立专家重标样本的reviewer gold），在固定系统输出的情况下交换参考标准，并计算参考-系统配对的交互效应。
AI.result: 交换参考后分数变化4.95和2.00个F1点（95%CI [3.23,6.27]及[0.26,3.37]），最差语言达7.55点；两系统比较的配对交互为+2.95点（CI [+1.97,+3.87]），通过多重检验校正，并直接改变某语言的比较结果。原因是未记录的聚合默认规则使发布的参考成了被评输出的部分副本。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出“参考敏感性区间”（reference-sensitivity band），给出从任意保留标注记录计算该区间的方法，并主张该指标应与分数并列报告。

title: REACT: Physically and Chemically Consistent Reconstruction of Marine Active Tracers
summary: Reconstructing global sea surface pH from sparse observations is critical for monitoring ocean acidification and understanding marine carbon cycling. Traditional assimilation and inverse models are physically grounded but costly for large-scale reconstruction. Recent black-box and physics-guided AI models improve efficiency, but are mainly designed for passive tracers, where the reconstructed variable is also the transported inventory. In contrast, pH is an active carbonate tracer: it is the prediction target, while dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) is the conserved carbon inventory. This mismatch can produce low pH error while violating carbonate closure and source-free carbon conservation. To address this, we introduce \textbf{REACT}, a carbon-first reconstruction framework that decouples transport, active correction, and chemical decoding. REACT transports a latent carbonate state with a conservative advection--diffusion solver, captures non-conservative carbon-cycle variations with a source module, decodes the corrected state into pH, and constrains the output through carbonate equilibrium. This design keeps pH as the target while enforcing consistency on the underlying carbon state. On simulation data, REACT reduces pH NRMSE by (14.7%) and chemical consistency error by (24.0%) over the best baseline. Cross-temporal-scale evaluations show robustness against error accumulation from coarse to fine temporal scales, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出REACT框架，以"碳优先"思路解耦传输、活性校正与化学解码，重建全球海表pH，兼顾精度与碳酸盐闭合及碳守恒。
AI.motivation: 传统同化与反演模型物理扎实但大规模重建代价高；现有AI模型多针对被动示踪物（重建变量本身即输运量），而pH是活性碳酸盐示踪物——pH是预测目标、DIC才是守恒碳库，直接套用会pH误差低却违反碳酸盐闭合与无源碳守恒。
AI.method: REACT将传输、活性校正与化学解码解耦：用守恒的平流-扩散求解器输运潜在碳酸盐状态；用源模块刻画非保守碳循环变化；将校正后状态解码为pH；并通过碳酸盐平衡约束输出。设计上保持pH为目标，同时对底层碳状态施加一致性约束。
AI.result: 在模拟数据上，pH NRMSE比最佳基线降低14.7%，化学一致性误差降低24.0%；跨时间尺度评估显示从粗到细尺度对误差累积具有鲁棒性；消融实验验证各组件有效性。
AI.conclusion: REACT以碳状态为核心的重建范式，在保持pH预测精度的同时强化碳酸盐闭合与碳守恒，并在跨时间尺度上表现稳健，为海表pH重建提供新思路。

title: Stochastic Sequential Feedback Optimization for Wind Farm Control under Time-Varying Inflow
summary: We consider steady-state optimization of nonlinear dynamical systems under time-varying stochastic operating conditions, where the objective is an expected-value function over the current operating-condition distribution, so that changes in the distribution induce a moving stochastic optimum. To address this problem, we propose stochastic sequential feedback optimization (S2FO), which combines projected feedback-gradient updates with sequential sensitivity estimates obtained by linearizing the plant at realized stochastic operating conditions. We analyze the closed-loop performance of S2FO through expected dynamic regret, instantaneous tracking in expectation, and almost-sure convergence under diminishing step sizes. We then apply the method to wind farm power maximization under time-varying stochastic inflow. Simulations on a benchmark layout and on a realistic offshore wind farm show that S2FO improves average power generation when persistent wake interactions are present, and that its advantage decreases as wind-direction variability increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机序列反馈优化(S2FO)方法,用于时变随机工况下非线性动力系统的稳态优化,并验证于风电场功率最大化。
AI.motivation: 在时变随机运行工况下,目标函数是随工况分布变化的期望值函数,分布变化导致最优解不断移动(移动的随机最优),需要新的优化方法应对此挑战。
AI.method: 提出S2FO方法,将投影反馈梯度更新与序列灵敏度估计相结合,灵敏度通过在实际随机工况点对系统进行线性化获得,并采用递减步长。
AI.result: 从期望动态遗憾、期望瞬时跟踪和几乎必然收敛三方面分析闭环性能;在基准布局和实际海上风电场的仿真中,S2FO在存在持续尾流交互时提升平均发电量,且优势随风向变化增大而减小。
AI.conclusion: S2FO可有效处理时变随机工况下的稳态优化,在风电场功率最大化中展现了实用性,尤其适用于持续性尾流交互场景。

title: A posteriori error bounds for the Uncertain Volatility Model
summary: We develop a posteriori primal-dual bounds for numerical approximations of European option prices in the Uncertain Volatility Model. Given a smooth candidate approximation of the value function, a feedback control induced by its Hessian yields a primal lower bound. On the dual side, we derive a representation based on a matrix-valued Gamma field, which provides an upper bound through a nonnegative Hamiltonian penalty. We further show that, when the dual field is generated by the candidate itself, this upper bound admits an equivalent representation in terms of the residual of the associated Black-Scholes-Barenblatt equation. We then study discrete-time approximations of these primal and dual quantities and quantify the corresponding discretization errors. Finally, we investigate their numerical evaluation for candidates obtained by stochastic policy-gradient and physics-informed neural-network methods, and compare the resulting estimates with a martingale dual approach from the stochastic-control literature. The numerical experiments highlight the importance of derivative accuracy, and in particular of second-order information, for obtaining tight a posteriori bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文为不确定波动率模型中的欧式期权价格数值近似开发了后验原始-对偶界，并给出离散误差量化与数值验证。
AI.motivation: 在不确定波动率模型下，数值近似期权价格缺少可靠的事后误差保证，尤其需要紧致的上下界来评估近似质量。
AI.method: 给定光滑候选值函数，由其Hessian诱导反馈控制得到原始下界；对偶侧基于矩阵值Gamma场，通过非负Hamiltonian惩罚得到上界，并证明当对偶场由候选本身生成时，上界等价于Black-Scholes-Barenblatt方程残差表示。随后研究这两种量的离散时间近似并量化离散误差。
AI.result: 对随机策略梯度和物理信息神经网络得到的候选解进行了数值评估，并与随机控制文献中的鞅对偶方法比较，估计结果展示了这些后验界的效果。
AI.conclusion: 数值实验表明，导数精度尤其是二阶信息对获得紧致的后验界至关重要。

title: Barrier-Shaped Recurrent Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Landing on a Heaving Ship Deck
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA). Video: https://youtu.be/S5hDkrSZJt4
summary: This paper addresses autonomous landing of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) rotorcrafts on a heaving ship deck using a recurrent policy trained via asymmetric actor-critic reinforcement learning: the critic sees 6 s of future deck height during training, while the actor sees only what the onboard sensors provide in flight, a 17-dimensional state made of the vehicle's position, velocity and attitude relative to the deck and outputs world-frame velocity and yaw-rate commands. Training is performed across 4096 parallel simulated environments, followed by fine-tuning in 16 environments with an onboard vision pipeline in the loop. A control-barrier-function (CBF) stopping margin on the deck-relative vertical state is incorporated at two stages: as a reward term during training, where it halves the median simulated contact speed relative to a policy trained without it, and as a runtime safety filter at deployment, evaluated at every control step to abort and retry the descent when the margin is violated. Because the autopilot's disarm logic cannot detect the vehicle resting on a moving deck, proximity-based thrust cutoff at touchdown is commanded directly in the landing pipeline. The proposed approach is validated using a parallel-manipulator-platform-based deck emulator that reproduces the heaving motion of the ship deck (scaled to 0.70 m peak-to-peak, 7.5 s mean period) and a quadcopter UAV with an onboard camera. Across 31 motion-capture and 20 vision-based trials, the UAV landed every time, with median times to contact of 6.5 and 7.3 s; 77% and 50% landed on the first attempt, with mean deck-relative speeds of 0.29 and 0.27 m/s, respectively, at the instant of thrust cutoff, which is the last speed under the policy's control. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/S5hDkrSZJt4

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于非对称actor-critic强化学习的循环策略，实现UAV旋翼机在摇荡船甲板上的自主降落，并引入控制屏障函数（CBF）停止裕度作为训练奖励与运行时安全过滤器，在搭载视觉管线的四旋翼上验证，31次动捕与20次视觉试验全部成功降落。
AI.motivation: 在起伏不定的船甲板上自主降落对UAV而言极具挑战：甲板随海浪摇荡，且机载自动驾驶的解除武装（disarm）逻辑无法检测到飞行器已停靠在运动甲板上，容易导致触地速度过高或误判停靠状态。因此需要一种能在感知受限下稳健执行、并保证触地安全的方法。
AI.method: 采用非对称actor-critic强化学习训练循环策略：训练时critic可看到未来6秒的甲板高度，而actor仅使用机载传感器提供的17维状态（相对甲板的位置、速度与姿态），输出世界坐标系下的速度与偏航角速率指令。先在4096个并行仿真环境中训练，再在16个环境中结合机载视觉管线微调。将甲板相对垂直状态的CBF停止裕度用于两个阶段：训练中作为奖励项，部署时作为运行时安全过滤器，每个控制步评估，违反裕度则中止并重试下降。由于自动驾驶disarm逻辑无法检测运动甲板上的停靠，降落流程直接命令基于接近的推力切断。
AI.result: 使用可复现船甲板摇荡运动（缩放到0.70 m峰峰值、平均周期7.5 s）的并联机械臂平台甲板模拟器与搭载相机的四旋翼进行验证。在31次动捕试验和20次视觉试验中，UAV均成功降落，触地中位时间分别为6.5 s和7.3 s；首次尝试成功率为77%和50%；在推力切断（策略可控的最后速度）瞬间，平均甲板相对速度分别为0.29 m/s和0.27 m/s。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，结合非对称强化学习与CBF停止裕度（训练奖励+运行时安全过滤）的方法，能使UAV在摇荡船甲板上实现高成功率、低触地速度的自主降落，并在仅依赖机载视觉的情况下依然可靠，验证了该方法在实际部署中的有效性与安全性。

title: Buying at Support: The Entry Problem under Multi-Skew Brownian Motion
summary: We study when to buy a share that will later be sold optimally, when the price follows a geometric multi-skew Brownian motion whose skew levels model support and resistance. The reward for buying is the exit premium of the liquidation problem solved in a companion paper. This premium is strictly $r$-subharmonic inside the exit continuation region, so buying is optimal only at levels where the price is pushed upward, and the entry problem reduces to a finite one whose value is an upper concave hull of finitely many points. With one support and one resistance, the optimal rule is to buy exactly at the support, in every exit regime, with an explicit value.

AI.tldr: 研究在几何多偏斜布朗运动（支撑/阻力位作为偏斜水平）下，何时买入将在后续最优卖出的股票。买入收益设定为清算问题的退出溢价。因该溢价在退出连续区域内严格r-次调和，买入仅在价格被向上推动的水平处最优，买入问题约化为有限点集上的上凹包。单支撑单阻力时，最优规则是在支撑位买入（对所有退出机制皆然），并给出显式值。
AI.motivation: 现实中投资者常在明确的支撑/阻力位决策买入。作者希望将支撑与阻力形式化为几何多偏斜布朗运动的偏斜水平，并把"何时买入"与"何时最优卖出"耦合起来统一求解。
AI.method: 以几何多偏斜布朗运动刻画价格，偏斜水平对应支撑/阻力；买入收益取companion paper中清算问题的退出溢价作为奖励函数。利用该溢价的严格r-次调和性质定位买入最优区域，将买入问题约化为有限候选点集的上凹包，求最优入场边界。
AI.result: 买入只在价格被向上推动（即支撑/偏斜处）才最优；买入问题化为有限点集的上凹包。一个支撑和一个阻力情形下，无论退出处于何区域，最优规则都是在支撑位买入，并得到显式价值。
AI.conclusion: 支撑/阻力水平刻画的偏斜模型下，最优买入可与最优退出共同分析；一般情形归结为上凹包计算，单一支撑—阻力结构给出简洁的显式买入规则。

title: Least Squares for Time Series Forecasting
summary: A time-series forecast is scored on a future value of the series. A representation loss that regresses the next latent, as in LeNEPA, is a different least-squares problem on the same bottleneck. We write both programs down. The forecast program minimizes the error of a decoded latent on the coordinate that will be reported. For a scalar target and a linear decoder, every latent rank of at least one matches ordinary least squares, and an isotropy constraint is only a rescaling: after the decoder is refit, the forecast does not move. The other program fits the whole next vector at a fixed rank, then freezes the encoder and attaches a head. On a four-dimensional series whose last three coordinates are the same autoregression, that rank-1 fit puts mass $0.9998$ on the repeated coordinate and forecasts the remaining signal at the marginal variance $2.794$. The forecast program puts mass $1$ on the signal and matches the innovation variance $0.992$. Rank $2$ gives the vector fit a second direction, and the two programs agree. Iterating the fitted one-step coefficient $0.803$ raises the open-loop error from $0.992$ at one step to $2.700$ at eight steps.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了两种时序预测表示学习目标：直接最小化预测误差的"预测程序"与回归下一隐向量的"表示损失"（如LeNEPA），证明在标量目标下二者对线性解码器等价，但在低秩瓶颈下表示损失会将容量浪费在无关坐标上。
AI.motivation: 时序预测的评分只取决于未来某一具体数值，而回归下一隐向量的表示损失是在同一瓶颈上求解不同的最小二乘问题。作者希望厘清这两者的差异，指出表示损失在低秩设置下可能偏离实际预测目标。
AI.method: 作者将两个程序形式化写出。预测程序最小化解码隐变量在将要报告的坐标上的误差；表示损失程序先以固定秩拟合整个下一向量，再冻结编码器并接一个预测头。以一个四维为例，检验秩1与秩2下两者的行为。
AI.result: 对标量目标和线性解码器，任何秩≥1的隐表征都与普通最小二乘等价，各向同性约束仅是重缩放，解码器重拟合后预测不变。在四维序列（后三个坐标相同）中，秩1向量拟合把0.9998质量放在重复坐标上，把剩余信号预测为边际方差2.794；预测程序把质量1放在信号上，匹配创新方差0.992。秩2时两者一致。迭代一步系数0.803使开环误差从1步的0.992升至8步的2.700。
AI.conclusion: 表示损失与预测损失并不等价：在低秩瓶颈且存在冗余/重复坐标时，向量拟合会把容量浪费在无关方向上并给出错误方差，而直接预测程序能正确匹配真实信号；提高秩可使两者重新一致。

title: Cities of Signals: Compression, Separation, and the Geometry of Novelty
summary: A cross-sectional signal is a forecast vector over $d$ assets at each date; demeaned and normalized, it is a point on a sphere. Its city is the direction of its time-averaged vector in a common target-aligned frame, a compressed summary. When is the angle between two cities a conservative estimate of the angle between the histories? For independent uniform histories, the probability that the history angle is at least the city angle tends to one when the city angle is at most 90 degrees, with an $O(T^{-1/2})$ error bound uniform in dimension. Selecting for positive average information coefficient (IC) changes the unconditional limit to $γ_q>1/2$, about 56% for 20 assets. The bound extends to independent, rotationally symmetric histories with temporal dependence; summable products of lag correlations preserve the conditional limit. A stationary ergodic theorem allows shared signal movement and identifies the population margin determining the limiting ordering. Among 266,815 positive-IC pairs in AlphaNova's Competition May 2026, the history angle is at least the city angle for 58.9% overall, 74.1% at city angles up to 90 degrees, and 1.5% beyond. These frequencies describe the observed library and do not validate the uniform null: residual agreement is mostly positive, and an empirical second-moment diagnostic cannot be matched within that null by adjusting temporal dependence alone. On the full 776-signal sample, a city angle of at least 60 degrees selects pairs with a 94.3% success rate at the same history-angle threshold, against an 85.0% base rate, and retains 72.5% of pairs. Explicit constructions show the limits of direction-only summaries, retained lengths give sharp bounds, and shared time blocks recover missing information, here only at fine resolution. Persistent positive IC confines cities and bounds their motion; convergence also requires a stable mean direction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究横截面信号"城市"（时间平均方向的归一化摘要）与"历史"角度之间的关系，证明在独立均匀历史下城市角度是历史角度的保守估计，并给出误差界及在AlphaNova数据中的验证。
AI.motivation: 用一个压缩的方向摘要（城市）来代表完整历史方向，需要理论保证这种压缩是否保守、何时可靠。论文旨在回答："城市之间的夹角何时是历史夹角的一个保守估计？"
AI.method: 将去均值归一化的横截面信号视为球面上的点，定义"城市"为共同目标对齐框架下时间平均向量的方向。对独立均匀历史推导历史角度≥城市角度的概率及其O(T^{-1/2})误差界；将结论推广到独立旋转对称且时间相关的历史，利用平稳遍历定理处理共享信号运动，并识别决定极限排序的总体边际。
AI.result: 独立均匀历史下，当城市角度≤90°时历史角度≥城市角度的概率趋于1，误差O(T^{-1/2})且对维度一致。选择正平均IC将无条件下限改变为γ_q>1/2（20资产约56%）。在AlphaNova 2026年5月竞赛的266,815个正IC对中，历史角度≥城市角度整体占58.9%，城市角度≤90°时占74.1%，超过90°仅占1.5%。在完整776个信号样本上，城市角度≥60°可选择成功率94.3%的对（基准85.0%），保留72.5%。
AI.conclusion: 这些频率描述的是观测库而非验证均匀零假设：残差一致性多为正，经验二阶矩诊断在均匀零假设下仅靠调节时间依赖性无法匹配。显式构造展示了仅方向摘要的局限，保留长度给出紧界，共享时间块可恢复缺失信息（仅在细分辨率下）。持续正IC限制城市并约束其运动，收敛还需稳定的平均方向。

title: Impulse Response Inference for Matrix Autoregressions
summary: Matrix autoregressive (MAR) models offer a parsimonious framework for modeling matrix-valued time series, yet tools for estimation and inference for their impulse response functions are lacking. We develop asymptotic and bootstrap-based inference for impulse responses of stable MAR($p$) models. We derive the joint asymptotic distribution of the coefficient and covariance estimators, which permits closed-form delta-method standard errors. To address finite-sample bias, we propose ProBAB-MAR, a bias-corrected bootstrap that projects the corrected coefficients back onto the Kronecker parameter space, and prove that it attains asymptotically correct coverage. Monte Carlo simulations show that delta-method intervals undercover in small samples, while ProBAB-MAR achieves near-nominal coverage with intervals considerably narrower than those from an unrestricted VAR. An application to euro area inflation illustrates how shocks transmit across countries and inflation categories.

AI.tldr: 本文为稳定MAR(p)模型的脉冲响应函数开发渐近与自助法推断，提出偏差校正的ProBAB-MAR方法，并证明其渐近正确覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 矩阵自回归(MAR)模型虽为矩阵值时间序列提供了简洁建模框架，但缺乏其脉冲响应函数的估计与推断工具。
AI.method: 推导系数与协方差估计量的联合渐近分布以实现闭式delta法标准误；针对有限样本偏差提出ProBAB-MAR——将校正后的系数投影回Kronecker参数空间的自助偏差校正方法，并证明其渐近正确覆盖率。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛模拟显示小样本下delta法区间覆盖不足，而ProBAB-MAR达到接近名义覆盖率且区间明显比无约束VAR更窄；欧元区通胀应用展示了冲击在国家与通胀类别间的传导。
AI.conclusion: ProBAB-MAR为MAR模型脉冲响应提供了优于delta法与无约束VAR的稳健推断工具，并具实际应用价值。

title: Data Colonisation and AI Governance in South Africa: Data Protection, Algorithmic Power, and the Struggle for Digital Sovereignty
summary: AI is not only a technological artefact; it is also a new site of political economy, legal struggle, and sovereignty contestation. AI systems depend on the continuous collection, storage, processing, and monetisation of large volumes of data. In South Africa, these datasets increasingly include behavioural, biometric, financial, consumer, health, and public-sector information. Our article uses data colonisation as a theoretical lens to analyse whether South Africa's existing legal and governance framework can regulate AI-specific risks. It argues that South Africa's current laws, including the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), regulate personal information but do not adequately prevent data colonisation. POPIA remains important for privacy, lawful processing, automated decision-making, and cross-border transfers. However, data colonisation cannot solely be reduced to privacy protection. It concerns ownership, dependency, infrastructure, surveillance, regulatory power, value extraction, and the capacity of people and institutions to challenge algorithmic decisions. The article examines South African AI-related risks in various areas (e.g. cloud and digital infrastructure, biometric surveillance, and digital markets). This paper argues that South Africa's legal framework does not yet adequately regulate algorithmic opacity, externally controlled digital infrastructure, biometric surveillance, automated profiling, collective data harms, or the extraction of value from South African data. We argue for the need of a decolonial AI governance framework based on algorithmic impact assessments, public-sector AI registers, independent audits, biometric safeguards, competition-law remedies, public-interest data governance, stronger regulatory capacity, and democratic control to strengthen South Africa's digital future.

AI.tldr: 本文以"数据殖民"为理论视角，分析南非现行法律与治理框架能否规制AI特有风险，指出POPIA等信息法不足以防止数据殖民，主张建立去殖民化的AI治理框架。
AI.motivation: AI不仅是技术产物，也是政治经济、法律斗争与主权争夺的新场域，其依赖大规模数据的持续收集、存储、处理与变现。南非的此类数据集日益涵盖行为、生物识别、金融、消费、健康及公共部门信息，因此需要评估现有法律框架能否应对AI特有风险。
AI.method: 采用"数据殖民"（data colonisation）作为理论透镜，审视南非现行法律与治理框架（如POPIA），并结合云与数字基础设施、生物识别监控、数字市场等领域的AI相关风险进行实例分析。
AI.result: POPIA在隐私、合法处理、自动化决策与跨境传输方面仍有价值，但无法充分防止数据殖民。数据殖民不能被简化为隐私保护问题，而涉及所有权、依附性、基础设施、监控、监管权力、价值榨取，以及个人与机构挑战算法决策的能力。现行法律框架在算法不透明性、外部控制的数字基础设施、生物识别监控、自动化画像、集体数据损害及南非数据价值外流等方面规制不足。
AI.conclusion: 需构建去殖民化的AI治理框架，包括算法影响评估、公共部门AI登记册、独立审计、生物识别保障措施、竞争法救济、公共利益数据治理、更强监管能力与民主控制，以强化南非的数字未来。

title: Probability flow ODEs in score-based and reflected diffusion models
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary:
Probability-flow ordinary differential equations (PF-ODEs) are widely used as deterministic samplers for score-based diffusion models. Their usual justification is that the Fokker--Planck equation of a diffusion can be rewritten as a continuity equation driven by the score function of the forward diffusion. This identity does not, however, guarantee that the resulting velocity field generates a well-posed flow. We provide theoretical insights into the design of such deterministic samplers for generative models based on diffusions and reflected diffusions. We identify sufficient conditions for a regular Lagrangian PF-ODE flow to exist; reverse sampling and invertibility require two-sided divergence control. For learned scores, sampler stability is controlled by an unweighted velocity error, exposing a mismatch with density-weighted score matching and motivating architectural control of Jacobians, divergence, growth, and compression. Under the manifold hypothesis, positive-time regularization justifies an early-stopped PF-ODE while constants deteriorate near the data endpoint; an explicit sphere example shows that the exact deterministic flow becomes singular as the noise level vanishes even though the diffusion marginals remain well defined.
  These theoretical insights translate into concrete design principles for stable, invertible, and constraint-preserving diffusion samplers. We illustrate the practical relevance of these design principles using controlled numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文为基于扩散与反射扩散的确定性采样器(PF-ODE)提供理论分析，指出其速度场未必良定，并给出稳定、可逆、保约束采样器的设计原则。
AI.motivation: PF-ODE常被当作扩散模型的确定性采样器，理由是扩散的Fokker-Planck方程可改写为由前向扩散score驱动的连续性方程。但该恒等式并不能保证所得到的velocity field生成良定(well-posed)的流，因此需要理论澄清其成立条件。
AI.method: 从理论上识别正则Lagrangian PF-ODE流存在的充分条件；分析反向采样与可逆性所需的双侧散度控制(two-sided divergence control)；针对学习到的score，用无权重velocity误差刻画采样器稳定性。并在流形假设下分析正时间正则化的作用，构造球面上的显式例子。
AI.result: 反向采样与可逆性需要双侧散度控制；采样器稳定性由无权重velocity误差控制，这与密度加权的score matching存在不匹配，因此需要从架构上控制Jacobian、散度、增长与压缩。流形假设下，正时间正则化支持早停PF-ODE，而常数会在数据端点附近退化；球面例子表明当噪声水平趋于0时，精确确定性流会奇异，即使扩散边缘分布仍良定。
AI.conclusion: 这些理论洞见转化为稳定、可逆、保约束扩散采样器的具体设计原则，并通过受控数值实验验证了其实用相关性。

title: The Score Is Not the Structure: Brain Alignment and Cross-Lingual Transfer
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 - Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models (LP4FM). Code: https://github.com/saman-rahbar/score-is-not-the-structure
summary: Researchers often support the claim that a model shares structure with the brain, or across languages, by reporting a similarity score. We ask what such a score reads when the shared structure is absent, or when the tool that measures it does not work. We check two settings, and in both the score is not what it appears. First, a probe trained to tell grammatical from ungrammatical sentences in one language transfers worse to more distant languages, the usual evidence for shared structure. But the probe itself gets worse along the same axis: in four of seventeen languages it performs at chance, so 64 of 272 language pairs are scored with a tool that does not work. Dropping those languages halves the strength of the relationship, but they are also the most distant, and this design cannot separate the two effects. Counting matters too: the same data give p = 0.0006 when the 272 pairs are treated as independent and p = 0.155 when the seventeen languages are, which is the correct unit. Second, training a language model to match human brain responses raises its similarity score from 0.10 to 0.34, against a ceiling of 0.54. A model trained on a target whose correspondence to the brain was destroyed still scores 0.31, so only 0.028 to 0.068 of the rise is specific to the brain. With no model at all, a destroyed target already sits at 0.204 from the real one, a floor that tracks the target's rank divided by the number of sentences. Finally, steering a language along its own direction works (+6.2 over a random direction in sixteen of seventeen languages) yet shows no effect that varies with language distance. Before asking whether a correspondence helps, ask how much of the score would survive without it.

AI.tldr: 相似度分数在结构缺失或测量工具失效时会产生误导；报告分数前应先问"没有对应关系时分数还剩多少"。
AI.motivation: 研究者常以相似度分数支持"模型与大脑共享结构"或"跨语言共享结构"的结论，但当共享结构不存在、或测量工具本身失效时，该分数的真实含义存疑。作者旨在检验这类分数到底读出了什么。
AI.method: 两组检验：(1) 跨语言探针：训练区分语法的探针并测量跨语言迁移，考察探针在远距离语言上的失效情况及统计单位问题；(2) 脑-模型对齐：训练语言模型匹配人脑响应，并设置"目标被破坏"的对照，量化真正特异于大脑的分数增量及无模型时的下限。
AI.result: 跨语言：探针在17种语言中的4种仅达随机水平，272个语言对中有64个用失效工具评分；剔除后关系强度减半，但这些恰是最远语言，设计无法区分两种效应。统计单位影响显著：272对独立时 p=0.0006，17种语言时 p=0.155（正确单位）。脑对齐：训练使相似度从0.10升至0.34（上限0.54），但目标被破坏的模型仍得0.31，真正特异于大脑的增量仅0.028–0.068；无模型时被破坏目标已达0.204，该下限随目标排名/句数变化。引导语言方向有效（17种语言中16种优于随机），但不随语言距离变化。
AI.conclusion: 相似度分数在结构缺失或工具失效时会大幅虚高。在追问"对应关系是否有帮助"之前，应先评估"没有对应关系时分数能保留多少"。

title: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
summary:
A deployed LLM agent emits tool calls, queries, and code that can be silently wrong -- by the time the error surfaces, the action has run. Frontier chat APIs hide the model's token probabilities; the agent's stated confidence barely beats chance on the mistakes that matter; and resampling does not help, since frontier models are highly repetitive, reproducing the same call across samples.
  We recover the missing signal from a low-cost open-weight surrogate run in parallel. It reads the same context, schema, and proposed action as the agent, then scores the call from its own log-probabilities through a family of complementary readouts: teacher forcing and request-PMI weigh the likelihood of each argument value, a discriminative verdict judges the call as a whole, and tool-choice competition tests the function against its siblings. One principle says which to trust: a generative likelihood localizes wrong argument values, while the verdict catches holistically wrong calls. When the error type is unknown, an ensemble is the low-regret default. The readout is training-free, needs no access to the agent's internals, and costs one prefill pass alongside the tool call.
  On difficult coding tasks it reaches AUROC 0.825 where the actor's stated confidence is near chance (0.598), and the generative readouts beat it by +0.07 to +0.28 across three further actors. Against self-consistency it gains +0.14 to +0.19 on near-deterministic actors, at 1/K the cost. The signal drives two deployment modes: a real-time gate escalating the least-trustworthy calls for review (+0.05 to +0.30 accepted-action accuracy at 50% coverage), and confidence feedback, returning the tool result with the score so the agent adapts its next step -- lifting task success on live-execution benchmarks (+0.119 and +0.137, p <= 1e-4) and beating a random-value control where step errors are silent (+0.078, p = 0.003).

AI.tldr: 提出用低成本开源代理模型并行评估LLM智能体工具调用的可靠性，无需访问内部logit，即可在错误暴露前检测静默错误。
AI.motivation: 已部署LLM智能体产生的工具调用、查询和代码可能静默出错，错误未被发现时动作已执行。前沿聊天API隐藏token概率，智能体自述置信度对关键错误近乎随机，重采样因前沿模型高度重复也无效，因此需要一种外部可用的错误信号。
AI.method: 并行运行低成本开源代理模型，读取相同上下文、schema与候选动作，从自身log-probabilities通过多种互补读出打分：teacher forcing与request-PMI评估各参数值似然、判别式verdict整体判断调用、tool-choice competition与同类函数竞争。原则是生成式似然定位错误参数值，verdict捕捉整体错误调用，未知错误类型时用集成。该读出无需训练、不需智能体内部信息，仅需一次prefill。
AI.result: 在困难编码任务上AUROC达0.825，而actor自述置信度仅0.598；生成式读出在另外三个actor上提升+0.07至+0.28。相比self-consistency在近确定性actor上提升+0.14至+0.19，成本仅1/K。两种部署模式：实时门控在50%覆盖率下提升接受动作准确率+0.05至+0.30；置信反馈将分数随工具结果返回，在实时执行基准上提升任务成功率+0.119和+0.137（p<=1e-4），在静默步骤错误场景优于随机值控制+0.078（p=0.003）。
AI.conclusion: 用开源代理模型的log-probabilities可训练无关地检测智能体工具调用错误，优于自述置信度与重采样，并能通过门控和置信反馈提升实际部署任务成功率。

title: Accelerated Benders decomposition for bi-objective mixed integer programming
summary: We investigate bi-objective mixed integer programming to which Benders decomposition can be applied, a widely used technique for exploiting problem structures in real-world applications. Our study focuses on a sustainable supply chain network design problem that aims to minimise both economic and environmental objectives. To address the bi-objective nature, we employ the weighted sum method, which requires solving similar problems repeatedly with different weight values. To tackle this, we propose a straightforward acceleration technique that reuses Benders cuts generated in previous iterations of the weighted sum method. This approach enables the Benders decomposition master problem to be initialised with pre-generated cuts. Our computational experiments demonstrate that reusing these cuts significantly reduces computing time.

AI.tldr: 研究双目标混合整数规划中Benders分解的应用，提出复用加权和方法迭代中生成Benders割的加速技术，在可持续供应链网络设计问题上显著缩短计算时间。
AI.motivation: 双目标混合整数规划（如可持续供应链网络设计，需同时最小化经济与环境目标）具有重要实际意义，而Benders分解是挖掘问题结构的常用技术；加权和方法需用不同权重反复求解相似问题，计算代价高，亟需加速。
AI.method: 采用加权和方法处理双目标特性；提出一种简洁的加速技术，复用加权和方法前序迭代中生成的Benders割，并用预生成割初始化Benders分解主问题。
AI.result: 计算实验表明，复用这些割可显著减少计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 复用Benders割是加速双目标混合整数规划加权和求解的有效且直接的策略，可推广至可应用Benders分解的实际问题。

title: Network Adaptation in IRS-Aided Hybrid RF/VLC Systems Using Cooperative Multi-Agent DRL
summary: Hybrid radio frequency (RF) and visible light communication (VLC) networks have emerged as a promising solution for high-capacity indoor wireless connectivity in sixth-generation (6G) systems. However, the limited optical coverage and vulnerability of VLC links to line-of-sight (LoS) blockage under user mobility remain fundamental challenges. In this work, a mirror-based intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) is deployed to assist a dynamic indoor hybrid RF/VLC network, where each mobile user is exclusively assigned to either the IRS-enhanced VLC subnetwork or the RF subnetwork through a binary selection decision. A joint optimization problem is then formulated to maximize proportional fairness by jointly optimizing the RF/VLC technology selection, power allocation, and IRS mirror roll and yaw orientation angles. To enable real-time adaptability, the problem is reformulated as a Markov decision process (MDP) and solved using a cooperative multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithm based on centralized training with decentralized execution. Simulation results demonstrate the superior performance of the optimized hybrid network compared with optimized standalone VLC and RF networks. The results further validate the practicality and effectiveness of the proposed DRL framework compared to widely adopted DRL algorithms as well as conventional model-based optimization approaches.

AI.tldr: 部署镜面IRS辅助动态室内混合RF/VLC网络，通过二进制选择为用户分配子网，联合优化技术选择、功率分配与IRS镜面朝向，并用协作多智能体DRL求解，性能优于独立网络及基线算法。
AI.motivation: 6G室内高容量连接需求推动RF与VLC混合网络发展，但VLC光覆盖有限且易受用户移动下的视距阻塞影响，是根本挑战。
AI.method: 部署镜面IRS增强动态室内混合RF/VLC网络，每用户通过二进制决策被独占分配给IRS增强VLC或RF子网；构建联合优化问题以最大化比例公平性，变量含技术选择、功率分配及IRS镜面roll/yaw角度；将问题重构为MDP，采用基于集中训练、分散执行的协作多智能体DRL算法求解。
AI.result: 仿真显示优化混合网络性能优于优化的独立VLC与RF网络，且所提DRL框架相较主流DRL算法及传统基于模型的优化方法更具实用性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 镜面IRS辅助的混合RF/VLC网络结合协作多智能体DRL，可有效应对移动性下VLC阻塞与覆盖问题，实现公平性与实时自适应。

title: Model Risk Analysis for Entropic Hedging Strategies
summary: Entropic risk optimisation is a general framework for pricing and hedging financial derivatives in incomplete markets that can be used to decompose P&L into market and model risk contributions. When the prices are quadratic Gaussian, the coupled equations for price and hedge ratios are solved in closed form. This enables comprehensive analysis of trading P&L, with a decomposition of the model value-at-risk into convexity, dimension and funding contributions that are attributed in the explanation of realised P&L. The equations of the quadratic Gaussian model are directly applicable when the underlying prices follow Gaussian processes, such as fractional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes. The model also provides simple parametric expressions for hedge ratios that can be used for regressions in deep hedging.

AI.tldr: 本文在熵风险优化框架下，针对二次高斯价格模型得到价格与对冲比率的闭式解，可将模型VaR分解为凸性、维度和融资贡献。
AI.motivation: 在不完全市场中为衍生品定价与对冲，并分解损益（P&L）中的市场风险与模型风险贡献，需要一个统一且可解析的框架。
AI.method: 采用熵风险优化的一般框架；当价格服从二次高斯模型时，求解价格与对冲比率的耦合方程，得到闭式解，并进行交易P&L分析。
AI.result: 价格与对冲比率有闭式解；模型VaR可分解为凸性、维度和融资三部分，并用于解释已实现P&L；方程适用于高斯过程（如分数Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程）。
AI.conclusion: 该模型给出对冲比率的简单参数化表达，可用于深度对冲中的回归分析。

title: Robust enhanced index tracking portfolio selection under distributional uncertainty
summary:
