We show that the RC problem is mathematically an extension of a classic problem in systems and control theory, the Kazantzis-Kravaris-Luenberger (KKL) observer design problem. As a consequence, many of the questions considered open for RC stand to benefit from a large body of theory in the mature KKL literature, non-exhaustively including on questions of embedding, transverse stability, local and global uniqueness guarantees, and effective data-driven solution constructions. Elaborating on this connection, we show that the surprising forecasting ability of reservoirs is in fact a direct consequence of the well-known observer internal model principle, derive an upper bound on the prediction error over a fixed forecast horizon, and provide a partial explanation for why linear readout training in RC works reasonably well. This work illustrates how classical ideas from systems and control can provide strong theoretical backing and open new questions for modern machine learning methods.

AI.tldr: 储层计算(RC)可视为控制系统经典KKL观测器设计问题的数学推广，从而借助成熟控制理论解释RC的学习机制并提出改进方向。
AI.motivation: RC在机器学习、物理计算和神经科学中应用广泛，但"储层为何能学习"及"如何选择好的储层结构"仍是未解问题。作者希望为这些开放问题寻找坚实的理论基础。
AI.method: 将RC问题数学上归结为系统与控制理论中的Kazantzis-Kravaris-Luenberger (KKL)观测器设计问题的推广，并借助KKL文献中的嵌入、横截稳定性、局部/全局唯一性保证及数据驱动构造等理论展开分析。
AI.result: 证明储层令人惊讶的预测能力实际源自观测器的内模原理；推导了在固定预测时域上的预测误差上界；并为RC中线性读出训练为何效果良好提供部分解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明经典系统与控制理论可为现代机器学习方法提供强有力的理论支撑，并为RC研究开辟新的问题方向。

title: DePICT: Decision-Preserving Interface for Constrained Downstream Tasks
summary: A constrained optimization problem may involve a parameter in its objective and active constraints, yet the final decision may remain insensitive to small changes in that parameter. This raises a fundamental question: which inputs does a decision making system truly depend on? Building on this question, we introduce DePICT, a procedure for constructing decision preserving interfaces by ranking context directions according to the optimizer's solution sensitivity and aggregating them across an operating regime. We study this problem in a high dimensional setting where primitive context parameterizes a constrained task and the downstream agent observes only a selected subset of context directions. For locally regular constrained programs, we derive a Karush Kuhn Tucker (KKT) based characterization of when a context direction is optimizer relevant. Our analysis shows that appearing in the active optimization problem does not necessarily imply that a variable affects the final decision. Some context directions can alter the KKT conditions while leaving the optimal solution unchanged because their effect is absorbed by the dual variables. DePICT is designed to remove exactly these directions. In a controlled diagnosis, it recovers the decision relevant interface exactly and reduces linear predictor regret to 0.009, compared with 0.475 for the strongest competing baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出DePICT，通过KKT条件对上下文方向排序并聚合，构建决策保持接口，剔除对最优解无影响的上下文方向。
AI.motivation: 约束优化问题的目标与活跃约束中可能含参数，但最终决策对参数的小变化可能不敏感，因此需明确决策系统真正依赖哪些输入。
AI.method: 在高维设定下，将原始上下文参数化约束任务，下游仅观察选定的上下文方向子集；对局部正则约束程序，基于KKT推导上下文方向与优化器相关的判定条件，并据此按解敏感性排序、跨操作区间聚合构建接口。
AI.result: 分析表明出现在活跃优化问题中不必然影响最终决策，某些方向改变KKT条件却因被对偶变量吸收而不改变最优解；DePICT可精确剔除这些方向。在受控诊断中精确恢复决策相关接口，将线性预测器遗憾降至0.009，最强基线为0.475。
AI.conclusion: DePICT能有效识别并保留真正影响决策的上下文方向，显著优于竞争基线。

title: Representational Control over Self-Report & Behavior Coherence in LLM Risk-Taking
comment: 10 pages main content, 62 pages total, 21 figures, 19 tables
summary: Self-report is an appealing low-cost probe of an LLM's dispositions, but recent work finds only selective agreement between what models report and how they behave. Prior accounts establish these patterns by prompting black-box LLMs, leaving open whether the gap is a prompting artefact or a fact about how the underlying constructs are represented internally. We investigate risk-taking, a consequential dimension of agentic decision-making, using activation steering to measure self-report and behavior under the same internal intervention. We survey nine steering-vector extraction methods spanning task-specific directives, the model's own task behavior, and dispositional descriptions at two granularities, evaluated on two behavioral tasks and two psychometric instruments across four open-weight LLMs. We find that (1) a shared internal intervention does not ensure shared responsiveness: directions built from trait descriptions move self-report but leave behavior at chance, directions built from the model's own task choices do the reverse, and only task-specific directives reach both, weakly. (2) Diagnosis dissolves that exception: removing surface confounders leaves the directives only 32% of their behavioral effect. The two channels are otherwise steered by near-orthogonal directions, each channel reachable by several independent constructions. (3) An intervention composing one behavior-moving and one self-report-moving direction moves both together; flipping one sign sets them in opposition, with reported and enacted risk pointing in opposite directions on 69-89% of flipped compositions in all models. These findings move the self-report-behavior relationship from a black-box observation to a representational one that can be inspected and controlled, motivating representational checks alongside behavioral evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文用激活引导研究LLM风险倾向的自我报告与行为关系，发现两者由近乎正交的内部方向驱动，可被独立或组合控制。
AI.motivation: 自我报告是探测LLM倾向的低成本手段，但已有研究仅通过黑盒提示发现报告与行为只有选择性一致，无法判断这一差距是提示假象还是内部表征的真实事实。
AI.method: 以风险承担为切入点，用激活引导在同一内部干预下同时测量自我报告与行为。比较九种引导向量提取方法（任务指令、模型自身任务选择、两种粒度的倾向描述），在四个开源权重LLM、两个行为任务和两个心理测量工具上评估。
AI.result: (1) 共享干预不保证共享响应：倾向描述方向只改变自我报告，任务选择方向只改变行为，仅任务指令能弱地同时影响两者；(2) 去除表面混淆后，指令的行为效应仅剩32%；两通道由近乎正交的方向驱动，各有多种独立构造可达；(3) 组合一个行为方向与一个自我报告方向可同时移动两者，翻转符号使两者对立，所有模型中69-89%的翻转组合出现报告与行为风险方向相反。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将自我报告-行为关系从黑盒观察提升为可 inspect、可控制的表征层面事实，主张在行为评估之外增加表征检查。

title: A Statistical Inference Framework for PMI Estimation and SGNS Word Embeddings
summary:
Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) is a core measure of testing word association, and Skip-gram with Negative Sampling (SGNS) is essentially a method that implicitly factorizes a shifted PMI matrix. However, a systematic and well-rounded characterization of finite-sample uncertainty in PMI estimation remains absent and imperative to venture into.
  We provide a statistical framework for PMI estimation and its connection to SGNS. We prove consistency, asymptotic unbiasedness, and asymptotic normality of the empirical PMI estimator, derive its variance via the Delta method, and, applying stochastic approximation theory, obtain a variance decomposition for SGNS-based PMI estimation that separates data variance from optimization variance.
  Simulation experiments validate the Delta method approximation. Real-data experiments on the Brown Corpus (d = 100) reveal that SGNS systematically deviates from the theoretical relationship PMI + log K. The empirical relationship shows an attenuated PMI coefficient, an amplified log K effect, and a positive intercept, indicating systematic bias. Word analogy validation confirms the models are effective.
  The failure to validate the variance decomposition under low-dimensional conditions does not diminish its theoretical value; rather, it identifies the unbiasedness assumption as the key bottleneck and clarifies the gap between asymptotic theory and practice, providing implications for both practice and theory.

AI.tldr: 本文建立PMI估计的统计框架并联系SGNS，证明经验PMI估计量的相合性、渐近无偏性与渐近正态性，用Delta方法推导方差，并用随机逼近理论对SGNS的PMI估计做方差分解（区分数据方差与优化方差）。模拟验证Delta近似；Brown语料实验发现SGNS偏离理论关系PMI+logK，呈现衰减的PMI系数、放大的logK效应与正截距，说明系统性偏差。低维下方差分解未获验证，但指出无偏性假设是瓶颈。
AI.motivation: PMI是词关联度量的核心，SGNS本质上隐式分解平移后的PMI矩阵，但对PMI估计的有限样本不确定性缺乏系统、完整的刻画，这一空白亟需填补。
AI.method: 提出PMI估计的统计框架及其与SGNS的联系；证明经验PMI估计量的相合性、渐近无偏性和渐近正态性；通过Delta方法推导方差；应用随机逼近理论，得到SGNS-based PMI估计的方差分解，将数据方差与优化方差分离。并用模拟实验与Brown语料（d=100）真实数据实验及词类比验证。
AI.result: 模拟实验验证了Delta方法的近似。Brown语料（d=100）实验表明SGNS系统性偏离理论关系PMI+logK：经验关系表现为PMI系数衰减、logK效应放大以及正截距，说明存在系统性偏差。词类比验证确认模型有效。低维条件下方差分解未能得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 低维条件下方差分解未获验证并不削弱其理论价值，反而识别出无偏性假设是关键瓶颈，厘清了渐近理论与实践的差距，对实践和理论均有启示。

title: LongSocialBench: Do Long-Context LLMs Understand Online Discussion Threads?
summary: Long-context LLMs can now ingest entire online discussion threads, but understanding their social discourse requires more than reading a long document: models must track parent-reply relations, turning points, scoped subtrees, cross-branch contrasts, and participant trajectories. To test this structure-aware social reasoning, we introduce LongSocialBench, a benchmark of 1,462 verified human-authored multiple-choice items drawn from 94 complete Hacker News, Stack Exchange, and Reddit r/ChangeMyView episodes, with a median length of approximately 73K tokens. Each item pairs a complete serialized discussion and reply structure with a four-option question, requiring models to recover structured social evidence. Released items are verified for answerability, option uniqueness, and evidence grounding. Across 18 models and 29 evaluation settings, current long-context workflows remain far below human performance. The best individual result comes from Claude-Opus-4.7, which reaches 63.0% when prompted to eliminate incorrect options before answering, compared with 72.4% for independent human readers. Averaged across all 18 models, the full-context Baseline scores 43.9%. Supplying the gold evidence scope raises this to 55.0%, showing that substantial errors remain even after the relevant thread region is identified. LongSocialBench shows that the missing capability is not context access or prompting alone, but social understanding over structured reply trees.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LongSocialBench，一个用于测试长上下文 LLM 进行结构化社会推理能力的基准，包含 94 个完整在线讨论串、1462 道人工验证多选题（中位长度约 73K tokens），结果显示现有模型远低于人类水平。
AI.motivation: 长上下文模型虽能读入整段在线讨论，但理解社会话语需要追踪父子回复关系、转折点、局部子树、跨分支对比和参与者轨迹，现有评测未能检验这种结构感知的社会推理能力。
AI.method: 构建 LongSocialBench：从 Hacker News、Stack Exchange 和 Reddit r/ChangeMyView 收集 94 个完整讨论 episode，序列化讨论与回复结构，并为每个 episode 设计四选一多选问题；题目经过可答性、选项唯一性和证据支撑验证；在 18 个模型、29 种评测设置下测试。
AI.result: 最佳单模型 Claude-Opus-4.7 在“先排除错误选项”提示下仅达 63.0%，而独立人类读者为 72.4%；18 个模型的全上下文基线平均仅 43.9%；即使提供黄金证据范围也只提升到 55.0%。
AI.conclusion: LongSocialBench 表明，模型缺失的不是上下文访问或提示技巧，而是对结构化回复树的社会理解能力。

title: A Quantitative Analysis of Graph Representation Strategies for Cyber Attack Detection
summary: Graph based cyber attack detection studies employ various graph construction and representation strategies across different cybersecurity application domains. This diversity motivates a quantitative examination of how representation strategies are distributed across these application domains. This study presents a quantitative analysis of 37 original studies published between 2019 and 2026. Each study was coded according to publication year, application domain, graph representation type, feature extraction strategy, learning paradigm, algorithm, and dataset. Frequency analysis, cross tabulation, and statistical association tests were applied. Automated representation learning was the most frequently employed strategy, accounting for 73.0% of the studies, while handcrafted representation strategies accounted for 27.0%. The Fisher Freeman Halton exact test revealed a statistically significant association between application domain and representation strategy (exact p = 0.008; Cramer's V = 0.540). The findings indicate that automated representation learning predominates within the analyzed corpus and that the distribution of representation strategies differs across cybersecurity application domains.

AI.tldr: 本文对2019–2026年间37篇基于图的网络攻击检测研究进行定量分析，发现自动表示学习占主导（73.0%），且表示策略在不同网络安全应用域间的分布存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 图方法在网络攻击检测中应用广泛，但图构建与表示策略多样，缺乏对不同应用域中表示策略分布的定量考察。这一多样性促使作者系统梳理与量化比较。
AI.method: 系统性定量分析37篇原创研究（2019–2026）。按发表年份、应用域、图表示类型、特征提取策略、学习范式、算法和数据集进行编码；采用频次分析、交叉表及统计关联检验（Fisher–Freeman–Halton精确检验、Cramér's V）。
AI.result: 自动表示学习为最常用策略，占73.0%，手工表示策略占27.0%。应用域与表示策略之间存在统计显著关联（精确p = 0.008；Cramér's V = 0.540）。
AI.conclusion: 在所分析语料中，自动表示学习明显占主导；表示策略的分布因网络安全应用域不同而存在差异。

title: Asking the Crowd the Right Question: Bias-Cancelling Weights for Federated Learning
summary: A federated objective is a weighted sum of client risks, and the weights are almost always fixed in advance. We treat them instead as the only instrument of a wisdom-of-crowds mechanism: clients are noisy views of one truth, each seeing it through an independent distortion that is unbiased across the crowd. That the optimal weights are inversely proportional to the clients' error energies is classical; we begin at the question that answer presupposes, which energies belong there and whether a crowd can recover them from itself. Excess risk on the truth is of the exact order of the aggregate bias energy, so no optimizer can repair a bad weight vector; the truth itself is identifiable only up to a linear tilt, so subtracting estimated client biases provably reproduces uniform weighting. The expected per-client second moments, however, are exactly identified from the law of the crowd's disagreement by a well-conditioned linear inversion, a step random-effects meta-analysis cannot take because a source reports once; their realized counterparts are estimable up to an incoherence floor the algorithm can measure. This yields CROWD, which reads the disagreement off the optimization trajectory at no extra cost and matches a Bayesian minimax lower bound in the same constant: per instance as the horizon grows, and unconditionally as the prior becomes diffuse. For arbitrary distortions it stays competitive with the optimal weights, at a ratio governed by a geometric incoherence the algorithm can measure. On real scans split into sites with their own miscalibrated detectors it attains the oracle excess risk; on a companion federation that pulls bias and noise apart, weighting by noise variance is worse than not weighting at all, and CROWD is not.

AI.tldr: 该论文将联邦目标中的固定权重重新解释为"群体智慧"机制的工具，提出 CROWD 方法：通过优化轨迹上的客户端分歧，从群体自身估计各客户端的误差能量，从而实现接近最优的加权，并匹配贝叶斯极小极大下界。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习权重几乎总是预先固定。作者视客户端为对同一"真理"的带噪独立视角（偏差在群体上无偏），希望研究能否让群体从自身分歧中恢复出各客户端的误差能量，从而确定合适的权重，避免因权重不当导致的不可修复的超额风险。
AI.method: 理论上证明：关于真理的超额风险量级由聚合偏差能量决定，真理仅可辨识至线性倾斜，故减去估计的客户端偏差等价于均匀加权。而各客户端的期望二阶矩可由"群体分歧"通过良态线性反演精确辨识（随机效应元分析做不到，因单一来源只报告一次）。据此提出 CROWD 算法，它从优化轨迹中零额外成本地读取分歧。
AI.result: CROWD 在同一常数下匹配贝叶斯极小极大下界：随迭代步数逐实例成立，当先验弥散时无条件成立。对任意失真，其表现与最优权重相比的比率由算法可测量的几何不相干性控制。在划分为不同站点、各自检测器存在校准误差的真实扫描数据上达到 oracle 超额风险；在将偏差与噪声分离的联邦算例中，按噪声方差加权甚至不如不加权，而 CROWD 不会如此。
AI.conclusion: 联邦目标的权重不应预先固定，而可作为群体智慧工具，让群体从自身分歧中辨识误差能量，从而鲁棒地逼近最优加权、匹配理论下界，并在真实数据上优于噪声方差加权等常见做法。

title: Envelope Characterizations for Trajectories of the Ćuk Converter
summary: In this paper, a complete characterization of the stability and the boundaries of the envelopes for trajectories of the Ćuk converter is provided in the cases of time and state-dependent switching. In particular, difference equations are developed and used to compute boundaries for the system's response envelopes as well as Lyapunov functions to show the system's stability in both continuous and discontinuous regimes of operation. Each case is illustrated by multiple simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文对Ćuk变换器在时间相关与状态相关切换下的轨迹稳定性及包络边界给出完整刻画，利用差分方程计算响应包络边界，并用Lyapunov函数证明系统在连续与断续工作模式下的稳定性，附有多组仿真验证。
AI.motivation: Ćuk变换器轨迹的稳定性与响应包络边界缺乏完整刻画，尤其在时间相关与状态相关两种切换情形下。
AI.method: 建立差分方程以计算系统响应包络边界；构造Lyapunov函数以证明连续与断续两种工作模式下的稳定性；对每种情形进行多组仿真。
AI.result: 获得了时间相关与状态相关切换两种情形下Ćuk变换器轨迹的完整稳定性刻画及包络边界。
AI.conclusion: 差分方程与Lyapunov函数方法可有效刻画Ćuk变换器的响应包络与稳定性，适用于连续和断续工作模式。

title: Synthesizing Physics Formulae with Transformers
summary: Finding a compact formula that fits a set of input-output pairs and predicts outputs on unseen inputs is a fundamental problem in science. Symbolic regression automates the search for such formulae: search-based methods explore the space of possible formulae directly, while transformers pre-trained on synthetic data produce formulae of comparable quality substantially faster. Existing transformers, however, are prone to overfitting --- they find formulae that fit the training data well but do not extrapolate to input ranges unseen during training. We address this by shaping the set of formulae used to train a transformer, and show that the resulting formulae extrapolate substantially better. Fine-tuning the transformer on data with noise-corrupted target values further makes the synthesized formulae robust to noise in the observations. On SRBench and LLM-SRBench our transformer synthesizes a formula in about ten seconds and extrapolates better than all evaluated methods at a comparable budget. Search-based methods surpass our accuracy only when given one to three orders of magnitude more time.

AI.tldr: 本文通过设计预训练transformer所用的公式集合，提升符号回归的外推能力和抗噪性，在SRBench等基准上以约十秒生成优于同类方法的公式。
AI.motivation: 符号回归旨在从输入输出对中找到简洁公式，现有基于transformer的方法虽快，但容易过拟合，导致无法外推到训练时未见过的输入范围。
AI.method: 通过塑造/筛选用于训练transformer的公式集合来改善外推能力；并通过对含噪声目标值的数据进行微调，使生成公式对观测噪声更鲁棒。
AI.result: 在SRBench和LLM-SRBench上，该transformer约十秒即可合成公式，在同等预算下外推表现优于所有对比方法；基于搜索的方法只有在多花1至3个数量级时间时才能超过其精度。
AI.conclusion: 合理设计预训练公式分布并结合噪声微调，可显著提升transformer符号回归的外推性和鲁棒性，在效率与性能上取得优势。

title: InvestigationWorlds: An Agentic Environment for Legal Investigation
summary: We introduce InvestigationWorlds, an agentic environment for legal investigation. We build on an underused artifact of U.S. civil litigation: the summary judgment motion. This motion relies upon a record composed of real evidence exhibits, and results in a court-adopted hypothesis that is treated as ground truth for the purposes of deciding the motion. Each environment is built from a real U.S. Federal Court case retrieved from Public Access to Court Electronic Records (PACER) and augmented by an attorney-validated generation pipeline that synthesizes role-tagged documents around the original record. The resulting corpus admits multiple coherent factual readings, only one of which matches the court-adopted hypothesis. Evaluating on 100 cases, we find agents often commit to incorrect hypotheses despite retrieving relevant evidence, struggling to distinguish the court-adopted hypothesis from alternative hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 提出 InvestigationWorlds：基于美国民事诉讼简易判决的智能体法律调查环境，用真实法院案件构建，考验智能体在多义证据中还原法院认定事实的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体缺乏需从多义证据中推断唯一"官方事实"的法律调查基准，简易判决动议正好提供了法院采纳的假设作为地面真值。
AI.method: 从 PACER 取真实联邦案件，以律师验证的生成流程围绕原始记录合成带角色标签的文书，构建可支持多种自洽解读、仅一种匹配法院假设的语料；在 100 个案例上评估。
AI.result: 智能体常检索到相关证据，却仍锁定错误假设，难以区分法院采纳的假设与替代假设。
AI.conclusion: 该环境揭示智能体在法律事实推断上存在明显缺陷，为研究证据推理提供了新基准。

title: Taylor Representations for Model-Free RL in Networked MDPs
summary: In Networked Markov Decision Processes, transition dynamics are often unknown and the state--action space grows rapidly with the number of agents. In this setting, Taylor representations naturally approximate $Q$-functions, but a naive order-$n$ expansion over $N$ agents requires $Θ(N^n)$ coefficients. We justify these expansions under smooth expected future local rewards with controlled derivatives. Under this condition, finite-speed information propagation and discounting imply that local-critic Taylor coefficients decay exponentially with the graph distance to the farthest agent involved. Discarding distant-agent coefficients and marginalizing then yield scalable local Taylor representations with a bound controlled by graph locality. Building on these representations, we propose a scalable model-free actor--critic algorithm, establishing finite-sample critic and near-stationarity guarantees for a linear LSTD critic. We then introduce a more expressive neural TD parameterization. Unlike prior constructive spectral methods, our approach covers settings without access to a known local dynamics map, such as hidden switched linear--quadratic regulation. Across three control benchmarks, our method matches or outperforms spectral baselines while scaling efficiently to large graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对网络化MDP中状态-动作空间随智能体数急剧增长的问题，提出局部Taylor表示及其可扩展的无模型Actor-Critic算法。
AI.motivation: 网络化MDP中转移动态未知，且状态-动作空间随智能体数量快速膨胀；传统Taylor展开需Θ(N^n)个系数，难以扩展。
AI.method: 在期望未来局部奖励平滑且导数受控条件下，证明局部critic Taylor系数随到最远智能体的图距离指数衰减；丢弃远距离系数并边缘化，得到可扩展的局部Taylor表示，并据此设计无模型Actor-Critic算法（含LSTD critic及神经网络TD参数化）。
AI.result: 给出线性LSTD critic的有限样本与近驻点保证；相比需要已知局部动态映射的谱方法，可处理隐式切换线性二次调节等场景；在三个控制基准上匹配或超越谱基线，并能高效扩展到大图。
AI.conclusion: 局部Taylor表示与相应Actor-Critic算法为大规模网络化MDP提供了可扩展、理论有保障的无模型控制方案，且不依赖已知局部动态映射。

title: Copying Before Suppression: What Drives a Below-Chance Dip During Language Model Training?
summary: Mechanistic interpretability usually studies fully trained models, yet the computations that drive a behaviour can change while the model is still learning the task. On the Indirect Object Identification task, a model should continue with the name mentioned once rather than the name mentioned twice. Pythia models pass through an early training window in which they prefer the repeated name, so accuracy in a choice between the two names falls below one half while language-model loss on a fixed text sample keeps decreasing across the same window. The window reflects a temporary imbalance between two computations. We identify one cause of the wrong preference by selecting a set of attention heads that write the repeated name, on prompts separate from those used for causal evaluation, keeping that selection fixed, and then replacing each head's final-token output with its average output on a separate set of non-repeated-name prompts. This improves the correct-minus-repeated logit difference in a separately trained 160M model and in the official 160M, 410M, and 1B models. At 160M, the head that lowers the repeated name in the mature model shows little of its mature behaviour at this point. It directs less than one percent of its attention to the repeated mention, and its output makes almost no direct contribution to lowering that name's logit. Both properties grow over the interval in which behaviour recovers. Across the 160M, 410M, and 1B models, transplanting the corresponding head's mature parameters into the early checkpoint recovers 35 to 68 percent of the total improvement in the correct-minus-repeated logit difference seen by the end of training. Related early-to-late reversals appear at further Pythia scales, in two independently trained GPT-2 models, and in OLMo. A mature circuit can therefore conceal a transient causal configuration that shaped behaviour earlier in training.

AI.tldr: 在训练早期，模型经历一段暂时偏好重复名字的窗口，行为回退而语言建模损失仍在改善。作者定位了若干写入重复名字的注意力头，替换其输出可改善正确-重复logit差；成熟回路掩盖了早期瞬态因果结构。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性通常只研究完全训练好的模型，但驱动某个行为的计算在训练过程中会发生变化。作者关注IOI任务中出现的早期阶段性行为反转（准确率低于0.5）的现象，探究其成因及是否反映了暂时的因果结构。
AI.method: 在IOI任务上定位一组写入重复名字的注意力头（在与因果评估不同的提示上选择并保持固定），并用其在非重复名字提示上的平均输出替换各头在最终token的输出，测量正确-重复logit差的变化；同时在160M模型中分析降低重复名字的头在早期与成熟期的行为差异，并将成熟参数移植到早期检查点。
AI.result: 替换头输出可在独立训练的160M及官方160M/410M/1B模型中改善正确-重复logit差。160M中，成熟期负责压低重复名字的头在早期几乎不参与该行为：对重复提及的注意力不足1%，输出几乎不直接降低该名字logit，两者随行为恢复而增长。移植对应成熟头参数可恢复这三个尺度上训练末期改善量的35%-68%。类似的早期-晚期反转也出现在其他Pythia规模、两个独立训练的GPT-2和OLMo中。
AI.conclusion: 成熟回路可能掩盖了在训练早期塑造行为的瞬态因果配置；机制解释需要关注训练过程中的动态变化，而非仅分析最终模型。

title: The Reported Engagement with AI Level (REAL) Rating: A Framework for Disclosing Human-AI Collaboration
summary: Generative artificial intelligence has become increasingly incorporated into digital media and more generally into production workflows with which the public frequently interacts. Current provenance standards and disclosure methods frequently rely on binary categorizations, differentiating only between entirely human-authored and AI-generated content, or depend on technical watermarking that lacks user-facing clarity. However, there are very different risks and outcomes depending on the different uses of AI in the creation and consumption of end products. Therefore, we propose the Reported Engagement with AI Level (REAL) Rating framework which addresses these concerns by introducing a six-tier scale (Levels 0-5) that discloses the extent of AI involvement in both product creation and user experience. This paper details the structural methodology of the REAL Rating system and the specifics of its application across text, image, audio, video, and software products.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REAL评级框架，用六级量表（0-5级）披露AI在内容创作与用户体验中的参与程度。
AI.motivation: 现有溯源与披露方法多依赖二元分类（纯人工 vs. AI生成）或缺乏用户可读性的技术水印，无法反映AI不同使用方式带来的差异化风险。
AI.method: 设计六层级（Level 0-5）的REAL评级框架，同时披露产品创作与用户体验中的AI参与程度；论文阐述其结构化方法及在文本、图像、音频、视频、软件产品中的应用细则。
AI.result: 提出了覆盖多模态（文本、图像、音频、视频、软件）的评分应用规范。
AI.conclusion: REAL评级通过细粒度披露AI参与度，弥补现有二元分类与黑箱水印的不足，提供更清晰、面向用户的AI披露方案。

title: On randomized batch-sampling coordinate descent methods for solving linear least-squares problems
summary: This paper refines randomized block coordinate descent by introducing a coordinate-level batch-sampling distribution characterization, yielding a fine-grained randomized batch-sampling coordinate descent framework, which applies to any block coordinate descent method under an arbitrary static stochastic sampling rule for solving large-scale linear least-squares problems. Based on this framework, we derive new linear convergence rate bounds that are invariant to the column scaling of data matrices. Theoretical analysis and numerical experiments validate that the new bounds are significantly sharper than existing results and better aligned with the practical convergence rate. Furthermore, we proposed a learning-based sampling strategy by parameterizing the batch-sampling distribution and optimizing its parameters through gradient-based training. Preliminary numerical results on computed tomography (CT) reconstruction problems demonstrate that the resulting method converges significantly faster than variants using other fixed sampling rules, and outperforms tested adaptive coordinate descent methods and full gradient descent in computational efficiency, confirming that learned sampling distributions can effectively capture problem-specific structure to accelerate convergence within the framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出细粒度随机批采样坐标下降框架，推导出对列缩放不变的线性收敛率界限，并提出基于学习的采样策略。
AI.motivation: 改进随机块坐标下降，克服现有收敛率界限不够紧致、对数据矩阵列缩放敏感的问题。
AI.method: 引入坐标级批采样分布刻画，构建适用于任意块坐标下降与静态随机采样规则的框架；推导列缩放不变的收敛率界限；通过参数化批采样分布并用梯度训练优化，提出学习型采样策略。
AI.result: 新界限显著更紧且更符合实际收敛；CT重建实验表明所学采样分布收敛更快，计算效率优于自适应坐标下降和全梯度下降。
AI.conclusion: 学习型采样分布能捕捉问题特定结构，加速框架内收敛，验证了方法的有效性与优越性。

title: Integrating Prescribed Performance and RISE Control for Asymptotic Tracking of Uncertain High-Order Nonlinear Systems
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
summary: This paper addresses asymptotic tracking with prescribed transient and steady-state performance for a class of uncertain high-order nonlinear systems with uncertain dynamics. The proposed controller combines a barrier-type transformation of a filtered tracking error with a robust integral of the sign of the error (RISE) mechanism, yielding a continuous and low-complexity design. The proposed method does not employ neural, fuzzy, or other global approximation structures. It is shown that all closed-loop signals remain bounded, the prescribed performance funnel is preserved for all initial conditions in the funnel, and that the tracking error converges asymptotically to zero under appropriate gain selection. The analysis provides a continuous-feedback synthesis that integrates prescribed performance control (PPC) with the RISE methodology. Simulation results on a ship-steering example illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将障碍型变换与RISE机制相结合的低复杂度连续控制器，实现不确定高阶非线性系统的预设性能渐近跟踪。
AI.motivation: 解决一类含不确定动态的高阶非线性系统在预设瞬态与稳态性能下的渐近跟踪问题，且避免使用神经网络、模糊等全局逼近结构。
AI.method: 将滤波跟踪误差的障碍型变换与误差符号鲁棒积分（RISE）机制相结合，构成连续、低复杂度的反馈综合方法，把预设性能控制（PPC）与RISE方法有机融合。
AI.result: 证明闭环所有信号有界；只要初值位于性能漏斗内，漏斗约束始终被保持；在适当增益选择下跟踪误差渐近收敛到零；船舶操舵仿真验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 为不确定高阶非线性系统提供了一种无需全局逼近结构的连续反馈预设性能渐近跟踪方案，兼具PPC与RISE的优点。

title: Evolving LLM-Generated Features for Interpretable Classification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as classifiers, yet they operate as opaque systems whose decisions are difficult to interpret, which complicates their use in regulated domains such as credit scoring or medical diagnosis. We propose an evolutionary framework that iteratively discovers natural language feature definitions (rubrics) for interpretable classification. An LLM generates candidate binary features, evaluates each sample against them, and the resulting vectors can be used to train a transparent classifier such as logistic regression. The feature set evolves over multiple iterations guided by classification errors, per-class activation rates, and feature ablation scores. We evaluate across three benchmarks, including a credit risk dataset representative of regulated domains, comparing single-shot LLM rubrics, evolved rubrics, and direct zero-shot LLM classification. Evolved features improve over single-shot rubrics by +2.9 pp on average and outperform zero-shot LLM classification on two of three tasks, while providing fully auditable decision logic. On the credit risk task, the zero-shot LLM performs at chance (50.7%) with a strong bias toward a single class, whereas evolved features achieve balanced, interpretable predictions. Crucially, this failure is invisible in aggregate accuracy and surfaces only under per-class auditing. Analysis reveals that evolution is most effective when label boundaries cannot be inferred from category names alone or when the LLM lacks reliable domain-specific reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出进化式框架，迭代发现自然语言特征定义（rubrics），使LLM分类更可解释。
AI.motivation: LLM作为分类器虽流行，但决策不透明，难以用于信用评分、医疗诊断等受监管领域，需要可审计的决策逻辑。
AI.method: 用LLM生成候选二值特征并逐样本评测，得到特征向量训练透明分类器（如逻辑回归）；特征集依据分类错误、各类激活率和消融分数在多轮迭代中进化。
AI.result: 在三个基准（含信用风险数据集）上，进化特征比单次生成平均提升+2.9个百分点，在三个任务中的两个上超过零样本LLM；信用风险任务中零样本仅50.7%（接近随机且有强烈单类偏置），进化特征则实现均衡可解释预测。
AI.conclusion: 这种失败在总体准确率中不可见，仅在逐类审计下暴露；当标签边界无法从类别名推断或LLM缺乏可靠领域推理时，进化方法最有效。

title: AI-Enabled Quality Assurance for Multiple-Choice Assessment Items
comment: 8 pages, 2 tables, Full paper accepted to the AIME Conference 2026
summary: Generating multiple-choice questions is increasingly scalable, but establishing their assessment quality remains difficult. We present a focused narrative review of automated item-writing flaw detection, revision, psychometric screening, and NLP benchmark auditing. Database searches, citation retrieval, and nominated sources yield fourteen research reports reviewed in full text. We distinguish surface checks from content-sensitive judgments and map a 19-criterion rubric to detection methods and reported evidence. High label-level accuracy often coexists with weak positive case detection, while rubric definitions and reference standards vary. Revision evidence is mixed, and the associations reported in prior work do not establish the effects of repair. We propose evaluating quality assurance as a sequence of independently validated decisions, with criterion-specific reporting, calibrated human review, and outcome-based assessment of revisions.

AI.tldr: 本文对自动选择题缺陷检测、修订、心理测量筛查与NLP基准审计进行了叙述性综述，纳入14篇全文报告，指出高标签级准确率常伴随弱阳性检测，并提出以"独立验证决策序列"来评估质量保障。
AI.motivation: 自动生成选择题日益可行，但如何确立其评估质量（题目质量）仍很困难，现有检测方法效果与评估标准不明确。
AI.method: 叙述性聚焦综述：通过数据库检索、引文追踪与推荐来源，获得14篇研究全文；区分表层检查与内容敏感判断，将19项标准评分表映射到检测方法及已报告证据。
AI.result: 高标签级准确率常与弱阳性样本检测并存；评分表定义与参照标准各异；修订证据结论不一致；既往研究报告的相关性无法确立修复的因果效应。
AI.conclusion: 建议将质量保障评估为一连串可独立验证的决策，采用分标准报告、校准人工复核，并对修订进行基于结果的评估。

title: G-CARB: Graph-Localized Conformal Agent Risk Budget for Compositional Harm
comment: SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris, France, 2026
summary: Small language model (SLM) agents need safety controls that track consequences across tool calls with little monitoring overhead. A private read, for example, becomes a leak when a later action sends that data outside the system. We introduce CARB (Conformal Agent Risk Budget), which calibrates when to stop an agent using a ledger of harm incurred before stopping. Under exchangeable episodes, standard conformal risk control bounds this declared loss in expectation over calibration and a future episode. G-CARB selects scorer evidence along observable dependencies from private sources to outgoing actions. The ledger still covers the entire executed history, and computing the gate score requires no additional language-model inference. On AgentDojo replay with two 14B backbones, G-CARB roughly halves scorer-input records at intermediate risk budgets while improving autonomous task completion relative to full-prefix scoring; random context of the same size achieves similar gains. Controlled examples show how retaining the relevant dependency can further avoid stopping benign work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARB/G-CARB，用“伤害账本”和保形风险控制来校准SLM智能体的停止时机，在低监控开销下追踪工具调用间的风险传播。
AI.motivation: SLM智能体需要低开销的安全控制，能跨工具调用追踪后果：例如一次私有读取，在后续动作把数据外发时就变成泄露。
AI.method: CARB（Conformal Agent Risk Budget）基于停止前累积的伤害账本校准停止时机；在可交换episode下，标准保形风险控制对该声明损失在期望上给出界。G-CARB沿可观测依赖从私有源到外发动作选择评分证据，账本仍覆盖全部执行历史，且计算门控分数无需额外语言模型推理。
AI.result: 在AgentDojo回放、两个14B骨干上，G-CARB在中等风险预算下约减半评分器输入记录，同时相比全前缀评分提升自主任务完成率；同尺寸随机上下文取得类似增益。受控例子显示保留相关依赖可进一步避免停止良性工作。
AI.conclusion: 通过依赖感知的证据选择与保形风险预算，可在不增加推理开销的情况下降低监控成本并改善任务完成，保留相关依赖有助于减少对良性工作的误停。

title: Box-iLQR: Constraint-Aware Feedback via Finite-Barrier Trajectory Optimization
summary: Iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (iLQR) and Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP) are attractive trajectory-optimization methods because their backward recursions provide both nominal trajectories and local time-varying feedback laws. Hard state and input constraints, however, can drive solutions toward constraint boundaries where little corrective authority remains during closed-loop execution. This paper presents Box-iLQR, a log-barrier iLQR method for box-constrained states and controls, with emphasis on the resulting feedback policy. Barrier gradients bias nominal trajectories away from constraint boundaries, while barrier curvature enters the Riccati recursion that determines the feedback gains. We show that control-barrier curvature smoothly attenuates feedback as an actuator approaches saturation, while state-barrier curvature propagates backward through the value function to shape feedback before future state constraints are encountered. This motivates retaining a finite barrier rather than always driving the barrier parameter toward zero, thereby preserving state and actuator margin. Comparisons with CL-DDP and ALTRO are presented on pendulum, cart-pole, Acrobot, and car-parking problems. Monte Carlo experiments demonstrate improved closed-loop behavior with finite barriers, while a six-input MuJoCo fish example demonstrates data-driven Box-iLQR using dynamics Jacobians estimated from simulator rollouts. Box-iLQR achieves convergence comparable to, and in some cases better than, the baseline methods. Moreover, the feedback policy obtained with a finite barrier ensures constraint satisfaction even under execution uncertainty.

AI.tldr: Box-iLQR是一种基于对数障碍函数的iLQR方法，处理带箱式约束的状态与控制问题，重点在于保留有限障碍参数以维持闭环执行时的约束裕度与反馈质量。
AI.motivation: iLQR/DDP的逆向递归能同时给出标称轨迹与时变反馈律，但硬约束会把解推向约束边界，导致闭环执行时缺乏纠偏控制权限。
AI.method: 采用对数障碍处理箱式状态/控制约束；障碍梯度使标称轨迹远离边界，障碍曲率进入Riccati递归以调节反馈增益；并保留有限障碍参数而非趋于零，以维持状态与执行器裕度；还展示了基于仿真rollout估计雅可比的数据驱动版本。
AI.result: 控制障碍曲率能在执行器接近饱和时平滑衰减反馈，状态障碍曲率通过值函数反向传播提前塑造反馈；在摆、车杆、Acrobot、泊车问题上与CL-DDP、ALTRO对比，收敛性相当甚至更好；蒙特卡洛显示有限障碍改善闭环表现，MuJoCo六输入鱼形机器人验证数据驱动版本，且有限障碍反馈在执行不确定性下仍满足约束。
AI.conclusion: 保留有限障碍的Box-iLQR能在保证约束满足的同时获得更优闭环反馈，优于始终将障碍参数驱向零的做法。

title: Control Systems with Model Hierarchies: A Category-Theoretic Framework
summary: Storage functions are widely used to relate a control system to a simpler model for analysis and controller design, and to quantify model mismatch when a controller is designed on one model but implemented on another. In applications, several models of the same physical process are available at different levels of refinement, while refinement relations, consisting of a storage function and an associated interface, are constructed only between neighboring levels. Thus, a direct refinement relation may be unavailable between the model used for controller design and the model used for implementation. To address this gap, we consider open control systems with internal ports for interconnection and external ports for input-output analysis. We define a category, $\mathsf{OCS}_{\mathrm{chain}}$, whose objects are open control systems and whose morphisms are finite chains of refinement relations. Using this category, we derive an output mismatch bound and a closed-loop performance result for controllers refined through a sequence of interfaces. We then define a functor that transfers refinement relations from open control systems to systems without internal ports. We also develop a network lifting result showing that, under standard interconnection compatibility conditions, subsystem storage functions can be combined to obtain refinement relations and performance bounds for composite networks. Two thermal network examples illustrate recursive controller refinement and the propagation of model mismatch along refinement chains. Simulations show that an HVAC system tracks a time-varying reference temperature with error below $0.2^\circ\mathrm{C}$ even when the controller is designed on the coarsest model and deployed on the finest model.

AI.tldr: 该文引入开放控制系统的范畴 OCS_chain，用细化关系链将控制器设计模型与实现模型关联，推导输出失配界与闭环性能结果，并给出网络提升与双热网实例验证。
AI.motivation: 同一物理过程存在不同精度的多级模型，但细化关系仅在相邻层级间构建，导致控制器设计模型与实现模型之间可能缺乏直接细化关系。
AI.method: 定义对象为开放控制系统、态射为有限细化关系链的范畴 OCS_chain；据此推导输出失配界与闭环性能结果；定义将细化关系从开放控制系统转移到无内部端口系统的函子；在标准互连兼容条件下建立网络提升结果，组合子系统存储函数。
AI.result: 获得经接口链细化控制器的输出失配界与闭环性能保证；两例热网络展示递归控制器细化及模型失配沿细化链传播；HVAC 仿真在控制器基于最粗模型设计、部署于最细模型时，时变参考温度跟踪误差低于 0.2°C。
AI.conclusion: 通过细化关系链的范畴框架，可在相邻层级信息有限的条件下为跨层级控制器细化提供失配与性能保证，并支持网络组合与递归细化。

authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
title: One-Step Curvature Probes Miss the Fitting Operator: Retained Capacity and Terminal Null-Space Correction for Continual Learning
summary: A one-step curvature probe evaluates an initial direction, whereas continual learners are judged after reaching comparable new-task fit. In an overparameterized linearization, projected gradient descent converges to $Δ_P=PJ^\top(JPJ^\top)^{-1}r$, and its squared-displacement inflation is exactly the reciprocal of the retained fitting capacity $c_P(r)$. More generally, the terminal old-task quadratic ratio factorizes as $1/[c_P(r)G_{\rm end}(P,r)]$, where $G_{\rm end}$ compares curvature along endpoint directions. In the rank-one case, $G_{\rm end}$ equals the one-step probe gain; for multiple outputs, the two gains can differ. The terminal quadratic also separates into a curvature-optimal fitting floor and an algorithm-dependent null-space excess, motivating terminal null-space correction, which preserves linearized new-task outputs on its Jacobian batch. Controlled checks validate the local quadratic and show that projection can greatly reduce matched-norm curvature while barely changing terminal forgetting. Across common-threshold configurations, projection yields the larger signed old-task loss change in 73/99 matched pairs, retained fitting capacity falls with rank, and fixed-rank comparisons separate terminal forgetting even when probe gain is approximately matched. On Permuted MNIST and Split CIFAR-100, terminal correction decreases signed old-task loss in 166/180 method--dataset--seed pairs under the all-seed intention-to-correct analysis; because acceptance and outcome reporting use the same held-out split, this result is descriptive and test-conditioned. Overall, terminal cost depends jointly on retained fitting capacity, endpoint-direction curvature, and the null-space component selected by optimization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用终端拟合能力与端点曲率来分析持续学习中的遗忘，指出遗忘取决于保留拟合容量、端点方向曲率与优化选择的零空间分量，并提出终端零空间校正方法。
AI.motivation: 单步曲率探针只评估初始方向，而持续学习者的性能应在达到相当的新任务拟合后评判，二者视角不同，需要从终端角度理解遗忘。
AI.method: 在过参数化线性化下分析投影梯度下降的终端解，将旧任务二次比分解为保留拟合容量c_P(r)、端点曲率因子G_end及算法相关零空间超额；据此提出保留新任务输出的终端零空间校正。
AI.result: 受控实验验证局部二次模型；投影能大幅降低匹配范数曲率但几乎不改变遗忘；常见阈值下73/99配对投影有更大旧任务损失变化；Permuted MNIST和Split CIFAR-100上166/180配对降低旧任务损失，但结果为描述性且条件于测试集。
AI.conclusion: 终端代价由保留拟合容量、端点方向曲率和优化选定的零空间分量共同决定，单步探针不足以刻画持续学习中的遗忘。

title: Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究用户在行使AI模型"被遗忘权"时如何影响模型行为，定义了自适应性(adaptivity)与集体性(collectivity)两种用户删除行为，从理论上揭示这两类行为的效果差距，并利用数据估值技术设计能显著改变模型行为的删除请求策略，在计算机视觉任务中验证了不同用户行为模式的差异化影响。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘被视为让用户在AI模型中行使"被遗忘权"的重要途径，但现有研究较少关注用户自身的行为方式如何影响模型行为，用户能否主动影响模型尚不明确。
AI.method: 定义两种用户删除行为——自适应性(adaptivity)与集体性(collectivity)；将用户目标与随机优化结果建立理论联系；借助数据估值(data valuation)技术设计删除请求者策略；在计算机视觉任务上进行实验并分离两种行为的影响。
AI.result: 理论上证明了是否展现这两类行为的用户群体在潜在效果上存在差距；实验表明不同用户行为模型具有差异化效果，并尝试分离自适应性(adaptivity)与集体性(collectivity)各自的影响。
AI.conclusion: 用户可通过自适应性(adaptivity)与集体性(collectivity)行为显著影响模型行为，数据估值技术可用于设计有效的删除请求策略，这为"被遗忘权"的实际执行提供了新视角。

title: Moment-Accurate Gaussian Mixtures for Constant-Step Stochastic Approximation
summary: Local Gaussian models of constant-step learning predict output variability and expected losses, but weak convergence alone does not justify these moment predictions. We establish moment-accurate Gaussian mixtures by matching stationary energy with local Ornstein--Uhlenbeck limits, ruling out quadratic tail mass invisible to weak convergence. For step size $a$, the second-order Wasserstein error is $o(\sqrt a)$, uniformly over invariant laws, using each law's actual root weights. The assumptions combine confinement, descent, finitely many hyperbolic equilibria and root continuity with finite-variance innovations. The result yields observable covariances, expected objective gaps and first-order mean shifts, while allowing singular covariances, compatible saddles and weights without a limit. For additive noise given by a fixed invertible transform of independent standardized Student $t_3$ coordinates, symmetry gives an order-sharp $\sqrt a$ smooth-test bound. Numerical transport calculations demonstrate the value of root-specific covariances; controlled SGD studies assess observable predictions across step sizes, batch sizes and model geometries.

AI.tldr: 本文为常步长学习（如SGD）的局部高斯（Ornstein–Uhlenbeck型）近似提供严格的理论基础，证明其在二阶Wasserstein意义下moment-accurate，误差为$o(\sqrt a)$，并给出可观测的协方差与期望损失等预测。
AI.motivation: 局部高斯模型能预测输出波动和期望损失，但仅有弱收敛不足以支撑对矩（moments）的预测，因为弱收敛可能遗漏无法观测的二次尾部质量。需要建立矩精确的高斯混合近似。
AI.method: 通过将平稳能量与局部Ornstein–Uhlenbeck极限相匹配，构造矩精确的高斯混合；证明在步长$a$下二阶Wasserstein误差为$o(\sqrt a)$，且关于不变律一致，使用每个律的真实根权重。假设包括：约束性(confinement)、下降性(descent)、有限个双曲平衡点、根连续性以及有限方差的新息(innovations)。对加性噪声（独立标准化Student $t_3$坐标经固定可逆变换）利用对称性给出阶数最优的$\sqrt a$光滑检验界。
AI.result: 得到可观测的协方差、期望目标间隙和均值一阶偏移，同时允许奇异协方差、兼容鞍点以及无极限的权重；对Student $t_3$噪声给出阶数最优的$\sqrt a$光滑检验界。数值传输计算展示了根特定协方差的价值，受控SGD实验在不同步长、批大小和模型几何下评估了可观测预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为常步长学习的局部高斯moment预测提供了严格且矩精确的理论支撑，超越了弱收敛的局限，并通过数值与SGD实验验证了其实际预测价值。

title: PB-GRPO: Learning Socially Adaptive LLM Agents from Persona-Driven Simulation with Preference-Batched GRPO
summary: Building LLMs that behave well socially, not merely correctly, requires Building LLMs that behave well socially, not merely correctly, requires more than producing locally helpful responses. A socially competent agent must infer users' unstated goals, respect their preferences, and adapt as the conversation unfolds. These behaviors are inherently multi-turn and social, making them hard to optimize: real interaction data is scarce, and user preferences are typically latent rather than directly observable. To address these challenges, we build on a persona-driven social simulation environment (consisting of a persona library, LLM-based user simulators, and a user-satisfaction scoring system ranging from [0, 1]), to introduce preference-batched GRPO (PB-GRPO), a post-training algorithm that learns socially adaptive policies from conversation-level feedback. Compared to vanilla GRPO, PB-GRPO computes advantages using a normalization estimated across a bucket of users with similar preferences, stabilizing training across a diverse social population. Empirical evidence shows that PB-GRPO improves models' social behavior over strong reinforcement learning baselines in our simulated environment.

AI.tldr: 提出偏好分批GRPO（PB-GRPO），在人格驱动的社交模拟环境中学习社交自适应策略。
AI.motivation: 让LLM具备社交能力（推断隐含目标、尊重偏好、动态适应）本质是多轮且社交的，难以优化：真实交互数据稀缺，用户偏好通常是潜在不可观测的。
AI.method: 基于人格驱动社交模拟环境（人格库、LLM用户模拟器、[0,1]满意度评分系统），提出PB-GRPO后训练算法：利用一组相似偏好用户bucket上估计的归一化来计算优势，相比vanilla GRPO可在多样社交群体上稳定训练。
AI.result: 实证表明，PB-GRPO在模拟环境中相比强RL基线提升了模型的社交行为表现。
AI.conclusion: 从对话级反馈学习社交自适应策略，通过偏好分批归一化提升训练稳定性，验证了该方法在提升LLM社交能力上的有效性。

title: The Cost of a Hop: Benchmarking NLIP and A2A
summary: Autonomous agents built on Large Language Models (LLMs) need standardized protocols to interoperate across systems. Several now exist (A2A, MCP, ACP, ANP, NLIP), but the Natural Language Interaction Protocol (NLIP) has not appeared in any controlled performance study, and no work has measured where an agent protocol's latency is spent. We compare NLIP and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol empirically, decomposing latency into message creation, connection, and send phases across three independent hardware environments. For lightweight coordination, NLIP is 8.4-9.6x faster than the baseline A2A SDK implementation on two environments and about 4x on a third; the direction of the advantage is consistent, its magnitude depends on the hardware. The advantage is stage-specific: for the end-to-end pipeline, where LLM inference dominates, the protocols are near parity. The difference comes almost entirely from connection setup. To test A2A at its best, we also ran A2A SDK with connection caching enabled; caching narrows its gap with NLIP by a hardware-dependent amount, from 2.75x on one machine to near-parity on faster hardware, where at scale a cache-optimized A2A-SDK matches NLIP. We report these as measured conditions without a single causal account of the residual send-phase cost. Against the more optimized Python-A2A, NLIP leads by about 4x on the same stage. We close with a protocol-selection guide keyed to workload characteristics.

AI.tldr: 该论文实证比较了NLIP与A2A两种LLM智能体协议的性能，将延迟分解为消息创建、连接和发送三阶段，发现NLIP在轻量协调中快约4-9.6倍，优势主要来自连接建立。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体跨系统互操作需要标准化协议（如A2A、MCP、ACP、ANP、NLIP），但NLIP从未被纳入受控性能研究，且尚无工作测量智能体协议延迟的具体分布。
AI.method: 在三种独立硬件环境中对NLIP与A2A进行实证对比，将延迟分解为消息创建、连接、发送三个阶段；并测试启用连接缓存的A2A-SDK以及与更优化的Python-A2A对比。
AI.result: 轻量协调下NLIP比基线A2A-SDK快8.4-9.6倍（两台环境）及约4倍（第三台）；端到端流程因LLM推理主导而接近持平。差异几乎全部源于连接建立。连接缓存可将差距缩小（从2.75倍到近乎持平，快速硬件上规模扩展时缓存优化A2A-SDK可追平NLIP）。对Python-A2A，NLIP仍快约4倍。
AI.conclusion: 协议性能差异具有阶段特异性并依赖硬件，缓存优化可弥补部分差距；论文未对残余发送阶段成本给出单一因果解释，最后提出按工作负载特征选择协议的指南。

title: GPU-Accelerated Bregman Douglas-Rachford Splitting for Discrete Optimal Transport
summary: We present GPU-accelerated Bregman Douglas--Rachford splitting algorithm (BDRS) for discrete optimal transport problem in three input formats: an explicit cost matrix, a point cloud with a ground cost between them, and a separable cost on a regular grid. For each input format, we propose hardware-aware designs of mathematically equivalent representations for the BDRS iterations to enhance numerical stability and empirical runtime. We benchmark the three proposed implementations against eight GPU baseline solvers from the literature on the same device. We demonstrate that our implementations of BDRS achieve state-of-the-art performance on their respective input formats. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first cross-solver study of GPU DOT solvers with a unified measure of optimality.

AI.tldr: 提出GPU加速的Bregman Douglas-Rachford分裂算法(BDRS)，针对离散最优传输的三种输入格式给出硬件感知设计，并在统一最优性度量下与八个GPU基线求解器对比，取得各自格式上的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 离散最优传输(DOT)求解在GPU上有多种实现，但缺乏在统一最优性度量下的跨求解器系统对比，且不同输入格式需要针对硬件的高效表示。
AI.method: 提出GPU加速Bregman Douglas-Rachford分裂算法(BDRS)，针对三种输入格式(显式代价矩阵、点云及其间的基本代价、规则网格上可分代价)分别设计数学等价的硬件感知迭代表示，以提升数值稳定性与运行时间。
AI.result: 在同一设备上与文献中八个GPU基线求解器进行基准测试，BDRS实现在各自输入格式上达到最先进性能；这是首个采用统一最优性度量的GPU DOT求解器跨求解器研究。
AI.conclusion: 硬件感知的BDRS实现在各输入格式上优于现有GPU DOT求解器，并为GPU DOT求解器提供了统一度量的对比基准。

title: Approximate Feedback Nash Equilibria in Constrained Differential Games via Model Predictive Control with Upper Bound Guarantees
summary: Physical human--machine interaction and other multi-agent control settings require decision-making policies that adapt online. Differential games provide a principled framework where each agent optimizes an individual objective while anticipating the other's response. The relevant solution concept in many applications is the feedback Nash equilibrium (FNE), which yields time-consistent state-feedback strategies. However, computing the FNE is demanding and becomes intractable when state and input constraints must be enforced, motivating the need for approximate methods. This paper presents a Model Predictive Control (MPC) approach that approximates infinite-horizon FNE trajectories through repeated solution of finite-horizon open-loop games. An auxiliary-game formulation is introduced that selects prediction horizons and terminal costs to approximate the feedback-game optimality conditions. The approach is extended to incorporate hard constraints via a constrained open-loop game formulation. For the unconstrained setting, an analytic upper bound on the state-trajectory deviation between the MPC-induced and FNE trajectories is derived, enabling quantitative performance certification. Numerical examples illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with baseline approaches from the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于模型预测控制(MPC)的方法，用有限时域开环博弈的重复求解来近似无限时域反馈纳什均衡(FNE)轨迹，并给出无约束情形下的误差上界及约束扩展。
AI.motivation: 在人机交互等多智能体控制中，策略需在线自适应；微分博弈的反馈纳什均衡(FNE)虽提供时间一致的状态反馈解，但当状态和输入存在约束时计算变得不可行，因此需要近似方法。
AI.method: 采用MPC框架，通过重复求解有限时域开环博弈来近似无限时域FNE轨迹；引入辅助博弈表述，通过选择预测时域和终端代价来逼近反馈博弈的最优性条件；并通过约束开环博弈形式扩展到硬约束情形。
AI.result: 在无约束情形下，推导出MPC诱导轨迹与FNE轨迹之间状态偏差的解析上界，可实现定量的性能认证；数值算例表明该方法优于文献中的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效近似FNE并支持硬约束处理，且提供可量化的性能保证，适用于人机交互等多智能体在线决策场景。

title: Probabilistic Algorithms for Ising Machines from Optimization to Generative AI
summary: Ising machines have emerged as promising hardware accelerators for intractable optimization and sampling problems, yet their practical impact increasingly hinges on the co-design of algorithms and hardware, where algorithmic demands shape new architectures and new hardware capabilities inspire entirely new algorithms. In this Review, we survey probabilistic algorithms designed for portability across diverse Ising platforms, advocating a top-down perspective that prioritizes principled methods with provable guarantees. We cover foundational methods such as simulated annealing and parallel tempering, including two-dimensional extensions that natively encode hard constraints, and examine approaches that expand the scale of solvable problems from cluster mean-field methods to variational samplers. We highlight the Probabilistic Approximate Optimization Algorithm (PAOA), a classical analog of QAOA that emerged directly from probabilistic hardware development, and explore how generative AI and Ising machines might reinforce each other: learned models propose global moves to accelerate optimization, while probabilistic techniques improve inference in large language models. Much as quantum computing has seen algorithms co-evolve with hardware, probabilistic and Ising computing stand at a similar inflection point. We outline a co-design framework for accelerating the capabilities and adoption of next-generation Ising machines.

AI.tldr: 本文综述Ising机上可移植的概率算法，主张算法-硬件协同设计，并展望生成式AI与Ising机的相互促进。
AI.motivation: Ising机的实际影响力取决于算法与硬件的协同设计，算法需求塑造新架构，新硬件能力也催生新算法，因此需要从算法与硬件共同演进的角度系统梳理。
AI.method: 采用自上而下、强调可证明保证的视角，综述可跨多种Ising平台移植的概率算法，包括模拟退火、并行回火及其二维扩展、聚类平均场、变分采样器，并重点介绍源自概率硬件开发的PAOA。
AI.result: 梳理了从基础方法到扩展问题规模的各类概率算法，揭示PAOA作为QAOA经典类比的地位，并探讨生成式AI与Ising机在全局移动加速优化和改善大语言模型推理方面的互补关系。
AI.conclusion: 概率与Ising计算正处于类似量子计算的算法-硬件协同演进拐点，本文提出一个协同设计框架以加速下一代Ising机能力的提升与推广。

title: Understanding Generative AI Use in Programming MOOCs: The Role of Course Context and Learner Characteristics
summary: The increasing availability of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools, such as ChatGPT and code-completion assistants, raises questions about how learners integrate these tools into learning activities, particularly in MOOCs that attract diverse participant populations. This study examines the use of GenAI in two programming MOOCs taught in Estonian that differ in duration, workload, topic complexity, and assignment volume: About Programming (4 weeks, 26 expected hours, n = 187) and Introduction to Programming (8 weeks, 78 expected hours, n = 182). Post-course questionnaire data were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods to examine self-reported adoption, usage frequency, and purposes of GenAI use across courses and learner backgrounds. The results show that GenAI adoption was widespread in both MOOCs, with no statistically significant differences by gender, age, education level, or prior programming experience. However, participants in the longer, more extensive MOOC reported significantly higher usage frequency and were more likely to use GenAI for debugging and idea generation. Reported usage frequency for code explanation and debugging was also higher in the longer course. Exploratory analyses found limited relationships between GenAI use and learning-related outcomes. The findings suggest that course context may play a greater role than learner characteristics in shaping how GenAI tools are used. These results provide implications for instructional design and guidance in programming education.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过问卷分析两门爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC，发现GenAI使用广泛且与学习者背景无关，而课程情境（时长、复杂度）显著影响使用频率与用途。
AI.motivation: GenAI工具（如ChatGPT、代码补全助手）日益普及，学习者在MOOC等多元人群中如何整合这些工具尚不清楚，尤其缺少对不同课程情境下使用差异的研究。
AI.method: 针对两门爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC（"About Programming"：4周、26小时、n=187；"Introduction to Programming"：8周、78小时、n=182），采用课后问卷数据，运用非参数统计方法分析自报的GenAI采用率、使用频率与用途，并对比课程及学习者背景差异。
AI.result: 两门MOOC中GenAI采用率均很高，且按性别、年龄、教育程度、先前编程经验无显著差异；但更长、内容更广的课程中，使用频率显著更高，更常用于调试与构思，代码解释和调试的频率也更高。探索性分析显示GenAI使用与学习成果关系有限。
AI.conclusion: 课程情境可能比学习者特征更能影响GenAI工具的使用方式，为编程教育的教学设计与引导提供启示。

title: Gaussian Limits for SGD Without Stationary Moments
summary: Temporal dependence can separate the Gaussian approximation of stochastic gradient descent from its stationary moments. For unmodified least-squares SGD, we construct a design with standard Gaussian marginals whose stationary error has every positive moment infinite. Independent observations with the same marginals instead give finite stationary variance. Both regimes retain a Gaussian small-step limit. Our general theory establishes pathwise contraction from a finite second design moment, then uses score cancellation and localization to obtain stationary Gaussian and Ornstein--Uhlenbeck limits. Independent Gaussian regression errors yield an exact conditional Gaussian law and total-variation convergence under the same design integrability. Stronger design conditions identify a positive first-order total-variation constant and a deterministic covariance correction with $o(a)$ error. A scalar coverage expansion translates this correction into its inference consequence. Experiments examine distributional error, coverage, and calibration with dependent scores. Together, these results establish precise probability-law approximation beyond moment-based stationary analysis.

AI.tldr: 论文研究时序相依性对SGD平稳分布高斯近似的根本影响，证明未修正的最小二乘SGD在标准高斯边缘设计下平稳误差的所有正阶矩均为无穷，而独立观测下方差有限，并给出一般理论刻画高斯与OU极限、总变差收敛、协方差修正及其推断后果。
AI.motivation: 现有时序SGD分析多依赖矩和方差，难以区分带时序相依与独立观测的平稳分布行为。作者希望超越基于矩的平稳分析，精确刻画概率律近似，揭示时序相依对高斯近似的破坏作用。
AI.method: 构造具有标准高斯边缘的设计，对比未修正最小二乘SGD与独立观测的平稳误差。建立一般理论：从有限二阶设计矩出发得到路径收缩性，结合score cancellation与局部化推导平稳高斯极限及Ornstein–Uhlenbeck极限。独立高斯回归误差下证明条件高斯律与总变差收敛；在更强设计条件下确定一阶总变差常数与确定性协方差修正，误差为o(a)，并通过标量覆盖展开联系到推断后果。
AI.result: 未修正最小二乘SGD在标准高斯边缘设计下平稳误差的每个正阶矩均为无穷，而相同边缘的独立观测平稳方差有限，且两者均保持高斯小步长极限。独立高斯回归误差给出精确条件高斯律与总变差收敛。更强设计条件下得到正的一阶总变差常数与o(a)精度的确定性协方差修正，并将修正转化为覆盖率的推断影响。实验考察分布误差、覆盖率与带有相依score的校准。
AI.conclusion: 时序相依性使基于矩的平稳分析失效，可导致平稳误差矩发散。论文提供了超越矩分析的精确概率律近似理论，刻画SGD平稳分布的高斯/OU极限、总变差收敛及协方差修正，并揭示其对统计推断覆盖率的实际影响。

title: Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable, Resource-Aware Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI). 19 pages, 7 figures
summary: LLM agents for clinical text-to-SQL applications reason autonomously over multiple steps but cannot assess whether their own reasoning or outputs can be trusted. In high leverage applications such as healthcare, this presents a critical risk where system mistakes can be costly. These reliability failures are also resource failures: an incorrect reasoning trajectory spends computation budget on outputs that must be discarded. We introduce Sentinel, a trajectory-derived, classifier-based confidence layer that analyzes an agent's reasoning, code and database outputs to decide at three points whether to stop: refusing unanswerable questions before the agent runs, halting doomed trajectories mid-run, and withholding untrustworthy answers at delivery. Here, utilizing Chow's rule, we optimize decisions under the EHRSQL shared task's Reliability Score, which penalizes incorrect answers given a utility weighting, and find on the benchmark EHRSQL that Sentinel raises this score from +0.08 to +0.24 when mistakes have a low utility weighting, well above the +0.03 earned by refusing every question, with delivered-answer accuracy rising from 54% to 69% as coverage falls from 84% to 55%. At higher stakes the agents we test rarely answer reliably enough to deliver, and Sentinel detects this on its own, abstaining to that same +0.03 where the unmonitored agent scores -3.02. The same stopping decisions cut computation: at low stakes, where the system still answers, Sentinel eliminates 13-28% of agent steps at little or no reliability cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sentinel——基于轨迹分类器的置信层，在三个决策点判断 LLM agent 临床 text-to-SQL 是否可信并选择停止，兼顾可靠性提升与算力节省。
AI.motivation: 临床 text-to-SQL 的 LLM agent 虽能多步自主推理，但无法自评推理与输出是否可信；在医疗高风险场景中错误代价大，且错误推理轨迹还会浪费算力预算。
AI.method: Sentinel 是基于轨迹导出的分类器置信层，分析 agent 的推理、代码与数据库输出，在三个时点决策：运行前拒答不可回答问题、运行中终止注定失败的轨迹、交付时扣留不可信答案；并利用 Chow 规则在 EHRSQL 的 Reliability Score 下优化决策。
AI.result: 在 EHRSQL 上，低风险加权时 Reliability Score 从 +0.08 提升至 +0.24（远高于全部拒答的 +0.03），交付答案准确率由 54% 升至 69%，覆盖率由 84% 降至 55%；高风险时 agent 几乎无法可靠交付，Sentinel 自动弃答至 +0.03，而未监控 agent 为 -3.02；同时减少 13-28% 的 agent 步骤且几乎不损可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹导出的置信层能有效监测 LLM agent 的可靠性，在高风险场景中通过主动停止避免错误并节省算力，实现可靠性收益与资源节约的双重目标。

title: Discrete Diffusion for Large Graph Generation via Structural Candidate Restriction
summary: Synthesizing realistic graphs at scale is vital when the graphs of interest are large and real-world samples are limited or access-sensitive. Diffusion-based generators have recently driven much of the progress, offering high modeling capacity, but most such methods have quadratic computational complexity and are hence restricted to small-scale networks, currently up to 3k nodes. Existing non-quadratic methods remain limited by memorization issues and a trade-off between scalability and generation quality. Our goal is to generate large graphs whose structural statistics --- e.g., degree distribution, clustering, and path length --- faithfully reflect those of real-world sparse graphs, without resorting to memorizing the training data. We introduce a discrete graph diffusion model that restricts training to a structurally motivated subset of node pairs --- observed edges and their wedge non-edges --- reducing training complexity below quadratic in the number of nodes. To keep the noisy graph informative throughout both the forward and reverse trajectories, we design a three-class absorbing forward process governed by a \emph{degree-aware, floored} cosine noise schedule: unlike a structure-blind schedule that adds noise to every pair identically, ours adapts to each node's degree and never fully erases the graph's structure, keeping the noisy graph informative at every step. Experiments across diverse datasets show that our model consistently ranks among the top methods for structural fidelity against existing discrete diffusion baselines in large graph generation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种离散图扩散模型，将训练限制在观测边及其楔形非边这一结构驱动的节点对子集上，并设计度感知、带下限的余弦噪声调度，使训练复杂度低于二次，实现大规模稀疏图的真实生成。
AI.motivation: 大规模真实图难以获取（样本有限或访问敏感），合成真实图至关重要。现有扩散生成器建模能力强但多为二次复杂度，仅能处理至多3k节点的网络；非二次方法则受记忆化问题及可扩展性与生成质量权衡的限制。
AI.method: 1) 离散图扩散模型，仅在观测边及其楔形非边这一结构驱动的节点对子集上训练，使训练复杂度低于节点数的二次；2) 三分类吸收式前向过程；3) 度感知、带下限的余弦噪声调度，替代对所有节点对同等加噪的结构盲调度，使含噪图在正向与反向轨迹中始终保留结构信息。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该模型在大图生成的结构保真度方面，相较现有离散扩散基线始终位列最优方法之一。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构驱动的节点对采样与度感知噪声调度，可在避免记忆化训练数据的同时，生成结构统计（度分布、聚类系数、路径长度）忠实反映真实稀疏图的大规模图。

title: Safe Leader-Follower Density Control via Higher-Order Mean-Field Control Barrier Functions
summary: Safety filters for large-scale multi-agent systems can be formulated at the population level through mean-field control barrier functions (MF-CBFs). Most existing formulations are first-order, requiring the control input to appear explicitly in the first time derivative of the safety functional; higher-order extensions have only very recently been proposed for a single, directly actuated population. We consider instead the case in which the population to be kept safe is not directly actuated, but is transported by a field generated by a second, controlled population. For this setting, we develop a higher-order MF-CBF framework for density dynamics with safety constraints of relative degree larger than one. Our main result is that indirect actuation of this kind does not destroy the control-affine structure of the safety condition: the control-dependent part of the second time derivative of the safety functional is obtained in closed form and is linear in the control velocity field, with a kernel given by the actuated density times the spatial gradient of a first variation. Relative-degree-two safety constraints can therefore still be enforced through a convex quadratic program. We then specialize the framework to a leader-follower density control problem in the presence of dangerous regions, where safety is ensured by keeping the overlap of each population with those regions below a prescribed threshold. We show that the follower safety functional has relative degree two with respect to the leader control field, while the leader safety functional has relative degree one. We further characterize exactly when the two simultaneous constraints are infeasible, introduce an adaptive-gain mechanism to mitigate potential conflicts, and bound the tracking errors induced by the safety correction. Numerical simulations in cluttered environments illustrate the resulting safety-performance trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文为间接驱动种群的密度动力学提出高阶平均场控制障碍函数(MF-CBF)框架，证明相对阶为二的约束仍保持控制仿射结构，可通过凸二次规划实现，并应用于领导者-跟随者密度控制问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MF-CBF多数是一阶的，需要控制输入显式出现在安全泛函的一阶时间导数中；高阶扩展仅针对单一、直接驱动的种群。本文关注被安全的种群不被直接驱动，而是由受控的第二个种群所产生的场来输运的情形。
AI.method: 针对相对阶大于一的密度动力学构造高阶MF-CBF框架。推导安全泛函二阶时间导数中依赖控制的部分，证明其关于控制速度场是线性的，核为被驱动密度乘以一阶变分的空间梯度。将该框架特化到危险区域下的领导者-跟随者密度控制问题，其中安全性通过使各群体与危险区域的重叠低于阈值来保证。
AI.result: 证明间接驱动不破坏安全条件的控制仿射结构，相对阶为二的约束仍可通过凸二次规划施加。表明跟随者安全泛函相对领导者控制场具有相对阶二，而领导者安全泛函相对阶为一。精确刻画了两个同时约束不可行的条件，引入自适应增益机制缓解冲突，并对安全修正引起的跟踪误差给出界。杂乱环境中的数值仿真展示了安全-性能权衡。
AI.conclusion: 间接驱动下的高阶MF-CBF为不可直接驱动种群的密度安全控制提供了可行框架，安全约束的凸QP实现、不可行性刻画、自适应增益与误差界共同构成一套可用的安全-性能折中方案。

title: Differentiable Ternary Temporal Logic Semantics with Polynomial Surrogate Networks
summary: Temporal logic provides designers a formal reasoning tool for specifying complex spatio-temporal behaviors and tasks for autonomous systems. Many techniques exist for control synthesis according to temporal logic specifications, spanning a large variety of systems, including robotics. However, the vast majority of implementations are limited to Boolean temporal logics. Boolean temporal logic does not have an innate mechanism for quantifying abstention, rather verdicts are either definitively \textit{True} or \textit{False}. Recent work demonstrates that ternary logic is a capable formalism for reasoning about robotic behaviors, with the natural ability to classify uncertainty with the \textit{Unknown} literal. Ternary temporal logic is still in its infancy, with work limited to synthesis for linear systems and monitoring. This work proposes a probabilistic relaxation of ternary temporal logic that allows for value and gradient computation through the same network while retaining exact verdicts on actual data. The relaxed network can be used as an objective in gradient-based control synthesis for both offline and online robotic control applications. We demonstrate the utility of our framework with two robotic manipulator tasks, one offline and one online, involving intermediate checking and sequencing of subtasks to demonstrate the benefit of our approach in terms of correct and timely execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出三元时序逻辑的概率松弛方法，可对网络进行值与梯度计算，同时在实际数据上保持精确判定，用于离线与在线机器人控制的梯度合成。
AI.motivation: 现有时序逻辑控制合成多局限于布尔逻辑，无法量化"弃权/未知"；三元时序逻辑虽能分类不确定性，但研究尚处初期，仅限于线性系统合成与监控。
AI.method: 提出三元时序逻辑的概率松弛，使同一网络可进行值与梯度计算，同时在实际数据上保留精确判定；将松弛网络作为梯度控制合成的目标函数，支持离线与在线机器人控制。
AI.result: 通过两个机械臂任务（一个离线、一个在线），涉及子任务的中间检查与排序，验证了方法在正确性与及时执行方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效扩展了三元时序逻辑，实现了可用于离线与在线机器人控制的梯度合成，提升了执行的正确性与及时性。

title: Learning Latent Protein Languages for Autoregressive Generation
summary: Autoregressive transformers remain comparatively weak for protein sequence and structure generation. We study the role of target representation: amino acid tokens encode residue identities without explicit contextual semantics, while backbone coordinates require a discrete representation in our framework. We introduce two learned latent protein languages. Protein Latent Language (PLL) maps sequences to a 4,096-state contextual alphabet built on a frozen ESM-2 encoder, with one token per residue. Structure Latent Language (SLL) adapts GCP-VQVAE Lite with auxiliary sequence and confidence supervision while retaining decoding to backbone coordinates. We separately pretrain autoregressive transformer models on PLL and SLL tokens using next-token prediction, yielding PLLM and SLLM. Under matched downstream sequence training, PLLM has a fitted compute-scaling exponent of 0.038 versus 0.020 for the amino acid autoregressive model. In unconditional sequence generation, PLLM reduces the fraction of samples below a heuristic 1.5-bit residue-composition entropy threshold by 54% relative to the amino acid model across sampling temperatures. For sequence-to-structure prediction, replacing the original GCP-VQVAE Lite tokenizer with SLL reduces best validation perplexity by 34% under matched training. For long proteins, latent-token sampling is approximately 1,000 times faster than MSA-based AlphaFold2 in our measurements. In backbone generation, SLLM compares favorably with other generative models on diversity and novelty. We also observe early signs that using SLLM's internal token confidence for inference-time sampling can improve sequence-to-structure prediction quality beyond a single decoded sample. These results position learned latent protein languages as a promising substrate for autoregressive transformer scaling and inference-time sampling in protein generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种学习的潜在蛋白语言（PLL和SLL），用离散潜在token替代氨基酸token和骨架坐标，预训练自回归Transformer（PLLM、SLLM），在序列和结构生成上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 自回归Transformer在蛋白质序列和结构生成上表现相对较弱。作者认为关键在于目标表示：氨基酸token只编码残基身份而缺乏显式上下文语义，而骨架坐标又需要离散化表示。
AI.method: 提出两种潜在蛋白语言：PLL基于冻结的ESM-2编码器将序列映射为4096状态的上下文词表，每个残基一个token；SLL改造GCP-VQVAE Lite，加入序列和置信度辅助监督，保留骨架坐标解码。分别在PLL和SLL token上用下一token预测预训练自回归Transformer，得到PLLM和SLLM。
AI.result: 匹配下游序列训练下，PLLM的计算缩放指数为0.038，优于氨基酸模型的0.020；无条件序列生成中，低于1.5比特残基组成熵阈值的样本比例降低54%。序列到结构预测中，用SLL替换原tokenizer使最佳验证困惑度降低34%。长蛋白上潜在token采样比基于MSA的AlphaFold2快约1000倍。骨架生成中SLLM在多样性和新颖性上有竞争力，且用SLLM内部token置信度做推理采样可提升序列到结构预测质量。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的潜在蛋白语言是有前景的基底，可支持自回归Transformer的缩放和蛋白生成中的推理时采样。

title: Inductive Claims Extraction at Scale
summary: A large part of political discourse on social media is built and expressed at a level of claims: i.e. declarative, typically single-clause statements, which convey a particular interpretation of reality and can range from factual to evaluative. Moreover, rather than occurring randomly, claims coalesce, recur in patterns, and come to be associated with different world views. When paired with structural computational tools such as Social Network Analysis, claims can be a powerful unit of analysis to study political phenomena such as echo chambers or polarisation. In this paper, we present a pipeline that uses a large language model (LLM) to inductively extract and catalogue claims from large social media corpora, and apply it to two different Twitter datasets: one relating to the 2020 US presidential election and the other to the 2022 FIFA World Cup. We comprehensively evaluate the approach by measuring the pipeline's recall and precision against manually annotated samples, run ablation studies isolating the contribution of its various components, and perform a qualitative error analysis. We discuss the value of the approach in the context of Computational Social Science research, and illustrate its capabilities by presenting the claims catalogue obtained from each dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型从大型社交媒体语料中归纳式提取与编目"主张"(claims)的流程，并在2020美国大选和2022世界杯两个Twitter数据集上验证，展示了其在计算社会科学中分析回音室与极化的潜力。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体政治话语多以"主张"（陈述性、单句、承载特定现实解读）为基本单元，且这些主张会聚合、复现并关联不同世界观。将主张与社交网络分析等结构计算工具结合，可作为研究回音室、极化等政治现象的有力分析单元。
AI.method: 构建一条基于大语言模型(LLM)的流程，从大型社交媒体语料中归纳式提取并编目主张；在2020美国大选和2022 FIFA世界杯两个Twitter数据集上应用；通过人工标注样本测量召回率与精确率、进行消融研究以分离各组件贡献，并开展定性错误分析。
AI.result: 流程在两个数据集上均得到评估；提供了召回率与精确率指标、各组件消融结果和定性错误分析，并展示了从每个数据集中获得的主张编目(catalogue)。
AI.conclusion: 该LLM驱动的流程能有效提取与编目社交媒体主张，对计算社会科学研究具有重要价值，可支持回音室、极化等政治现象的分析。

title: Two-Sample Testing via Path-based Inference
summary: Modern deep generative models are primarily studied for their ability to generate realistic samples, yet the generative dynamics they learn can also serve as objects of statistical inference. We develop this idea for two-sample testing, the problem of deciding whether the same distribution generated two finite datasets. Using stochastic interpolants, we connect both distributions to a shared Gaussian bottleneck, so that each half of the resulting path is a Gaussian channel acting on a single population. We prove that the null hypothesis holds if and only if the population denoiser, or equivalently, the velocity fields of the two halves, coincide at any single noise level, which amounts to a reflection symmetry of the path about the bottleneck. Deviations from this symmetry yield a continuum of two-sample witnesses, which we estimate via held-out regression risks on learned denoisers and velocities and aggregate along the path; under an information-theoretic weighting, the aggregated discrepancy equals the Jeffreys divergence between the noise-smoothed distributions. Calibrating the resulting statistics by permutation yields tests that are valid in finite samples for any trained networks and consistent when the fields are learned accurately. On a synthetic benchmark and three image benchmarks, the proposed tests improve power over the strongest baseline by up to 33 percentage points at an equal total sample budget, with the best choice of regression representation and path weighting depending on the data modality. These results show that generative paths provide a principled representation for statistical testing, extending stochastic-interpolant models beyond generation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出利用随机插值(STOCHASTIC INTERPOLANTS)将两个分布连接到共享高斯瓶颈，通过路径反射对称性构造双样本检验统计量，该统计量与噪声平滑分布间的Jeffreys散度等价，在合成及3个图像基准上功率最高提升33个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现代深度生成模型主要被研究其生成逼真样本的能力，但模型学习到的生成动力学本身也可作为统计推断的对象；作者希望将这一视角推广到双样本检验问题（判断两个有限数据集是否来自同一分布）。
AI.method: 利用随机插值将两分布映射到共享高斯瓶颈，使路径每一半构成作用在同一总体上的高斯信道；证明零假设成立当且仅当总体去噪器（等价地两半的速度场）在任意单一噪声水平上重合，即路径关于瓶颈的反射对称性。偏离该对称性产生连续统的双样本见证量，通过留出回归风险在学习的去噪器/速度场上估计并沿路径聚合；在信息论加权下聚合差异等于噪声平滑分布间的Jeffreys散度。用置换校准统计量，保证有限样本有效性，且在速度场学习准确时一致。
AI.result: 在合成基准和三个图像基准上，相同总样本预算下该检验相比最强基线功率提升最多33个百分点；最佳回归表示与路径加权方式取决于数据模态。
AI.conclusion: 生成路径为统计检验提供了有原则的表示，将随机插值模型的应用从生成扩展到统计推断领域。

title: Can LLMs Separate Pasted Artifacts from User Speech? Absorption at Unmarked Prompt Seams
summary: Large language models (LLMs) receive each user message as plain text, even when it combines text from different sources. For example, a user may paste text into a prompt and keep typing a comment directly below it. We study absorption: a phenomenon where the model treats a trailing user comment as part of the pasted text, returning it inside the edited text. This happens even though the user did not intend the comment to become part of that text. Existing instruction-data separation benchmarks tell the model which text is instruction and which is data, then test whether it obeys that separation. They do not test harmless user speech following an unmarked paste. We introduce SEAM, a controlled benchmark of 300 editing examples. Each example is tested under six matched conditions that vary how the boundary between pasted text and later user speech is expressed. Across 20 models, absorption at a bare newline ranges from 7.7% to 66.7%. Adding a blank line does not significantly reduce absorption in any model, while boundary markers reduce it in 19 of 20 models. Comments that fit the pasted text, such as a code comment typed after code, are absorbed significantly more often in 17 of 20 models. Models often fail to separate pasted material from later user speech, and explicit boundaries reduce but do not remove this failure.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM的"吸收"现象：模型将粘贴文本后紧跟的用户评论误当作粘贴内容的一部分，并为此提出SEAM基准进行测量。
AI.motivation: 用户消息常混合不同来源的文本（如粘贴文本+下方评论），但现有指令-数据分离基准会明确告知模型何为指令、何为数据，无法测试"无标记粘贴后跟随无害用户话语"的真实场景。
AI.method: 提出SEAM：包含300个编辑示例的受控基准，每个示例在6种匹配条件下测试（改变粘贴文本与后续用户话语边界的表达方式），覆盖20个模型。
AI.result: 裸换行下吸收率为7.7%–66.7%；加空行在全部模型中均无显著降低；边界标记在20个模型中19个有效降低吸收；与粘贴文本风格契合的评论（如代码后接代码注释）在17个模型中显著更易被吸收。
AI.conclusion: 模型常无法区分粘贴材料与后续用户话语，显式边界可减少但无法消除这一失败。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Comparative Evidence for Social Intelligence
summary: Developing socially intelligent AI remains heavily dependent on human-annotated data, limiting the scale and breadth of social understanding models can acquire. Methods that derive training signals from unlabeled data offer a path beyond this dependence, but social predictions lack the verification oracles available in mathematics and coding. Moreover, core social targets such as affect, intent, preference, and pragmatic meaning are often ambiguous. The same behavior can support multiple plausible interpretations, making it difficult to verify which is best supported. To address this challenge, we introduce Reinforcement Learning with Comparative Evidence (RLCE), a reinforcement learning method that learns social understanding from unlabeled training data without constructing rewards from ground-truth annotations. Given distinct answers in a rollout group, RLCE constructs evidence tests that identify observable evidence favoring an answer over another, validates these tests against the input sample, and aggregates test outcomes to determine the best-supported interpretation. Tests are regenerated as the policy produces new answers, enabling them to evolve with the policy. Across four benchmarks spanning affect, pragmatics, communicative intent, and preference, RLCE attains the strongest performance among seven methods that use no ground-truth training labels for rewards, including consensus, policy LLM-judge verification, multimodal co-evolution, and rubric-based rewards. Gains over the strongest baseline reach up to +18.93 points. Analyses further show that RLCE exhibits a larger share of reward variation between correct and incorrect predictions than compared rubric methods, can overturn erroneous policy-derived preferences, and benefits from pairwise test construction, compositional test aggregation, and on-policy test evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出RLCE，一种无需标注的强化学习方法，通过构建比较性证据测试来学习社会智能，在四个基准上超越现有无标注方法。
AI.motivation: 社会智能AI依赖人工标注数据，限制了规模与广度；无标注方法虽有前景，但社会预测缺乏数学/代码中的验证预言机，且情感、意图等目标本身模糊，同一行为可有多种合理解释，难以验证哪个更被支持。
AI.method: 提出Reinforcement Learning with Comparative Evidence (RLCE)。在rollout组内针对不同答案，构建证据测试以识别支持某一答案优于另一答案的可观察证据，并将测试对输入样本进行验证，再聚合测试结果以确定最佳支持的解读；随着策略产生新答案，测试会重新生成并随策略演化。
AI.result: 在涵盖情感、语用、交际意图和偏好的四个基准上，RLCE在七种不依赖真实标签构造奖励的方法中表现最佳，包含共识、策略LLM-judge验证、多模态协同演化和基于rubric的奖励等，相对最强基线提升最高达+18.93分。分析显示RLCE在正确与错误预测间的奖励变异占比高于rubric方法，能推翻错误的策略衍生偏好，并受益于成对测试构建、组合式测试聚合与在策略测试演化。
AI.conclusion: RLCE无需真实标注即可从无标签数据中学习社会理解，通过比较性证据实现可验证奖励，显著优于同类无监督奖励方法，并具备可演化性与可解释的分析优势。

title: Global Optimization of Mixed-Integer Bound-Constrained Quadratic Fractional Problems
summary: We study mixed-integer quadratic fractional optimization problems with binary and continuous box-constrained variables. The objective is the ratio of two quadratic functions, a structure that arises naturally in portfolio selection, signal processing, and data analytics. We propose an exact algorithm based on Dinkelbach's parametric reformulation. At each Dinkelbach iteration, the fractional problem is replaced by a nonconvex mixed-integer quadratic subproblem with box constraints. This subproblem is solved globally by a specialized branch-and-bound solver. To accelerate the outer scheme, we use a Variable Neighborhood Search heuristic to provide an initial feasible solution to the Dinkelbach scheme. The heuristic alternates between continuous local searches and a binary-space exploration phase in which the continuous variables of a feasible incumbent are fixed. Numerical results show that the proposed approach outperforms general-purpose exact algorithms based on Dinkelbach's parametric reformulation.

AI.tldr: 针对含二进制与连续箱约束的混合整数二次分式优化问题，提出基于Dinkelbach参数化重构的精确算法，结合专用分支定界与变量邻域搜索启发式加速，实验优于通用精确算法。
AI.motivation: 这类问题在投资组合选择、信号处理与数据分析中自然出现，目标为两个二次函数之比，结构复杂且具非凸性，缺乏高效的精确求解方法。
AI.method: 采用Dinkelbach参数化重构迭代求解；每步将分式问题转为带箱约束的非凸混合整数二次子问题，由专用分支定界全局求解；并用变量邻域搜索启发式（交替连续局部搜索与固定连续变量的二进制空间探索）提供初始可行解以加速外层循环。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，所提方法优于基于Dinkelbach参数化重构的通用精确算法。
AI.conclusion: 结合精确分支定界与启发式加速的Dinkelbach框架能有效求解混合整数二次分式优化问题。

title: Feasibility of Simultaneous Input-Output Constraints for Tracking in a Class of LTI Systems: Part II
summary: This paper illustrates the properties of a new CBF-governor that enables simultaneous input and output constraint satisfaction for a class of multi-input linear time-invariant systems with state feedback and integral action. This governor is designed so as to modify the reference command while preserving the nominal feedback controller. Necessary and sufficient conditions are derived in a companion paper under which the governor is shown to be feasible at every state of a prescribed operating set and ensures simultaneous input and output constraint satisfaction, forward invariance, and bounded closed-loop solutions. These theoretical results are illustrated in this paper through several numerical examples. In each of these examples, we show how the goals of the CBF-governor are met and corroborate the corresponding necessary and sufficient condition. The computational burden associated with the proposed CBF-governor is also articulated, with its online component comparable to either that of a QP solver or determined using an exact closed-form solution.
