AI.motivation: 标准bCBF依赖有限时域预测下的不变备份集作为终端集，但为到达小终端集往往需要长预测时域，增加在线预测成本。因此需要一种在固定预测时域下扩大终端集的方法。
AI.method: 提出在线构建方法：从沿备份轨迹存储的集合构建认证区域，存储有限个球集，将新认证球集连接到备份集或已存储球集；推导保证这些球集与备份集之并在固定备份控制器下前向不变的条件，且保证每个存储状态有限时间内到达备份集；将该并集作为扩大的终端集，并建立可行的二次规划进行安全控制。
AI.result: 推导的条件保证并集前向不变及有限时间到达备份集；所提二次规划可行，且随着在线存储更多认证集合仍保持安全性；四旋翼仿真显示相比标准bCBF，可在更短预测时域下安全完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 在线构建的认证球集并集可有效扩大bCBF终端集，在固定且更短的预测时域下保持安全性，降低在线预测成本，并在四旋翼任务中验证有效性。

title: Articulatory Entrainment and Coordination Complexity in Spontaneous Autistic and Non-autistic Dialogue
comment: Accepted to be published in Interspeech 2026
summary: Articulatory entrainment, the adaptation of vocal tract coordination to facilitate interaction remains underexplored in spontaneous dialogue, particularly among autistic speakers. Many prior studies have utilized task-based, phoneme-level analyses with invasive measurement techniques. Here, we introduce a speaker-independent framework to quantify articulatory entrainment in spontaneous dyadic conversations among autistic and non-autistic adults using acoustic-to-articulatory inversion and coordination complexity metrics. We examine temporal changes in articulatory coordination across interaction. Non-autistic dyads exhibit increasing coordination complexity and stronger entrainment over time, autistic dyads show moderate effects, and mixed dyads demonstrate the least alignment. Greater articulatory entrainment correlates with higher self-reported conversational success, indicating increase in coordination complexity as a marker of effective social interaction.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个说话人无关的框架，利用声学到发音反演和协调复杂度指标，量化自闭症与非自闭症成人在自发对话中的发音同步现象，并发现发音同步与对话成功感正相关。
AI.motivation: 发音同步（articulatory entrainment）在自发对话中研究不足，尤其针对自闭症说话者。以往研究多采用任务导向、音素级别的分析以及侵入式测量手段，限制了对自然互动的理解。
AI.method: 提出说话人无关框架，对自闭症和非自闭症成人二元自发对话进行声学到发音反演，并采用协调复杂度指标，考察互动过程中发音协调的时间变化。
AI.result: 非自闭症二元组随时间表现出协调复杂度增加和更强的同步；自闭症二元组效应中等；混合二元组对齐程度最低。更强的发音同步与更高的自评对话成功度相关。
AI.conclusion: 协调复杂度的增加可作为有效社会互动的标志，发音同步能够反映对话质量，为自闭症社交互动研究提供了非侵入式的量化途径。

title: On the Comparison of Optimizers for Imbalanced Learning
summary: Data imbalance is pervasive in machine learning, from rare words and anomalies to underrepresented patterns in heterogeneous or cross-tabulated data. We study idealized optimizers geometries in continuous time to model small-step training in deep learning. We assume that the source of imbalance is unobserved: the optimizer has only access to the aggregate training loss ignoring the exact contributions of the majority and minority groups. In this setting, we characterize a region where majority losses are optimized regardless of the admissible minority structure. We derive explicit equations of this zone and bounds on the time needed to leave it. These bounds exhibit a milder dependence on minority amplitude for sign, spectral, and Newton descent than for Euclidean gradient descent. Experiments with AdamW and Muon suggest similar advantages over SGD across language, tabular, and image tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文用连续时间优化几何分析深度学习中的不平衡训练，刻画了少数群体损失优化不受关注、多数群体主导优化的"区域"，并给出离开该区域的时间上界。结果表明sign、spectral、Newton等下降法比欧氏梯度下降对少数群体幅度的依赖更弱，实验在语言、表格、图像任务上验证了AdamW/Muon优于SGD。
AI.motivation: 数据不平衡在机器学习中普遍存在（稀有词、异常、异构或交叉表中的少数模式）。论文针对"不平衡来源不可观测"的情形——优化器只能看到聚合损失，无法区分多数与少数群体的确切贡献，研究小步长训练的理想化连续时间优化几何。
AI.method: 在连续时间中建立理想化优化器几何模型，假设不平衡源不可观测，优化器仅能访问聚合训练损失。在此设定下刻画一个区域：在该区域内多数群体损失会被优化，不受可允许的少数群体结构影响。推导该区域的显式方程，并给出离开该区域所需时间的界，比较sign、spectral、Newton下降与欧氏梯度下降对少数群体幅度的依赖。用AdamW与Muon在语言、表格、图像任务上做实验验证。
AI.result: 理论界显示：sign、spectral、Newton下降在离开"多数主导区域"的时间上对少数群体幅度的依赖比欧氏梯度下降更缓和。实验中AdamW与Muon在语言、表格、图像任务上较SGD表现出类似优势。
AI.conclusion: 自适应/谱/二阶几何优化器在处理不可观测的数据不平衡时，比SGD更不容易长期忽视少数群体，理论与实验一致支持这一结论。

title: GlitchPatch: Repairing Glitch Tokens in Frozen Language Models via Local Retokenization
summary: Glitch tokens are anomalous vocabulary entries that can cause large language models (LLMs) to produce outputs inconsistent with their inputs. Existing repair methods require access to model internals, making them impractical for frozen checkpoints. We investigate whether glitch tokens can be repaired outside the model by optimizing the input tokenization. An empirical study on BPE merge-rule deletion reveals that (1)deleting a glitch token's merge rule can fix a substantial fraction of failures, yet disrupting normal tokens sharing intermediate merge nodes causes the overall glitch rate to rise, and (2)different decomposition granularities yield non-monotonic fix rates while collateral damage on normal tokens grows monotonically. Motivated by these findings, we propose GlitchPatch, a repair framework for frozen language models based on local retokenization, consisting of two stages: the offline stage uses Behavioral Path Optimization (BPO) to find the behaviorally optimal replacement token sequence for each glitch token and compiles validated replacements into a rule table; the online stage substitutes only the IDs of matched glitch tokens in the canonical token sequence, with no modification to model parameters or internal states. Experiments on ten models spanning six tokenizer families show that GlitchPatch achieves an 85.10% mean fix rate, outperforming the strongest baseline by 14.37 percentage points, and reduces the average glitch rate from 14.88% to 2.27%. GlitchPatch achieves a 0.00% RR in full-vocabulary evaluation and leaves rule-unmatched inputs unchanged by design. We further evaluate the practical impact of repair from the perspectives of time cost, language understanding, and capability, supporting its deployment feasibility. We hope this work provides a practical option for improving tokenizer reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出GlitchPatch，一种无需访问模型内部、通过优化输入分词来修复冻结LLM中glitch token的框架，平均修复率达85.10%。
AI.motivation: 现有glitch token修复方法需访问模型内部，对冻结checkpoint不实用，因此探索在模型外部通过优化输入分词进行修复。
AI.method: 基于BPE merge-rule删除的实证研究；提出GlitchPatch两阶段框架：离线阶段用Behavioral Path Optimization (BPO)为每个glitch token寻找行为最优替换序列并编译成规则表；在线阶段仅替换匹配glitch token的ID，不改动模型参数或内部状态。
AI.result: 在六个分词器家族共十个模型上，GlitchPatch平均修复率85.10%，超最强基线14.37个百分点，平均glitch率从14.88%降至2.27%；全词表评估RR为0.00%，未匹配输入保持不变。并从时间成本、语言理解与能力角度验证部署可行性。
AI.conclusion: GlitchPatch为提升分词器可靠性提供了一种实用的模型外部修复选项。

title: Agentic Cognitive Depth: Operational Criteria for Evaluating LLM Agents
comment: The 5th International Conference on Human and Artificial Rationalities
summary: Agentic large language model (LLM) systems are commonly implemented as an LLM in a loop with Planning, Memory, Tools, and Control Flow. This application-focused view connects agentic LLM research with deployable systems and leaves open how such systems should be evaluated beyond end-to-end task success. Building on this view, we define agentic cognitive depth as a trajectory-level profile across five operational criteria. The profile contains context sensitivity ($C$), temporal continuity ($T$), multimodal coordination ($M$), adaptive interaction ($A$), and metacognitive monitoring ($Mc$). The first four criteria measure how well Control Flow, Memory, Tools, and Planning are used across a trajectory. The fifth measures whether the system monitors and regulates the full run. For each criterion, we give operational proxies and a perturbation procedure, then connect the profile to the agent's world model. We provide the structure needed to extend benchmarks such as GAIA, SWE-bench, WebArena, and TRIP-Bench with per-criterion diagnostics. Symbolic verifiers, structured memory, planner coupling, and tool constraints provide practical ways to build and test these capacities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体认知深度"概念，用轨迹级五维画像（上下文敏感性、时间连续性、多模态协调、自适应交互、元认知监控）超越端到端任务成功率，评估智能体LLM系统。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体LLM系统以"LLM循环+规划/记忆/工具/控制流"实现，评估多停留在端到端任务成功，缺乏对系统运行方式的深入诊断，因此需要更细致的轨迹级评估框架。
AI.method: 定义智能体认知深度为跨五项操作标准的轨迹级画像；前四项分别衡量控制流、记忆、工具、规划的使用质量，第五项衡量全局监控与调节；每项给出操作代理指标与扰动程序，并将画像与智能体世界模型关联。
AI.result: 提供可扩展GAIA、SWE-bench、WebArena、TRIP-Bench等基准的结构，支持逐项诊断；符号验证器、结构化记忆、规划器耦合与工具约束是构建与测试这些能力的实用手段。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为智能体LLM评估提供了超越任务成功的多维诊断视角，并指明通过符号验证、结构化记忆、规划耦合和工具约束来构建与测试认知能力的方向。

title: A Local Geometric Analysis of Maximal Coding Rate Reduction via Error Bounds
comment: This paper is accepted by NeurIPS 2026
summary: While the maximal coding rate reduction (MCR$^2$) objective has become a useful principle for learning compact and discriminative representations, a theoretical understanding of its optimization geometry remains limited, especially regarding why first-order methods often exhibit fast convergence near its local maximizers. In this work, we show that the MCR$^2$ objective satisfies an error-bound property in a neighborhood of its local maximizers. This property guarantees that the distance to the local maximizer set can be bounded above by the gradient norm at any point in the neighborhood, directly implying regularity conditions such as the Polyak--Łojasiewicz inequality and quadratic growth. Leveraging this property, we prove that first-order methods converge linearly to a local maximizer of the MCR$^2$ objective under mild conditions. Numerical experiments validate the predicted local convergence behavior and provide empirical evidence that optimizing the MCR$^2$ objective improves representation geometry while maintaining competitive downstream accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文证明MCR²目标在局部极大值附近满足误差界性质，从而保证一阶方法线性收敛。
AI.motivation: MCR²虽是有用的表征学习原则，但其优化几何理论理解有限，尤其缺乏对一阶方法在局部极大值附近快速收敛的解释。
AI.method: 证明MCR²目标在局部极大值邻域内满足误差界性质，即到局部极大值集合的距离可由梯度范数上界约束，进而推导Polyak–Łojasiewicz不等式与二次增长等正则条件。
AI.result: 基于误差界性质证明一阶方法在温和条件下线性收敛到MCR²的局部极大值；数值实验验证了预测的局部收敛行为，并显示优化MCR²可改善表征几何同时保持竞争力下游精度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为MCR²的优化几何提供理论支撑，解释了其一阶方法的快速局部收敛现象，并通过实验验证了理论预测。

title: Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control with Constant Distance Gaps for Retrofitted Legacy Vehicles
summary: A Constant Distance Gap (CDG) spacing controller for Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control (CACC) designed to increase the capacity of oversaturated signalized intersections is presented. In a departing platoon of production passenger vehicles, the controller maintains close inter-vehicle distances below 3 m within limited platoon lengths, using one-vehicle-look-ahead (OVLA) communication only. Extensive real-world experiments on heterogeneous, retrofitted legacy production cars demonstrate robust operation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first experimental demonstration of such close distances under this combination of conditions. A CDG policy can substantially increase discharge rates at oversaturated signalized intersections when vehicles preserve their standstill spacing during startup, as shown in our previous simulation study. Because this benefit unfolds only at high penetration rates, it calls for retrofit-capable solutions deployable in existing combustion-dominated fleets. However, practical realization in such fleets remains an open challenge. The proposed MPC-based controller combines a first-order longitudinal prediction model with precise powertrain feedforward employing OEM-specific torque models, without exchanging confidential vehicle parameters. It avoids explicit platoon coordination to minimize air-interface load in dense traffic. To mitigate disturbance amplification and increase feasible platoon length at very small gaps, two controlled spacing-relaxation strategies are compared: (i) a micro-time-gap policy near the theoretical string-stability bound, and (ii) an acceleration-dependent spacing relaxation based on a virtual mass-spring-damper model. We introduce the Desired Acceleration Overshoot (DAO), a time-domain metric relating local actuator-demand amplification to achievable platoon length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种恒定距离间隔(CDG)的CACC控制器，可在仅用单车前视通信、异质改装燃油车队上实现<3m车间距，提升过饱和信号交叉口通行能力。
AI.motivation: CDG策略能显著提升过饱和交叉口排放率，但仅在高渗透率下有效，需适配现有燃油车队的可改装方案；在异质改装车队上实现极小间距仍是难题，尤其是干扰放大与可行驶车队长度受限。
AI.method: 基于MPC的控制器，结合一阶纵向预测模型与使用OEM专用扭矩模型(不交换保密参数)的动力总成前馈；不做显式车队协同以降低空口负载。对比两种受控间距松弛策略：(i)接近理论弦稳定边界的微小时距策略；(ii)基于虚拟质量-弹簧-阻尼模型的加速度相关间距松弛。并引入期望加速度超调(DAO)指标关联局部执行器需求放大与可达车队长度。
AI.result: 在异质改装量产燃油车上进行大量实车实验，验证了稳健运行；作者称这是该组合条件下如此小间距的首次实验演示。DAO指标将局部执行器需求放大与可达车队长度关联。
AI.conclusion: CDG间距控制器可改装部署于现有燃油车队，在单车前视通信下实现<3m极小间距且运行稳健，为提升过饱和信号交叉口通行能力提供了可行路径。

title: DUET: Co-Evolving Solver and Grader Agents
summary: Agentic workflows are increasingly used across domains such as technology, finance, and enterprise operations. As these agents become more widely deployed, continually improving them becomes increasingly important. This raises an immediate challenge: How should the agent evolve? This evolution requires effective evaluation that can assess outcomes and provide useful feedback for optimization. As the agent evolves, its behaviors and failure modes may also change, making a fixed evaluator increasingly inadequate. Another fundamental question: How should we evaluate an evolving agent? These two challenges are inherently coupled; changes in agent behavior can expose limitations of the current evaluator, while a stronger evaluator provides more informative feedback for improving the agent. Motivated by this interaction, we introduce DUET, a framework that jointly optimizes a solver agent and a grader agent to improve both. DUET iteratively selects training tasks, executes them with the solver, evaluates the resulting outcomes with the grader, and uses a tool-using update module to revise the solver and the grader, alternating between the two across rounds. By updating the grader within the optimization loop, DUET turns evaluation from a fixed source of feedback into a first-class optimization objective that adapts alongside the solver. Experiments across four agent benchmarks show that DUET improves both solver and grader performance and consistently outperforms baselines that optimize the solver with a fixed grader.

AI.tldr: 提出DUET框架，联合优化求解器智能体与评分器智能体，在优化循环中交替更新两者，将评估从固定反馈转变为一等优化目标。
AI.motivation: 智能体工作流广泛应用，需持续改进。但存在两个耦合难题：如何让智能体进化（需要有效评估提供优化反馈）；随着智能体行为与失败模式变化，固定评估器逐渐失效，如何评估进化的智能体。二者相互影响。
AI.method: DUET迭代选择训练任务，用solver执行，用grader评估结果，再通过工具使用的更新模块修订solver与grader，多轮交替进行。
AI.result: 在四个智能体基准上，DUET同时提升solver与grader性能，并持续优于使用固定grader优化solver的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 在优化循环内更新grader，可让评估随solver自适应演化，实现求解器与评分器的协同改进。

title: Valid Stopping in Adaptive Generator-Verifier Loops
summary: Numerous agentic workflows are based on a generator-verifier loop: a generator proposes candidates, a cheap verifier scores them, and the workflow terminates when a proposal is verified as good enough. The verifier typically proxies a more costly ground-truth oracle, and as the generator searches adaptively against it, false acceptances may accumulate. Proposals can pass the proxy but fail under the costlier ground-truth check. We study when to stop these loops while controlling the false discovery rate of the accepted proposals. Our construction introduces tools of independent interest in distribution-free statistical testing and conformal risk control, including analysis of $e$-values constructed through index betting and a novel conformal risk control procedure for non-monotone losses. We validate the approach in synthetic settings and on a protein-design benchmark.

AI.tldr: 研究生成器-验证器循环中何时停止搜索，以控制被接受提案的假发现率（FDR）。
AI.motivation: 生成器会自适应地针对廉价验证器搜索，导致假接受累积——提案可能通过代理验证但在昂贵的真实标注检查中失败。因此需要一个能控制假发现率的停止准则。
AI.method: 构建了无分布假设的统计检验工具与共形风险控制，包括对通过指数下注构造的$e$-值的分析，以及针对非单调损失的新型共形风险控制程序。
AI.result: 在合成设置和蛋白质设计基准上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能在控制被接受提案假发现率的同时，为生成器-验证器循环提供理论上有保证的停止准则。

title: XTurnix: Large-Scale Self-Supervised Turn Control through Two-State Binary Decisions
summary: General turn-taking behavior in real-time dialogue systems requires deciding whether to keep listening or start responding while listening, and whether to continue or stop while speaking. Existing turn detectors use heterogeneous, task-specific label spaces and are often trained on limited annotations or evaluated on isolated utterances, making them difficult to use as a unified causal controller with comprehensive context. We propose XTurnix, a compact text-based model that formulates turn control as two binary decisions conditioned on the AI's current listening or speaking state and predicts a single control token from the complete dialogue history. XTurnix is pretrained on 5.5 million causal action examples automatically derived from timestamped two-speaker transcripts, then fine-tuned on synthetic multi-turn examples with a flatter distribution across the four state-action labels. We evaluate XTurnix on four public benchmarks and a balanced self-curated benchmark. Across the public benchmarks, XTurnix achieves the best results on all SemanticVAD and LiveKit splits, ties the native Smart-Turn model on Smart-Turn Bench, and achieves the highest incomplete-turn accuracy on Easy-Turn. On the self-curated benchmark, it reaches 89.06% accuracy, more than 20 percentage points above the strongest third-party baseline at 68.75%, while maintaining F1 scores between 84.21% and 90.63% across all four categories. These results demonstrate unified listening- and speaking-state turn control in a single compact model. Code is available at https://github.com/xcc-zach/xturnix, with an interactive demo at https://huggingface.co/spaces/xcczach/xturnix-demo.

AI.tldr: XTurnix 提出统一文本模型，将对话轮次控制建模为两个二分类决策，预训练于 550 万因果动作样本，在多个基准上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有轮次检测器标签空间异构、任务专用、训练标注有限且多在孤立话语上评估，难以作为具备完整上下文和因果性的统一控制器。
AI.method: 将轮次控制形式化为基于 AI 当前听/说状态的两个二分类决策，从完整对话历史预测单一控制 token；先在 550 万条由带时间戳双人转写自动导出的因果动作样本上预训练，再用跨四类状态-动作标签分布更均衡的合成多轮样本微调。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准和自建均衡基准上评估：SemanticVAD 与 LiveKit 各划分均最优，Smart-Turn Bench 与原生 Smart-Turn 持平，Easy-Turn 不完整轮次准确率最高；自建基准准确率 89.06%，超最强第三方基线 68.75% 逾 20 个百分点，四类 F1 在 84.21%–90.63%。
AI.conclusion: 单一紧凑模型即可实现统一的听与说状态轮次控制。代码与演示已开源。

title: SHarP: Saliency-based Pruning of Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent harnesses are systems that coordinate model calls, tool use, and task execution to help large language models complete complex tasks. To meet task requirements and address failures, these systems are often iteratively refined by amending and patching their instructions, tools, and workflows, continuously increasing harness complexity. It is therefore unclear whether some resulting harness modules are redundant, introducing substantial token overhead with little, if any, performance gain. Inspired by neural network pruning, in this paper, we study harness pruning as a means of striking a better balance between task performance and token cost. We propose SHarP (Saliency-based Harness Pruning), a simple yet effective pruning strategy based on the saliency of each harness module with respect to performance and efficiency. Specifically, we first identify tools, instructions, and supporting mechanisms as components that can be individually disabled. We then estimate the saliency of each module by ablating it and assessing its task performance and token cost relative to the full set of single-module ablations. Modules with the smallest contribution to performance or largest computational overhead are subsequently pruned. Our evaluation across various harnesses on held-out validation sets reveals a surprising finding: most harnesses that we studied are highly redundant and can maintain comparable performance and efficiency even after a substantial portion of their modules are pruned. Our pruning approach and empirical findings provide new perspectives on agent harness design and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SHarP，一种基于显著性的agent harness剪枝策略，通过消融评估各模块对性能和token成本的影响来剪枝冗余模块，发现多数harness高度冗余。
AI.motivation: Agent harnesses通过协调模型调用、工具使用和任务执行来帮助LLM完成复杂任务，但为满足需求和处理失败，系统被反复修补、不断增加复杂度，导致部分模块可能冗余，带来大量token开销却无性能收益。因此需要平衡任务性能与token成本。
AI.method: 受神经网络剪枝启发，提出SHarP（基于显著性的Harness剪枝）。首先将工具、指令和支持机制识别为可单独禁用的组件；然后通过消融每个模块并相对全部单模块消融结果评估其任务性能和token成本来估计显著性；最后剪除对性能贡献最小或计算开销最大的模块。
AI.result: 在多种harness和留出验证集上的评估显示一个令人惊讶的发现：所研究的大多数harness高度冗余，即使剪除相当大比例的模块后仍能保持可比的任务性能和效率。
AI.conclusion: 该剪枝方法与实证发现为agent harness的设计和优化提供了新视角。

title: Single-call Polyak-Type Extragradient Methods for Monotone Root-Finding Problems
summary: We propose a single-call variant of Polyak extragradient, termed SPolyakEG, by recycling the previous extrapolation operator evaluation. Under a delayed critical condition, we establish that SPolyakEG achieves an $O(1/K)$ residual convergence rate for monotone operators and linear convergence under strong monotonicity. Compared with PolyakEG, SPolyakEG reduces the number of operator evaluations from two to one per iteration.

AI.tldr: 提出单次算子评估的Polyak外推梯度变体SPolyakEG，通过复用上一步外推算子，在延迟临界条件下实现$O(1/K)$与线性收敛，并将每步算子评估次数从两次降为一次。
AI.motivation: PolyakEG每步需两次算子评估，计算开销大；希望降低算子评估次数而不损失收敛性。
AI.method: 通过recycling上一次外推算子评估构造single-call变体SPolyakEG，在延迟临界条件下分析收敛性。
AI.result: 单调算子下达到$O(1/K)$残差收敛速率；强单调下实现线性收敛；每步算子评估由两次降为一次。
AI.conclusion: SPolyakEG在保持PolyakEG收敛保证的同时显著降低每步计算成本。

title: Unlocking AI Data Center Interconnection Capacity Through Coordinated Grid and Data Center Flexibility
summary: The rapid growth of AI data centers is creating concentrated electricity demands that can exceed available distribution network headroom and delay interconnection. This paper investigates whether capacity can be used effectively by coordinating flexibility on both sides of the interconnection. A day-ahead mixed integer second order cone programming framework maximizes feasible AI data center IT capacity using utility side conservation voltage reduction and network topology reconfiguration, together with data center workload shifting and reserve constrained uninterruptible power supply storage. Background feeder demand uses voltage dependent ZIP models, while the data center is modeled as constant power demand using Training, Inference, and Mixed workload profiles. A two-stage solution first maximizes interconnection capacity and then minimizes feeder losses for the retained capacity, with numerical relaxation screening. Studies on a 116-bus model derived from the IEEE 123-node feeder show that, at the constrained bus-60 connection point, grid side flexibility, driven almost entirely by network reconfiguration, increases feasible IT capacity by approximately 42.5-45.0%, while data center flexibility alone provides approximately 2.1-5.4% gains. Coordinated operation increases feasible IT capacity from approximately 10.5-10.6 MW under BASE operation to 15.3-16.0 MW, corresponding to gains of approximately 45.9-50.8%; the 16.0 MW Inference result is limited by the adopted UPS reserve requirement. Benefits are strongly location dependent and influenced by workload flexibility, deferral duration, PUE, UPS energy and reserve requirements, and feeder loading. Under a combined adverse operating condition, FULL capacity decreases by only 3.4% relative to the nominal Mixed case while retaining substantial additional capacity over BASE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种日前混合整数二阶锥规划框架，通过协调电网侧（CVR与网络重构）和数据中心侧（工作负载转移与UPS储能）灵活性，最大化AI数据中心的可行IT容量。
AI.motivation: AI数据中心的快速扩张造成集中电力需求，可能超出配电网可用裕度并延迟并网，因此需要研究如何通过协调并网点两侧的灵活性来有效利用现有容量。
AI.method: 采用日前混合整数二阶锥规划（MISOCP）框架，结合电网侧CVR与网络拓扑重构、数据中心侧工作负载转移及受备约束的UPS储能；背景馈线采用电压相关ZIP模型，数据中心按训练、推理和混合负载建模为恒功率需求。采用两阶段求解：先最大化并网容量，再最小化馈线损耗，并进行数值松弛筛选。
AI.result: 在基于IEEE 123节点的116母线模型上，约束点母线60处，电网侧灵活性（主要来自网络重构）使可行IT容量提升约42.5-45.0%，数据中心灵活性单独提升约2.1-5.4%；协调运行使容量从BASE的约10.5-10.6 MW增至15.3-16.0 MW（提升约45.9-50.8%），其中16.0 MW推理结果受UPS备约束限制。效益高度依赖位置，并受负载灵活性、延迟时长、PUE、UPS能量与备约束及馈线负载影响。在综合不利工况下，FULL容量仅比名义混合情形下降3.4%，仍显著高于BASE。
AI.conclusion: 协调并网点两侧灵活性可显著提升AI数据中心可行IT容量，其中网络重构贡献最大；该效益具有强位置依赖性，且在不利工况下仍具鲁棒性。

title: Pareto-Dominant Clarification: Post-Training Coding LLMs via PPO-Lagrangian Budget Constraints
comment: Accepted to the LMP Workshop at EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Abhinav Rajput and Acey Vogelstein contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/Abhinav0710rajput/coding_llms_cmdp
summary: Coding agents operating under ambiguous instructions or user prompts must decide whether to ask clarifying questions or attempt a solution directly. While clarification from the user may improve the correctness of the agent's solution, each back-and-forth interaction incurs user and system costs, forming an explicit accuracy vs. efficiency tradeoff. Existing works study clarification behavior but do not train policies under enforceable clarification budgets; penalty-based approaches typically require separate coefficient tuning swept across all clarification budget levels. We formulate clarification as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and post-train Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with PPO-Lagrangian to optimize coding accuracy, subject to an expected question-budget constraint. Evaluated on HumanEvalComm with a GPT-4o-mini oracle simulator, the resulting policies reveal that untuned clarification behavior is Pareto-inefficient: budget-constrained policies can simultaneously achieve higher accuracy and lower clarification rates than the baseline model. Across budget levels, we observe a log-shaped Pareto frontier with diminishing returns to additional clarification. Gains arise not from simply asking more questions overall, but from improved question targeting and better code generation under ambiguity. Without explicit supervision, trained policies learn to allocate clarification budget non-uniformly, asking more frequently on tougher (multi-degradation) tasks. These results suggest that unconstrained interactive LLM systems may systematically use clarification inefficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文将"代码智能体是否提问澄清"建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)，用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练，在显式问题预算约束下优化编码准确率，发现受约束策略可同时实现更高准确率与更低提问率。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体面对模糊指令时需在"主动提问澄清"与"直接尝试解答"间权衡：提问可提升正确性，但每次交互带来用户与系统开销，形成准确率-效率的取舍。现有工作只研究澄清行为，未在有可执行预算约束下训练策略；基于惩罚的方法需针对每个预算水平单独调参扫描，成本高。
AI.method: 将澄清问题形式化为CMDP，以期望问题预算为约束，用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练，在HumanEvalComm上以GPT-4o-mini作为oracle模拟器评估。
AI.result: 未经调优的澄清行为是帕累托低效的：受预算约束的策略能同时取得更高准确率和更低提问率。不同预算水平下呈现对数型帕累托前沿，额外提问收益递减。收益并非来自问得更多，而是来自更精准的提问定位与模糊条件下的代码生成改进；无需显式监督，策略即学会非均匀分配预算，在更难（多重退化）任务上提问更频繁。
AI.conclusion: 无约束的交互式LLM系统可能系统性地低效使用澄清。显式预算约束训练能带来更优的准确率-效率权衡。

title: KESurv: A Kernel Ensemble Method for Patient-Specific Survival Prediction
summary: Predicting patient-specific survival functions is crucial for clinicians in making informed decisions about patient care and treatment strategies. Among the various models available, the Survival Forest has demonstrated significant effectiveness in numerous scenarios. In this work, we propose an ensemble method that leverages the strengths of the Survival Forest as the master model, complemented by several base models. This ensemble incorporates the Beran estimator, a type of kernel estimator, to enhance predictions of patient-specific survival curves. We evaluated the performance of our proposed model using four distinct healthcare datasets. The results highlight the superiority of our ensemble method over baseline models in both calibration and ranking across most datasets. The findings suggest that our approach offers a more accurate and reliable estimation of patient-specific survival functions, providing a valuable tool for clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以Survival Forest为主模型、结合Beran核估计器等基模型的集成方法，用于预测患者个体化生存函数，在多个医疗数据集上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 准确预测患者个体化生存函数对临床决策至关重要；Survival Forest虽有效，但仍有提升空间，需更精准的生存曲线估计。
AI.method: 集成方法：以Survival Forest为master model，辅以多个基模型，并引入Beran估计器（一种核估计器）来增强个体化生存曲线预测。
AI.result: 在四个不同医疗数据集上评估，结果显示该集成方法在大多数数据集的校准度（calibration）和排序能力（ranking）上均优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能提供更准确、可靠的个体化生存函数估计，是辅助临床决策的有价值工具。

title: Ideological Stance Detection in a Low-Resource Language: Polarization in Bangladeshi Public vs Private University Discourse on Social Media
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Information, Communication and Systems (SPICSCON), 13-14 August 2026, Bangladesh Army University of Engineering & Technology (BAUET), Qadirabad, Natore, Bangladesh
summary: Public vs. private universities is a debatable issue, and it creates polarization on social media in Bangladesh. Debate on quality, jobs, and prestige is passionate among the students, parents, and graduates, the majority of whom speak Bengali, a low-resource language. To measure this polarization, this paper introduces a manually annotated dataset of 4,060 Bengali comments labeled as Pro-Public, Pro-Private, or Neutral. We evaluated the quality of our annotations by Fleiss's Kappa agreement that was 0.89, corresponding to a high agreement among annotators. The classical ML (SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost), BiLSTM network, hybrid BanglaBERT+XGBoost models and the state-of-the-art zero-shot LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, DeepSeek-V3.1, Llama 4 Maverick, Kimi K2 Thinking, Qwen3-235B Thinking) models are evaluated. The accuracy of BanglaBERT+XGBoost is 91.81% and macro F1 score is 91.70%, which is higher than all the supervised baselines. The zero-shot Llama 4 Maverick Thinking achieves a macro F1 of 0.931 (overall accuracy of 93.31%) without any fine-tuning. All machine learning (ML), deep machine learning (DL) and transformer models were outperformed by the zero-shot Llama 4 Maverick model. Polarization also is evident, in some ways more clearly in the Pro-Private comments, which emphasize modern facilities and timely graduation, versus the Pro-Public comments, which emphasize affordability and government jobs. Our findings open new directions for analyzing social media polarization in low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了孟加拉语公立 vs 私立大学话题的标注数据集（4060条评论），评估多种ML、DL与零样本LLM模型，发现零样本Llama 4 Maverick表现最佳（macro F1 0.931），并揭示了社交媒体的极化现象。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国公立与私立大学之争在社交媒体上引发极化，涉及质量、就业与声望等议题，但相关评论多为低资源语言孟加拉语，缺乏标注数据与系统的极化分析研究。
AI.method: 构建4060条孟加拉语评论的人工标注数据集，标注为Pro-Public、Pro-Private或Neutral（Fleiss Kappa=0.89）；对比评估经典ML（SVM、随机森林、XGBoost）、BiLSTM、BanglaBERT+XGBoost混合模型及零样本LLM（Claude Sonnet 4、DeepSeek-V3.1、Llama 4 Maverick、Kimi K2 Thinking、Qwen3-235B Thinking）。
AI.result: BanglaBERT+XGBoost准确率91.81%、macro F1 91.70%，优于所有监督基线；零样本Llama 4 Maverick Thinking无需微调即达macro F1 0.931（准确率93.31%），超越所有ML、DL和Transformer模型。极化在Pro-Private评论中尤为明显（强调现代化设施与按时毕业），Pro-Public评论强调可负担性与政府工作。
AI.conclusion: 研究为低资源语言社交媒体极化分析开辟了新方向。

title: Language Model Activations Inhabit Privileged Error-Correcting Basins
summary: Language models exhibit remarkable robustness, continuing to produce coherent text even when their activations are perturbed by interventions like linear steering. We hypothesize that this robustness is a result of passive dynamics, i.e., constraining mechanisms in the forward pass that funnel activations toward "good" regions that produce coherent outputs. To investigate these hypothesized error-correcting mechanisms, we probe the geometry of language model activation space by observing the action of model layers on low-dimensional curves. In doing so, we discover that model activations occur within a cluster of distinct attracting basins, which differentiate natural activations geometrically from distributionally similar synthetic activations. Applying this lens to language model steering, we observe feature-specific basins along semantic steering directions, and find that steering moves activations between these basins. To demonstrate the active role of this geometry in neural computation, we show that adaptively modulating steering strength to transport activations across basins improves inter-language steering, significantly increasing the probability of sampling tokens from the target language compared to fixed-strength steering. Our findings establish analysis of activation space geometry as a promising approach to interpreting and controlling language models.

AI.tldr: 语言模型的鲁棒性源于前向传播中的被动动力学：激活空间存在多个吸引盆地，自然激活与合成激活在几何上被区分，并可用于改进语言模型引导。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在激活被线性引导等干预扰动时仍能生成连贯文本，作者假设这种鲁棒性来自"被动动力学"，即前向传播中存在的约束机制会把激活导向能产生连贯输出的"良好"区域，因此需要研究这种误差纠正机制。
AI.method: 通过观察模型层对低维曲线的作用来探测语言模型激活空间的几何结构；并在此视角下分析语义引导方向上的特征特异性盆地，以及引导如何在盆地之间移动激活。
AI.result: 发现模型激活位于一组不同的吸引盆地中，可将自然激活与分布相似的合成激活在几何上区分；语义引导方向上存在特征特异性盆地，引导会使激活在盆地间转移；自适应调制引导强度以跨盆地运输激活，能改进跨语言引导，相比固定强度显著提高采样目标语言词元的概率。
AI.conclusion: 激活空间几何分析是解释和控制语言模型的一种有前景的方法。

title: Ordered Weighted Average Support Vector Regression
summary: This paper introduces a novel Support Vector Regression (SVR) model that incorporates Ordered Weighted Average (OWA) operators to differently penalize deviations of observations from the ε-strip. The penalty is determined based on the position of each deviation in the ordered vector of all deviations. A key contribution of this work is the development of two nonlinear formulations: a continuous formulation for non-decreasing monotone weight vectors and a mixed-integer formulation for general weight vectors. By leveraging dual approaches associated with these formulations, the model accommodates nonlinear kernel functions. To enhance computational efficiency, two heuristic approaches are proposed for deriving suitable regression hyperplanes in reduced computation times, as compared to exact methods. Additionally, a third heuristic approach is developed to handle nonlinear kernel functions effectively. Computational experiments conducted on both real and synthetic datasets demonstrate that the exact formulations yield remarkable regression functions with respect to the following standard metrics: mean absolute errors (MAE) and mean squared errors (MSE). The heuristic approaches are shown to be particularly efficient for larger datasets, striking a balance between solution quality and computational effort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种引入OWA算子的SVR模型，对偏离ε带的观测按偏差排序位置施加不同惩罚，给出连续与混合整数两种非线性建模方式，并配以三种启发式方法，在真实和合成数据上验证了精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统SVR对ε带外所有偏差施加相同惩罚，无法体现不同偏差的重要性差异，因此需要用OWA算子按偏差排序位置区别对待惩罚。
AI.method: 将OWA算子融入SVR，按偏差在有序向量中的位置确定惩罚；构建两种非线性形式：针对非递减单调权重向量的连续形式，以及针对一般权重向量的混合整数形式；借助相关对偶方法支持非线性核函数；提出两种启发式用于快速求回归超平面，第三种启发式处理非线性核。
AI.result: 在真实和合成数据集上，精确形式在MAE和MSE上取得显著回归效果；启发式方法在较大数据集上效率突出，能在解质量与计算代价间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: OWA-SVR为偏差惩罚提供了更灵活的建模框架，精确形式精度高，启发式方法适合大规模数据，兼顾效果与效率。

title: New and Improved Analytical Methods for Calculating Power System Adequacy Metrics
summary: A new analytical technique is proposed for calculating adequacy metrics for generation planning. The proposed technique is simple, direct, and provides higher accuracy than traditional discretized approaches. Additionally, a new analytical methodology is introduced for calculating loss of load days (LOL Days) as distinct from loss of load events or frequency of load loss. This paper emphasizes that, where feasible, analytical methods are preferable to Monte Carlo simulations because they yield exact closed-form solutions rather than statistical estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于发电规划充裕度指标计算的解析技术，精度高于传统离散化方法，并引入计算停电天数（LOL Days）的新解析方法，主张优先使用解析法而非蒙特卡洛模拟以获得精确闭式解。
AI.motivation: 传统离散化方法在计算发电规划充裕度指标时精度不足；同时停电天数与停电事件/频率概念不同，缺乏专门的解析计算方法。
AI.method: 提出一种简单直接的解析技术用于计算充裕度指标；并给出计算停电天数（LOL Days）的解析方法，区别于停电事件或停电频率的计算。强调在可行时应采用解析法而非蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.result: 所提解析技术比传统离散化方法具有更高的计算精度，并能给出精确的闭式解，而非蒙特卡洛模拟的统计估计值。
AI.conclusion: 在可行的情况下，解析方法优于蒙特卡洛模拟，因其提供精确闭式解；该方法适用于发电规划充裕度与停电天数的计算。

title: Robust blind unmixing: A geometric approach to overcoming basis variation
summary: Signal separation problems are common in science. A prominent example of this occurs during the use of diffraction or spectroscopy to identify the individual components of a mixture by measuring it. In the simplest case, the measured signal is a linear combination of basis patterns corresponding to the constituent parts. The unmixing problem is to infer all or some of these basis patterns and abundances of components from measurements of distinct mixtures. One of the core challenges of this task is the variation of the basis from mixture to mixture due to noise and the exact physics of the measurement process. This is usually addressed with tailored model-based and parametric methods that are then limited in use to specific application domains by the nature of the assumptions made. We propose a novel geometric approach to unmixing problems which views the generation of data during measurement through a metric space lens, thereby shifting the focus from parametrised models to a general relationship between basis transformations and the corresponding geometry. We take advantage of the optimal transport distances to capture commonly occurring basis variations, and use minimisation of in-class variance of candidate solutions to drive the optimisation. We pay special attention to the one-dimensional case due to its practical importance and availability of efficient distance and transport map routines. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on a range of unmixing tasks using random Gaussian mixture models, simulated powder X-ray diffraction, and laboratory hyperspectral imaging datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于度量空间视角的几何解混方法，利用最优传输距离捕捉基变换变化，通过最小化类内方差驱动优化，在1D及多类数据上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 解混问题中基模式随混合变化（噪声、测量物理机制）而变化，传统基于模型的参数化方法假设特定，局限于特定应用领域。
AI.method: 将数据生成置于度量空间，聚焦基变换与几何间的一般关系；用最优传输距离刻画常见基变化，最小化候选解的类内方差进行优化，特别关注一维情形及其高效距离与传输映射算法。
AI.result: 在随机高斯混合模型、模拟粉末X射线衍射及实验室高光谱成像数据集等多种解混任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该几何方法突破参数化模型的领域限制，为解混问题提供通用框架。

title: The Surrogate Is Not the Reward: Post-Surrogate Primary-Outcome Acquisition in Contextual Bandits
summary: We study contextual bandits in which a surrogate is observed after the action but before the learner decides whether to acquire the primary outcome that defines action value and regret. The value of acquiring the primary outcome depends on both decision relevance (how much the current outcome matters for comparing policies) and the residual uncertainty after observing the surrogate. The Audited Surrogate Bandit (ASB) learns a contextual policy while allocating a budget of $B$ primary-outcome acquisitions over $T$ rounds. ASB sets a pre-surrogate acquisition level from current decision relevance and, after observing the surrogate, redistributes that level using an estimate of that residual uncertainty. For a finite class of $N$ policies over $K$ actions, ASB incurs $\widetilde O[\sqrt{KT\log N}\{1+\sqrt{T/B}\}]$ regret relative to the best policy in the class. In a two-action family where the surrogate does not reveal the better action, a learner that observes the surrogate before deciding whether to acquire can achieve bounded regret, whereas any learner that must decide before seeing the surrogate incurs $Ω(T/B)$ worst-case regret under the same budget. Synthetic experiments show that both acquisition factors matter: ASB has lower regret than variants using only decision relevance or only residual uncertainty. On a KuaiRec benchmark of user-video interactions, the regret gap relative to relevance-only acquisition widens and then narrows as the budget grows.

AI.tldr: 研究"审计代理老虎机(ASB)"：在动作后、决定是否采买主结果前可观测代理变量，学习上下文策略并在预算B下分配主结果采买，达到近优遗憾。
AI.motivation: 采买主结果(定义动作价值与遗憾)成本高，但其价值取决于决策相关性与代理观测后的残余不确定性，需在预算约束下权衡两者。
AI.method: ASB先依据当前决策相关性设定"代理前置采买水平"，观测代理后再用残余不确定性估计对该水平进行重分配。
AI.result: 对N个策略、K动作的有限类，遗憾为Õ[√(KT log N)(1+√(T/B))]；两动作族中，先看代理者可实现有界遗憾，而先决定者最坏遗憾Ω(T/B)。合成实验显示两个采买因素均重要；KuaiRec基准上，与仅用相关性相比，遗憾差距随预算先增大后缩小。
AI.conclusion: 代理观测后决策可显著降低采买成本与遗憾，决策相关性与残余不确定性需联合建模，实证支持理论结论。

title: Saying, Not Knowing: Aggressively GGUF-Quantized Small Language Models Still Write Rare Words They Can No Longer Define
comment: 41 pages, 15 figures, 1 table. Data, answer key, scored outputs and scorer code: https://github.com/NietzscheDostoevsky/snk-release
summary: Post-training quantization to the GGUF format's mixed-precision K-quants is commonly how open-weight language models reach consumer hardware, yet its effect on fine-grained lexical competence is uncharacterized. We audit 27 quantized artifacts across 13 families and four architecture backbones, 0.35B-14B parameters, evaluated down their published ladder to Q2_K (about 2.6 bits per weight), on 429 frequency-validated rare English words under two probes: surface inclusion of a prompt-supplied word and its one-sentence definition, scored by a tiered multi-synonym matcher, its error measured by a blind LLM-judge census of every definition, with human verification. Three regimes emerge at Q2: total collapse into unusable builds, severe semantic dissociation in sub-2B models, and mostly robust preservation above about 3B. In every sub-2B artifact, definitions fall 20-67% below the artifact's baseline, typically several times the inclusion loss. Two controls separate rarity from task difficulty: within the rare set, loss rises with rarity in six of seven sub-2B artifacts, and on a 100-word common-word set rare words lose more than common words in all eight, significantly in six. Tokenizer vocabulary size does not predict the damage (Spearman rho=0.12); parameter count dominates (rho=0.72), confirmed within five of six same-tokenizer families. Q4_K_M remains lexically clean at >=1B. The damage is frequency-graded, provider-dependent, and not calibrated by WikiText-2 perplexity: across nine artifact-matched ladders, near-identical Q2 penalties (44.7%/47.6%) separate an artifact keeping its definitions (3.6%) from one losing them (43.6%). Aggressively quantized small models can keep generating fluent text while no longer knowing what it means, risking hardware-constrained deployments in domains where semantics carries consequences. Validation must be per artifact.

AI.tldr: 本文审计13个模型家族、27个GGUF低比特量化产物，发现Q2_K量化对小模型（<3B）的罕见词释义能力造成严重破坏，且这种损害无法由WikiText-2困惑度预测。
AI.motivation: 低比特后训练量化（GGUF混合精度K-quants）是开源模型进入消费级硬件的常用途径，但其对细粒度词汇能力（尤其是罕见词释义）的影响尚不清楚。作者希望厘清量化损害是否、如何随参数量、稀有度、分词器规模等因素变化，并检验困惑度等常用指标能否校准这一损害。
AI.method: 审计27个量化产物，覆盖13个家族、4种架构、0.35B–14B参数，按官方量化阶梯下探至Q2_K（约2.6 bit/权重）。测试429个经过词频验证的罕见英文词，采用两种探针：提示词的表层包含和其一词句释义，用分层多同义词匹配器打分；释义错误由盲测LLM评判器逐一普查并辅以人工验证。另设两个对照：罕见集内按稀有度分层，以及100个常用词对照集。
AI.result: Q2下出现三种情形：完全崩溃不可用、亚2B模型严重语义解离、约3B以上基本保持。每个亚2B产物释义下降20–67%，通常为数倍于包含损失。稀有度梯度：7个亚2B产物中6个损失随稀有度上升；常用词对照中8个全表现出罕见词损失更大，6个显著。分词器词表规模不预测损害（rho=0.12），参数量占主导（rho=0.72），6个同分词器家族中5个证实。Q4_K_M在≥1B时词汇能力干净。损害随频率分级、依赖提供方，且WikiText-2困惑度无法校准：9个配对的量化阶梯中Q2惩罚几乎相同（44.7%/47.6%），却区分出保留释义(3.6%)与丢失释义(43.6%)的产物。
AI.conclusion: 激进量化的小模型可保持流畅输出却不再"理解"其含义，对语义重要的硬件受限部署构成风险。验证必须逐产物进行，不能依赖困惑度等聚合指标。

title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Design Their Own Evaluations?
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) relies on evaluation feedback to assess progress and guide further research, yet repeatedly running complex benchmarks is costly and slows iteration. Human experts reduce this cost by selecting benchmark subsets or designing compact suites. We ask whether AI agents can automate this design process and introduce EvalResearchBench (ERB), a benchmark for autonomous evaluation research. Given target materials, development references, candidate APIs, and fixed time and API budgets, an agent called the researcher selects or synthesizes tasks, implements graders, and revises them in pilot tests before freezing an executable evaluator for coding, co-work, and reasoning. We study 9 researchers and 13 candidate models and compare each frozen evaluator with 14 target benchmarks on score concordance and pairwise agreement. The best evaluators order about 75\% of candidate pairs as the targets do, below the 91\% ceiling set by disagreements among the targets. No researcher leads on every metric, and the best evaluator on development targets is not the best on sealed targets hidden from the researcher. A human-designed sample of public tasks remains a strong baseline, and the evaluator with the lowest recorded execution cost attains the highest pairwise agreement. Agents repair tasks and graders through pilot feedback, yet their evaluators can still truncate answers, exhaust the evaluation budget, or let a few questions dominate a domain score.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EvalResearchBench (ERB)，考察AI智能体能否自动完成评估研究——即自主选择/合成任务、实现打分器并通过试运行迭代，为编码、协作、推理三类能力生成可执行评估器。实验对9个研究者智能体、13个候选模型进行测试，最佳评估器在约75%的候选模型配对上与目标基准排序一致，接近目标基准间91%的一致性上限，但无单一智能体全面领先。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进依赖评估反馈来判定进展并指导后续研究，但反复运行复杂基准成本高昂、拖慢迭代。人类专家通过精选基准子集或设计紧凑套件来降低成本。本文追问：AI智能体能否自动完成这一评估设计过程。
AI.method: 提出EvalResearchBench (ERB) 作为自主评估研究的基准。给定目标材料、开发参考、候选API以及固定的时间和API预算，"研究者"智能体需选择或合成任务、实现打分器，并在试点测试中修订，之后冻结为针对编码、协作、推理的可执行评估器。研究测试9个研究者与13个候选模型，将每个冻结评估器与14个目标基准在分数一致性和成对一致性上比较。
AI.result: 最佳评估器对约75%的候选配对排序与目标基准一致，低于目标基准间分歧所设定的91%上限。没有研究者在所有指标上领先；在开发目标上表现最好的评估器，在被隐藏的密封目标上并非最佳。人工设计的公开任务样本仍是强基线，且记录执行成本最低的评估器取得最高成对一致性。智能体可通过试点反馈修复任务与打分器，但其评估器仍可能截断回答、耗尽评估预算，或让少数问题主导某一领域的得分。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体已能部分自动化评估研究，但尚不及人类设计基线，也受制于目标基准自身的不一致性；评估器的鲁棒性与预算控制仍是主要短板。

title: Chebyshev-Exact Acceleration under Hessian Variation, II: Computer-Assisted Variational Lower Bound
summary:
We study two-step recurrences with positive step sizes and nonnegative momentum coefficients whose terminal residual is the Chebyshev minimax polynomial on a prescribed spectral interval $[μ,L]$. These recurrences have the same terminal error on a fixed quadratic, but their first-order responses to stepwise Hessian perturbations can differ. We prove that the sine-Jacobi recurrence of Part I is asymptotically optimal for this response norm within a factor of $1.000004$, uniformly over $0<μ<L$. Every terminal-exact recurrence satisfies $A_N\ge(2\sqrt{c_{cert}}-o(1))N^{3/2}ε_N^\star/(L-μ)$ with $c_{cert}>1.14268353624$, whereas the sine-Jacobi recurrence attains the constant $2\sqrt{c_{\sin}}$ with $c_{\sin}<1.14269218$.
  The proof reduces the gain to the diagonal energy of a Jacobi Green matrix. A centering lift represents this matrix by an exponential kernel; packing its diagonal into a density on the line preserves the energy and controls the change in the Birman-Schwinger spectrum. A calibrated identity gives a lower bound using the ground parameter and one Fredholm determinant. Two further determinants and a trace observation improve the bound through a pointwise inequality on an explicit compact state region. One rational certificate verifies this inequality by interval arithmetic. A second certificate constructs a density satisfying the selected observations and both normalizations with energy below the sine value. Finally, no $C^1$ function of finitely many observations of the specified kinds gives a locally sharp lower bound at the sine density.

AI.tldr: 本文研究两步递推（正步长、非负动量）在终端残差为 Chebyshev 极小极大多项式时的稳健性，证明 Part I 的 sine-Jacobi 递推在 Hessian 扰动响应范数上渐近最优（因子 1.000004），并给出最优常数的严格下界与上界。
AI.motivation: 固定二次型上所有终端精确递推的错误相同，但对 Hessian 逐步扰动的响应可不同，需要判定哪种递推在该响应范数下最优。
AI.method: 将增益归约为 Jacobi Green 矩阵的对角能量；用 centering lift 表示指数核，把对角打包为直线上的密度并控制 Birman-Schwinger 谱变化；通过校准恒等式、Fredholm 行列式、点态不等式及区间算术的有理证书进行证明。
AI.result: 每条终端精确递推满足 A_N≥(2√c_cert−o(1))N^{3/2}ε_N^★/(L−μ)，c_cert>1.14268353624；sine-Jacobi 达到 2√c_sin，c_sin<1.14269218，故在 1.000004 因子内渐近最优。
AI.conclusion: sine-Jacobi 递推在指定响应范数下渐近最优；且任何基于有限个指定观测的 C^1 函数在 sine 密度处都不能给出局部尖锐下界。

title: Optimal Dynamic Resource Allocation for Multicore Real-time Systems
summary: We formulate a novel optimal control problem for data-driven dynamic resource allocation in multicore real-time systems. The proposed formulation accounts for hard deadline constraints and resource bounds. Under mild assumptions, we prove several results on the feasibility and existence of optimal solution for the proposed formulation. Building on these analyses, we design an algorithm to solve the multi-core dynamic resource allocation problem. We demonstrate the practical use of this new algorithm by experimentally evaluating it on a real multicore platform using four benchmarks from the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向多核实时系统的数据驱动动态资源分配最优控制问题，考虑硬截止期约束与资源上限，证明可行性与最优解存在性，并设计算法在真实多核平台用四个基准测试验证。
AI.motivation: 多核实时系统中的动态资源分配需同时满足硬截止期约束和资源边界，现有方法缺乏数据驱动的最优控制理论支持。
AI.method: 将数据驱动动态资源分配建模为新的最优控制问题，纳入硬截止期与资源约束；在温和假设下证明可行性与最优解存在性，并据此设计求解算法。
AI.result: 理论上证明了问题的可行性和最优解存在性；实验上在真实多核平台用四个文献基准测试验证了算法的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该最优控制框架为多核实时系统数据驱动资源分配提供了理论基础与实用算法，实验表明其可行且有效。

title: Beyond Masked Sparsity: SNACK Enables Truly Sparse Neural Networks on GPU
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/JafarBadour/Snack-SNN
summary: Deep neural networks continue to grow in parameter count, driving up training and inference cost on GPUs. Sparse neural networks and Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) promise to reduce these costs, but most implementations rely on binary masks over dense tensors and recover little of the theoretical compute, memory, or energy savings. We propose SNACK, a truly sparse GPU layer that stores and computes only non-zero connections. SNACK exposes a simple PyTorch API for restructuring connections and backpropagating gradients entirely in the sparse paradigm, and ships SNACK-COO, a custom COO-format SpMM CUDA kernel with a batch-to-Streaming-Multiprocessor mapping tuned for the small-batch, high-sparsity regime typical of large-model training and single-stream inference. At the kernel level, SNACK is up to 7x faster than the masked dense baseline (Dense+Mask) and competitive with cuSPARSE, Sputnik, and FlashSparse at 95% sparsity. At 90% sparsity, a single SNACK layer accelerates training by 8x and 3.7x, and inference by 4x and 2x, over Dense+Mask and fully dense layers, respectively, while using 72% less memory than dense and substantially less energy. End-to-end, SNACK reduces GPT-2 peak training memory by up to 40% and graph-style inference latency by 4.8x over Dense+Mask at 99% sparsity.

AI.tldr: SNACK 是一种真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储和计算非零连接，配合定制 COO SpMM CUDA 内核 SNACK-COO，在大模型训练和推理中显著降低计算、内存和能耗成本。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络参数量持续增长导致 GPU 训练和推理成本上升。稀疏神经网络和动态稀疏训练（DST）有望降低成本，但多数实现依赖稠密张量上的二值掩码，几乎无法实现理论上的计算、内存或能耗节省。
AI.method: 提出 SNACK，一个真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储和计算非零连接，提供简单 PyTorch API 用于在稀疏范式中重构连接和反向传播梯度。同时提出 SNACK-COO，一种定制 COO 格式 SpMM CUDA 内核，采用批到流多处理器（SM）映射，针对小批量、高稀疏的大模型训练和单流推理场景优化。
AI.result: 内核层面，SNACK 在 95% 稀疏度下比 masked dense 基线（Dense+Mask）快最多 7 倍，并与 cuSPARSE、Sputnik、FlashSparse 相当。在 90% 稀疏度下，单个 SNACK 层使训练比 Dense+Mask 和全稠密层分别加速 8 倍和 3.7 倍，推理加速 4 倍和 2 倍，内存比稠密少 72%，能耗也显著降低。端到端，SNACK 在 99% 稀疏度下将 GPT-2 峰值训练内存降低最多 40%，图风格推理延迟比 Dense+Mask 降低 4.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: SNACK 通过真正稀疏的存储与计算方式及定制 CUDA 内核，在训练和推理中实现了显著的加速、内存节省和能耗降低，验证了稀疏范式的实际收益。

title: Inverse Cross-spectral Neural Networks for Multivariate Time Series
summary: CoVariance Neural Networks and their extensions have emerged as effective tools for processing multivariate data, deriving graph shift operators directly from second-order statistics. These architectures, however, are designed for independent and identically distributed observations and do not fully capture the joint structure of temporal and cross-variable dependencies in multivariate time series. In this work, we introduce Inverse Cross-Spectral Neural Networks (iCSNNs), a class of graph neural networks for stationary multivariate time series whose shift operators are the inverse cross-spectral density (iCSD) matrices. These operators encode frequency-specific conditional relationships among variables, exploiting the decomposition provided by the spectral representation theorem. Leveraging spectral smoothness, frequencies are grouped into bands sharing a single iCSD operator, yielding a compact parametrisation that retains the frequency-dependent structure of the process. We further propose a joint learning procedure to estimate both the Fourier-domain dependence structure and the iCSNN parameters, adapting the iCSD operators to the downstream task. When tested on synthetic data, iCSNN outperforms baselines from different methodological families.

AI.tldr: 提出逆交叉谱神经网络(iCSNN)，以逆交叉谱密度矩阵为图移位算子，处理平稳多变量时间序列，联合学习频域依赖结构与网络参数。
AI.motivation: 现有CoVariance神经网络及其扩展虽能从二阶统计量构建图移位算子处理多变量数据，但面向独立同分布观测，无法充分捕捉多变量时间序列中时间与变量间的联合依赖结构。
AI.method: 引入逆交叉谱密度(iCSD)矩阵作为图神经网络移位算子，编码变量间频率相关的条件关系，利用谱表示定理分解；借助谱平滑性将频率分组为共享同一iCSD算子的频带，实现紧凑参数化并保留频率依赖结构；提出联合学习流程，同时估计傅里叶域依赖结构与iCSNN参数，使iCSD算子适配下游任务。
AI.result: 在合成数据上测试，iCSNN优于来自不同方法学家族的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: iCSNN为平稳多变量时间序列提供了一种基于频域条件依赖的图神经网络框架，通过联合学习实现任务自适应的频域结构建模。

title: Understanding and Mitigating Hallucination Escape in Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as autonomous agents that invoke external tools. However, this capability introduces tool hallucination, selecting incorrect tools or generating invalid calls. Existing mitigation methods report substantial improvements, yet we identify a previously overlooked failure mode that we term Hallucination Escape. These methods reduce hallucination on the tool configuration they are tuned on but increase it on other configurations, canceling out the gain. We further investigate this phenomenon and find that hallucination rises sharply when a model's intrinsic tool-use tendencies conflict with the current tool configuration, and that existing methods reinforce rather than suppress these tendencies, which in turn contributes to hallucination escape. Building on these findings, we propose EscapeGuard, a training-free inference-time method that combines conflict-aware gating with configuration-derived attention enhancement to mitigate tool hallucination while preventing hallucination escape. Across six benchmarks on various models, EscapeGuard reduces tool-selection hallucination by 9.0 pp and suppresses hallucination escape, lowering the cross-configuration mean by 23.7 pp and achieving an 89.1% net improvement in paired-query evaluation. We hope this work can encourage evaluation beyond a single tool configuration and pave the way for more reliable tool-using LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出工具幻觉缓解中的新失效模式"Hallucination Escape"，并提出免训练推理方法EscapeGuard来同时抑制工具选择幻觉与幻觉逃逸。
AI.motivation: LLM作为自主智能体调用外部工具时会产生工具幻觉（选择错误工具或生成无效调用）。现有缓解方法虽报告显著改进，但存在被忽视的失效模式：在调优的工具配置上减少幻觉，却在其他配置上增加幻觉，抵消收益。作者想探究这一现象并解决它。
AI.method: 作者首先分析Hallucination Escape机制，发现当模型内在的工具使用倾向与当前工具配置冲突时幻觉急剧上升，且现有方法强化而非抑制这些倾向。基于此提出EscapeGuard：一种免训练的推理时方法，结合冲突感知门控（conflict-aware gating）与源自配置的注意力增强（configuration-derived attention enhancement）。
AI.result: 在多个模型的六个基准上，EscapeGuard将工具选择幻觉降低9.0个百分点，并抑制幻觉逃逸，跨配置均值降低23.7个百分点，在配对查询评估中取得89.1%的净提升。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁评估不应局限于单一工具配置，并希望推动更可靠的工具使用LLM智能体研究。

title: Agentic AI with Structured CoT for Enhancing AI's Spatial Intelligence: Visualization and Reasoning of Rotation
summary: Recent studies show that artificial intelligence (AI) with language and vision capabilities still experiences limitations in spatial reasoning. In this paper, we have studied the spatial capabilities of advanced generative AI to understand the rotations of objects in 3D space, utilizing AI's image processing and language processing features. We trained and examined the spatial intelligence of a generative Agentic AI model (GPT-5.6) to understand the spatial rotation process with rotation diagrams based on the revised Purdue Spatial Visualization Test: Visualization of Rotations (Revised PSVT:R). We improvised the Revised PSVT:R by superimposing additional graphical and contextual features to evaluate how different Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning strategies influence model performance. The results indicate that structured CoT reasoning improves the spatial reasoning performance of the base GPT-5.6 model in both datasets (PSVT:R and PSVT:R with coordinate system). We used three CoT approaches - (1) Structured CoT, (2) few-shot Structured CoT, and Structured CoT with Self-optimized Prompt. The three CoT approaches evaluated in this study showed no significant performance difference. Results showed that combining structured CoT reasoning with relevant contextual information leads to considerable improvements in VLM performance on 3D rotation tasks, demonstrating the potential of agentic AI for more effective spatial reasoning. However, when contextual information is removed, structured CoT reasoning alone provides limited improvement, and the models continue to exhibit notable difficulties in understanding spatial transformations. These findings suggest that effective spatial reasoning in VLMs relies on the integration of visual, textual, and reasoning-based information in future agentic AI systems for spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式Agentic AI模型（GPT-5.6）在3D物体旋转空间推理上的能力，基于改进的Revised PSVT:R测试，比较三种Chain-of-Thought策略的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有具备语言和视觉能力的AI在空间推理方面仍存在局限，作者希望探究先进生成式AI对3D空间物体旋转的理解能力，并寻找提升其空间智能的方法。
AI.method: 基于Revised PSVT:R，通过叠加额外图形与上下文特征对其进行改造（含坐标系版本），训练并考察GPT-5.6的空间智能；采用三种CoT策略：(1) 结构化CoT，(2) 少样本结构化CoT，(3) 带自优化提示的结构化CoT。
AI.result: 结构化CoT推理在两个数据集（PSVT:R及带坐标系的PSVT:R）上均提升了基础模型的性能；三种CoT方法之间无显著性能差异。结构化CoT结合相关上下文信息带来显著提升，但去除上下文信息后，仅靠结构化CoT改进有限，模型仍在空间变换理解上存在明显困难。
AI.conclusion: VLM的有效空间推理依赖于视觉、文本与推理信息的整合，未来Agentic AI系统需融合多模态信息以实现更强的空间智能。

title: Ambiguity-Aware Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Operations Research under Logical Inconsistency
summary: Operations research (OR) problems are often described by stakeholders with incomplete knowledge and vague expressions in real-world settings. Such ambiguous descriptions can not be used to formulation directly. Thus, automating OR problems solving requires processing this logical inconsistency in advance. To address this challenge, we propose an \textbf{A}mbiguity-Aware \textbf{M}ulti-Agent Framework for \textbf{A}utomated \textbf{O}R Problem Solving, \textbf{AMAO}, which first addresses logical inconsistency through two-stage alignment before downstream formulation and coding. Specifically, a logical alignment agent with OR-guided experts structure first produces an aligned candidate using supervised routing over variables, parameters, objectives, and constraints. Then, a source-sufficiency verifier determines whether the original description supports the required repairs. When evidence is insufficient, an interactive repair agent requests additional information and revises the description before modeling and coding. In addition, an ambiguity-aware benchmark and its matched dialogue extension are proposed to support evaluation of both stages. The 32B model achieved 86.8\% error-recovery success and 60.4\% solution accuracy, reaching 1.98 and 1.86 times the respective base-model scores. The 8B model achieved 47.9\% solution accuracy, exceeding the best evaluated variant such as DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Claude-sonnet-4.5. Interactive repair further achieved 90.71\% complete-description accuracy when cases requiring clarification. These results support combining context-based repair with evidence assessment and targeted user clarification for automated OR modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出AMAO多智能体框架，通过两阶段对齐处理运筹优化问题的模糊描述，实现自动化建模与求解。
AI.motivation: 现实中运筹优化问题常由利益相关者用不完整知识和模糊表达描述，存在逻辑不一致，无法直接用于建模求解，需自动化处理这些歧义。
AI.method: AMAO框架先做两阶段对齐：逻辑对齐智能体采用OR引导的专家结构，通过监督路由处理变量、参数、目标和约束生成候选；源充分性验证器判断原始描述是否支持修复；证据不足时，交互式修复智能体请求补充信息并修订描述，再进行建模与编码。同时提出歧义感知基准及其对话扩展用于评估。
AI.result: 32B模型达86.8%错误恢复成功率和60.4%求解准确率，分别为基线的1.98倍和1.86倍；8B模型达47.9%求解准确率，超越DeepSeek-V4-Flash和Claude-sonnet-4.5等最佳变体；交互式修复在需澄清案例中达90.71%完整描述准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结合基于上下文的修复、证据评估与针对性用户澄清，能有效支持自动化OR建模求解。

title: The asymptotic variance of the Hermite-Domain Predictor-Based Subspace Identification method
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC). 6 pages, 3 figures
summary: This paper derives analytical expressions for the asymptotic variance of the Hermite-Domain Predictor-Based Subspace Identification (HD-PBSID) method. Unlike continuous-time subspace approaches that rely on intermediate-domain transformations, HD-PBSID identifies continuous-time state-space matrices directly. The derivation first establishes the uncertainty of the estimated state-space matrices and then exploits these results to obtain asymptotic variance expressions. These expressions provide analytical uncertainty bounds for system eigenvalues, which are invariant under similarity transformations and therefore uniquely characterize the identified dynamics. The proposed formulas are first validated in an ideal Hermite-domain setting, where the conditions underlying the derivation are satisfied, and then assessed on noisy time-domain data through Monte Carlo simulations. The predicted bounds show very good agreement with the eigenvalue distributions in the ideal setting and acceptable agreement in the time-domain case when the innovation sequence is enforced to be white.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了HD-PBSID方法的渐近方差解析表达式，提供系统特征值的解析不确定性界，并通过理想Hermite域与含噪时域蒙特卡洛仿真验证。
AI.motivation: HD-PBSID直接辨识连续时间状态空间矩阵，无需中间域变换，但缺乏对该方法估计不确定性的解析刻画，需要给出渐近方差表达式以量化辨识结果的可靠性。
AI.method: 先建立估计状态空间矩阵的不确定性，再据此推导渐近方差解析表达式，得到对相似变换不变的系统特征值不确定性界。
AI.result: 在理想Hermite域条件下，预测界与特征值分布吻合很好；在含噪时域数据中，当新息序列为白噪声时吻合程度可接受。
AI.conclusion: 所提解析方差公式可有效刻画HD-PBSID方法的不确定性，理想条件下高度准确，实际时域条件下具合理可用性。

title: Progressive Multi-Ancestor Bit-Depth Distillation
summary: Model compression strategies are widely employed to reduce memory footprint and network complexity, particularly for devices with constrained computational, memory, and energy resources. Prior works that rely on simultaneous conversion from floating-point high-precision (FP32) to integer low-precision (INT4) representations and distillation into smaller models suffer from unstable training and drastic degradation of prediction performance. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework, known as \textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}ncestor \textbf{B}it-depth \textbf{D}istillation (PMABD), that progressively compresses the network while transferring knowledge through a growing pool of higher-precision ancestor teachers. PMABD generates a sequence of intermediate teachers that each learn from all higher-precision ancestors and jointly supervise the final target student. This multi-ancestor, multi-stage design stabilizes ultra-low-bit quantization by lowering quantization noise profiles across training and ensuring stable quantization. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 with ResNet-20/32/18, and Tiny-ImageNet with MobileNetV2 show that PMABD outperforms state-of-the-art compression frameworks, results in 1.06$\%$ increase in performance of W2A2 (ResNet-18/CIFAR-100) student model. We show that a saturation-based stopping criterion contributes to improve the performance of our final student.

AI.tldr: 提出PMABD统一框架，通过渐进式多祖先比特深度蒸馏实现超低比特量化，稳定训练并提升压缩网络性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法同时进行FP32到INT4转换和蒸馏到小模型，存在训练不稳定和预测性能急剧下降的问题。
AI.method: PMABD渐进压缩网络，生成一系列中间教师，每个教师学习所有更高精度祖先知识，并共同监督最终目标学生；通过多祖先多阶段设计降低量化噪声、稳定超低比特量化；引入基于饱和的停止准则。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100（ResNet-20/32/18）及Tiny-ImageNet（MobileNetV2）上超越SOTA压缩框架，W2A2（ResNet-18/CIFAR-100）学生模型性能提升1.06%。
AI.conclusion: PMABD有效稳定超低比特量化并提升性能，饱和停止准则进一步提升最终学生模型表现。

title: A Solvable Model of Adaptive Learning Rate Rescaling: Acceleration, Stability & Scaling
summary: A recurring design principle in modern optimizers is to decouple update magnitude from the raw gradient norm, yet its consequences for learning-curve and resource scaling remain unclear. We isolate this mechanism by studying normalized SGD in a random-feature model with power-law teacher and data covariance. Fixed-norm updates induce an effective learning rate that grows as gradients shrink. We derive a dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) describing the joint dependence of the loss on training time, model width and batch size. Normalization initially accelerates SGD, mapping the power-law exponent $r_{\rm SGD}<1$ to $2r_{\rm SGD}/(1-r_{\rm SGD})$, with exponential convergence at $r_{\rm SGD}=1$ and formal finite-time convergence for $r_{\rm SGD}>1$. At finite step size, however, the same feedback ultimately breaks the acceleration and leads to marginal stability. The late-time theory yields width-limited, edge-of-stochastic-stability (EoSS), and deterministic edge-of-stability (EoS) regimes. These phases determine when larger batches or wider models reduce serial training time at comparable compute. We quantify in which of these phases increased batch size or width can compensate the excess compute use per step by fewer optimization steps to target loss. Linearized ResNet experiments on CIFAR-5M support the predicted acceleration, breakdown, and resource-scaling trends. Together, these results connect normalization-induced acceleration, EoS effects, and width--batch allocation within a solvable theory.

AI.tldr: 通过随机特征模型中带幂律教师与数据协方差的归一化SGD分析，揭示归一化对学习曲线与资源缩放的影响，推导DMFT理论并识别宽度受限、EoSS与EoS三种相。
AI.motivation: 现代优化器普遍将更新幅度与原始梯度范数解耦，但这种机制对学习曲线与资源（宽度、批量）缩放的影响尚不清楚，需一个可解模型来隔离并刻画该机制。
AI.method: 在随机特征模型中研究归一化SGD，设定幂律教师与数据协方差，推导动态平均场理论（DMFT），刻画损失对训练时间、模型宽度和批量的联合依赖，并用线性化ResNet在CIFAR-5M上做实验验证。
AI.result: 归一化初期加速SGD，将幂律指数r_SGD映射为2r_SGD/(1-r_SGD)，r_SGD=1时指数收敛，r_SGD>1时形式化有限时间收敛；有限步长下反馈破坏加速并导致边缘稳定。晚期理论给出宽度受限、EoSS与EoS三类相，决定何时增大批量或宽度能在同等算力下减少串行训练时间。CIFAR-5M实验支持预测的加速、崩溃与资源缩放趋势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将归一化诱导的加速、EoS效应与宽度-批量分配统一在一个可解理论中，为理解解耦更新幅度与梯度范数这一设计原则的后果提供了理论框架。

title: DV-Lens: Revealing the Functional Organization of Language Model Parameters
summary: Understanding parameter functions helps elucidate the internal mechanisms of large language models (LLMs). However, how to connect parameters from different modules to verifiable output effects and further characterize the relationship between their functional organization and model capability remains to be explored. To this end, we introduce the downstream vocabulary lens (DV-Lens), a parameter-level interpretability framework that links native parameter directions to their downstream vocabulary responses. Specifically, we first estimate module-specific downstream Jacobians over a reference prompt set for attention query, key, value, and output (Q/K/V/O) projections and feed-forward networks (FFNs). Second, we use these mappings to project native parameter columns into the final vocabulary space, obtaining signed readouts that characterize their average local output responses. Third, we group parameter columns by their vocabulary readouts and introduce downstream vocabulary complexity (DV-Complexity), which quantifies within-group structural variation using normalized reconstruction residuals of the original weights. At the parameter level, randomized controls and finite-difference tests show that DV-Lens readouts capture non-random vocabulary structure and predict local logit changes with 98.0% coordinate-orientation agreement across 720 cases from nine models. These readouts further guide parameter ablation, steering, and swapping across 21 models, shifting target-token probabilities in the predicted directions under controlled conditions. At the model level, the joint-parameter score of DV-Complexity achieves a Spearman correlation of 0.904 with benchmark-based capability rankings across 48 language models. Together, these results provide intervention-based evidence for DV-Lens interpretations and reveal an association between DV-Complexity and model capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DV-Lens，一种参数级可解释性框架，将原生参数方向映射到下游词汇响应，并引入DV-Complexity指标，关联参数组织与模型能力。
AI.motivation: 理解参数功能有助于阐明大语言模型内部机制，但如何将不同模块参数与可验证的输出效果连接，并刻画其功能组织与模型能力的关系仍待探索。
AI.method: 1) 在参考提示集上估计注意力Q/K/V/O投影和FFN的模块级下游Jacobian；2) 用这些映射将原生参数列投影到最终词汇空间，得到带符号读出；3) 按词汇读出对参数列分组，并用归一化重构残差定义DV-Complexity，量化组内结构变化。
AI.result: 随机对照与有限差分测试表明，DV-Lens读出捕获非随机词汇结构，在9个模型720个案例中预测局部logit变化达98.0%坐标方向一致；读出指导21个模型的参数消融、引导与交换，在受控条件下按预测方向移动目标token概率；DV-Complexity联合参数分数与48个模型基准能力排名的Spearman相关为0.904。
AI.conclusion: 基于干预的证据支持DV-Lens解释的有效性，并揭示DV-Complexity与模型能力之间的关联。

title: MemLeak: Cross-User Semantic Leakage in Multi-Tenant AI Agent Memory
summary: Personal AI agents in enterprise multi-tenant deployments share a common vector store for long-term memory. Shared embedding spaces create a surface for cross-user memory leakage: a user's query can retrieve semantically adjacent memories belonging to another user through ordinary cosine-similarity retrieval, without any exploit. We formalize this as cross-user admissibility failure and evaluate it across six experiments, plus follow-up ablations, under both sparse (TF-IDF) and production-faithful (MiniLM-L6-v2) retrieval. Non-adversarial, incidental leakage reaches 70--100\% under pooled {same-team} retrieval; adversarially crafted memories achieve 90--100\% top-$k$ placement, exceeding weaker keyword-based attacker baselines, with score lifts of $+0.416$ to $+0.511$ under production-faithful dense retrieval (Config B); and end-to-end response contamination reaches 5.00/5 under a production retrieval path and 4.67/5 with Claude Sonnet~4.5, with contaminated responses often scoring as helpful or more helpful than clean ones, a gap validated against human judgment. Among three architectural mitigations, only hard post-retrieval ownership gating consistently restores the clean baseline (1.00/5) across {two generation models, at a measured latency overhead of roughly 1.4~ms per query.

AI.tldr: 企业多租户部署的共享向量库导致跨用户记忆泄漏，非对抗性泄漏达70-100%，对抗性攻击top-k命中90-100%，响应污染高达5.00/5；仅硬检索后所有权门控能恢复干净基线。
AI.motivation: 企业多租户AI代理共享长期记忆向量库，共享嵌入空间使一个用户的查询可通过普通余弦相似度检索到其他用户的语义相近记忆，无需任何漏洞利用，构成跨用户准入失效风险。
AI.method: 形式化定义"跨用户准入失效"，在稀疏(TF-IDF)与生产级(MiniLM-L6-v2)检索下进行六组实验及消融，考察非对抗与对抗性记忆注入对top-k检索与端到端响应的影响，并评估三种架构缓解措施。
AI.result: 非对抗性附带泄漏在同团队池化检索下达70-100%；对抗性记忆top-k命中90-100%，超过关键词攻击基线，密集检索分数提升+0.416至+0.511；端到端响应污染达5.00/5（生产路径）和4.67/5（Claude Sonnet 4.5），且污染响应常被评为不劣于干净响应（经人类判断验证）。
AI.conclusion: 共享向量库存在严重跨用户记忆泄漏，甚至污染响应被判定更有帮助；三种架构缓解中仅硬检索后所有权门控能在两种生成模型上一致恢复干净基线(1.00/5)，每查询额外延迟约1.4ms。

title: Harnessing LLMs with Direction-Scope Control for Combinatorial Solver Refinement
comment: The authors are listed in alphabetical order
summary: Harnesses are increasingly unlocking the potential of large language model (LLM) agents by making their actions more controllable. In automatic heuristic design (AHD) for combinatorial optimization (CO), LLMs iteratively revise solvers using execution and verification feedback. However, these revisions often break previously validated solver behavior, making refinement unstable and costly. We characterize this pattern as feasibility oscillation and document it across CO benchmarks, AHD methods, and backbone LLMs. Tracing this oscillation, our analysis reveals that feasibility degradation often follows large solver revisions, while substantial feedback redundancy makes it harder to identify which failures deserve attention. Motivated by these findings, we introduce DiSH, a harness that jointly controls revision direction and scope. It selects representative failure evidence to guide each update and progressively narrows the revision scope as feasible behavior accumulates. Across nine CO benchmarks, DiSH consistently improves QYI scores and reduces feasibility oscillation, while roughly halving feedback token consumption relative to prior methods that use full feedback. These results establish DiSH as a strong baseline for solver refinement under harness control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiSH harness，通过控制LLM智能体修改求解器的方向与范围，解决组合优化自动启发式设计中的可行性振荡问题，显著提升性能并减少反馈消耗。
AI.motivation: 在组合优化自动启发式设计中，LLM迭代修改求解器时常常破坏已验证的可行性行为，导致"可行性振荡"，使精炼不稳定且代价高昂。分析发现可行性下降多发生在大幅修改求解器后，且大量反馈冗余使关键失败难以识别。
AI.method: 提出DiSH harness，联合控制修改方向与范围：选取有代表性的失败证据来指导每次更新，并随着可行行为的累积逐步缩小修改范围。
AI.result: 在九个组合优化基准上，DiSH持续提升QYI分数并减少可行性振荡，同时相较使用完整反馈的先前方法大约减半反馈token消耗。
AI.conclusion: DiSH在harness控制下为求解器精炼建立了一个强有力的基线。

title: Doppler-Aware Meta-Learning for Evolutive STAR-RIS in Cognitive Autonomous Networks
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE JSTSP for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: In real-time optimization of simultaneous transmis- sion and reflection reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (STAR- RIS), limitations arise due to Doppler effects and reduced adaptation speed. Existing RIS memoryless surface models use quasi-static optimization and incur high latency, which limits their application in cognitive autonomous networks. To overcome this limitation, we propose a stateful RIS model that includes an element-wise memory, which locally stores and updates its phase history across coherence intervals. Hence, the metasurface be- comes a stateful surface with element-level memory that enables the exploitation of temporal channel correlations. This element- wise memory is complemented with a meta-parameter, yielding faster convergence and giving rise to hierarchical adaptation in gradient and episodic timescales. The proposed framework supports autonomous and experience-driven learning, which en- ables the STAR-RIS architecture and memory to adapt according to the Doppler effect, as seen in cognitive communication sys- tems. Results demonstrate an improvement in spectral efficiency and adaptation speed across various mobility patterns, fading models, interference levels, and array sizes. An analytical field- programmable gate array (FPGA) latency estimate indicates that the critical path fits within the coherence window.

AI.tldr: 提出带元素级记忆的状态化STAR-RIS模型，通过元参数实现梯度与情节时间尺度的分层自适应，提升频谱效率与适应速度。
AI.motivation: 现有STAR-RIS优化受多普勒效应与适应速度限制；无记忆表面模型采用准静态优化，延迟高，难以用于认知自主网络。
AI.method: 引入元素级记忆的状态化RIS模型，局部存储并更新每个单元跨相干区间的相位历史，利用时间信道相关性；辅以元参数，实现梯度与情节双时间尺度的分层自适应，支持自主经验驱动学习。
AI.result: 在多种移动模式、衰落模型、干扰水平和阵列尺寸下，频谱效率与适应速度均提升；FPGA延迟分析表明关键路径落在相干窗口内。
AI.conclusion: 状态化、元素级记忆的STAR-RIS可显著改善动态环境下的实时优化，适配认知通信系统的多普勒效应。

title: Physics is the Best Teacher: Consistency Learning for Time-Invariant Operators of Chaotic Dynamics
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Accepted for the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Accelerating the prediction of long-term behavior in chaotic systems is crucial in scientific computing. However, existing methods rely on numerical solvers or autoregressive models that advance one small step at a time, which makes long horizons expensive. We instead view this problem as learning the system's time-invariant evolution operator, which jumps the state across a large time span in a single evaluation. To this end, we derive the consistency equations a time-invariant operator must satisfy, with differential and compositional objectives in physical time. These equations also connect the learned operator to the physics-prescribed instant dynamics, enabling physics embedding in consistency learning. Across five chaotic systems, we find that physics-distilled consistency makes both short-term trajectories and long-term statistics more accurate. The learned operator survives temporal extrapolation and requires one-tenth as many evaluations as autoregressive rollout, offering an efficient route to long-term simulation of chaotic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文将混沌系统长期预测视为学习时间不变演化算子，用一致性方程实现大步长跳跃，效率提升10倍。
AI.motivation: 现有数值求解器或自回归模型逐步小步推进，长期预测代价高昂。
AI.method: 学习时间不变演化算子，推导其必须满足的一致性方程（物理时间下的微分与复合目标），并连接瞬时动力学实现物理嵌入的一致性学习。
AI.result: 在五个混沌系统上，物理蒸馏一致性使短期轨迹和长期统计更准确，支持时间外推，评估次数仅为自回归的十分之一。
AI.conclusion: 为混沌动力学长期仿真提供了一条高效路径。

title: Direct Intermediate Initialization for Tilted Diffusion Samplers
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics (STODY)
summary: Some diffusion posterior samplers construct Gaussian-tilted intermediate distributions along the reverse process. We observe that these targets can be pulled back to clean-space posteriors with weaker conditioning, with samples transported analytically to the corresponding noisy-space target through a Gaussian bridge. For the sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) sampler MCGDiff, the effective observation variance of this pulled-back problem is up to twice the diffusion-noise variance. We exploit this structure to initialize MCGDiff directly at an intermediate time: an approximate solver samples the softened clean-space posterior, the Gaussian bridge maps these samples to the tilted target, and only the remaining SMC suffix is run. This trades asymptotic consistency for finite-particle performance. With moment-matching posterior sampling (MMPS) as the solver, the hybrid improves sliced Wasserstein distance by roughly $2\times$ at matched particle count on a structured Gaussian-mixture inverse problem, and by more than an order of magnitude when the posterior-relevant mode is rare under the prior. A prior-initialization control, which retains the bridge but drops the clean-space conditioning, shows that on MCGDiff's standard Gaussian-mixture benchmark most of the improvement is insensitive to the conditioning. Conditioning the initialization gives a further consistent gain on the structured problem, and becomes decisive on a rare-mode problem, where resampling cannot repopulate a mode absent from the initial population.

AI.tldr: 提出将MCGDiff的中间分布拉回至条件更弱的干净空间后验，用高斯桥将样本解析地传输到噪声空间目标，从而支持从中间时刻初始化的混合采样器，牺牲渐近一致性换取有限粒子性能。
AI.motivation: MCGDiff等扩散后验采样器构造高斯倾斜中间分布，但标准SMC从头开始采样，在有限粒子数下效率受限，尤其是后验相关模式在先验下罕见时。
AI.method: 观察到倾斜目标可拉回为条件更弱的干净空间后验，拉回问题的有效观测方差最高可达扩散噪声方差的两倍；据此直接在中间时刻初始化MCGDiff：用近似求解器（如MMPS）采样软化后的干净空间后验，再用高斯桥映射到倾斜目标，仅运行剩余SMC后缀。
AI.result: 在结构化高斯混合逆问题、匹配粒子数下，切片Wasserstein距离约改善2倍；当后验相关模式在先验下罕见时改善超过一个数量级。先验初始化对照（保留桥但去掉干净空间条件）显示标准高斯混合基准上大部分提升对条件不敏感；条件化初始化为结构化问题带来持续增益，并在罕见模式问题上起决定性作用。
AI.conclusion: 利用倾斜目标与干净空间后验的桥接结构，可有效改进有限粒子扩散后验采样的初始化；条件化初始化在罕见模式场景中不可替代，因为重采样无法恢复初始粒子群中缺失的模式。

title: Emoji-Emotion Ranking System Using Twitter Data
summary: Nowadays, emojis are often replacing words. Yet computational systems still oversimplify them. Most existing approaches treat emojis as static sentiment indicators and overlook their emotional distributions. In this study, we propose an emoji-aware emotion analysis framework based on a Twitter (X) dataset of 100,000 emoji-containing replies collected between 2020-2025. After preprocessing and text cleaning, we applied text-to-emotion classification to detect five primary emotions (Happy, Angry, Sad, Fear, and Surprise) for each message. By aggregating emotion scores across contexts in which each emoji appears, we estimate emoji-emotion association distributions and construct an emoji-emotion ranking system reflecting relative emotional dominance. Furthermore, we project emojis into the Russell valence-arousal space to enable continuous affective interpretation. Our results demonstrate that emojis exhibit probabilistic, context-sensitive emotional profiles rather than fixed sentiment polarities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于10万条含表情推文的情感分析框架，揭示表情具有概率性、情境敏感的情感分布而非固定极性。
AI.motivation: 现有计算系统将表情简单视为静态情感指标，忽视其情感分布，尽管表情正日益取代文字。
AI.method: 收集2020-2025年10万条含表情的推文回复，预处理后做五类情感分类（高兴、愤怒、悲伤、恐惧、惊讶），聚合各表情出现情境的情感得分，构建表情-情感关联分布与排序系统，并投影到Russell效价-唤醒空间。
AI.result: 表情呈现概率性、情境敏感的情感画像，而非固定情感极性。
AI.conclusion: 表情应被建模为动态情感分布而非静态极性，为更精细的情感计算提供了框架。

title: Asynchronous Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: LLM-based long-horizon agentic post-training is often bottlenecked by rollout generation: trajectories span many interaction turns, completion times vary substantially, and synchronous update barriers leave faster workers waiting for stragglers. Asynchronous reinforcement learning which has been adopted in LLM post-training addresses this inefficiency by consuming trajectories as they arrive, but introduces policy lag and off-policy optimization. Evolution strategies (ES) offer a backpropagation-free alternative for LLM post-training, yet it relies on a larger number of rollouts and existing practices have remained largely synchronous. In this short-form paper, we introduce bounded-staleness asynchronous ES and demonstrate it on Endless Terminals benchmark using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across three evaluation seeds, natural Async-1 matches synchronous ES, achieving 25.9\% versus 25.4\% held-out success. Controlled schedules that delay 10\% of each update cohort by four or eight policy updates reduce success by only 1.6 and 3.1 percentage points, respectively, without explicit off-policy correction. GRPO performs better overall, reaching 29.0\% held-out success, but importantly our results show that ES tolerates moderate policy staleness with limited degradation, opening possibilities for future improvement of ES-based post-training with asynchronous algorithms. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to demonstrate the effectiveness of sync and async ES on a multi-turn terminal style agentic coding task.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在多轮终端式智能体编码任务上验证了同步与异步进化策略(ES)的有效性，提出有界陈旧性异步ES，并表明ES能容忍中等程度的策略陈旧。
AI.motivation: LLM长时程智能体后训练受限于rollout生成：轨迹交互轮次多、完成时间差异大，同步更新屏障让快worker等待慢worker。异步RL虽提升效率却引入策略滞后；ES无需反向传播但依赖大量rollout且通常同步。
AI.method: 提出有界陈旧性的异步ES，在Endless Terminals基准上用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct验证。设置自然Async-1以及受控调度（将每批10%的轨迹延迟4或8次策略更新），不做显式离策略修正。
AI.result: 三个评估种子下，自然Async-1与同步ES相当（25.9% vs 25.4%留出成功率）。延迟10%队列4或8次更新仅使成功率降低1.6和3.1个百分点。GRPO整体更好，达29.0%留出成功率。
AI.conclusion: ES能容忍中等策略陈旧且性能退化有限，为未来基于异步算法的ES后训练改进开辟了可能。作者称是首次在多轮终端式智能体编码任务上展示同步与异步ES的有效性。

title: Curvature, Scaling, and Complexity in Riemannian Projection-Free Optimization
