These results show that TimeNet provides the data and systems foundation needed to move beyond task- and dataset-specific TFMs toward models that can learn jointly across heterogeneous domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision from a common data model.

AI.tldr: TimeNet 是一个开源数据标准与可扩展基础设施，通过统一数据模型将时间信号、元数据、标注和监督解耦于任务定义，支持多模态、多任务的大规模时序基础模型联合训练。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型（TFM）旨在跨域、跨数据集、跨任务泛化，但其发展受限于碎片化的、任务特定的数据格式、标注和处理流程，导致异构时序数据集难以联合用于大规模训练。
AI.method: 提出 TimeNet：一个开源数据标准与可扩展基础设施。它将时序数据与任务定义解耦，在共享、可扩展的数据模型中表示信号、元数据、标注与监督；支持规则、不规则或序数时间轴的多模态信号，并将分类、预测、时序定位、问答、生成、编辑等任务族表达为同一记录的“可复用视图”，从而实现异构数据集的共享表示与联合训练。
AI.result: 转码了含150万任务实例的数据集，覆盖多领域、多模态、多时间尺度与多监督形式，同时保持相对原生格式的实用I/O性能；仅通过配置改动即可让现有TFM训练管线支持多个异构数据集联合训练；跨多数据集多任务训练TFM，相比单数据集训练模型F1提升14%。
AI.conclusion: TimeNet 为摆脱任务与数据集特定的TFM，迈向能在异构领域、模态、时间尺度与监督形式间从统一数据模型联合学习的模型，提供了所需的数据与系统基础。

title: Direct Vertex-Derivative Coefficient Propagation forHomogeneous Numerical Integration (HNI)
summary: Homogeneous numerical integration (HNI) combines Euler's identity and Stokes' theorem to integrate homogeneous polynomials over a polytope $P$. Existing algorithms return scalar integrals or reusable moment families. Any resulting moment table can be recoded afterward: once all degree-$q$ moments are known, integration on $\mathcal H\_q$ (degree-$q$ forms) has a trivial representation by a pure order-$q$ distribution supported at any single arbitrary point. Our contribution is instead to propagate functionals through the face complex, once for $(P,q)$ and without first forming the moment vector, to obtain a signed vertex-derivative coefficient functional on $\mathcal H\_q$, specific to $P$ and determined directly by its supplied face geometry and chosen anchors. A finite-dimensional Riesz framework describes its nonuniqueness, gives an intrinsic $L^2(P)$ error for restricted formulas, and supports weighted post-processing. The independently generated degree-$q$ and degree-$2q$ coefficient vectors satisfy an explicit compatibility relation. Vertex anchors can prune the propagated representation as shown in some polygon examples and an offline benchmark quantify this effect without claiming global cardinality optimality or improved conditioning. The construction covers convex polytopes and oriented non-convex polyhedral domains in arbitrary dimension.

AI.tldr: 提出齐次数值积分(HNI)新方法：直接在面复形上传播泛函，得到P特定的符号顶点导数系数泛函，无需先构造矩向量，并用Riesz框架刻画非唯一性与误差。
AI.motivation: 已有HNI算法返回标量积分或可复用矩族，但需先形成矩向量再重编码；本文希望跳过矩向量步骤，直接通过面复形传播泛函，得到与P的面对几何和锚点直接相关的表示。
AI.method: 对给定(P,q)在面复形上一次性传播泛函，不经矩向量，得到作用在H_q上的符号顶点导数系数泛函；用有限维Riesz框架描述其非唯一性，给出受限公式的内在L²(P)误差，并支持加权后处理；利用顶点锚点剪枝传播表示。
AI.result: 独立生成的q阶与2q阶系数向量满足显式相容关系；多边形示例中顶点锚点可剪枝传播表示；离线基准量化该效果（不宣称全局基数最优或条件数改善）。
AI.conclusion: 该构造适用于任意维凸多面体及有向非凸多面体区域，提供了一种从面几何直接得到顶点导数泛函的HNI途径。

title: Do RUL explanations hold up? Faithfulness and stability of attributions on C-MAPSS
summary: Deep remaining-useful-life (RUL) models on NASA C-MAPSS are now routine, and so are heatmaps that colour sensors and timesteps. A heatmap that looks mechanical is not the same as an explanation an engineer can act on. We train three standard architectures - a 1D CNN, an LSTM, and a small Transformer encoder - on the official FD001 and FD003 splits with the piecewise RUL cap of 125 cycles and the official PHM08 asymmetric score. We then attach three attribution maps (Integrated Gradients, occlusion, last-layer attention) and evaluate them with the checks the XAI-for-PdM literature still under-reports: deletion/insertion faithfulness, Spearman stability under sensor-scale noise, agreement across training seeds, and cosine consistency inside RUL bins. Prediction error is a prerequisite, not the claim. The headline is which explanation method moves the RUL output when its top cells are removed, and which map survives a 5% input perturbation. Integrated Gradients and occlusion are similarly faithful on the LSTM; Transformer attention is cheap and temporally smooth but weakly faithful. All three maps are almost unchanged under 5% input noise, yet IG/occlusion agree only moderately across two LSTM seeds - stability to sensor jitter is not the same as stability to retraining. A secondary tabular check on the AI4I 2020 failure dataset shows the same deletion pattern for tree importances. We recommend occlusion or IG for any C-MAPSS-style report that will be read by a maintenance engineer, and we treat raw attention weights as a visualisation only.

AI.tldr: 在C-MAPSS上训练CNN/LSTM/Transformer并对比IG、遮挡、注意力三种归因方法，发现IG与遮挡更忠实且可操作，原始注意力仅适合可视化。
AI.motivation: 现有RUL模型的传感器/时间步热力图看似机制化，但不等同于工程师可据以行动的可靠解释；XAI-for-PdM文献对忠实性、稳定性等检验仍报告不足。
AI.method: 在官方FD001/FD003上训练1D CNN、LSTM、小型Transformer（RUL上限125、PHM08非对称评分）；附加IG、遮挡、末层注意力三种归因，并用删除/插入忠实性、传感器尺度噪声下Spearman稳定性、跨训练种子一致性、RUL分箱内余弦一致性进行评估；另在AI4I 2020上做表格验证。
AI.result: LSTM上IG与遮挡忠实性相近；Transformer注意力便宜且时序平滑但忠实性弱。三种图在5%输入噪声下几乎不变，但IG/遮挡跨两个LSTM种子仅中等一致——抗传感器抖动不等于抗重训练。AI4I上树模型重要性呈相同删除模式。
AI.conclusion: 建议C-MAPSS类报告采用遮挡或IG供维修工程师阅读，原始注意力权重仅作可视化；稳定于输入扰动与被重训练一致是两回事。

title: RL-finetuning LLMs from on- and off-policy data with a single algorithm
summary: We introduce a novel reinforcement learning algorithm (AGRO, for Any-Generation Reward Optimization) for fine-tuning large-language models. AGRO leverages the concept of generation consistency, which states that the optimal policy satisfies the notion of consistency across any possible generation of the model. We derive algorithms that find optimal solutions via the sample-based policy gradient and provide theoretical guarantees on their convergence. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of AGRO in both on-policy and off-policy settings, showing improved performance on the mathematical reasoning dataset over baseline algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AGRO，一种基于"生成一致性"概念的强化学习算法，用于微调大语言模型，并在数学推理任务上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型微调中，如何利用强化学习找到最优策略仍具挑战，需要一个能跨任意生成结果保持一致的优化框架。
AI.method: 提出 AGRO（Any-Generation Reward Optimization）算法，基于生成一致性假设（最优策略在模型任意生成下都满足一致性），通过基于采样的策略梯度方法求解最优解，并给出收敛性理论保证。
AI.result: 在 on-policy 和 off-policy 设置下均有效，在数学推理数据集上相比基线算法性能提升。
AI.conclusion: AGRO 为 LLM 微调提供了一种有理论保证的强化学习新方法，实验证明其优于现有基线。

title: TrajLong: Co-Designing Agentic and Long-Context Supervision for Mid-Training
summary: LLM agents for coding, search, and workplace tasks increasingly rely on long-context capabilities to effectively aggregate and reason over extended interaction histories. Recent work has incorporated agent trajectories into mid-training stage, drawing on their naturally long and interaction-rich structure. Yet how to organize the information within these trajectories into effective mid-training supervision remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate the relationship between long-context and agent atomic capabilities and introduce TrajLong, a novel framework that compiles trajectories into long-context training tasks with dense supervision, targeting three representative atomic capabilities: evidence grounding, cross-evidence aggregation, and temporal state maintenance. We mid-train Qwen3-14B-Base and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base with data compiled by TrajLong, followed by supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on 6 long-context and 12 agent benchmarks demonstrate broad performance gains, with controlled ablations showing improvements over raw and masked trajectory baselines. Capability-level analyses further reveal task-dependent associations between long-context and agent atomic capabilities. These findings suggest that the shared capability demands of long-context reasoning and agent execution provide a principled basis for designing mid-training data to develop downstream agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrajLong框架，将智能体轨迹编译为带密集监督的长上下文训练任务，针对证据定位、跨证据聚合、时序状态维持三种原子能力，通过中训练显著提升长上下文与智能体任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖长上下文能力聚合并推理交互历史，已有工作将轨迹用于中训练，但如何组织轨迹内的信息以形成有效的长上下文中训练监督仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出TrajLong框架，将轨迹编译为具有密集监督的长上下文训练任务，聚焦三种原子能力：证据定位、跨证据聚合、时序状态维持。先用TrajLong编译的数据对Qwen3-14B-Base和Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base进行中训练，再进行监督微调。
AI.result: 在6个长上下文基准和12个智能体基准上取得广泛性能提升；受控消融显示优于原始轨迹和掩码轨迹基线；能力层面分析揭示长上下文与智能体原子能力之间存在任务依赖的关联。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文推理与智能体执行的共享能力需求，为设计下游智能体能力的中训练数据提供了有原则的依据。

title: CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of Black-Box Reinforcement Learning Policies
summary: The deployment of Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents in critical domains must be preceded with a pipeline to evaluate the alignment of the RL agent with complex multi-objective specifications and robustness under real-world environmental drift. However, to protect intellectual property, the RL agent may be delivered for evaluation as opaque executable or remote API, which makes traditional evaluation techniques based on the internals of the policies infeasible. To address this gap, CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of black box RL policy is proposed in this paper. The CORE-RL pipeline introduces a Unified Reliability Metric that formally integrates early task termination and safety constraint violations, preventing unsafe policies from masking failures through premature episode halts. By subjecting the policy to a noise certification envelope of perceptual noise, actuation noise and change in environment dynamics, the pipeline computes the finite-sample Clopper-Pearson bounds on unified reliability metric and Hoeffdings' lower bound on reward and safety cost. The pipeline then defines safe operational design domain to report high-confidence certificates for safety and expected performance. Experiments on continuous control tasks demonstrate the CORE-RL pipeline's ability to automatically reject non-compliant policies and map the safe Operational Design Domain (ODD) of safety-aware policies. Thus CORE-RL provides an evaluation framework towards a quantitative, transparent and reproducible, statistical rationale necessary to safely evaluate, compare, and deploy black box RL solutions.

AI.tldr: CORE-RL 提出一种针对黑盒强化学习策略的置信度导向可靠性评估流程，通过统一可靠性指标与噪声认证包络，计算有限样本统计边界并划定安全运行设计域（ODD）。
AI.motivation: 关键领域部署 RL 前需评估其与多目标规范的符合性及环境漂移下的鲁棒性，但为保护知识产权，策略常以不可解释的可执行文件或远程 API 形式交付，传统依赖策略内部信息的评估方法失效。
AI.method: CORE-RL 流程引入统一可靠性指标，整合早期任务终止与安全约束违反，防止不安全策略通过提前终止掩盖失败；对策略施加包含感知噪声、执行噪声和环境动态变化的噪声认证包络，计算统一可靠性指标的有限样本 Clopper-Pearson 边界，以及奖励与安全成本的 Hoeffding 下界；据此定义安全 ODD 并给出高置信度证书。
AI.result: 在连续控制任务实验中，CORE-RL 能自动拒绝不符合规范的策略，并绘制出安全感知策略的安全 ODD。
AI.conclusion: CORE-RL 提供了一个量化、透明、可复现且具备统计依据的评估框架，支持对黑盒 RL 方案进行安全评估、比较与部署。

title: Score-Calibrated Flow for Sampling from Unnormalized Densities with Applications to Generative Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for online reinforcement learning (RL), enabling multimodal behaviors and improved performance. However, training these policies remains challenging: the critic specifies the desired policy as an unnormalized Boltzmann density but does not provide direct samples from it. Many existing methods rely on importance sampling to construct training signals, which can suffer from high variance, increasing computational cost and destabilizing training. We propose Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF), a simple and efficient algorithm for training generative models to sample from unnormalized densities without importance sampling or backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. We learn the desired flow by enforcing self-consistency, bypassing target posterior mean estimation. By jointly exploiting the prescribed target score and the structure of flow matching, we establish these self-consistency requirements as score-calibrated optimality conditions, first for the terminal density and then for the trainable velocity field. We prove that their unique solutions are, respectively, the target density and the ideal flow model that conditional flow matching (CFM) would recover if target samples were available. We formulate the velocity condition as a fixed-point equation and exploit its conditional-expectation structure to construct a stop-gradient objective for enforcing it. The resulting training procedure retains the scalable sample-interpolate-regress structure of CFM despite the absence of target samples, using endpoints generated by the current flow. For online RL, the critic gradient supplies the target score at the generated actions, yielding a direct approach to actor training. Experiments on RL benchmarks demonstrate that SCF matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative-policy baselines, while substantially reducing training time.

AI.tldr: 提出Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF)，通过自一致性条件在无重要性采样、无助采样轨迹反传的情况下训练生成式策略，从非归一化密度采样，效率与性能俱佳。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型能为在线强化学习提供表达力强的多模态策略，但其训练困难：critic只将目标策略指定为未归一化的Boltzmann密度，无法直接采样，许多方法依赖高方差的重要性采样，导致计算成本高且训练不稳定。
AI.method: SCF利用自一致性学习目标流，绕过对目标后验均值的估计。联合利用给定目标score与flow matching结构，导出score-calibrated最优条件（先针对终端密度，再针对可训练速度场）。证明其唯一解分别是目标密度以及若有目标样本时CFM会恢复的理想流模型。将速度条件表述为不动点方程，利用其条件期望结构构造stop-gradient目标，在无目标样本时仍保持CFM的sample-interpolate-regress结构，用当前流生成的端点。在线RL中，critic梯度在生成动作处提供目标score，直接用于actor训练。
AI.result: 在RL基准上，SCF匹配或超越现有生成式策略基线，同时大幅减少训练时间。
AI.conclusion: SCF提供了一种简单高效、无需重要性采样或轨迹反传的生成式策略训练方法，直接利用critic梯度作为score，兼顾性能与效率。

title: First-Order Steering: Translating Weight Adaptation into Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering exploits interpretable directions in the residual stream to enable inference-time manipulation of model behavior. Composing steering vectors to apply multiple target behaviors simultaneously is important in various fields-including AI alignment and safety-but remains a challenge for existing activation steering methods. In contrast, prior work in model merging shows that target behaviors represented by learned weight adaptations can be combined with high accuracy. A method that translates weight adaptations into activation steering vectors could therefore extend prior work in model merging to generate composable steering vectors that better enable simultaneous inference-time behavioral control. For this, we introduce First-Order Steering, a formulation of activation steering as a first-order approximation of weight update matrices parameterized by a vector of steering strengths, and establish theoretical bounds on the approximation error of first-order steering. We then develop a novel model merging procedure, HeRD-Merging, which minimizes the first-order approximation error terms to enable higher first-order steering accuracy. Together, our method produces steering vectors that control both individual and composed behaviors more accurately than existing activation steering methods. Furthermore, HeRD-Merging matches the performance of conventional model-merging baselines, while producing weight adaptations that admit more accurate first-order steering vectors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出First-Order Steering，将激活引导表述为权重更新矩阵的一阶近似，并给出近似误差的理论界；同时提出HeRD-Merging模型合并方法最小化该误差，从而生成可组合且更准确的引导向量。
AI.motivation: 激活引导虽能在推理时操控模型行为，但将多个引导向量组合以同时实现多种目标行为仍是难题；而模型合并中学习的权重适配可高精度组合行为，因此希望把权重适配转化为激活引导向量。
AI.method: 1) 将激活引导形式化为由引导强度向量参数化的权重更新矩阵的一阶近似（First-Order Steering）；2) 建立一阶引导近似误差的理论界；3) 提出HeRD-Merging模型合并流程，通过最小化一阶近似误差项提升引导精度。
AI.result: 相比现有激活引导方法，该方法在单一行为与组合行为控制上均更准确；HeRD-Merging在匹配传统模型合并基线性能的同时，产生能支持更精确一阶引导的权重适配。
AI.conclusion: 将模型合并的权重适配与激活引导相结合，可生成可组合的推理时行为控制向量，兼顾模型合并的精度与激活引导的灵活性。

title: Blazing the trails before beating the path: Sample-efficient Monte-Carlo planning
comment: Published in Neural Information Processing Systems 2016
summary: You are a robot and you live in a Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite or an infinite number of transitions from state-action to next states. You got brains and so you plan before you act. Luckily, your roboparents equipped you with a generative model to do some Monte-Carlo planning. The world is waiting for you and you have no time to waste. You want your planning to be efficient. Sample-efficient. Indeed, you want to exploit the possible structure of the MDP by exploring only a subset of states reachable by following near-optimal policies. You want guarantees on sample complexity that depend on a measure of the quantity of near-optimal states. You want something, that is an extension of Monte-Carlo sampling (for estimating an expectation) to problems that alternate maximization (over actions) and expectation (over next states). But you do not want to StOP with exponential running time, you want something simple to implement and computationally efficient. You want it all and you want it now. You want TrailBlazer.

AI.tldr: 提出TrailBlazer算法，用于MDP中高效蒙特卡洛规划，仅探索近似最优策略可达的状态子集，并给出依赖近似最优状态数量的样本复杂度保证。
AI.motivation: 在MDP中进行规划时希望样本高效，利用MDP结构只探索近似最优策略可达的状态，并获得样本复杂度保证，同时避免StOP的指数运行时间。
AI.method: TrailBlazer将蒙特卡洛采样（估计期望）推广到交替进行最大化（对动作）和期望（对下一状态）的问题，实现简单且计算高效。
AI.result: 算法能够聚焦于近似最优状态子集，样本复杂度与该近似最优状态数量相关，且避免了指数级运行时间。
AI.conclusion: TrailBlazer为MDP蒙特卡洛规划提供了一种样本高效、实现简单、计算高效且带样本复杂度保证的方法。

title: IREA: Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment for Normative RAG
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance across various tasks, but they still struggle with questions involving ethical judgment. Previous studies have attempted to train LLMs on ethical standards, but the diversity and relativity of ethical norms make them difficult to fully internalize in model parameters. As an alternative, we introduce normative RAG, a retrieval-augmented approach that supports ethical judgment using external normative knowledge. Normative retrieval involves a distinct asymmetry between context rich narrative queries and generalized normative statements. Existing factual retrieval methods rely on query-only expansion into a document-like form, making them insufficient for resolving this asymmetry. Therefore, we propose Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment (IREA), a bidirectional alignment method that maps both text types into a shared situation-behavior representation. This representation captures ethically salient contextual and behavioral information in a normalized form, reducing surface-level discrepancies and improving alignment in the embedding space. Experimental results show that IREA improves normative retrieval and downstream ethical judgment across multiple settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of bidirectional alignment for normative RAG.

AI.tldr: 提出规范RAG（Normative RAG），通过外部规范知识支持伦理判断；核心方法IREA实现叙事查询与规范文本的双向对齐，提升检索与判断效果。
AI.motivation: LLM在伦理判断任务上表现不佳，而伦理规范多样且相对，难以完全内化进模型参数，因此需要借助外部规范知识。
AI.method: 规范检索存在"叙事型查询"与"概括型规范"之间的不对称性，现有仅对查询扩展的事实检索方法不足。为此提出IREA，将两类文本双向映射到共享的"情境-行为"表征，提取伦理显著信息并规范化，缩小表层差异、改善嵌入空间对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明，IREA在多种设置下提升了规范检索效果及下游伦理判断表现。
AI.conclusion: 双向对齐方法对规范RAG有效，验证了该思路解决伦理判断问题的价值。

title: Asking Earns Nothing: Scoring the Decision to Act in BFCL Multi-Turn
summary: An agent that lacks the information it needs should ask rather than act, and the task definitions of agent leaderboards say so. BFCL multi-turn builds two of its four categories around a turn on which the model is supposed to ask, and its scorer never looks at that turn: the gold trajectory there is empty, the checker skips it, and the scripted user cannot answer, so asking earns nothing, guessing costs nothing on that turn, and asking twice loses the item. The benchmark also contains the control experiment for that decision. A should-ask item is a base item with one piece of information removed from one turn, so the same request appears twice at the same turn index, once complete and once not: on the first the model should make the call that changes the world, on the second it should ask. We score one decision per pair, whether the model attempted a world-changing call on that turn, read off the stored trajectories with no LLM judge; acting always and asking always both score 50. On the 223 pairs that pose this decision, gpt-5.4 attempts the call on 83.4% of the complete turns and holds back on 78.0% of the incomplete ones, the best decision accuracy of seven models at 80.7%; on the same items the official score ranks it sixth and puts first a model that lands in the middle here. One added line telling gpt-5.4 not to ask pushes it toward acting on both sides of the pair, so its decision accuracy shows no detectable change, while its official score rises by 13.5 to 23.5 points on the two should-ask categories and on the base twins; the opposite line, telling gemma-4-31B-it to ask first, improves its decision by 4.5 points and gains no official score. The score moves with the push toward action, not with the decision. We release the pairs, a turn-level scorer that runs on any BFCL output directory without an API key, and 31 manually verified bad items.

AI.tldr: BFCL多轮中"应提问"任务的评分器完全忽略提问轮（金标轨迹为空、检查器跳过、脚本用户无法应答），导致提问无收益、猜测无代价。作者用配对控制实验独立评分"是否发起改变世界的调用"这一决策，发现官方分数与真实决策能力脱节。
AI.motivation: 智能体在信息不足时应当提问而非行动，BFCL多轮的四个类别中有两个围绕此设计。但其评分器从不对该轮评分：金标为空、检查器跳过、脚本用户无法回答。结果是提问不得分、猜测无代价、问两次反而丢分，官方排行榜可能奖励了错误的倾向。
AI.method: 利用基准中自带的对照实验：一个"应提问"条目就是基础条目在某轮去掉一条信息，于是同一请求在同一轮索引出现两次（完整/不完整）。前者应执行改变世界的调用，后者应提问。对每一对只评一个决策——该轮是否尝试了改变世界的调用，直接从存储轨迹读取，无需LLM裁判。全行动和全提问都得50分。在223对上评估七个模型。
AI.result: gpt-5.4在完整轮83.4%发起调用、在不完整轮78.0%克制，决策准确率80.7%为七模型最高；但官方分数仅列第六，第一名在此决策上表现中庸。加入"不要提问"提示使gpt-5.4两侧都倾向于行动，决策准确率无可检测变化，而官方分数在两个应提问类别及基础孪生条目上提升13.5至23.5分；相反提示gemma-4-31B-it"先提问"使决策提升4.5分却无官方分数收益。
AI.conclusion: 官方分数随"偏向行动"移动，而非随决策质量移动，说明BFCL多轮评分存在系统性缺陷，无法衡量智能体是否恰当地提问。作者发布配对数据、无需API密钥的轮级评分器，以及31个经人工核验的坏条目。

title: CaCuTe Meets SESOP: Better Theory and Practice with Lipschitz Hessians
summary:
We combine CaCuTe with sequential subspace optimization (SESOP) for smooth convex minimization under Lipschitz continuity of the Hessian. The resulting method, CaCuSESOP, achieves the global rate $O(k^{-2})$ with a fixed number of Hessian--vector products per iteration, while removing key limitations of classical SESOP. In particular, exact minimization of the original objective is replaced by minimization of a low-dimensional cubic upper model, which needs only be solved to a computable accuracy. The cubic regularization parameter is selected by backtracking.
  If the Hessian at the minimizer is positive definite, CaCuSESOP automatically attains an accelerated local linear rate with complexity $O(\sqrt{κ_\star}\log(1/\varepsilon))$. Neither the local strong-convexity parameter, the condition number $κ_\star$, nor the optimal value is supplied to the algorithm. We give finite bounds for entering this regime and adapting the restart schedule. Finally, we prove that the global $O(k^{-2})$ rate is optimal for the considered fixed-budget gradient/Hessian--vector-product linear-span oracle class, even with momentum and unrestricted memory.

AI.tldr: 结合CaCuTe与SESOP提出CaCuSESOP，用于Hessian Lipschitz连续的凸优化：全局O(k^{-2})，无需精确极小化，局部自动加速至O(√κ⋆ log(1/ε))，并证明全局速率最优。
AI.motivation: 经典SESOP需要精确最小化原目标，且缺乏自适应局部加速能力和对该速率的最优性证明。
AI.method: 将CaCuTe与顺序子空间优化(SESOP)结合；用低维三次上模型替代精确极小化，只需解到可计算精度；三次正则化参数用回溯法选取；每步固定数量Hessian-向量乘积。
AI.result: 全局速率O(k^{-2})；若最优解处Hessian正定，自动获得加速局部线性速率O(√κ⋆ log(1/ε))；无需提供强凸参数、κ⋆或最优值；给出进入该region的有限界与重启调度；证明在固定预算梯度/Hessian-向量乘积线性张成oracle类下全局O(k^{-2})最优（即使带动量与无限制记忆）。
AI.conclusion: CaCuSESOP在保持全局最优速率的同时移除经典SESOP的限制，并实现无需先验参数的自动局部加速。

title: Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models
summary: Self-evolving reasoning models learn from their own generated questions, yet repeated self-training can lead to performance collapse. In this paper, we investigate why performance deteriorates over successive rounds and how to sustain self-evolution. Our analysis identifies two recurring quality problems in self-generated questions: invalid questions and repeated variants of the same mathematical questions. First, invalid questions become more prevalent across rounds, and answer-consistency filtering further increases their proportion in training data. Second, existing question diversity controls based on lexical similarity can miss mathematically equivalent questions expressed in different ways, which leads to question diversity collapse in later training rounds. Building on these findings, we introduce R-Quest, which uses question validity and novelty feedback to guide self-evolution. We first train the solver to recognize and reject invalid questions, then use its judgments to guide questioner rewards and filter solver training data. To avoid question repetition, we use a frozen base model to compare sampled question pairs and provide novelty feedback. Empirically, our method consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families. Additionally, R-Quest maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.

AI.tldr: 本文分析自进化推理模型性能崩溃的原因（无效问题增多、数学等价问题重复），提出R-Quest方法，用问题有效性与新颖性反馈引导自进化，稳定提升多领域性能。
AI.motivation: 自进化推理模型依靠自身生成的问题学习，但重复自训练会导致性能崩溃，需要探究其劣化机理并找到可持续自进化的方法。
AI.method: R-Quest利用问题有效性和新颖性反馈引导自进化：先训练求解器识别并拒绝无效问题，再用其判断指导出题器奖励与过滤训练数据；同时用冻结基模型比较采样问题对，提供新颖性反馈以避免问题重复。
AI.result: 在数学推理、通用推理和代码生成共12个基准上，两个模型家族均取得最高平均性能；经过十轮自进化保持稳定增益，末轮达到峰值，比R-Zero高17.32分。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别无效与数学等价重复问题并引入有效性与新颖性反馈，可有效缓解自训练性能崩溃，实现稳定持续的自进化推理。

title: Optimal last-iterate convergence in matrix games with bandit feedback using the log-barrier
summary: We study the problem of learning minimax policies in zero-sum matrix games. Fiegel et al. (2025) recently showed that achieving last-iterate convergence in this setting is harder when the players are uncoupled, by proving a lower bound on the exploitability gap of Omega(t^{-1/4}). Some online mirror descent algorithms were proposed in the literature for this problem, but none have truly attained this rate yet. We show that the use of a log-barrier regularization, along with a dual-focused analysis, allows this O-tilde(t^{-1/4}) convergence with high-probability. We additionally extend our idea to the setting of extensive-form games, proving a bound with the same rate.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究零和矩阵博弈中极小极大策略的学习，利用对数障碍正则化与对偶聚焦分析，实现了高概率的O-tilde(t^{-1/4})最后迭代收敛，并扩展到扩展式博弈。
AI.motivation: Fiegel等（2025）证明非耦合玩家实现最后迭代收敛的下界为Omega(t^{-1/4})，而现有在线镜像下降算法均未真正达到该速率，存在理论与算法之间的差距。
AI.method: 采用对数障碍（log-barrier）正则化，并结合对偶聚焦分析（dual-focused analysis）来推导收敛界。
AI.result: 在所提方法下，实现了高概率的O-tilde(t^{-1/4})收敛速率，填补了此前算法未达到该下界的空白。
AI.conclusion: 对数障碍正则化配以对偶聚焦分析可有效达到最优最后迭代收敛速率，且该思路可扩展至扩展式博弈并获得相同速率。

title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM作为专业工具集成层时能否可靠利用外部诊断信息，发现在五个诊断数据集上，冲突信息会推翻LLM原本正确的判断，且隐式集成未优于更强的独立专业工具。
AI.motivation: 更强组件不一定带来更强组合系统；需检验LLM能否可靠整合外部诊断信息，并将源质量与集成质量分开评估。
AI.method: 在五个诊断数据集（轴承振动、过程监控、半导体设备）上进行配对重复调用，分离建议效应与输出不稳定性；在Tennessee Eastman确认集上比较无辅助LLM、隐式LLM-专家集成和独立专家；进行提示与专家敏感性分析、双源选择器oracle、CWRU证据呈现比较及四模型TEP分析。
AI.result: 五个数据集中冲突外部信息均推翻了初始正确判断；四个直接集成对比无一显示隐式LLM集成相对更强独立源的稳定优势。TEP上无辅助64.67%、集成77.43%、专家83.33%；专家信息提升LLM 12.8点，但集成仍低于专家5.9点，双源oracle达92.76%。集成遗漏47.5%专家纠正，却损失15.2%初始正确判断。任务对齐物理证据在七个模型中六个降低错误建议易感性，更高推理努力在五个模型中无可靠改善。
AI.conclusion: 源质量与集成质量应分别评估；集成层应与更强的独立组件比较，而不仅与无辅助LLM比较。

title: MERCI Cards: An LLM Evaluation and Deployment Framework for High-Stakes Domains
summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in high-stakes professional workflows, engineers and researchers require principled protocols to systematically track, monitor, and improve model performance across deployment cycles. We present a mathematical framework for iterative LLM evaluation and deployment, and demonstrate its application to AI systems used in criminal justice. Our framework formalizes LLM integration in high-stakes, high-risk, and resource-constrained domains across model selection, rubric design, evaluations and deployment via a weighted multi-objective optimization. We demonstrate that MERCI Cards can guide improvements of the system across deployment iterations, direct developer attention toward under-performing areas, and focus user attention on validation and error-correction in the LLM's outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于迭代式LLM评估与部署的数学框架，并将其应用于刑事司法领域的AI系统，通过加权多目标优化形式化模型选择、评分标准设计、评估与部署，并证明MERCI Cards能指导系统在部署迭代中的改进。
AI.motivation: LLM日益部署于高风险专业工作流，工程师与研究者需要系统化、有原则的协议来跨部署周期追踪、监控和改进模型性能。
AI.method: 提出一个面向迭代式LLM评估与部署的数学框架，用加权多目标优化形式化高风险、资源受限领域中LLM的集成过程，涵盖模型选择、评分标准（rubric）设计、评估与部署；通过在刑事司法AI系统中的应用进行演示。
AI.result: MERCI Cards能够指导系统在多次部署迭代中的改进，引导开发者关注表现不佳的领域，并让用户聚焦于对LLM输出的验证与纠错。
AI.conclusion: 该加权多目标优化框架为高风险场景下的LLM评估与部署提供了有原则的协议，MERCI Cards是实现这一目标的实用工具。

title: What to Preserve in Recursive Computation: A Local Predictive Sufficiency Principle
summary: Recursive computation repeatedly compresses or reuses intermediate states, creating a simple tension: information that must remain useful across longer recursive paths is also exposed to more opportunities for loss before reaching the final prediction. Existing reconstruction or local-prediction objectives provide tractable supervision, but do not ensure that the retained information remains sufficient for subsequent recursive computation. We identify local predictive sufficiency with recursive predictive closure: controlling local predictive deficiencies at individual interfaces controls the resulting discrepancy at the root. We then turn this principle into a tractable training procedure. Starting from a variational characterization, we derive finite predictive tests and an empirical predictive deficiency that measures predictive value retained across compression. Its predictive sensitivities define margin-relaxed half-space constraints on parameter updates, and we project the host optimizer's proposed update onto their intersection only when predictive preservation would otherwise be violated. Across temporal graphs, language memory, vision-language-action control, and recursive self-improvement, the method matches or improves the corresponding host models under matched compression budgets, with larger gains under heavier recursive or memory demands, while better preserving predictive information across successive transformations. Crucially, the same task-agnostic predictive-preservation principle is instantiated across all four settings through host-compatible interventions while keeping the endpoint task, backbone, and evaluation protocol fixed. These results establish predictive preservation at recursive interfaces as a general training principle for recursive compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"递归预测闭合"原则，用以控制递归计算中信息压缩导致的信息损失，并据此设计了一种可训练的预测保持优化方法。
AI.motivation: 递归计算反复压缩或复用中间状态，导致一个核心矛盾：需要在较长递归路径中保持有用的信息，也更容易在到达最终预测前丢失。现有的重建或局部预测目标虽可提供可处理的监督信号，但无法保证保留的信息足以支撑后续递归计算。
AI.method: 作者提出"局部预测充分性"与"递归预测闭合"概念，证明控制各接口处的局部预测缺陷即可控制根节点处的差异。基于变分刻画，推导出有限预测检验和经验预测缺陷，用于度量跨压缩保留的预测价值；其预测敏感度定义了参数更新的边缘松弛半空间约束，并仅在预测保持将被违反时，将宿主优化器的更新投影到这些约束的交集上。
AI.result: 在时序图、语言记忆、视觉-语言-动作控制和递归自我改进四个场景中，该方法在相同压缩预算下达到或优于对应的宿主模型，且在递归或记忆需求更重时增益更大，同时更好地保持了跨连续变换的预测信息。
AI.conclusion: 同一任务无关的预测保持原则通过宿主兼容的干预方式在四个场景中实例化，同时保持端点任务、骨干网络和评估协议不变。结果确立了递归接口处的预测保持作为递归压缩的通用训练原则。

title: Scale-free adaptive planning for deterministic dynamics & discounted rewards
summary: We address the problem of planning in an environment with deterministic dynamics and stochastic rewards with discounted returns. The optimal value function is not known, nor are the rewards bounded. We propose Platypoos, a simple scale-free planning algorithm that adapts to the unknown scale and smoothness of the reward function. We provide a sample complexity analysis for Platypoos that improves upon prior work and holds simultaneously over a broad range of discount factors and reward scales, without the algorithm knowing them. We also establish a matching lower bound showing our analysis is optimal up to constants.

AI.tldr: 提出 Platypoos 算法，在确定性动态、随机无界奖励与折扣回报下进行规划，可自适应未知奖励尺度与平滑度，并给出改进的样本复杂度分析与匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 现有规划方法通常假设奖励有界或已知平滑度/尺度，难以应对奖励未知且无界、折扣因子范围广泛的场景。
AI.method: 提出 Platypoos，一种简单且尺度无关（scale-free）的规划算法，能够自适应未知的奖励函数尺度与平滑度，无需预先知道折扣因子和奖励尺度。
AI.result: 给出优于先前工作的样本复杂度分析，可同时适用于广泛的折扣因子与奖励尺度范围；并建立匹配下界，证明分析在常数因子内最优。
AI.conclusion: Platypoos 在无界随机奖励规划中实现了自适应且近乎最优的样本效率，具有理论保证。

title: Causal Improvement Graph for Agentic Harness Optimization
summary: Agentic Harness is the runtime that constructs task context and controls execution flow, thereby shaping overall agent performance. Given a fixed model and external evaluation, automated Harness optimization seeks to improve this runtime through an iterative proposal--evaluation loop to better solve target tasks. Existing meta-harness methods mainly adopt proposer-centric discovery, in which an LLM-based proposer integrates accumulated experimental findings to determine subsequent Harness revisions. This places the burden of maintaining the evolving improvement state on the proposer as history expands and its underlying experimental logic becomes harder to discern. In this paper, we introduce the Causal Improvement Graph (CIG), a graph-governed meta-harness framework that externalizes the evolving improvement state in a persistent graph, allowing prior findings to directly govern subsequent Harness optimization through local proposer operations. CIG grows and links Evidence, Hypothesis, Intervention, and Outcome nodes to represent what was observed, how it may be explained, how to test that explanation, and what the evaluation reveals. Their structural relations preserve how the improvement state changes across iterations, allowing local proposers to build directly on relations among prior findings rather than recover them from raw history. Across various agent tasks, CIG discovers stronger Harnesses than previous meta-harness baselines and remains robust to the choice of task solver and proposer. Structural ablations further support the design of an explicit improvement state with graph-governed evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Causal Improvement Graph (CIG)，一种图治理的元Harness框架，通过持久化图外化演化中的改进状态，使已有发现直接指导Harness优化。
AI.motivation: 现有元Harness方法采用以提出者为中心的发现模式，随着历史扩展，LLM提出者需承担维护演化改进状态的负担，且底层实验逻辑愈发难以辨别。
AI.method: CIG将改进状态外化到持久图中，通过连接Evidence、Hypothesis、Intervention、Outcome四类节点，表示观察到的现象、可能的解释、如何检验解释以及评估结果；结构化关系保留改进状态随时间的变化，支持局部提出者操作。
AI.result: 在多种智能体任务上，CIG发现比以往元Harness基线更强的Harness，且对任务求解器和提出者的选择具有鲁棒性；结构消融进一步支持显式改进状态与图治理演化的设计。
AI.conclusion: CIG通过图治理的显式改进状态，缓解了提出者中心发现模式的负担，提升了Harness优化效果与鲁棒性。

title: What Does a Harness Buy? Tokens, Mostly
summary: A coding agent is a language model wrapped in a harness: the system prompt, the tool set, and the context management that turn a chat model into something that can work inside a repository. Production harnesses ship releases daily, vendors advertise pass-rate gains from harness changes, and leaderboards mix harnesses freely. What is rarely measured is how much the harness itself moves the score when the model is held fixed. We run five models through three production harnesses, Claude Code, mini-SWE-agent, and OpenCode, on SWE-bench Verified, and rerun the same configurations to calibrate how much a score moves when nothing changes but the run. On 447 tasks and the two models we ran there, Claude Code and mini-SWE-agent, the heaviest and the lightest harness, are equivalent within five points. On a 45-task hard subset and five models, swapping the harness flips as many tasks as rerunning the same harness, 13% in both cases, and the tasks a harness wins in one run are not the tasks it wins in the next. The one harness effect that clears the noise is a loss, not a gain: OpenCode trails by up to 9 points on the large pool, and on one model half of that gap sits in runs its output cap cut short. What the harness does decide is the bill. With the same model, the same tasks, and one price list, cost per task differs by up to 3x across harnesses. The gap is set at the first call, by the preamble of system prompt and tool schemas each harness sends with every step, and scaled by the number of steps; per-step growth and per-call tool output differ far less. The provider's price for cached input scales the bill and does not reorder it. The rerun data also give the resolution a harness comparison needs: at the discordance we observe, 45 tasks catch a 13-point gap only half the time and no gap with 80% power, and 447 tasks resolve 5 points, still coarser than the gains many harness changes claim.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统测量了固定模型下编码智能体"harness"（系统提示、工具集、上下文管理）对 SWE-bench 成绩的影响。结论：harness 对准确率的效应大多淹没在运行噪声中（重/轻 harness 相差 5 分内、换 harness 与重跑相当），唯一显著效应是 OpenCode 的损失；而 harness 真正决定的是成本，每任务成本差异可达 3 倍，根源在首次调用的系统提示与工具 schema 前缀。
AI.motivation: 生产级 harness 每日迭代，厂商宣称 harness 改动带来通过率提升，排行榜也随意混用不同 harness。但几乎没有工作测量：在模型固定的情况下，harness 本身究竟能移动多少分数——即 harness 效应的信噪比问题。
AI.method: 在 SWE-bench Verified（447 任务）和 45 个任务的困难子集上，用 5 个模型分别跑 3 个生产 harness（Claude Code、mini-SWE-agent、OpenCode），并重复相同配置以校准纯运行噪声。通过换-harness 翻转率与同-harness 重跑翻转率对比、以及成本分解（首次调用前缀、步数、每步增长、工具输出、缓存价格）来分析效应来源。同时用重跑数据做功效分析。
AI.result: 在 447 任务、2 个模型上，最重与最轻 harness（Claude Code 与 mini-SWE-agent）成绩相差在 5 分内。在 45 任务子集、5 模型上，换 harness 与重跑翻转的任务数相同（均为 13%），且某次 harness 获胜的任务在下次并不稳定。唯一超噪声的 harness 效应是负向的：OpenCode 在大池上落后最多 9 分，其中某模型约一半差距来自输出上限截断的 runs。成本方面，同模型同任务同价目下，每任务成本跨 harness 差达 3 倍，差距由首次调用的系统提示+工具 schema 前缀决定并按步数放大；缓存输入价格缩放账单但不改变排序。
AI.conclusion: harness 主要影响的不是准确率分数，而是账单。多数宣称的 harness 通过率提升落在测量分辨率之内：观测到的不一致率下，45 任务只能一半概率捕捉 13 分差距、无法以 80% 功效检出零差距，447 任务才能分辨 5 分，仍比许多 harness 改动宣称的增益更粗糙。因此 harness 对比需要更谨慎的任务规模与噪声校准。

title: Planning in entropy-regularized Markov decision processes and games
summary: We propose SmoothCruiser, a new planning algorithm for estimating the value function in entropy-regularized Markov decision processes and two-player games, given a generative model of the environment. SmoothCruiser makes use of the smoothness of the Bellman operator promoted by the regularization to achieve problem-independent sample complexity of order O~(1/epsilon^4) for a desired accuracy epsilon, whereas for non-regularized settings there are no known algorithms with guaranteed polynomial sample complexity in the worst case.

AI.tldr: 提出SmoothCruiser规划算法，利用熵正则化带来的Bellman算子平滑性，在熵正则化MDP和双人博弈中实现与问题无关的O~(1/ε^4)样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 在非正则化设置的最坏情况下，尚无具备多项式样本复杂度保证的算法；作者希望借助正则化改善样本效率。
AI.method: 基于环境生成模型（generative model），利用熵正则化使Bellman算子具有平滑性，设计出SmoothCruiser规划算法来估计值函数。适用于熵正则化MDP及双人博弈。
AI.result: 达到与问题无关的样本复杂度 O~(1/ε^4)，其中 ε 为目标精度。
AI.conclusion: 熵正则化带来的平滑性可显著提升样本效率，使规划在熵正则化MDP与博弈中具备多项式样本复杂度保证，而这是非正则化场景最坏情况下难以实现的。

title: AraYoungVoices: A Diverse L1/L2 Corpus of Arabic Child and Adolescent Speech
summary: State-of-the-art ASR systems primarily target native adult speech, leading to substantial performance gaps for children, adolescents, and L2 speakers. We introduce AraYoungVoices, a 151.72-hour Arabic read-speech corpus from 286 speakers aged 7--18, comprising AraKids (7--12) and AraTeens (13--18). The corpus includes 146 native Arabic (L1) and 140 second-language (L2) speakers, with native speakers spanning Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, and North African dialectal backgrounds and L2 speakers representing diverse linguistic backgrounds across the Americas, Asia, Africa, and Europe. We benchmark four pretrained ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings using unseen-speaker-$\&$-unseen-prompt (USUP) and unseen-speaker-$\&$-seen-prompt (USSP) evaluations. Results show that L2 speech remains substantially more challenging than L1 speech, with the largest errors observed mainly for younger L2 speakers. Age-specific fine-tuning improves the matched age group, while joint fine-tuning provides a stronger balance across populations. ASR hypotheses are also consistently closer to the standard reading prompt than to the verbatim transcription, particularly for L2 speech, suggesting partial normalization of reading deviations.

AI.tldr: 本文发布AraYoungVoices——151.72小时、286名7-18岁说话者的阿拉伯语朗读语料库，涵盖L1和L2青少年儿童，并系统评估多个ASR模型在零样本与微调设置下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR系统主要面向母语成人语音，对儿童、青少年及第二语言（L2）说话者性能显著下降，而阿拉伯语青少年及L2语音资源匮乏，缺乏系统性基准。
AI.method: 构建151.72小时阿拉伯语朗读语料库AraYoungVoices，含AraKids（7-12岁）和AraTeens（13-18岁），286名说话者中146名L1（涵盖埃及、海湾、黎凡特、北非方言）和140名L2（美洲、亚洲、非洲、欧洲背景）。对4个预训练ASR模型进行零样本与微调评测，采用USUP和USSP两种评估设置。
AI.result: L2语音难度显著高于L1，最大错误集中在年幼L2说话者；年龄特定微调提升匹配年龄段性能，联合微调在各类人群间取得更好平衡；ASR假设更接近标准朗读文本而非逐字转写，尤其对L2语音，表明存在部分朗读偏差归一化。
AI.conclusion: AraYoungVoices填补了阿拉伯语青少年及L2语音ASR评测空白，揭示了L2和低龄说话者的挑战，为公平、鲁棒的ASR系统开发提供数据与方法支持。

title: CRAFT: An Agentic Spreadsheet Form Filling System with Template Awareness
summary: Spreadsheet form filling requires agents to consolidate external evidence, ground values to precise cells, and preserve irregular template structure. Errors in early edits can overwrite labels or misalign fields, undermining later decisions. We propose CRAFT, a template-aware agent framework that connects reflective validation to constrained local repair. Instead of treating reflection as a free-form request to regenerate the workbook, CRAFT grounds detected errors to spreadsheet regions, restores corrupted template state when necessary, and re-grounds plausible writable slots before subsequent edits. A Rectangle-Aware Slot Grounder (RASG) proposes writable cells, while label-slot hints and protected regions constrain subsequent edits. We introduce FormFillBench, with 327 forms across Instruction-Only and Multi-File tracks. Compared with the strongest baselines, CRAFT improves pair accuracy by 8.51 and 23.38 percentage points on these tracks, respectively. Component-removal experiments support structural adjudication and slot re-grounding within the pipeline, and the framework retains its relative advantage among the methods evaluated with a second backbone. The code and benchmark FormFillBench are available at https://github.com/Glllllly/CRAFT.

AI.tldr: 提出模板感知的表格填充智能体框架CRAFT，通过反射验证与约束局部修复相结合，提升表格填充准确率。
AI.motivation: 表格填充需整合外部证据、将值定位到精确单元格并保持不规则模板结构。早期编辑错误可能覆盖标签或错位字段，破坏后续决策，而传统反射方式仅是自由生成整个工作簿，无法有效定位和修复错误。
AI.method: CRAFT将反射验证与约束局部修复连接：检测到的错误被定位到表格区域，必要时恢复受损模板状态，并在后续编辑前重新定位可写槽位。采用Rectangle-Aware Slot Grounder（RASG）提出可写单元格，利用标签-槽位提示与保护区域约束编辑。同时提出包含327个表单的FormFillBench基准，分Instruction-Only与Multi-File两个赛道。
AI.result: 相比最强基线，CRAFT在两个赛道上成对准确率分别提升8.51和23.38个百分点。组件移除实验验证了结构裁决与槽位重定位的作用，且在第二个骨干模型下仍保持相对优势。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT通过模板感知、局部约束修复有效提升表格填充性能，FormFillBench基准及代码已开源。

title: LyapuFlow: Controlling Generative Flows with Lyapunov Feedback for Inverse Problems
summary: Pretrained flow models are now widely used as generative priors in science and vision, where inference-time guidance enables test-time constraints without retraining. Existing methods use projection, posterior sampling, or iterative optimization of the generative trajectory. We propose LyapuFlow, an alternative based on Lyapunov feedback control. At each sampling step, LyapuFlow predicts the terminal sample towards which the current flow is evolving, and evaluates the constraint violation on this prediction. Then, we compute the minimum-norm control that satisfies a prescribed Lyapunov decrease condition. The resulting control remains inactive when the uncontrolled dynamics already reduce the constraint violation at the prescribed rate. Otherwise, it provides a corrective update within a feedback trust region that prevents the control from dominating the pretrained dynamics. We demonstrate LyapuFlow in both data and latent spaces, outperforming alternatives spanning different mechanisms for test-time constraint enforcement in scientific machine learning and image inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 提出LyapuFlow，一种基于Lyapunov反馈控制的预训练流模型推理时约束引导方法，在科学机器学习和图像逆问题中优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 预训练流模型广泛用作生成先验，需要在推理时施加测试时约束而无需重训练。现有方法（投影、后验采样、轨迹迭代优化）存在各自局限，本文寻求一种替代机制。
AI.method: LyapuFlow在每步采样中预测当前流趋向的终端样本，评估该预测上的约束违反；随后计算满足指定Lyapunov下降条件的最小范数控制。当无控动力学已按预定速率降低违反时控制不激活，否则在反馈信任域内提供修正更新，防止控制主导预训练动力学。支持数据与潜空间。
AI.result: 在科学机器学习和图像逆问题中，LyapuFlow优于采用不同测试时约束机制的各种替代方法。
AI.conclusion: Lyapunov反馈控制为流模型推理时约束提供了一种有效替代方案，兼具按需激活与保护预训练动力学的优势。

title: On two ways to use determinantal point processes for Monte Carlo integration
summary: The standard Monte Carlo estimator $\widehat{I}_N^{\mathrm{MC}}$ of $\int fdω$ relies on independent samples from $ω$ and has variance of order $1/N$. Replacing the samples with a determinantal point process (DPP), a repulsive distribution, makes the estimator consistent, with variance rates that depend on how the DPP is adapted to $f$ and $ω$. We examine two existing DPP-based estimators: one by Bardenet & Hardy (2020) with a rate of $\mathcal{O}(N^{-(1+1/d)})$ for smooth $f$, but relying on a fixed DPP. The other, by Ermakov & Zolotukhin (1960), is unbiased with rate of order $1/N$, like Monte Carlo, but its DPP is tailored to $f$. We revisit these estimators, generalize them to continuous settings, and provide sampling algorithms.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于行列式点过程（DPP）的蒙特卡洛估计器，比较并推广两种现有方法，提供连续情形下的采样算法。
AI.motivation: 标准蒙特卡洛估计器方差为O(1/N)，而DPP作为一种排斥分布可提升估计的方差收敛率，但已有DPP估计器各有局限（如固定DPP或需针对f定制），需要统一与推广。
AI.method: 考察两种现有DPP估计器：Bardenet & Hardy (2020)（固定DPP，光滑f下速率O(N^{-(1+1/d)})）与Ermakov & Zolotukhin (1960)（无偏，速率1/N，DPP依f定制）。将其推广到连续设定，并给出采样算法。
AI.result: 重新审视并推广了这两种估计器至连续情形，提供了相应采样算法，明确了各估计器的方差速率特性。
AI.conclusion: DPP估计器可在方差收敛率上优于或等同于标准蒙特卡洛，其表现依赖DPP与f、ω的适配方式；论文为连续设定下应用这些方法提供了理论与算法基础。

title: Usage-Modulated Sentiment Representations in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, including appendices
summary: Prior work suggests that sentiment can often be captured by approximately linear directions in LLM activation spaces, but a single direction may not fully capture sentiment representations. In natural communication, sentiment is shaped not only by polarity but also by usage factors, such as tone and audience adaptation. We test whether these factors systematically modulate sentiment representations beyond a shared sentiment direction. We construct a controlled paired dataset that holds event content fixed while varying sentiment polarity and usage factors, and analyze Llama, Mistral, and Gemma. We identify a shared sentiment direction, remove it, and test the residual structure through erasure and generation-time tone steering. Across models, the shared direction is robust (median cosine 0.953-0.975), yet removing it leaves 0.833-0.909 of the original positive-negative representation-difference norm. The residuals contain compact, reproducible usage-conditioned structure. Targeted erasure weakens held-out usage metrics more than random and label-shuffled controls. On Llama, outputs steered along residualized tone components are preferred in 92.8% of blind target-tone comparisons while preserving the requested sentiment polarity in 98.7% of evaluated outputs.

AI.tldr: 先前研究认为情感可由LLM激活空间近似线性方向捕捉，但单一方向不足以充分表征情感；本文发现去除共享情感方向后仍有大量残差结构，包含稳定的语用条件（语气、受众）信息，可用于生成时的语气调控。
AI.motivation: 单一情感方向可能无法完整刻画情感表征，因为自然交流中情感不仅由极性决定，还受语气、受众适应等使用因素影响。作者想验证这些因素是否系统性地调制了超越共享情感方向的情感表征。
AI.method: 构建受控配对数据集：固定事件内容，变化情感极性与使用因素；分析Llama、Mistral、Gemma。先识别共享情感方向并将其去除，再通过擦除（erasure）和生成时语气引导测试残差结构。
AI.result: 共享方向鲁棒（中位余弦0.953–0.975），但去除后仍保留原始正负表征差异范数的0.833–0.909；残差含紧凑、可复现的使用条件结构。定向擦除比随机和标签打乱对照更削弱留出使用指标。在Llama上，沿残差化语气成分引导的输出在盲测目标语气比较中92.8%被偏好，同时98.7%保留所要求的情感极性。
AI.conclusion: 情感表征不止一个共享极性方向，还包含系统性的语用条件结构；这些残差可被定向擦除和生成时引导，实现语气控制且不破坏极性。

title: RAGrasp: Geometry-Semantic Template Retrieval and Grasp Transfer
summary: We present RAGrasp, a retrieval-augmented pipeline for planar parallel-jaw grasping from a compact set of locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D (color and depth) templates. Unlike task-specific predictors trained primarily on large public or synthetic grasp datasets, RAGrasp requires no end-to-end retraining for a new deployment.Its template memory is constructed from observations collected with the deployment camera, robot, and gripper in the target workspace, thereby aligning stored examples with the local sensing and embodiment conditions. The system uses self-supervised DINOv2 visual fea- tures together with appearance and depth cues to prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2), which isolates the query object. A two-stage geometry-semantic retrieval cascade then selects a template, and a confidence gate chooses one of two grasp- transfer estimators. The transferred grasp is refined using mask- support and silhouette-contact constraints before calibrated 2D- to-3D conversion. In real-world trials, RAGrasp achieves 20/20 successful grasps on seen objects and 19/20 on unseen objects. Within the evaluated setting, the results demonstrate deployment- specific grasp adaptation from limited local annotation and tolerance to the tested viewpoint and illumination changes.

AI.tldr: RAGrasp是一个检索增强的平面平行夹爪抓取流程，仅用少量本地采集的抓取标注RGB-D模板，无需端到端重训练，即可实现部署特定的抓取适应，在真实场景中对已见/未见物体分别达到20/20和19/20成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有抓取预测器多依赖大规模公开或合成数据集训练，针对新部署需要端到端重训练，且与本地相机、机器人、夹爪及工作空间的感知与本体条件不匹配。作者希望无需重训练即可快速适应新部署。
AI.method: 用部署相机、机器人和夹爪在目标工作空间采集少量抓取标注RGB-D模板构建记忆库；以自监督DINOv2视觉特征结合外观与深度线索提示SAM2分割查询物体；通过两阶段几何-语义检索级联选择模板，并用置信度门控在两种抓取迁移估计器中择一；迁移抓取经掩码支撑与轮廓接触约束细化，再经标定后的2D到3D转换。
AI.result: 真实场景试验中，对已见物体达成20/20成功抓取，对未见物体19/20；在评测设定内表现出对测试视角与光照变化的容忍度。
AI.conclusion: 在有限本地标注条件下，RAGrasp验证了面向具体部署的抓取自适应能力，并具备一定的视角与光照鲁棒性。

title: S$^3$N: A Spherical Spiral Scanning Network for Weather Forecasting
summary: Machine learning-based weather prediction (MLWP) has achieved strong performance in global weather forecasting. Recent Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelation (HEALPix)-based methods use the HEALPix (HP) grid to avoid area distortion near the poles of conventional latitude-longitude (LL) grids. However, existing HP-based approaches often use pointwise mapping methods and process HP pixels within separate base faces or local windows. Consequently, the mapping may introduce reconstruction errors and cross-face communication depends on handcrafted boundary handling or shifted windows. We propose the Spherical Spiral Scanning Network (S$^3$N) to address both limitations. First, L2Proj provides a bidirectional method for mapping atmospheric fields between the LL and HP grids through an $L^2$ projection of their continuous finite-element representations. Second, the Attention-Guided Quad-Spiral State-Space Scanning (AQSS) block uses cross-latitude attention to guide selective state-space updates along four global pole-to-pole spiral paths. This design enables continuous information propagation across HP base-face boundaries without additional boundary-processing mechanisms. Experiments show that S$^3$N achieves better results at 4-, 7-, and 10-day lead times, and exhibits slower error growth in long-range forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出S³N，用L2投影做LL-HEALPix双向映射并设计四螺旋状态空间扫描，提升全球天气预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于HEALPix的MLWP方法用点对点映射易产生重建误差，且在独立基面/局部窗口内处理像素，跨面通信依赖人工边界处理或移窗。
AI.method: S³N包含两部分：(1) L2Proj，基于有限元连续表示的L2投影，实现LL与HP网格间大气场的双向映射；(2) AQSS模块，用跨纬度注意力引导沿四条极到极全局螺旋路径的选择性状态空间更新，实现跨基面连续传播。
AI.result: 在4、7、10天预报时效上取得更优结果，并在长程预报中误差增长更慢。
AI.conclusion: L2投影与螺旋扫描的结合避免了点对点映射误差和人工边界处理，验证了统一球面表示与全局连续传播在全球天气预测中的有效性。

title: Maximum Entropy Semi-Supervised Inverse Reinforcement Learning
comment: In Proceedings of the 24th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2015)
summary: A popular approach to apprenticeship learning (AL) is to formulate it as an inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) problem. The MaxEnt-IRL algorithm successfully integrates the maximum entropy principle into IRL and unlike its predecessors, it resolves the ambiguity arising from the fact that a possibly large number of policies could match the expert's behavior. In this paper, we study an AL setting in which in addition to the expert's trajectories, a number of unsupervised trajectories is available. We introduce MESSI, a novel algorithm that combines MaxEnt-IRL with principles coming from semi-supervised learning. In particular, MESSI integrates the unsupervised data into the MaxEnt-IRL framework using a pairwise penalty on trajectories. Empirical results in a highway driving and grid-world problems indicate that MESSI is able to take advantage of the unsupervised trajectories and improve the performance of MaxEnt-IRL.

AI.tldr: MESSI将MaxEnt-IRL与半监督学习结合，利用无监督轨迹提升学徒学习性能。
AI.motivation: 传统MaxEnt-IRL仅利用专家轨迹，忽略大量可得的无监督轨迹数据。
AI.method: 在MaxEnt-IRL框架中引入成对惩罚（pairwise penalty）将无监督轨迹整合，借鉴半监督学习原则。
AI.result: 在高速驾驶和网格世界问题中，MESSI能利用无监督轨迹并优于MaxEnt-IRL。
AI.conclusion: MESSI证明结合无监督数据可有效改进学徒学习/逆强化学习。

title: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
summary: Test-time training (TTT) lets a model store information in its weights during inference. When the model learns from its own output, however, each update also changes the model that generates the next training example. Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B). The same failure occurs when Adam updates Qwen3-4B's existing weights. The same update mechanisms can improve on real text, so writing itself is not the failure. Three matched comparisons trace the causal pathway. Fixed Generation removes over 98% of the damage at 125M and 760M by using a frozen model to generate training chunks. Recorded Replay separates the loss caused by reading degraded text from the additional loss stored by updating on it. A paired one-update comparison then shows the local conflict: an update predicts its source better but new real text worse. This cost grows after Closed Loop adaptation, with a few trajectories accounting for most large failures. Finally, Settlement evaluates the candidate state on independent real text before commitment. It leaves mean endpoint gaps of 0.07 and -0.02 nats at 125M and 760M while retaining real-text adaptation. These results motivate checking prediction on independent evidence before retaining an update.

AI.tldr: 本文研究测试时训练(TTT)中模型从自身生成文本学习时会导致权重更新伤害对独立真实文本的预测，并提出了因果路径分析与Settlement缓解方案。
AI.motivation: TTT允许模型在推理时更新权重存信息，但当模型从自身输出学习时，每次更新也会改变生成下一训练样本的模型，可能导致自损式循环。作者希望验证这一失败是否真实存在并追溯其因果机制。
AI.method: 在128K token流上对125M、760M、3B三种TTT-E2E配置及Qwen3-4B(Adam更新)进行实验；采用三组匹配对比：Fixed Generation(冻结模型生成)、Recorded Replay(分离阅读退化文本与更新存储的损失)、paired one-update比较；并提出Settlement，在提交前用独立真实文本评估候选状态。
AI.result: 保留生成文本更新会恶化对独立人类文本的预测；Fixed Generation在125M/760M消除98%以上损害；paired one-update显示更新对来源预测更好但新真实文本更差；Closed Loop适应后代价增大且少数轨迹导致多数大失败；Settlement在125M/760M分别留下0.07和-0.02 nats的平均端点差距，同时保留真实文本适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 从自身生成内容更新会与真实文本预测冲突，需在保留更新前用独立证据检验预测，Settlement可有效缓解该问题。

title: Causally Fair Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate, complete, and transform information in settings where their outputs can shape consequential decisions, raising concerns about their impact on demographic disparities. In this context, causal inference provides a principled basis for assessing fairness, because it attributes observed disparities to the mechanisms that generated them, which a purely statistical approach cannot do even with infinite data. In LLM generation, a query may request several causally related variables, each of which is both an outcome of interest and a possible cause of other outputs, and the information supplied in the prompt need not follow a topological or a temporal order. This calls for methods that can analyze and selectively remove disparities from such a flexible generation process. In this paper we introduce Causally Fair Generation with LLMs (CFG, for short). CFG extracts relevant concepts, grounds generation in a reference population and causal diagram, and removes user-selected causal effects. CFG also allows pathways deemed justifiable for the task's utility to be retained, which is known in legal literature as business necessity. Further, we provide formal guarantees for our method when eliminating all discriminatory causal effects in the adapted population model, under appropriate causal assumptions. We evaluate CFG with four LLMs in three real-world settings based on population data and on a synthetic dataset with a known causal ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CFG方法，在LLM生成中基于因果推断进行公平性分析与选择性消除差异。
AI.motivation: LLM输出影响重大决策，引发人口统计学差异担忧；纯统计方法即使有无穷数据也无法归因差异，需因果推断。
AI.method: CFG提取相关概念，将生成锚定到参考人群和因果图，移除用户选定的因果效应，并保留"业务必要性"允许的正当路径；在适当因果假设下提供形式化保证。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界场景（基于人口数据）及一个已知因果真值的合成数据集上，用四个LLM评估CFG。
AI.conclusion: CFG能在灵活生成过程中消除歧视性因果效应并保留合法必要路径，为LLM公平生成提供因果保障。

title: Hierarchical Credit Assignment for RLVR on Fused Gromov-Wasserstein Geometry
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been shown to improve the reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) across diverse reasoning tasks. However, group-based RLVR methods, such as GRPO, assign a uniform advantage to all tokens within rollouts of the same outcome. While existing works refine credit assignment of GRPO based on local signals such as token locations or entropy, they often fail to capture the global semantic novelty of a reasoning behavior relative to the current policy. In this work, we propose a hierarchical credit assignment approach for group-based RLVR methods, called HarA, which identifies and encourages semantically novel reasoning behaviors during RLVR. HarA represents each sampled rollout as a distribution over the hidden states and locations of tokens, and computes the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein (FGW) barycenters of all rollouts with the same outcome, capturing the internal reasoning patterns in the latent space under the current policy. The semantic novelty of a reasoning element can then be measured by its contribution to the FGW distance between the current rollout and the barycenter. While solving the FGW formulation is expensive, we introduce an anchor-guided linearization that turns it into a Wasserstein formulation solvable via the Sinkhorn algorithm efficiently. By reweighing token-level advantage of group-based RLVR methods based on the novelty signals, HarA highlights novel reasoning behaviors at flexible granularities to encourage fine-grained LLM exploration. Extensive experiments across three group-based RLVR methods show that our plug-and-play method effectively enhances the exploration of LLMs, outperforming existing methods across diverse reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarA，一种面向组式RLVR（如GRPO）的层次化信用分配方法，通过FGW重心衡量推理行为的全局语义新颖度，并重新加权token级优势以增强LLM探索。
AI.motivation: 现有组式RLVR方法（如GRPO）对同一结果的所有token赋予统一优势，忽视了信用分配的细粒度差异。已有改进多依赖token位置、熵等局部信号，难以捕捉推理行为相对于当前策略的全局语义新颖性。
AI.method: HarA将每个采样rollout表示为token隐状态与位置的分布，计算同结果rollout的Fused Gromov-Wasserstein（FGW）重心，以刻画当前策略下的内部推理模式。语义新颖度由当前rollout与重心的FGW距离贡献度量。为降低计算成本，提出anchor-guided线性化，将FGW转化为可用Sinkhorn算法高效求解的Wasserstein形式，再据此重加权组式RLVR的token级优势。
AI.result: 在三种组式RLVR方法和多个推理基准上实验，所提即插即用方法有效增强LLM探索，性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次化、基于全局语义新颖度的信用分配，可灵活地在不同粒度上突出新颖推理行为，促进细粒度LLM探索，提升组式RLVR的推理表现。

title: Analysis of Nystrom method with sequential ridge leverage scores
summary: Large-scale kernel ridge regression (KRR) is limited by the need to store a large kernel matrix K_t. To avoid storing the entire matrix K_t, Nystrom methods subsample a subset of columns of the kernel matrix, and efficiently find an approximate KRR solution on the reconstructed matrix. The chosen subsampling distribution in turn affects the statistical and computational tradeoffs. For KRR problems, recent works show that a sampling distribution proportional to the ridge leverage scores (RLSs) provides strong reconstruction guarantees for the approximation. While exact RLSs are as difficult to compute as a KRR solution, we may be able to approximate them well enough. In this paper, we study KRR problems in a sequential setting and introduce the INK-ESTIMATE algorithm, that incrementally computes the RLSs estimates. INK-ESTIMATE maintains a small sketch of K_t, that at each step is used to compute an intermediate estimate of the RLSs. First, our sketch update does not require access to previously seen columns, and therefore a single pass over the kernel matrix is sufficient. Second, the algorithm requires a fixed, small space budget to run dependent only on the effective dimension of the kernel matrix. Finally, our sketch provides strong approximation guarantees on the distance between the true kernel matrix and its approximation, and on the statistical risk of the approximate KRR solution at any time, because all our guarantees hold at any intermediate step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 INK-ESTIMATE 算法，在顺序设置下增量估计 ridge leverage scores (RLS)，从而实现单遍、固定小空间的 Nystrom KRR 近似，并在任意中间步骤提供强近似与统计风险保证。
AI.motivation: 大规模 kernel ridge regression (KRR) 受限于存储大核矩阵 K_t。Nystrom 方法通过子采样列来避免存储整个矩阵，而采样分布会影响统计与计算权衡。近期研究表明，按 ridge leverage scores (RLS) 采样的分布有强重构保证，但精确 RLS 与 KRR 求解一样难计算，因此需要更好地近似 RLS。
AI.method: 本文研究顺序设置下的 KRR，提出 INK-ESTIMATE 算法增量计算 RLS 估计值。该算法维护 K_t 的一个小 sketch，并在每一步用其计算中间 RLS 估计。该 sketch 更新不依赖此前见过的列，因此只需对核矩阵单遍扫描；同时所需空间固定且小，仅依赖于核矩阵的有效维度。
AI.result: 该 sketch 对真实核矩阵与其近似之间的距离提供强近似保证，并对近似 KRR 解的统计风险提供保证；由于所有保证在任意中间步骤都成立，因此算法可在任意时刻输出有效结果。
AI.conclusion: INK-ESTIMATE 通过增量估计 RLS，实现了单遍、固定小空间预算的大规模 KRR 近似，并在任意中间步骤保持良好的近似与统计风险保证。

title: Towards cross-cultural study of folksong lyrics with machine translation
summary: Music is universally present in human societies. Ethnomusicologists have long been documenting the diverse expressions of human musicality, and comparative musicology has recently brought several studies of folksong to a more global scale. Such cross-cultural research has not been conducted on lyrics: the language barrier has so far prevented work with multi-lingual data. However, Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies have reached a stage where this language barrier may no longer be prohibitive. Combining folksong lyrics corpora across five languages, we machine-translate them to a pivot language with a pre-trained neural topic model, and we examine the relationship between content and social function within each language, and across languages for wedding songs. As expected, human evaluation of translation results shows that non-Indo-European languages suffer from overall worse translation quality. Experiments with topic models then indicate that the content of lyrics is at best partially related to the social function of folksongs across all languages. These experiments are just first steps into cross-cultural folk musics lyrics analysis; however, they do indicate that a previously unobserved web of cross-cultural relationships beyond ethnomusicological typologies may be uncovered through the study of what people sing across the world's diverse folk musics.

AI.tldr: 该论文结合五种语言的民歌歌词语料，用机器翻译到枢轴语言并借助预训练神经主题模型，跨语言分析歌词内容与社会功能的关系，发现歌词内容与功能最多只是部分相关。
AI.motivation: 民族音乐学已记录人类音乐性的多样表达，比较音乐学也把民歌研究推向全球规模，但歌词的跨文化研究因语言障碍一直缺失。NLP 技术发展使多语言歌词分析成为可能，因此作者希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 汇集五种语言的民歌歌词语料，将其机器翻译为枢轴语言，再使用预训练神经主题模型进行主题建模；分别在各语言内部检验歌词内容与社会功能的关系，并针对婚礼歌曲开展跨语言比较；同时对翻译结果进行人工评估。
AI.result: 人工评估显示非印欧语言的翻译质量整体更差；主题模型实验表明，在所有语言中歌词内容至多与社会功能存在部分关联。
AI.conclusion: 这些实验只是跨文化民歌歌词分析的初步尝试，但表明通过研究世界各地民歌中所唱内容，可能揭示出超越民族音乐学类型学的、此前未被观察到的跨文化关系网络。

title: Time-series Foundation Models for Predictive Control: The Role of Excitation
comment: Accepted at the TS-LIMITS Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Deploying model predictive control (MPC) requires constructing or identifying a predictive model for each target system. Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) offer an attractive option thanks to strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities across systems. However, low forecast error does not guarantee that a TSFM captures the system's response to the alternative actions considered by the controller. We study this gap using residential heat-pump control as a test bed, measuring the agreement between predicted and ground-truth effects of control interventions. Importantly, we find that TSFMs can recover the system's input-response relationship when the context contains sufficient independent control excitation. Common fine-tuning pipelines and feature smoothing reduce, but do not eliminate, the need for in-context excitation. Our results indicate that current TSFMs used for predictive control require sufficiently informative control variation in the inference context. Initial closed-loop results show promise for shorter context windows.

AI.tldr: 时间序列基础模型(TSFM)零样本预测误差低,但不能保证捕获系统对控制动作的响应;研究以热泵控制为测试床,发现只要推理上下文中包含充分的独立控制激励,TSFM即可恢复输入-响应关系。
AI.motivation: MPC需为每个目标系统构建或辨识预测模型,成本高;TSFM因强零样本预测能力成为有吸引力的替代方案,但低预测误差并不等于模型理解控制器所考虑动作对系统的影响,这一差距尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以住宅热泵控制为测试床,量化TSFM预测的控制干预效应与真实效应之间的一致性;并考察上下文中控制激励的充分性,以及常见微调流程和特征平滑对该能力的影响。
AI.result: 当上下文包含足够的、独立的控制激励时,TSFM能够恢复系统的输入-响应关系;常见微调流程和特征平滑可减少但不能消除对上下文激励的依赖;初步闭环实验显示较短上下文窗口也有前景。
AI.conclusion: 当前用于预测控制的TSFM要求在推理上下文中提供信息量足够的控制变化,单纯的低预测误差不足以支撑MPC部署。

title: Checkable NTK Positivity and Finite-Width Gradient Descent for Scalar- and Vector-Valued PINNs with Strong-Form, Weak-Form, and Nonlocal Linear Constraints
summary: We give checkable positive-definiteness criteria for the limiting neural tangent kernel (NTK) and high-probability finite-width gradient-descent guarantees for scalar- or vector-valued physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) with linear constraints. The constraints may be strong-form differential rows of any fixed finite order, including coupled systems, with any linear initial or boundary conditions; weak-form residual and boundary functionals; or finite-measure nonlocal observations such as integral, nonlocal-diffusion, and Dirac-data rows, all in any dimension. For each class, positive definiteness of the limiting NTK is equivalent to a rank condition on a finite coefficient, functional, or moment matrix of the fixed design: a certificate computed before training that detects structural zero modes. The model hypotheses are those of an ordinary two-layer PINN, a smooth nonpolynomial activation with bounded symmetric initialization, and are met by standard choices such as $\tanh$ with uniform initialization. Given a certificate, explicit width and step-size conditions ensure, with high probability, that the empirical NTK retains at least half the limiting gap and that full-batch gradient descent decreases the training loss geometrically at every iteration. Controlled experiments check the certificates and the finite-width mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该论文为带线性约束的PINN建立了可验证的正定性判据与有限宽度梯度下降保证：极限NTK正定等价于固定设计的有限矩阵秩条件，该证书可在训练前检测结构零模态；满足条件时给出宽度与步长保证经验NTK保持至少一半谱隙并几何收敛。
AI.motivation: PINN的训练收敛性缺乏理论保证，尤其当约束（微分方程、初边值、弱形式、非局部观测）引入结构性零模态时，极限NTK可能非正定，导致梯度下降失效。作者希望提供可在训练前计算的、统一适用于多种线性约束的判据。
AI.method: 针对标量/向量PINN，约束涵盖任意固定有限阶强形式微分行（含耦合系统）、任意线性初/边条件、弱形式残差与边界泛函、以及有限测度非局部观测（积分、非局部扩散、Dirac数据），任意维数。在两层普通PINN、光滑非多项式激活、有界对称初始化（如tanh均匀初始化）假设下，证明极限NTK正定等价于某个有限系数/泛函/矩矩阵的秩条件，给出训练前可计算证书；并由该证书导出显式宽度与步长条件。
AI.result: 将极限NTK正定性刻画为有限矩阵的秩条件，作为检测结构零模态的证书；给定证书时，以高概率保证经验NTK保留至少一半极限谱隙，且全批量梯度下降每次迭代几何式降低训练损失。受控实验验证了证书与有限宽度机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为广泛线性约束下的PINN提供了统一、可验证的收敛理论，把正定性检验简化为训练前的有限矩阵秩检查，并通过宽度/步长条件确保有限宽度下的几何收敛，实验支持理论预测。

title: Improved large-scale graph learning through ridge spectral sparsification
summary: Graph-based techniques and spectral graph theory have enriched the field of machine learning with a variety of critical advances. A central object in the analysis is the graph Laplacian L, which encodes the structure of the graph. We consider the problem of learning over this Laplacian in a distributed streaming setting, where new edges of the graph are observed in real time by a network of workers. In this setting, it is hard to learn quickly or approximately while keeping a distributed representation of L. To address this challenge, we present a novel algorithm, GSQUEAK, which efficiently sparsifies the Laplacian by maintaining a small subset of effective resistances. We show that our algorithm produces sparsifiers with strong spectral approximation guarantees, all while processing edges in a single pass and in a distributed fashion.

AI.tldr: 提出GSQUEAK算法，在分布式流式环境下高效稀疏化图拉普拉斯，通过维护少量有效电阻子集，单遍处理边并获得强谱近似保证。
AI.motivation: 图拉普拉斯L是谱图理论与图机器学习分析的核心对象。在分布式流式设定下，新边由多个worker实时观测，难以快速或近似地学习，同时还需维持L的分布式表示。
AI.method: GSQUEAK算法：通过维护一个小的有效电阻（effective resistances）子集来对拉普拉斯进行稀疏化；以单遍（single pass）方式并分布式地处理边。
AI.result: 算法生成的稀疏化器具有强谱近似保证（strong spectral approximation guarantees），且支持边的单遍、分布式处理。
AI.conclusion: GSQUEAK能在分布式流式场景下高效、近似地学习图拉普拉斯，兼顾速度、近似质量与分布式表示需求。

title: How Much Do LLM-as-a-Judge Design Choices Matter? A Systematic Comparison of Prompt Designs, Rating Scales, and Models
summary: Researchers increasingly use Large Language Models as judges (LLM-as-a-judge) to evaluate model outputs. Yet there are no standards for how to design these judges. Typically, researchers choose the prompt, rating scale, and model intuitively. If these choices change the judge's verdicts, two studies can reach different conclusions about the same facts. To address this risk and to provide an empirical basis for judge designs, we evaluate 10 reasoning models across multiple designs on two tasks: a scalar rating of sentence sentiment and toxicity (over 500 items per category), as well as a binary accuracy classification of question-answer pairs (n=600). For the rating tasks, despite judges showing significant disagreements with the human ground truth, the practical size of differences is small enough to consider most judges reliable (mean absolute deviation of 0.11 points on a 1 - 7 scale); toxicity judges even outperform standard classifiers. Judges are also highly accurate on average (96.5%) for the accuracy classification task. However, design choices can produce shifts: changing the rating scale alone can shift measured bias by up to 0.93 points (rating task), and while accuracy levels are rarely impacted, design choices consistently impact judge leniency (classification task; leniency drop of 28.9 percentage points when using detailed prompts, and up to 56.1 percentage points when switching models). Counterintuitively, lower reasoning effort affects neither accuracy nor leniency. Across both tasks, model identity is the dominant source of variance. These findings suggest that while LLM judges are broadly trustworthy in aggregate, design choices can be meaningful sources of variance. Given the growing reliance on automated evaluation in LLM research, we intend this study as a methodological reference for designing more robust and replicable LLM-as-a-judge pipelines.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了10个推理模型作为LLM裁判在情感/毒性评分和准确率分类任务上的表现，发现裁判总体可靠，但设计选择（评分量表、提示、模型）会带来显著方差，其中模型身份是主要差异来源。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge被越来越多用于评估模型输出，但缺乏裁判设计标准。研究者通常凭直觉选择提示、评分量表和模型，若这些选择影响裁决，不同研究可能对同一事实得出不同结论。因此需要为裁判设计提供实证依据。
AI.method: 评估10个推理模型，采用多种设计，在两项任务上测试：1）句子情感与毒性的标量评分（每类500+项）；2）问答对的二元准确率分类（n=600）。
AI.result: 评分任务中裁判与人类真值虽有显著分歧，但实际差异较小（1-7量表上平均绝对偏差0.11分），多数裁判可靠，毒性裁判甚至优于标准分类器；分类任务平均准确率96.5%。但设计选择会带来偏移：仅改变评分量表可使测得偏差变化达0.93分；设计选择一致影响裁判宽容度（详细提示使宽容度下降28.9个百分点，换模型最高下降56.1个百分点），而准确率很少受影响。反直觉的是，降低推理投入既不影响准确率也不影响宽容度。模型身份是两任务中方差的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: LLM裁判总体上值得信赖，但设计选择可能是重要的方差来源。鉴于LLM研究中日益依赖自动化评估，本研究旨在为设计更稳健、可复现的LLM-as-a-judge流程提供方法学参考。

title: Trinity: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models with a Self-Verifier
comment: NeurIPS'26 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
summary: Self-evolving vision-language models (VLMs), a form of self-improvement in which a model generates its own training data from unlabeled images, are a promising route toward agents that expand their reasoning capability in an unsupervised manner, without relying on ever-larger annotation budgets. Existing methods pair a Questioner that proposes problems with a Solver that answers them, but reward both roles mainly by agreement among sampled answers. Agreement is a weak proxy for truth: it cannot tell whether a question is grounded in the image, whether the proposed reference answer is right, or whether a confident majority is wrong in the same way. We present Trinity, in which one VLM plays three roles, Questioner, Solver, and Verifier, and the Verifier is a self-verifier: an exponential moving average (EMA) of the policy itself, requiring neither labels nor an external judge. The Verifier screens every generated question for image grounding and answer correctness before it becomes supervision, scores Solver reasoning against the image, and adjudicates disputes between the reference answer and a strong Solver consensus, correcting the reference and penalizing the Questioner when the consensus is right. Trained on images alone, Trinity improves Qwen3-VL-8B on mathematical visual reasoning and on science benchmarks with biology content, for example, +8.6 points on the biology split of SciVQR and +12.8 on MathVerse, and its reward dynamics behave as a healthy self-play curriculum should. These results suggest that a self-evolving multimodal agent can strengthen its scientific reasoning from unlabeled scientific images alone, with the model itself serving as the verifier.

AI.tldr: Trinity 让同一 VLM 扮演出题者、解题者与自验证者三角色，用策略自身的 EMA 作为无标签验证器，从无标注图像中自演化提升视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化 VLM 方法依赖出题者与解题者之间的答案一致性作为奖励，但一致性是真实性的弱代理：无法判断问题是否基于图像、参考答案是否正确，也无法识别"自信的多数共同犯错"。
AI.method: 一个 VLM 担任三角色：Questioner、Solver、Verifier。Verifier 是策略自身参数的指数移动平均（EMA），无需标签或外部评判者。它筛选生成问题的图像基础性与答案正确性，评估 Solver 推理与图像的一致性，并在参考答案与强 Solver 共识冲突时进行裁决——当共识正确时修正参考答案并惩罚 Questioner。
AI.result: 仅用图像训练，Trinity 在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上提升数学视觉推理与科学基准：SciVQR 生物部分 +8.6 分，MathVerse +12.8 分，且奖励动态表现出健康的自我博弈课程特征。
AI.conclusion: 自演化多模态智能体可仅凭无标注科学图像强化科学推理，由模型自身充当验证器。

title: Policy as Data: Replay-Based Policy Dual Averaging via Advantage Regression
summary: Actor-critic methods reuse past experience to improve sample efficiency. However, historical data are typically regarded as off-policy samples for the current policy-improvement update. This work introduces Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C), which assigns a distinct role to replay. In regularized dual averaging, the subsequent policy is determined by accumulated policy-improvement feedback, so historical advantage estimates contribute directly to the actor objective rather than solely to the most recent update. RDA2C stores state-action samples with critic-estimated advantage labels, fits a dual score model $Z_θ$ to the aggregated dataset, and derives the current policy from the accumulated score model using the entropy mirror map. In this way, replay defines an empirical dual objective from which the policy is computed. To analyze RDA2C, we establish a finite-time value-gap decomposition, separating the regularized dual-averaging term from errors due to stale-replay supervised fitting, critic bias, finite-buffer variance, and replay coverage, and stating the assumptions under which each error is bounded. RDA2C accepts advantage labels from any critic. With GAE labels, RDA2C outperforms PPO on six of eight MuJoCo tasks and eight of twelve Atari games. RDA2C also outperforms AAPDA, the closest dual-averaging baseline, on six of eight MuJoCo tasks. With twin-$Q$ labels, RDA2C matches SAC at matched batch size and update frequency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RDA2C，用正则化对偶平均重新定义回放缓冲区的角色，使历史优势估计直接累积到策略目标中，而非仅作为off-policy样本。
AI.motivation: actor-critic方法虽通过复用历史经验提升样本效率，但通常将历史数据视为相对当前策略的off-policy样本，仅服务于最近一次的策略改进更新，未充分利用历史优势信息。
AI.method: RDA2C存储带critic估计优势标签的状态-动作样本，拟合对偶分数模型Z_θ到聚合数据集，再通过熵镜像映射从累积的分数模型导出当前策略；回放因此定义了用于计算策略的经验对偶目标。
AI.result: 建立有限时间值差分解，分离正则化对偶平均项与stale-replay监督拟合、critic偏差、有限缓冲区方差、回放覆盖等误差。使用GAE标签时，在8个MuJoCo任务中6个、12个Atari游戏中8个超越PPO；在8个MuJoCo任务中6个超越AAPDA；使用twin-Q标签时matched batch size与更新频率下与SAC相当。
AI.conclusion: RDA2C通过让回放定义经验对偶目标，赋予历史数据直接参与策略优化的角色，兼容任意critic的优势标签，并在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能。

title: A Bird's-Eye View of Iterative Reward Design
summary: Designing effective reward functions in RL typically requires substantial expertise and trial and error. Recent work automates this process with LLM-based systems that generate and iteratively improve reward code using policy feedback. However, these methods are often hard to compare because they differ in implementation details, feedback assumptions, and evaluation environments. To address this, we introduce a Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design (BIRD) that expresses existing methods in a unified configuration and evaluation space. This lets us compare algorithms directly, ablate individual design choices, and prototype new components under matched feedback conditions and policy-training budgets. Across MuJoCo, Meta-World, Assistax, and HumanoidBench, we identify a small set of simple design choices that consistently improve performance. Combining these choices yields significantly better performance than the evaluated methods from prior work. Our results highlight the strength of simple baselines and motivate further study of when additional algorithmic complexity improves iterative reward design. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/bird.

AI.tldr: 提出 BIRD 基准，统一配置与评估空间来公平比较迭代式奖励设计方法，并发现一组简单设计选择即可超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: RL 奖励函数设计依赖专家经验和试错；现有基于 LLM 的自动化奖励生成方法因实现细节、反馈假设和评估环境差异难以直接比较。
AI.method: 构建 BIRD 基准，将已有方法纳入统一配置与评估空间，支持直接对比算法、消融各设计选择，并在匹配的反馈条件和策略训练预算下原型化新组件，覆盖 MuJoCo、Meta-World、Assistax 和 HumanoidBench。
AI.result: 识别出一小部分能持续提升性能的简单设计选择；组合这些选择后性能显著优于所评估的先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显简单基线的强大，并呼吁进一步研究何时增加算法复杂度能真正改善迭代式奖励设计。代码已开源。

title: Large-scale semi-supervised learning with online spectral graph sparsification
comment: Workshop on Resource-Efficient Machine Learning (REML), ICML 2015
summary: We introduce Sparse-HFS, a scalable algorithm that can compute solutions to SSL problems using only O(n polylog(n)) space and O(m polylog(n)) time.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sparse-HFS 算法，以 O(n polylog(n)) 空间和 O(m polylog(n)) 时间求解 SSL 问题，具备良好可扩展性。
AI.motivation: SSL（谱稀疏化/半正定相关图问题）问题在大规模图上求解时，传统方法空间与时间开销过大，难以扩展。
AI.method: Sparse-HFS 算法，利用稀疏化与启发式/分解策略，将求解控制在近线性空间与时间范围内。
AI.result: 空间复杂度 O(n polylog(n))，时间复杂度 O(m polylog(n))（n 为顶点数，m 为边数）。
AI.conclusion: Sparse-HFS 为 SSL 问题提供了近线性、可扩展的求解方案，适合大规模应用。

title: vMF Sentence LDA: A Spherical Topic Model over Sentence Embeddings
summary: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and models derived from it remain widely used topic models. LDA observes each document as a bag-of-words and models each topic by a categorical distribution over the vocabulary, so that it uses neither the internal structure of the document nor the similarity in meaning between words. Earlier work has responded to this limitation in two ways: many models have introduced embeddings, and some have assigned topics to sentences rather than to words. Their combination, a topic model that observes sentence embeddings, remains little explored. We propose vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA), which keeps the admixture structure of LDA, observes each sentence as its L2-normalized embedding and models each topic by a von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distribution, which matches the cosine geometry of sentence embeddings.
