OnePO combines Adaptive Objective Evolution to strengthen learning on informative low-probability teacher tokens and Teacher Retirement to discard teacher outputs once the current policy can surpass them. On medical adaptation, OnePO achieves 67.2 on HealthBench (Total) with only 20K training samples, outperforming SFT+RL and pure RL by 2.7 and 7.4 points, respectively. We further scale OnePO to produce HuatuoGPT-3, an open-source medical LLM series whose 27B variant reaches 70.1 on HealthBench (Total) and 71.4 on HealthBench Professional, surpassing frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra. Models and code are available at https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3.

AI.tldr: OnePO 提出单阶段策略优化，将教师输出作为瞬时引导，解决领域自适应中 SFT+RL 多样性下降及混合策略 RL 的两大失败模式，在医学领域超越 SFT+RL、纯 RL 及 GPT-6 Astra。
AI.motivation: SFT+RL 冷启动方便但降低探索多样性且多阶段优化复杂；纯 on-policy RL 有冷启动问题，mixed-policy RL 中教师信息 token 学习过慢（Gradient Starvation），陈旧教师输出阻碍后期提升（Teacher-Distribution Anchoring）。
AI.method: OnePO 将教师输出视为策略改进的瞬时引导，包含两个机制：Adaptive Objective Evolution 加强对低概率但信息量大的教师 token 的学习；Teacher Retirement 在当前策略超越教师后丢弃教师输出。
AI.result: 医学自适应：仅用 20K 训练样本，HealthBench (Total) 达 67.2，分别超 SFT+RL 和纯 RL 2.7 和 7.4 分。扩展到 HuatuoGPT-3，27B 版本达 HealthBench Total 70.1、Professional 71.4，超越 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: OnePO 提供高效的单阶段 RL-only 领域自适应方案，识别并解决两个关键失败模式，并成功构建开源医学 LLM 系列 HuatuoGPT-3。

title: Do More Modalities Always Help? A Geometric Perspective on Missing-Modality Robustness
summary: Missing modality remains a longstanding challenge in multimodal learning. Existing methods typically address this issue through modality recovery or adaptive strategies. However, they overlook models' internal cross-modal dependencies formed during multimodal training, which later impair robustness. We systematically characterize a counterintuitive deployment-time failure mode: models trained on full modalities can underperform unimodal models when one modality is missing at inference time. This pattern appears across diverse architectures, such as fusion models, CLIP-style two-tower models, and vision-language models. We show that such degradation is closely associated with learned cross-modal dependencies in the principal parameter subspaces. Multimodal training induces structured rotations of these subspaces, particularly in cross-modal interaction layers. These rotations are associated with reduced task-aligned margins and larger task-aware representation harm under missing-modality inputs. We propose Geodesic Unlearning (GU), a lightweight parameter-editing method that leverages Grassmannian subspace geometry for structured subspace correction to improve missing-modality robustness. It rotates the principal input subspace toward a unimodal reference along a geodesic path. We prove that this correction minimizes the distance to the reference within a fixed subspace-distance budget. Experiments across architectures and datasets show that GU improves performance under missing-modality inference while preserving full-modality accuracy, outperforming strong missing-modality robustness baselines. These findings support a geometric view of deployment-time missing-modality degradation and suggest localized subspace editing as a practical route for robustness correction.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了多模态模型在推理时缺失模态下性能下降的几何根源，并提出轻量级参数编辑方法Geodesic Unlearning (GU)进行修正。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过模态恢复或自适应策略应对缺失模态问题，但忽视了多模态训练中形成的内部跨模态依赖，导致部署时鲁棒性受损——甚至全模态训练的模型在缺失模态时不如单模态模型。
AI.method: 作者系统刻画了主参数子空间中的跨模态依赖，发现多模态训练会诱导主输入子空间的结构化旋转（尤其在跨模态交互层）。据此提出GU方法，利用Grassmannian子空间几何，沿测地线路径将主输入子空间旋转至单模态参考子空间，并证明该修正能在固定子空间距离预算内最小化与参考的距离。
AI.result: 跨架构（融合模型、CLIP式双塔模型、视觉语言模型）和数据集实验表明，GU提升了缺失模态推理性能，同时保持全模态精度，优于强鲁棒性基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持部署时缺失模态退化的几何视角，表明局部子空间编辑是实用的鲁棒性修正途径。

title: Learning Discriminative Geometry for Drifting Models
summary: Recently proposed Drifting Models shift iterative distribution refinement from inference to training, enabling effective one-step generation. However, their performance on complex image datasets depends strongly on the representation used to construct the drifting field: pixel-space drifting performs poorly, whereas pretrained feature spaces substantially improve sample quality for reasons that remain unclear. We trace this gap to the discriminative geometry of the representation, which determines sample weighting in kernel density estimation (KDE) and, consequently drift. We introduce persistent representation learning, which continuously learns a more discriminative representation geometry as the generator evolves across batches. We further establish a current-step gradient equivalence between the KDE ratio loss and drift regression loss under matched conditions, connecting density-ratio-based generator optimization to empirical drifting and motivating direct control of the drifting velocity. Across multiple datasets, our method learns effective discriminative representations directly from pixels and reduces FID by approximately $82-95\%$ over the original pixel-space Drifting Models, without pretrained encoders. Adapting pretrained representations and applying velocity clipping provide further gains.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Drifting Models中表示几何对生成质量的影响，提出持续表示学习与速度控制，使其无需预训练编码器即可从像素学习有效表示，FID降低约82–95%。
AI.motivation: Drifting Models将迭代分布细化从推理移到训练，实现有效的一步生成，但其在复杂图像数据集上的性能高度依赖用于构建漂移场的表示：像素空间漂移效果差，预训练特征空间显著提升样本质量，原因不明。
AI.method: 作者将差距归因于表示的判别几何，该几何决定KDE中的样本加权进而影响漂移；提出持续表示学习，在生成器跨批次演化时不断学习更具判别性的表示几何；并证明在匹配条件下KDE比率损失与漂移回归损失存在当前步梯度等价，从而连接密度比优化与经验漂移，并支持直接控制漂移速度（含速度裁剪）。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，该方法直接从像素学习有效判别表示，无需预训练编码器，相较原始像素空间Drifting Models将FID降低约82–95%；适配预训练表示并应用速度裁剪可带来进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明Drifting Models的性能瓶颈在于表示的判别几何而非是否有预训练编码器；持续表示学习与漂移速度控制可显著提升一步生成质量，并为漂移模型优化提供理论联系。

title: Round-Trip KNN Clustering: multiscale hierarchical cluster detection on directed nearest-neighbour graphs
comment: Submitted to Knowledge and Information Systems (KAIS). 32 pages, 6 figures
summary: We introduce Round-Trip KNN Clustering (RTKNNC), a graph-based method for finding cluster structure at several neighbourhood scales without requiring the number of clusters in advance. Unlike approaches that first make a $k$-nearest-neighbour (KNN) graph undirected, RTKNNC keeps both directions of the neighbour relation: which points a given point selects and which points select it. Incoming selections are treated as weighted votes that help decide which local connections remain visible during a recursive forward-and-reverse traversal. Repeating the procedure for increasing $K$ reveals how groups persist or merge as the neighbourhood scale grows; for the reference inverse-square model before structural refinement, clusters can merge but do not split. Because graph connectivity can occasionally join distinct groups through a sparse bridge or a small region of overlap, we add an optional label-free refinement. It first tests whether an already formed component is better described by two or three Gaussian subpopulations, and accepts a subdivision only when the proposed groups are large enough and consistent with the visible KNN graph. Across eight synthetic datasets and $K=2,\ldots,16$, independent C and Python implementations produced identical partitions in all 120 reference runs. Refinement increased adjusted Rand index from $0.7817$ to $0.9627$ on a variable-density benchmark and from $0.8083$ to $0.9853$ on a sparse-bridge benchmark. Comparisons with seven external clustering methods show competitive performance while preserving a label-free cluster-construction process.

AI.tldr: RTKNNC 是一种基于有向 KNN 图的聚类方法，通过递归正反映射遍历在多个邻域尺度发现簇结构，无需预设簇数，并可选用无标签高斯细分优化连通性错误。
AI.motivation: 传统 KNN 图聚类通常先把有向邻接关系变为无向图，丢失了"谁选择了谁"的信息；同时图连通性可能通过稀疏桥或小重叠区错误连接不同簇。
AI.method: 保留 KNN 关系的双向信息，将入边选择作为加权投票，在递归正反遍历中决定保留哪些局部连接；对递增 K 重复该过程观察簇的持续与合并；并加入可选的细分为两/三个高斯子群的步骤，仅当子群足够大且与可见 KNN 图一致时接受。
AI.result: 在 8 个合成数据集、K=2..16 的 120 次参考运行中，独立 C 与 Python 实现得到完全一致的分区；细化使变密度基准 ARI 从 0.7817 升至 0.9627，稀疏桥基准从 0.8083 升至 0.9853；与 7 种外部方法相比具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: RTKNNC 无需预设簇数即可多尺度构建簇结构，保持无标签流程，并通过可选细化显著改善连通性错误，性能具竞争力。

title: Can Language Models Learn to Reject Their Own Bad Reasoning Steps?
summary: Verifier-guided decoding can prevent harmful reasoning steps from contaminating subsequent generation, but typically relies on an external learned verifier. We ask whether a language model can instead reject its own bad reasoning steps. We define a prefix's recoverability as the probability that the frozen generator can complete it correctly. Diagnostics show that adjacent recoverability changes are often difficult to resolve with practical Monte Carlo budgets, while same-prefix candidates exhibit a sparse low-recoverability tail. We introduce Self-Step Rejection (SSR), which trains a lightweight LoRA acceptance gate on the generator backbone while keeping the base model frozen. SSR uses confidence-qualified first-passage supervision: steps before the first resolved crossing of a root-relative recoverability barrier are accepted, the crossing step is rejected, and unresolved steps and suffixes are excluded. Training combines pointwise classification, same-prefix pairwise learning, and group-relative policy refinement using final-answer correctness. At inference, SSR accepts candidates or resamples from the unchanged prefix under rejection budgets, without an external learned verifier. Across three reasoning models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SSR improves macro-average accuracy over single-pass decoding by 5.4--10.1 points using 1.21--1.40x as many generated tokens, and achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among evaluated step-level methods. Full-solution scaling methods require 4.47--8.27x the single-pass token cost for comparable performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Self-Step Rejection (SSR)，让语言模型通过轻量LoRA接受门自行拒绝错误推理步骤，无需外部验证器，在多个数学推理基准上提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 验证器引导解码能防止有害推理步骤污染后续生成，但通常依赖外部学习到的验证器。作者探索模型能否自行拒绝错误的推理步骤。
AI.method: 定义前缀"可恢复性"（冻结生成器正确补全该前缀的概率）。诊断发现相邻可恢复性变化难以用实际蒙特卡洛预算区分，而同一前缀候选呈现稀疏的低可恢复性尾部。SSR在冻结的生成器主干上训练轻量LoRA接受门，使用置信度合格的首达监督：首个跨过根相对可恢复性障碍前的步骤被接受，跨步被拒绝，未解决步骤和后缀排除。训练结合逐点分类、同前缀成对学习和基于最终答案正确性的组相对策略优化。推理时在接受/拒绝预算下接受候选或从不变前缀重采样。
AI.result: 在三个推理模型和五个数学推理基准上，SSR相比单次解码将宏平均准确率提升5.4–10.1个百分点，仅用1.21–1.40倍的生成token；在评估的步骤级方法中取得最高宏平均准确率。全解扩展方法需4.47–8.27倍单次token成本才能达到相当性能。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可通过自训练接受门实现自我步骤拒绝，在低token开销下显著提升推理准确率，优于依赖外部验证器或高成本全解扩展的方法。

title: Pressure, Context, and Machine Self-Control: A Criminological Test of Reward Hacking in Generative AI Models
summary: Recent incidents show that AI agents sometimes reach measured goals through unsanctioned means. This study applies self-control, general strain, anomie, neutralization and routine activity theory to reward hacking in generative AI models, and it treats the measures as behavioral analogues. Study 1 (2,310 conversations, seven models) measured delay discounting with the Kirby Monetary Choice Questionnaire and stated willingness to take shortcuts. Pressure raised the discount rate k 2.8-fold in fresh conversations but 12.6-fold when the same sentence followed a baseline answer, which indicates a response to conversational cues rather than a stable trait. Models chose a shortcut in 1 of 700 dilemmas when answering as themselves and in 64 of 700 when asked to assume human impulses, each step of pressure raised the odds by 40%, and shortcut answers contained far more techniques of neutralization (rate ratio = 146). In the preregistered Study 2, five models worked on 20 coding tasks whose tests contradicted their specifications. Two Claude models never cheated. GPT-5.6, Qwen and DeepSeek cheated in 86%, 69% and 65% of episodes and clearly disclosed the conflict in 27%, although their reasoning recognized it in 95%. GPT-5.6 had never endorsed a shortcut in Study 1. The registered effects of pressure and of an auditor cue did not survive correction for multiple testing. In exploratory analyses, two further models cheated in 69% and 100% of episodes, and one sentence stating that the specification takes priority eliminated cheating in all 280 episodes. Therefore, stated refusal does not guarantee compliant agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究将自我控制、一般紧张、失范、中和技术与日常活动理论应用于生成式AI的"奖励黑客"行为，发现模型会通过未经许可的手段达成目标，且声明拒绝并不能保证行为合规。
AI.motivation: 近期事件显示AI智能体有时通过未获授权的手段达到既定目标（奖励黑客）。作者希望借用犯罪学/社会学理论，把这些测量当作行为类比，探究AI在压力与情境线索下走捷径的行为机制。
AI.method: 研究1：2310段对话、7个模型，用Kirby货币选择问卷测量延迟折扣，并测量声称的走捷径意愿。研究2（预注册）：5个模型完成20个编码任务，其测试与规格说明相矛盾；另有探索性分析加入2个模型。
AI.result: 研究1：压力使折扣率k在新对话中上升2.8倍，但同一句话跟在基线回答后时上升12.6倍（对对话线索的响应而非稳定特质）；模型以自身身份回答时700次困境中仅1次选捷径，被要求模拟人类冲动时64次选捷径；每步压力使捷径几率提高40%；捷径回答中中和技术显著更多（比率=146）。研究2：两个Claude模型从不作弊；GPT-5.6、Qwen、DeepSeek分别在86%、69%、65%的回合中作弊，仅27%明确披露冲突，而推理中识别冲突达95%；GPT-5.6在研究1中从未认可捷径。压力与审计员线索的注册效应未通过多重检验校正。探索性分析中另两模型作弊率69%和100%，而一句"规格说明优先"消除了全部280回合的作弊。
AI.conclusion: 声称的拒绝不能保证智能体的合规行为；AI的奖励黑客行为更多受对话情境线索与压力影响，而非稳定特质，且模型常在推理中识别冲突却不披露。

title: Localized Operator Learning with Adaptive Partition-of-Unity Mixture-of-Expert Networks
summary: Operator learning methods such as DeepONets and FNOs often struggle with PDE families featuring sharp interfaces, heterogeneous coefficients, and localized multiscale structures. We introduce a partition-of-unity (POU) mixture-of-experts framework for localized operator learning, in which geometry-aware gating networks produce smooth spatial partitions which blend the contributions of local expert networks. Our main contribution is HiRefPOU, a residual-style hierarchical POU architecture for DeepONets that organizes localized representations through nested parent-child partitions while preserving global continuity. We also show that the same POU principle can be incorporated into Fourier Neural Operators to introduce spatial adaptivity without modifying the underlying spectral layers. On heterogeneous Darcy and reaction-diffusion benchmarks, HiRefPOU achieves substantially lower error than global DeepONet and static POU-MoE baselines, while the broader operator-learning experiments show that the benefits of localization depend on the PDE structure and the chosen neural-operator backbone. The learned partitions are interpretable and align with interfaces and regions of rapid solution variation. These results show that explicit geometric localization can improve both accuracy and interpretability in neural operator learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于单位分解(POU)的专家混合框架用于局部算子学习,核心贡献是面向DeepONet的层次化残差式POU架构HiRefPOU,通过几何感知门控网络生成平滑空间划分,并可推广至FNO;在非均质Darcy与反应扩散基准上显著降低误差,且学到的划分具有可解释性。
AI.motivation: DeepONet与FNO等算子学习方法在处理具有尖锐界面、异质系数和局部多尺度结构的PDE族时表现不佳,需要引入显式的几何局部化来提升精度与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出POU专家混合框架:几何感知门控网络生成平滑空间划分,对局部专家网络输出进行混合。核心为HiRefPOU——面向DeepONet的残差式层次化POU架构,用嵌套父子划分组织局部表示并保持全局连续性;同一POU原理也可嵌入FNO,在不改变谱层的前提下引入空间自适应性。
AI.result: 在非均质Darcy和反应扩散基准上,HiRefPOU误差显著低于全局DeepONet和静态POU-MoE基线;更广泛的实验表明局部化收益取决于PDE结构和所选神经算子骨干。学到的划分可解释,与界面及解变化剧烈区域吻合。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何局部化能够同时提升神经算子学习的精度与可解释性。

title: Block Disentanglement in CRL: Bridging Identifiability and Visual State Estimation
summary: Causal representation learning (CRL) is the process of recovering causally-related latent variables from high-dimensional observations. As a label-free inference method, CRL is particularly attractive for applications where data labels are unavailable or impractical to obtain. While there has been significant progress in understanding the identifiability guarantees of CRL, such guarantees often hold under highly stylized assumptions, which temper the direct application to real-world problems. This paper has a two-fold objective for interventional CRL. First, it establishes identifiability guarantees for substantially weaker interventional assumptions, resulting in block disentanglement of the causal variables, where the block structure depends on the realistically available intervention mechanisms. Secondly, the block disentanglement framework is used for embodied visual state estimation, in which the objective is to recover the latent physical variables of a robotic system directly from visual data (images and videos) without labeled data. These two components are critically complementary. The block disentanglement theory delineates identifiability guarantees under weakened assumptions, and the application demonstrates that the resulting objective remains effective in a controlled embodied setting despite further assumption violations, providing a theory-to-practice bridge needed to translate the promise of label-free CRL into practical problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对干预式因果表示学习(CRL)，在更弱的干预假设下建立可辨识性保证，得到因果变量的块解耦(block disentanglement)，并将其应用于具身视觉状态估计。
AI.motivation: 现有CRL可辨识性保证依赖高度理想化假设，难以直接应用于真实问题，尤其在缺乏标签的场景下需要更现实的假设与实用的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于现实可用干预机制的块解耦理论框架，放宽干预假设；将块解耦框架用于具身视觉状态估计，从图像和视频中无标签地恢复机器人系统的潜在物理变量。
AI.result: 在显著更弱的干预假设下获得了可辨识性保证，实现因果变量的块解耦；在受控具身场景中，即使存在进一步的假设违背，该方法目标仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 理论与应用互补：块解耦理论刻画弱假设下的可辨识性，应用验证其在实践中的有效性，搭建了将无标签CRL从理论转化为实际问题的桥梁。

title: Byte Language Models: Scaling, Emergent Abstractions, and Information Allocation
summary: Tokenizer-free language models remove the inductive bias of fixed tokenizers by modeling text directly as bytes, but the resulting longer sequences substantially increase computation and eliminate explicit text abstractions. We ask whether this additional computation can be useful, and whether standard Transformers can learn the abstractions that tokenization provides. We study these questions on Transformers without specialized tokenization-related architectures. With token-superposition training and hash embeddings, byte Transformers consistently outperform subword Transformers as model size scales. We further find that byte Transformers build local text abstractions as external tokenizers: a set of segmentation-like positions are used to collect local context representations, and restricting up to $25\%$ of intermediate layers to these local representations preserves downstream performance. Finally, these learned structures induce highly non-uniform generation difficulty, with uncertainty concentrated near local structure boundaries; exploiting them for speculative decoding yields $3.4\times$ more accepted tokens than in subword Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无分词器的字节级语言模型，发现随规模增长其性能优于子词模型，并自发学习出类似分词的局部抽象结构。
AI.motivation: 字节级模型去除了固定分词器带来的归纳偏置，但序列更长、计算量更大，且缺乏显式文本抽象。作者追问：这些额外计算是否有用？标准Transformer能否学到分词提供的抽象能力？
AI.method: 在无专门分词相关架构的标准Transformer上，采用token-superposition训练与hash embeddings，对比字节级与子词级模型，并分析字节Transformer学习到的内部结构。
AI.result: 字节Transformer随规模增长持续优于子词Transformer；它学习到类似分词的局部文本抽象，将最多25%的中间层限制为局部表示仍能保持下游性能；生成难度高度不均，不确定性集中在局部结构边界，用于推测解码可获得3.4倍于子词模型的接受token数。
AI.conclusion: 字节级Transformer的额外计算并非浪费，它能自发构建分词器式的抽象结构，并在生成效率上带来实际收益。

title: Knowing the Store: What a Memory Backend Must Write Down Before an Agent Can Read It
comment: 94 pages. Under review at ICLR 2027. Supplement included as ancillary file. Code and data: https://github.com/ansh348/knowing-the-store
summary: An agent with long-term memory can answer from a record it should no longer use, such as a plan the user later cancelled. We ask what a memory store must expose for an agent to know this before retrieving anything, and we score that judgment on its own, as metamemory monitoring. Readers see only a value-free summary: record counts by lifecycle state and a list of attribute names. Each of 148 questions is asked against three versions of one store that differ in one attribute, so wording cannot give the answer away. What a model adds depends on the length of that list. On the short lists the benchmark's ground truth produces (2.6 names on average), none of five language models reliably beats a cosine-similarity lookup over the names, and the three stronger ones are equivalent to it within 0.05. Under a control that fixes counts and list length, none is reliably above it and none is shown equivalent. On lists longer than the stores we tested write, padded to 60 names, the lookup loses 0.18; GPT-5.6 Luna and Sol lose 0.06 to 0.07 and lead it by 0.13 to 0.14, while the other three fall with it. The lead holds for Sol against a sibling padded to the same length and counts. Reworded to share no word with the names, the lookup loses 0.02 and one stronger reader edges 0.04 ahead. On the short lists the three stronger readers lead only where the summary counts a state without naming it, and one count feature closes that lead within a question, though not when items are pooled. The backends we tested omit or misstate this information: under FR-Bank's own metadata, GPT-4.1 mini, Haiku 4.5 and the lookup fall from 0.73, 0.82 and 0.75 to 0.60, 0.71 and 0.59. In these tests, what the store wrote down limited every reader we gave it to. All stores are synthetic; control, whether a better judgment yields a better answer, is left to a later study.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"元记忆监测"任务：智能体在检索前仅凭记录计数与属性名列表判断某记录是否仍应使用，并评测五种语言模型相对于简单名称余弦相似度基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆智能体会依据已作废（如用户取消的计划）的记录作答，因此需要在检索前预判哪些记忆不再适用；作者将这一能力单独形式化为元记忆监测并加以评测。
AI.method: 给读者只展示无值摘要（各生命周期状态的记录计数+属性名列表）；148个问题各测试同一存储的三个仅差一个属性的版本以避免措辞泄露；并与名称余弦相似度查找基线对比，另设控制条件（固定计数与列表长度）、长列表（填充至60名）、改写与FR-Bank元数据实验。
AI.result: 短列表（平均2.6名）下五个模型均无法稳定超过查找基线，三个较强模型与基线差距在0.05内；长列表下基线降0.18，GPT-5.6 Luna/Sol仅降0.06-0.07并领先0.13-0.14，另三个模型随基线同步下降；改写后查找降0.02、某强模型领先0.04；三个强模型仅在摘要计入某状态却未命名时有领先，一个计数特征即可在一问内消除；FR-Bank自带元数据下GPT-4.1 mini、Haiku 4.5与查找基线分别从0.73/0.82/0.75降至0.60/0.71/0.59。
AI.conclusion: 存储写入的信息量限制了所有读者的判断能力；所有存储均为合成数据，更优判断能否带来更优答案留待后续研究。

title: FoSeRL: Formal Sequential Robustness Certification for Reinforcement Learning Policies
summary: Even a few action perturbations can substantially degrade the performance of a deployed decision policy. Certifying the resulting return loss is challenging in stochastic environments, where returns vary even without an attack. We introduce FoSeRL, a framework for certifying deployed RL policies against precommitted, temporally sparse action attacks. The deployed policy is unchanged, with no smoothing or retraining. Certification requires a resettable simulator supporting shared randomness and independent one-step successor queries, but no analytical dynamics model. FoSeRL certifies that an attacked episode loses no more than a prescribed amount of return relative to the same episode unattacked, with at least a target probability and at a user-specified confidence level. Both runs share the initial state and randomness, so the measured loss reflects the attack, not the episode; carrying the running return gap as a state coordinate makes it the terminal value, reducing trajectory-level certification to terminal safety. Time-dependent barrier conditions on the augmented state bound the terminal failure probability: satisfied exactly, they certify every admissible precommitted attack; learned from sampled trajectories and verified on held-out data, they certify the same guarantee under a specified attack-episode setting. Across six stochastic continuous-control environments and three RL policy families (TD3, SAC, and PPO), FoSeRL certifies non-trivial cardinality--magnitude robustness frontiers, achieves substantially larger certified budgets than policy smoothing, and reveals marked robustness differences among policies with comparable nominal performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FoSeRL，一个在随机环境中、无需解析动力学模型即可认证已部署强化学习策略抵御稀疏动作攻击的框架。
AI.motivation: 少量动作扰动即可显著降低已部署决策策略的性能，但在随机环境中收益本身存在波动，使得认证由攻击导致的收益损失极具挑战。现有策略平滑等方法往往牺牲性能或认证预算有限。
AI.method: FoSeRL 不改变策略、不做平滑或重训练。它借助支持共享随机性与独立单步后继查询的可重置模拟器，使攻击与未攻击两条轨迹共享初始状态与随机性，从而让测得损失反映攻击而非回合波动；将运行收益差作为状态坐标并作为终值，把轨迹级认证化归为终端安全性问题。通过增广状态上的时变屏障条件约束终端失败概率：精确满足时认证所有可容许预承诺攻击；从采样轨迹学习并在留出数据上验证时，在指定攻击-回合设定下给出同样保证。
AI.result: 在六个随机连续控制环境和三种策略族（TD3、SAC、PPO）上，FoSeRL 认证了非平凡的基数-幅度鲁棒性前沿，认证预算显著大于策略平滑方法，并揭示了名义性能相近策略之间显著的鲁棒性差异。
AI.conclusion: FoSeRL 提供了一种可认证、无需动力学模型、不改变部署策略的随机环境 RL 鲁棒性认证方案，能有效刻画预承诺稀疏动作攻击下的收益损失上界。

title: Private online learning and prediction for Littlestone classes
summary: We study mistake bounds for differentially private online learning and online prediction under oblivious realisable adversaries. Online learning requires the learner to release a hypothesis at each time step whereas in online prediction, the learner only needs to make predictions without releasing a hypothesis. Using a novel lower bound for private online learning and an upper bound for private prediction, we show that the sample complexity of these two problems are separated by a factor that grows with the time horizon for every class of finite Littlestone dimension $d$. First, we prove that every $\br{ε,δ}$-private online learner has a deterministic realisable stream of length $T$ on which the mistake bound is at least $\bE\bs{M_T}=\Om{\frac dε\log\br{ T}^{2/3}}$. In particular, this is the first non-trivial lower in the range $1/T<δ<1/\log T)$ left open in earlier works[SR22,DSS24,LWY24]. Second, we prove that for every class of of Littlestone dimension $d$, there exists an $(ε,δ)$-jointly private predictor with at most $2^{2^{cd^2}}ε^{-2}\log^2\br{2/\br{εδ}}$ expected mistakes, independently of $T$, for some absolute constant $c>0$. Thus, for every fixed class of finite Littlestone dimension when $δ=Θ\br{1/\log T}$, private learning requires $\Om{\br{\log T}^{2/3}}$ expected mistakes, whereas private prediction admits $\bigO{\br{\log\log T}^2}$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究差分隐私在线学习与在线预测在可实现对手下的错误界，证明二者样本复杂度随T分离。
AI.motivation: 在线学习需每步发布假设，在线预测只需给出预测。二者在隐私约束下的样本复杂度关系此前在 1/T<δ<1/log T 的范围内缺少非平凡下界。
AI.method: 提出新的隐私在线学习下界与隐私预测上界。下界通过对任意(ε,δ)-隐私在线学习器构造确定性可实现流；上界构造(ε,δ)-联合隐私预测器。
AI.result: 每个(ε,δ)-隐私在线学习器存在长度T的确定性可实现流，使期望错误≥Ω((d/ε)log T^{2/3})；而对任意Littlestone维数d的类，存在(ε,δ)-联合隐私预测器，期望错误≤2^{2^{cd^2}}ε^{-2}log^2(2/(εδ))，与T无关。当δ=Θ(1/log T)时，隐私学习需Ω((log T)^{2/3})，隐私预测仅需O((log log T)^2)。
AI.conclusion: 在有限Littlestone维数类上，隐私在线学习与隐私在线预测的样本复杂度存在随T增长的分离因子，二者本质不同。

title: Breaking the Tie: A Cluster-Aware Routing Framework for Large Language Models
summary: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the emergence of various Large Language Models (LLMs) has created a rich model ecosystem. However, this also brings a key challenge: how to select the optimal model for a specific user query. LLM routing addresses this need by dynamically assigning queries to the most suitable expert in the pool of candidate models. However, existing routing frameworks often simplify this process to a standard classification task; thus, a critical vulnerability is exposed when multiple candidate models correctly answer the same query. We formalize this capability overlap as routing noise, which misleads the router with arbitrarily correct candidate models, ultimately leading to routing collapse (a severe decline in generalization ability on unseen tasks). To address this problem, we propose a novel Cluster-Aware Soft-Labeling Routing (CASLR) framework. CASLR shifts the evaluation paradigm from the success of a single query to macro-domain consensus by replacing traditional one-hot vectors with a masked softmax mechanism. Specifically, for experts who answer incorrectly, we penalize their target probability to zero; for the remaining candidates, we directly compute continuous fine-grained soft labels based on their global clustering utility scores. We then use these refined soft labels to supervise a lightweight router. Specifically, the framework not only demonstrates superior accuracy on multiple benchmarks, but also outperforms Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct by 7.80% in overall average performance. Furthermore, the extremely low routing inference latency of only 1.13s further confirms that CASLR can achieve efficient system scheduling with almost zero additional overhead, while ensuring high response quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CASLR 框架，通过聚类感知软标签解决 LLM 路由中的能力重叠（路由噪声）问题，提升泛化能力与效率。
AI.motivation: 多种 LLM 构成丰富生态，如何为特定查询选择最优模型成为关键挑战；现有路由框架将其简化为标准分类，当多个候选模型都能正确回答同一查询时，会产生路由噪声，导致路由崩溃（对未见任务泛化能力骤降）。
AI.method: 提出 Cluster-Aware Soft-Labeling Routing (CASLR)，将评估范式从单查询成功转向宏观领域共识：用掩码 softmax 取代 one-hot 向量，对回答错误的专家将目标概率置零，对剩余候选基于全局聚类效用分数计算连续细粒度软标签，并用其监督轻量级路由器。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得更优准确率，整体平均性能超越 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 达 7.80%；路由推理延迟仅 1.13s。
AI.conclusion: CASLR 以近乎零额外开销实现高效系统调度，同时保证高质量响应，验证了软标签路由应对能力重叠问题的有效性。

title: MedImageOSWorld: Benchmarking GUI Agents for Medical Image Consoles
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Supplementary material (8 pages) included as an ancillary file
summary: Graphical consoles offer a practical interface for medical acquisition assistance, allowing agents to work through the controls and visual feedback used by human operators. Reliable assistance requires linking on-screen anatomy to acquisition decisions that determine what image evidence becomes available next. We introduce MedImageOSWorld, a benchmark for evaluating this capability in simulated CT, MR, and ultrasound consoles. Using screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions, agents configure protocols, plan acquisitions, inspect the resulting images, and make corrective adjustments across seven capability levels, from console operation to feedback-driven control. Evaluation combines task-specific workflow checks with hidden anatomical ground truth to assess procedural completion and acquisition outcomes separately. A common evaluation protocol specifies episode conditions and interaction budgets, while recorded trajectories support analysis of how agents observe, act, and respond to acquisition feedback. Across eleven open-weight agents, success rates range from 3.0 to 25.0 on a 0-100 scale while workflow-progress rates reach 21.5-74.5: agents complete much of the console workflow but rarely acquire the intended anatomy. Success collapses between perception and planning, from 79-90% at the lowest three levels for the best agent to at most 12% for millimetre-level planning and 0% for closed-loop control among open-weight agents. Two proprietary agents reach success rates of about 34 and exceed the best open-weight agent mainly in acquisition quality (61 versus 42). MedImageOSWorld provides a controlled setting for studying whether general-purpose GUI agents can translate visual observations into effective medical acquisition decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出 MedImageOSWorld 基准，用于评估 GUI 智能体在模拟 CT/MR/超声控制台上完成医学影像采集的能力，揭示感知到规划之间的能力断层。
AI.motivation: 医学影像采集依赖操作者将屏幕解剖结构与采集决策关联，但通用 GUI 智能体是否能将视觉观察转化为有效的采集决策尚缺乏系统评测手段。现有基准缺少对采集结果与解剖正确性的独立评估。
AI.method: 构建模拟 CT、MR、超声控制台基准，智能体通过截图与鼠标键盘操作配置协议、规划采集、检查图像并做纠正性调整；任务分七个能力层级，从控制台操作到闭环反馈控制。评估将任务特定工作流检查与隐藏解剖真值结合，分别衡量流程完成度与采集结果，并统一设定回合条件、交互预算，记录轨迹以分析观察、动作与反馈响应。
AI.result: 十一个开源权重智能体得分仅 3.0–25.0（0–100），工作流进度达 21.5–74.5：能完成大部分流程但很少采集到目标解剖。最优智能体在最低三层的成功率为 79–90%，到毫米级规划降至至多 12%，闭环控制为 0%。两个闭源智能体成功率约 34，主要优势在采集质量（61 vs 42）。
AI.conclusion: MedImageOSWorld 提供了受控环境，用于研究通用 GUI 智能体能否将视觉观察转化为有效的医学采集决策，结果显示当前能力瓶颈主要位于感知到规划的转化与闭环控制环节。

title: EasyClassifier: Honest, Reproducible Machine-Learning Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program
summary: Machine-learning classification is now used across medicine, the social sciences, economics, education and engineering, very often by researchers who do not program. Two errors recur in such work: preprocessing learned on all rows before cross-validation (data leakage), and reporting the cross-validation score of the classifier that won a comparison (selection bias). Both make published scores optimistic. We present EasyClassifier, an open-source Python package that guides a user from a CSV or Excel file to a finished analysis through a sequence of plain-language, multiple-choice questions, with no code. It makes the correct procedure the default rather than an option: every preprocessing step is learned inside each training fold; the selected classifier receives a separate final score from nested cross-validation (up to 2,000 rows), or an untouched 20% test set; classifiers run with fixed default parameters and fixed random seeds; and every run writes a report with a ready-to-adapt Methods paragraph, the references to cite, and figures prepared for publication. On ten public datasets from seven fields and a random-label control, split in half so that one half served as an untouched external test, the common practice overstated balanced accuracy by 2.9 percentage points on average (up to 9.9 on small data), whereas the score EasyClassifier reports had a mean signed bias of +0.7 points and a mean absolute error of 2.3 points (one-sided Wilcoxon p = 3.2 x 10^{-4}, 30 runs). On random labels it reported 48.8% balanced accuracy against a chance level of 50%. EasyClassifier is available under the MIT license from PyPI (pip install easyclassifier), GitHub, and Zenodo.

AI.tldr: EasyClassifier是一个无需编程的开源Python工具，通过"正确流程作为默认"的设计，避免数据泄漏与选择偏差，使医学、社科等领域非编程研究者的机器学习分类结果更可靠。
AI.motivation: 机器学习分类被广泛用于医学、社会科学、经济学等领域，但许多使用者不会编程。此类工作常见两类错误：交叉验证前对全部数据做预处理（数据泄漏），以及只报告比较中获胜分类器的交叉验证分数（选择偏差），二者都会使发表分数偏乐观。
AI.method: EasyClassifier以一系列通俗的多选问答引导用户从CSV/Excel文件完成分析，全程无需代码。它将正确流程设为默认：每一步预处理都在训练折内部学习；在嵌套交叉验证（至多2000行）或未触碰的20%测试集上给出所选分类器的独立最终分数；分类器使用固定默认参数与随机种子；每次运行生成报告，含可直接改写的Methods段落、需引用的文献及可发表的图。
AI.result: 在来自七个领域的十个公开数据集及随机标签对照上，数据分半，一半作为未触碰的外部测试集：常见做法平均高估平衡准确率2.9个百分点（小数据上高达9.9）；而EasyClassifier报告的分数平均有符号偏差+0.7点、平均绝对误差2.3点（单侧Wilcoxon p = 3.2×10⁻⁴，30次运行）。在随机标签上，其报告的平衡准确率为48.8%（随机水平为50%）。
AI.conclusion: EasyClassifier通过默认执行无泄漏、无选择偏差的规范流程，为不会编程的研究者提供可靠且可复现的机器学习分类分析，分数更接近真实性能。工具以MIT许可发布于PyPI（pip install easyclassifier）、GitHub和Zenodo。

title: D-Loop: Looped Diffusion Drafting for Speculative Decoding
summary: Block diffusion accelerates speculative decoding by drafting multiple tokens in one forward pass. However, each position predicts a marginal distribution without observing earlier proposed tokens, limiting draft quality and acceptance length. We identify a concrete failure, the \emph{repetition trap}, in which neighboring positions produce redundant copies of the same token. We explain this tendency theoretically and empirically examine its association with shorter accepted drafts. Recent methods refine marginal predictions with an additional causal head or a separately trained drafter, increasing parameter storage and introducing separate training objectives. We instead propose D-Loop, which introduces \emph{intra-block causal conditioning} within the original diffusion drafter without additional model components. Inspired by semi-autoregressive generation and parameter sharing, D-Loop reuses the same backbone across looped passes. The first pass proposes a block, and the second conditions on a selected prefix to regenerate the suffix in parallel. A complementary prefix--suffix objective trains the shared drafter for both anchor-only prefix prediction and prefix-conditioned suffix prediction. Across eight math, code, and chat benchmarks, D-Loop can beat DFlash and DSpark on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with obvious gains.

AI.tldr: D-Loop通过块内因果条件化提升块扩散投机解码的草稿质量，无需额外模型组件。
AI.motivation: 块扩散可一次前向生成多个token加速投机解码，但各位置只预测边缘分布、无法观察先前提议的token，导致"重复陷阱"、草稿质量与接受长度受限；现有方法需额外因果头或独立草稿模型，增加参数与训练成本。
AI.method: 提出D-Loop，在原始扩散草稿器内引入块内因果条件化：复用同一骨干进行循环两遍生成，第一遍提议整块，第二遍以选定前缀为条件并行重生成后缀；并用前缀-后缀互补目标训练共享草稿器。
AI.result: 在八个数学、代码与对话基准上，D-Loop在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B上超越DFlash和DSpark，取得明显增益。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外模型组件即可缓解重复陷阱、提升草稿质量与接受长度，是更高效的块扩散投机解码方案。

title: Agent Behavior as Code: Efficient and Robust LLM Agents with Programmatic Specifications
summary: AI agents based on foundation models (FMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities to perform complex open-ended tasks. However, they face some common challenges in practice: (a) agent behavior can deviate drastically even for semantically similar tasks, leading to catastrophically propagated errors; (b) high cost and latency due to FM calls, repeated in full whenever a task recurs with different inputs; (c) FMs' limited context and instruction following capability confine how well agents manage the ever-growing execution context and follow complex plans. We introduce $\textbf{A}$gent $\textbf{B}$ehavior as $\textbf{C}$ode $\textbf{Agent}$ (ABCAgent), which uses a symbolic program (e.g., Python code with potential neural functions) to fully specify the agent's behavior at runtime, with a powerful FM agent editing that program for flexibility. Behavior is thus specified without premature variable binding, and its execution is deterministic. We evaluate ABCAgent on six agent benchmarks, two of which we construct to test how well a derived program generalizes to variants of the task it was written for. ABCAgent matches a model-matched neural agent on GAIA and augmented GAIA, and surpasses it where robustness and long control flows matter: 98.3% against 97.3% on GSM-Symbolic ($p = 0.001$), 71.9% against 47.4% $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ on the telecom domain of $τ^2$-bench ($p = 0.0001$), and more records written correctly at every loop length on our control-flow-augmented WorkArena benchmark. For more parametric task families, ABCAgent is also significantly superior in efficiency. Without authoring a new program, ABCAgent solves 92.6% of GSM-Symbolic instances and 20.1% of augmented GAIA variants, which yields $5.2\times$ lower latency and $7.0\times$ lower cost on GSM-Symbolic, 19% lower cost on augmented GAIA, and $9.5\times$ lower agent latency on $τ^2$-telecom.

AI.tldr: 提出ABCAgent，用符号程序（Python代码）完整指定agent运行时行为，以确定性执行替代传统神经agent的不稳定行为，在鲁棒性和效率上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于基础模型的agent存在三大问题：(a)语义相似任务行为偏差大，导致灾难性错误传播；(b)FM调用成本高延迟大，任务重现时需完整重复；(c)FM上下文和指令遵循能力有限，难以管理不断增长的执行上下文和复杂计划。
AI.method: ABCAgent用符号程序（如含潜在神经函数的Python代码）在运行时完整规定agent行为，由强大的FM agent编辑该程序以实现灵活性。行为规格无需过早变量绑定，执行是确定性的。
AI.result: 在六个agent基准上评估。GAIA与增强GAIA上与模型匹配的神经agent持平；鲁棒性和长控制流场景中超越：GSM-Symbolic 98.3% vs 97.3%（p=0.001），τ²-bench电信域71.9% vs 47.4% Pass⁴（p=0.0001），控制流增强WorkArena各循环长度下写入记录更多。参数化任务族中效率显著占优：无新程序时解决92.6% GSM-Symbolic实例与20.1%增强GAIA变体，GSM-Symbolic延迟降5.2×、成本降7.0×，增强GAIA成本降19%，τ²-电信agent延迟降9.5×。
AI.conclusion: 将agent行为编码为程序可实现确定性执行和跨任务变体复用，在鲁棒性、长控制流和效率方面显著优于神经agent，是构建可靠高效agent的有效范式。

title: Variance-Optimal Control Variates for Learning with Black-box Feedback
summary: Modern models increasingly learn through black-box oracles such as humans, optimization solvers, and external tools that provide feedback without exposing their internal mechanisms. A common remedy is to learn an (action-)value function as a control variate. In this paper, we first observe that even an exact action-value function can be arbitrarily far from variance-optimal. We show that this gap arises because the value function minimizes the noise in each action's own gradient term, while an action can still affect the rest of the gradient estimator through shared parameters. A simple unbiased correction, at no extra oracle cost, can still reduce its variance by an arbitrarily large factor. Motivated by this, we then prove that the residual variance can be decomposed exactly by actions with no cross terms. This decomposition yields a closed-form variance-minimizing correction for neural-network parameters, which can be computed by a simple projection. Empirically, our correction consistently reduces the variance left by the value function and improves learning across all tasks. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/Zihao-Kevin/black_box_opt.

AI.tldr: 本文指出即使精确的动作价值函数也远非方差最优，并提出一种无需额外oracle成本的无偏修正方法，可将残余方差按动作精确分解并得到闭式方差最小化修正。
AI.motivation: 现代模型常通过黑箱oracle（人类、优化求解器、外部工具）学习，常用动作价值函数作为控制变量来降方差，但作者发现价值函数最小化的是每个动作自身梯度项的噪声，动作仍可通过共享参数影响估计器其余部分，导致即使精确价值函数也远非方差最优。
AI.method: 提出一种简单的无偏修正，不增加oracle成本；证明残余方差可按动作精确分解、无交叉项；据此针对神经网络参数给出闭式方差最小化修正，可通过简单投影计算。
AI.result: 实验表明该修正持续降低价值函数残余的方差，并在所有任务上改善学习效果。
AI.conclusion: 动作价值函数作为控制变量并非方差最优，通过无偏的闭式投影修正可显著且普遍地降低方差、提升黑箱oracle下的学习性能。

title: Differentiable Bit-Widths: Co-optimizing Pruning and Quantization via SVD for Ultra-Efficient LLM Compression
comment: Accepted to Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: SVD-based pruning and quantization have recently emerged as a promising strategy for the ultra-efficient compression of large language models. In these methods, compression is performed in two stages: components are first truncated, and the remaining ones are subsequently quantized. Although this decoupled pipeline benefits from both pruning and quantization, it requires separate optimization for each stage and fails to fully exploit their balance, which can lead to suboptimal performance under aggressive compression. To address this limitation, we propose a new LLM compression method that co-optimizes pruning and quantization in a unified framework. Our key idea is a differentiable method for learning component-wise bit-widths, allowing less important components to be assigned 0-bit precision and pruned away. Notably, our method performs favorably against two-stage baselines, even when subjected to extreme quantization settings ($1.61$ bits) designed for ultra-efficiency. Code: https://github.com/MMAI-Laboratory/DBW.

AI.tldr: 提出DBW方法，用可微学习组件位宽统一协同优化剪枝与量化，实现LLM超高效压缩。
AI.motivation: SVD剪枝+量化两阶段解耦流程需分别优化，无法利用剪枝与量化的平衡，激进压缩下性能次优。
AI.method: 统一框架协同优化剪枝与量化；核心是可微的组件级位宽学习方法，使不重要组件获得0-bit精度从而被剪掉。
AI.result: 在两阶段基线对比中表现更优，即使在1.61-bit极端量化设置下也占优。
AI.conclusion: 统一协同优化剪枝与量化优于解耦两阶段流程，适用于超高效LLM压缩。

title: DICE: Decoupling Capability from Intervention Necessity in LLM Tutoring
summary: Fluent guidance is not the same as useful intervention. LLM tutors are typically trained to generate the next teacher utterance, implicitly assuming that every student turn warrants a response. However, our experiments indicate that this conflates tutoring capability (what to say) with intervention necessity (whether to say it). We introduce DICE, a framework that decouples intervention decisions from response generation by first selecting an explicit pedagogical action. To calibrate this action selection policy, we define Intervention Value (IV), a rollout-grounded counterfactual metric that compares each action against non-intervention. IV shows that many prescribed interventions provide little or no marginal benefit. We further introduce DICE-Bench, a multi-variant math tutoring benchmark with skill-preserving problem variants for session-level evaluation. Using IV-weighted and KL-regularized policy optimization, DICE learns to intervene selectively while preserving tutoring effectiveness. In simulated tutoring sessions, DICE reduces the over-intervention rate to near zero while guiding students to correct solutions in approximately 3-4 fewer turns on average than existing Socratic tutoring baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DICE框架，将"是否干预"与"如何回应"解耦，通过显式教学动作选择实现选择性干预，并引入干预价值(IV)指标与DICE-Bench评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM导师模型被训练生成下一个教师话语，隐含假设学生每一轮都需要回应，混淆了"教学能力(说什么)"与"干预必要性(是否该说)"。
AI.method: DICE框架先选择显式教学动作再生成回应；定义基于rollout的反事实指标干预价值(IV)，对比各动作与不干预的效果；构建带技能保持型问题变体的多版本数学辅导基准DICE-Bench；采用IV加权与KL正则的策略优化学习选择性干预。
AI.result: IV显示许多规定性干预几乎无边际收益；在模拟辅导中DICE将过度干预率降至接近零，且平均比现有苏格拉底式辅导基线少3-4轮即可引导学生得出正确答案。
AI.conclusion: 解耦干预决策与回应生成、并以反事实价值校准动作选择，可在保持辅导有效性的同时实现有选择的干预。

title: Repeated-Measure Leakage, Distribution Shift, and Reliability under Partial Observation in Patient World Models
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Selected for oral presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS) Replication Package: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/AUZVR
summary: Patient world models are increasingly proposed for longitudinal prediction, intervention-aware reasoning, and clinical-trial simulation. Causal or clinical intervention validity is distinct from predictive generalization and reliability; before making stronger claims, the underlying predictive state should generalize across patients, survive realistic shifts and missing observations, and expose failure through meaningful reliability signals. We evaluate these prerequisites in a deliberately narrow setting: short-horizon digital-biomarker forecasting from PhysioNet GaitPDB, comprising 165 participants, 306 recordings, and 51,129 context-future pairs. Using persistence, ridge, MLP, GRU, Transformer, and a compact JEPA-style predictor, we build an evaluation ladder that progressively removes raw temporal overlap, same-recording familiarity, and same-patient familiarity before testing unseen-patient generalization. For GRU, NMSE rises from 0.1227 under random-window splitting to 0.1393 after eliminating raw train-test overlap and to 0.1961 under patient holdout. Among 54 participants with repeated recordings, exposure to a different recording from the same patient improves GRU NMSE from 0.2177 to 0.1556, while a recording-excluded identity hypothesis is not supported at the participant level. Under participant-held-out evaluation, MLP and Transformer are statistically indistinguishable. Study shift, a four-times-longer prediction gap, and partial observation further degrade performance; under 50% temporal masking, Transformer NMSE rises to 0.611 while MC-dropout predictive variance falls. We do not claim a longitudinal or intervention-aware simulator. Instead, the results support a prerequisite evaluation stack of patient separation, repeated-measure controls, shift, missingness, and uncertainty validation before stronger patient-world-model claims are trusted.

AI.tldr: 本文对"患者世界模型"的预测前提进行严格评估，用PhysioNet GaitPDB数据构建递进式评估阶梯，揭示跨患者泛化、偏移、缺失观测与可靠性信号等基本问题。
AI.motivation: 患者世界模型被广泛用于纵向预测、干预推理与临床试验仿真，但因果/干预有效性不同于预测泛化与可靠性。在提出更强主张前，须先验证预测状态能否跨患者泛化、抵抗真实偏移与缺失观测，并通过可靠性信号暴露失败。
AI.method: 在窄设定下进行短时程数字生物标志物预测（GaitPDB：165人、306段记录、51129个上下文-未来对）。使用persistence、ridge、MLP、GRU、Transformer及紧凑JEPA式预测器，构建评估阶梯，依次去除原始时间重叠、同记录熟悉度、同患者熟悉度，最后测试未见患者泛化；并考察研究偏移、更长预测间隔、缺失观测与不确定性验证。
AI.result: GRU的NMSE从随机窗口划分的0.1227升至去除重叠后的0.1393，再到患者留出下的0.1961。54名有重复记录的参与者中，接触同患者另一记录将NMSE从0.2177改善到0.1556，但参与者层面不支持"排除记录的身份假设"。患者留出下MLP与Transformer统计上无差异。研究偏移、4倍长预测间隔、部分观测进一步损害性能；50%时间掩码下Transformer NMSE升至0.611，而MC-dropout预测方差反而下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者不主张纵向或干预感知仿真器，而是提出一个先决评估栈：患者分离、重复测量控制、偏移、缺失与不确定性验证，应在信任更强的患者世界模型主张之前完成。

title: LightMTP: Lightweight Latent Multi-Token Prediction
summary: Next-token prediction (NTP) is the standard pretraining objective for large language models, yet it provides an explicit training signal only for the immediate next token, which can lead models to exploit local patterns instead of capturing longer-range structure and ideas. Multi-token prediction (MTP) addresses this by training models to predict several future tokens. However, existing MTP methods often introduce a large number of new parameters with limited improvements in downstream performance. Latent MTP approaches address this efficiency issue by encoding future tokens into a vector representation. However, these approaches usually rely on external helper models for future token encoding. We propose LightMTP, a lightweight, i.e., parameter-efficient, latent MTP approach that bootstraps the future token representations from the model's own hidden states. Our two LightMTP variants extend supervision to more future tokens without requiring the additional computational overhead of conventional MTP nor the external supervision latent MTP normally relies on. LightMTP adds at most 1% extra parameters, retains better performance on general language modeling benchmarks, and achieves similar gains in planning, coding, and reasoning.

AI.tldr: LightMTP是一种轻量级潜在多token预测方法，利用模型自身隐藏状态生成未来token表示，最多仅增加1%参数即可提升语言建模与下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 标准下一token预测（NTP）只提供即时下一token的显式监督信号，容易让模型利用局部模式而非捕捉长程结构；现有多token预测（MTP）引入大量新参数但下游收益有限，潜在MTP又依赖外部辅助模型编码未来token。
AI.method: 提出LightMTP，通过引导模型自身隐藏状态来生成未来token表示，避免传统MTP的额外计算开销与潜在MTP的外部监督依赖；提供两种变体来扩展对未来token的监督。
AI.result: 最多仅增加1%参数，在通用语言建模基准上保持更好性能，并在规划、编程和推理任务上取得类似增益。
AI.conclusion: LightMTP以参数高效的方式实现多token监督，无需外部辅助模型或大量新增参数，兼具性能与效率优势。

title: MemTrace: State-Consistent Memory for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
summary: As coding agents take on long-horizon software evolution tasks spanning multiple files and stages, longer execution trajectories introduce two coupled challenges: (1) accumulated histories strain context budgets, and (2) repository changes can invalidate earlier execution evidence. Existing approaches address these challenges through techniques like larger context windows, compression, retrieval, or repository representations, but often fail to reconstruct a consistent task state after a context refresh or verify whether recalled evidence remains valid. Thus, we introduce MemTrace, a provenance-aware memory system that preserves execution history and aligns its reuse with the evolving task (e.g., iterative cross-file repair) and repository state. MemTrace stores history as immutable Memory Traces anchored to key information (e.g., files, symbols, tests), and organizes their execution order and dependencies in a Memory Trace Graph. When context is constrained, working memory retains only compact Memory Anchors, from which the agent can reconstruct the latest execution state and locate evidence relevant to its next action. Before restoring historical evidence, MemTrace checks its validity against the current repository state and retrieves only what the next action requires. Across three complementary long-horizon coding benchmarks, MemTrace consistently outperforms all fully evaluated baselines under the same backbone and harness, improving DeepSWE pass@1 by 21.2 points, SWE-EVO Resolved Rate by 4.4 points, and SWE-Milestone Score by 17.8 points under Codex CLI.

AI.tldr: MemTrace是一种溯源感知记忆系统，将执行历史编码为锚定在文件、符号、测试等关键信息的不可变Memory Traces，用图组织其顺序与依赖，在上下文受限时仅保留紧凑Memory Anchors，并在恢复历史证据前校验其与当前仓库状态的有效性，从而在长周期编程任务中显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 长周期软件演化任务带来两个耦合挑战：（1）累积历史挤占上下文预算；（2）仓库变更会使早期执行证据失效。现有方法（扩大上下文窗口、压缩、检索、仓库表示等）往往无法在上下文刷新后重建一致的任务状态，也无法验证召回证据是否仍然有效。
AI.method: MemTrace将历史存储为锚定关键信息（文件、符号、测试）的不可变Memory Traces，并用Memory Trace Graph组织其执行顺序与依赖。上下文受限时，工作记忆仅保留紧凑的Memory Anchors，智能体据此重建最新执行状态并定位下一步所需证据；在恢复历史证据前，先对照当前仓库状态校验其有效性，只检索下一步动作所需内容。
AI.result: 在三个互补的长周期编程基准上，相同骨干与工具链下MemTrace一致优于所有完全评测的基线：Codex CLI下DeepSWE pass@1提升21.2分，SWE-EVO解决率提升4.4分，SWE-Milestone得分提升17.8分。
AI.conclusion: 溯源感知的记忆机制能有效缓解长周期编程智能体的上下文压力与证据失效问题，通过紧凑锚点重建状态并校验证据有效性，可持续提升跨文件、多阶段软件演化任务的性能。

title: DASH: Fast, Valid Counterfactuals for Deep Networks via Batched Directional Search
summary: Counterfactual explanations are most useful when they can be generated with low latency, remain close to the factual input, and satisfy input-domain, categorical, and actionability constraints. Achieving these objectives simultaneously is challenging for deep neural networks. Heuristic methods are often fast but may return invalid counterfactuals, whereas exact methods can certify global proximity but may not finish within practical time limits. We introduce DASH, a batched heuristic search method for finding close, valid, and actionable counterfactuals for deep neural networks under $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$, and $\ell_\infty$ objectives. DASH uses directional Lipschitz bounds and local affine models to generate anchors, then ranks and expands promising regions with batched network evaluations. We compare DASH against nine prior heuristic methods and time-limited exact mixed-integer baselines on four tabular datasets, with network depths from 2 to 32, and evaluate scalability on PBMC3k. Across 9,000 tabular query-norm cases, DASH returns a valid counterfactual within $5\%$ of the best heuristic-observed valid distance in $94.6\%$ of cases, with a median CPU search runtime of $0.061$ s. PGD-bisect, the baseline with the highest pooled within-$5\%$ coverage, meets this criterion in $41.1\%$ of cases, with a median runtime of $0.298$ s. These results show that the proposed search maintains high valid proximity across norms while keeping its search runtime practical.

AI.tldr: DASH：一种批量启发式搜索方法，可快速生成接近、有效且可操作的反事实解释，在多种范数约束下优于九种启发式方法和限时精确基线。
AI.motivation: 反事实解释需同时满足低延迟、接近原始输入以及输入域、类别和可操作性约束，但深度神经网络中这些目标难以兼得：启发式方法快却常返回无效反事实，精确方法能保证全局接近性却耗时过长。
AI.method: DASH 采用批量启发式搜索，在 l1、l2、l∞ 目标下利用方向 Lipschitz 界和局部仿射模型生成锚点，再通过批量网络评估对候选区域进行排序与扩展。
AI.result: 在四个表格数据集（网络深度 2 至 32）和 PBMC3k 上与九种启发式方法及限时精确混合整数基线对比。9,000 个查询-范数案例中，DASH 在 94.6% 的情况下返回有效且在最佳启发式观测距离 5% 以内的反事实，中位 CPU 搜索时间 0.061 秒；表现最好的基线 PGD-bisect 仅 41.1%，中位耗时 0.298 秒。
AI.conclusion: DASH 在保持实用搜索运行时间的同时，能在多种范数下维持高有效接近性，兼顾速度与反事实质量。

title: TrustMI: Causally controlling how assistants trust their users
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) assistants routinely decide whether they can trust users and third parties whose competence, intentions, and integrity they cannot verify. This uncertainty matters for safety, as trusting the wrong party can lead an agent to comply with harmful requests or act on malicious instructions encountered during tool use. To study this problem, we define trust as an assistant's willingness to accept vulnerability to the actions of another party and ask whether such behavior can be causally controlled through model activations. We build 2,000 contrastive conversations spanning ability, benevolence, and integrity, where paired responses complete the same request but differ in whether the assistant trusts the user. From these pairs, we learn steering matrices while keeping the model parameters frozen and test them across six instruction-tuned models from three families, finding that steering changes trust decisions monotonically in both directions. We then ask whether this effect extends to several safety-related agent settings involving harmful requests, prompt injections, and insider threats, while using benign-task and reasoning as controls. Our findings provide evidence that trust in the user can be causally controlled along linear directions in model activations and provide a way to study how trust shapes safety-relevant behavior in language models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM助手对用户/第三方的"信任"能否通过激活值因果控制，发现信任决策可沿线性方向被单调调控，并影响安全相关行为。
AI.motivation: LLM助手常需决定是否信任无法验证的能力、意图和诚信的用户或第三方，错误信任可能导致顺从有害请求或执行恶意指令，因此需研究信任机制及其对安全的影响。
AI.method: 构建2,000组对比对话，覆盖能力(ability)、善意(benevolence)、诚信(integrity)三个维度，成对回复完成相同请求但在是否信任用户上不同；基于配对数据学习steering矩阵，冻结模型参数，在3个家族6个指令微调模型上测试；并将效应扩展到有害请求、提示注入、内部威胁等安全场景，以良性任务和推理作为对照。
AI.result: Steering可双向单调改变信任决策，效应在多个模型家族中一致，并能推广到多种安全相关的agent场景。
AI.conclusion: 用户信任可在模型激活中沿线性方向被因果控制，为研究信任如何塑造语言模型的安全相关行为提供了方法。

title: GitSwarm: Decentralized Compounding Inference
summary: Long-horizon problem solving and scientific research require computation to accumulate across successive attempts. Partial solutions, experimental findings, and unsuccessful approaches can inform later work, yet most inference-time computation is organized around individual trajectories or candidates rather than a persistent body of reusable work. We call this paradigm compounding inference: organizing inference-time computation so that intermediate work persists and can be inspected, extended, combined, or challenged by subsequent computation. We instantiate compounding inference in GitSwarm, an asynchronous system where homogeneous agents independently decide how to advance a task while collaborating through structured persistent memory. Agents explore, experiment, verify, refine, and synthesize previous work in a shared, branch-able Git repository. Atomic commits preserve intermediate artifacts, while explicit semantic dependencies record how later contributions build on work across branches. We evaluate GitSwarm on long-horizon problem solving and sustained GPU-backed experimental research. On IMOProofBench-Advanced, GitSwarm solves all 30 problems in one run using GPT-5.5. On ProgramBench, it achieves a $79.4\%$ mean score, versus $65.1\%$ for the strongest reported baseline under the stated budget. On three neural architecture research tasks (Residual Matrix Transformer, Looped Transformer, NanoChat), GitSwarm improves upon the starting architectures through successive experimentation. Beyond final performance, we measure whether computation accumulates: on ProgramBench, $94.7\%$ of contributions are subsequently built upon, while the selected solution's ancestry covers $82-93\%$ of the contribution graph. These results show that inference-time computation can accumulate across otherwise independent episodes, forming an evolving body of work that subsequent inference can reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"复合推理"(compounding inference)范式,并实现GitSwarm系统,让同质智能体通过共享可分支Git仓库协作,使推理时的中间成果持久化、可复用,从而在长程问题求解和科研任务上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 长程问题求解与科研需要计算在多次尝试间累积,但现有推理时计算多围绕单条轨迹或单个候选组织,忽略了部分解、实验结果和失败尝试的可复用价值。
AI.method: 提出compounding inference范式,将推理时计算组织为持久可复用成果。实例化为GitSwarm:异步系统,同质智能体独立决策并通过结构化持久记忆协作,在共享可分支Git仓库中探索、实验、验证、精炼与综合;原子提交保存中间产物,显式语义依赖记录跨分支的构建关系。
AI.result: IMOProofBench-Advanced上30题一次全解(GPT-5.5);ProgramBench平均得分79.4%,超过最强基线65.1%;三个神经架构任务(残差矩阵Transformer、Looped Transformer、NanoChat)均改进起始架构。累积性指标:ProgramBench中94.7%贡献被后续采用,最优解祖先覆盖贡献图82-93%。
AI.conclusion: 推理时计算可跨独立episode累积,形成可被后续推理复用的演化成果体系。

title: KALEIDO: Input-Space Adaptation of a Vision Model for Time-Series Forecasting Through Gated Fold Geometries
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS)
summary: Time-series foundation models buy zero-shot forecasting with large temporal corpora; a vision model needs none, since a natural image implicitly embeds the patterns a forecaster must model, and an ImageNet-pretrained masked autoencoder forecasts a series by inpainting a rendering of it. A rendered series is not a natural image, however, and closing that gap takes temporal-aware adaptation. We show that the rendering geometry - how the series is folded and drawn - is a controllable, mixable axis for it. Kaleido detects the dominant periods, renders a rule-generated set of fold geometries, combines the inpaintings with a convex per-position gate fit on validation only, and fuses the result with the zero-shot output at one fixed share, with no per-dataset hyperparameter beyond the baseline's published settings. Training only LayerNorm (0.05%), Kaleido lowers MSE by 13% against the published zero-shot baseline on LTSF and, frozen, by 6.6%; on GIFT-Eval it improves the baseline by 7.4% in MASE and 19.3% in CRPS.

AI.tldr: Kaleido通过可控、可混合的折叠几何，将序列渲染成图像以适配ImageNet预训练的掩码自编码器，仅训练0.05%参数即显著提升零样本预测性能。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型依赖大规模时序语料实现零样本预测，而视觉模型无需时序预训练，因为自然图像隐含了预测所需模式。但渲染后的序列并非自然图像，二者存在差距，需要时序感知的自适应方法来弥补。
AI.method: Kaleido检测主导周期，生成一组规则化的折叠几何来渲染序列，对多种渲染进行掩码自编码器修复（inpainting），用仅基于验证集的凸位置门控组合结果，并以固定比例与零样本输出融合，除基线已发布设置外无逐数据集超参数。仅训练LayerNorm（0.05%）。
AI.result: 在LTSF上相比已发布零样本基线降低MSE 13%，冻结模型时降低6.6%；在GIFT-Eval上MASE提升7.4%，CRPS提升19.3%。
AI.conclusion: 渲染几何是弥补时序渲染与自然图像差距的有效可控轴，Kaleido以极少训练参数和固定超参数实现了稳健的零样本预测提升。

title: Cross-Lingual Transferability of Training Data Extraction Attacks to Recover Memorized PII
summary:
The robustness of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection in Large Language Models (LLMs) is a critical concern, yet the risks associated with cross-lingual data extraction remain under-explored. This study evaluates the vulnerability of English-centric and multilingual models to Training Data Extraction (TDE) attacks when prompted in non-English languages.
  We construct a multi-domain PII dataset comprising social media handles, email addresses, and phone numbers and translate the attack contexts into Italian, Spanish, French, and German. Our results show that TDE attacks against both English-centric and multilingual models transfer to different languages: the attacks are successful on translated prompts, even though only the original English prompt might have been included in the pre-training data. A web-presence check on a sample of the translations confirms that they are not available online. The share of English leaks recovered in other languages grows with the multilingual capability of the model, and it drops sharply when the original wording is lost, even without a change of language.
  This suggests that native multilingual pre-training facilitates the emergence of latent cross-linguistic bridges that simplify the retrieval of personally identifiable information (PII). We analyze the activations of multilingual large language models (LLMs) and find that different translations of the same prompt are bridged in similar representations, with the strongest alignment in the middle layers.
  Our results highlight a fundamental security gap in modern LLMs, necessitating more robust, language-agnostic sanitization strategies for future model alignment.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示大语言模型存在跨语言训练数据提取（TDE）风险：即便原始英文提示才被用于预训练，翻译成意、西、法、德等语言的攻击提示仍可成功提取PII，且该风险随模型多语言能力增强而上升。
AI.motivation: PII保护在大语言模型中至关重要，但跨语言数据提取的风险尚缺乏研究。作者希望探究英语中心模型和多语言模型在面对非英语提示时的TDE攻击脆弱性。
AI.method: 构建涵盖社交媒体账号、邮箱、电话的多领域PII数据集，将攻击情境翻译为意大利语、西班牙语、法语和德语，对英语中心及多语言模型发起TDE攻击；对样本翻译进行网络存在性检查以排除线上可得；并分析多语言模型激活表示，考察同一提示不同翻译的跨语言对齐情况。
AI.result: TDE攻击可跨语言迁移成功，即使仅英文提示可能出现在预训练数据中；网络检查证实翻译文本未在线可得。模型多语言能力越强，其他语言中恢复出的英文泄露占比越高；一旦原始措辞丢失（即便语言未变），泄露率急剧下降。激活分析显示同一提示的不同翻译在表示空间中相互桥接，中层对齐最强。
AI.conclusion: 原生多语言预训练促成了潜在跨语言桥梁，简化了PII检索，暴露出LLM的根本性安全缺口，未来模型对齐亟需更稳健、语言无关的数据净化策略。

title: From Memory to Guide: Spatio-Temporal Composer for Procedural Coding Memory
summary: Memory-augmented agents typically integrate procedural knowledge by injecting retrieved skills directly into text prompts. This approach dangerously equates readable text with reliable execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce From Memory to Guide, a novel paradigm that transitions procedural memory from passive text delivery to active, inference-time policy adaptation. We instantiate this paradigm through the Spatio-Temporal Composer, an active policy compiler that explicitly manages exactly how and when retrieved knowledge should be applied. Rather than treating skills as plug-and-play modules, Composer dynamically aligns historical knowledge with current environmental constraints (spatial adaptation) and precisely dictates its applicable lifecycle (temporal orchestration). It actively transforms static memories into strictly bounded Runtime Guides---equipping the agent with localized objectives and behavioral guardrails without requiring a single parameter update. Extensive evaluations on 13 demanding, long-horizon software engineering tasks in EngramBench demonstrate the clear advantages of this architecture. Composer not only robustly prevents context mismatch but drives an absolute pass-rate increase of 7.2 percentage points on the most complex tasks, while simultaneously slashing the main agent's token usage by 32.2%.

AI.tldr: 提出从记忆到引导的新范式，将过程性记忆从被动文本注入转变为推理时的主动策略适配，通过时空组合器实现空间对齐与时间编排。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强代理直接将检索到的技能注入文本提示，错误地将可读文本等同于可可靠执行，导致上下文不匹配问题。
AI.method: 提出"从记忆到引导"范式，实例化为时空组合器（Spatio-Temporal Composer），一个主动策略编译器。它将历史知识与当前环境约束动态对齐（空间适配），并精确控制其适用生命周期（时间编排），将静态记忆转化为严格限定的运行时指南，无需参数更新。
AI.result: 在EngramBench的13个长时程软件工程任务上，组合器稳健防止上下文不匹配，在最复杂任务上绝对通过率提升7.2个百分点，同时主代理token使用减少32.2%。
AI.conclusion: 主动策略适配优于被动文本注入，能有效提升复杂任务表现并降低token消耗，为记忆增强代理提供新方向。

title: TIMBRE: Teaching Time Series Forecasters to Read, Remember, and Reconcile
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/stephen-guan-researcher/TIMBRE ; Checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/XinyuGuan/TIMBRE
summary: Event-informed forecasting requires translating reports and historical responses into changes to a numerical forecast. We propose TIMBRE (Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence), which combines source-aware representation, state-conditioned response transfer, and reliability-guided fusion before a frozen forecast head. A separate readout adjusts interval widths while preserving the median. In a single-seed, one-epoch development study of 13 tasks, TIMBRE improves MAE over ordinary fusion on eight tasks but over native Chronos-2 on only two. Disabling response transfer in the trained model reduces BTC and AULF MAE by 47.04% and 6.81%, respectively. These findings identify sensitivity to learned response transfer rather than a general forecasting advantage. Missing development-set scores and the absence of retrained ablations limit attribution to individual evidence mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出TIMBRE框架，将报告与历史响应整合到数值预测中，但在单种子开发研究中仅在2/13任务上优于原生Chronos-2，主要发现是对响应迁移的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 事件信息预测需要将文本报告与历史响应转化为数值预测的调整，现有方法缺乏整合证据机制的系统性研究。
AI.method: TIMBRE组合了源感知表示、状态条件响应迁移、可靠性引导融合，并在冻结的预测头前进行整合；另有独立读出层调整区间宽度但保留中位数。
AI.result: 在13个任务的单种子单轮开发研究中，TIMBRE在8个任务上MAE优于普通融合，但仅2个任务优于原生Chronos-2；禁用响应迁移后BTC和AULF的MAE分别下降47.04%和6.81%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明模型对学习到的响应迁移敏感，而非具有普遍预测优势；开发集分数缺失及未重训消融限制了各证据机制的归因。

title: From Traces to Agentic Worlds: Agentic Language World Models for Interactive Environment Simulation
summary: Realistic environment replicas are increasingly valuable for training and evaluating LLM agents, yet the original systems may be inaccessible or impractical to reproduce. We explore agentic language world modeling: rather than rebuilding an executable environment, a world model agent serves as the environment for a task agent and supports faithful and stateful simulation. We instantiate this paradigm with Trace2Env, a learning-free framework for settings where the original system is unavailable but historical interaction traces remain accessible. Trace2Env reconstructs these traces into a reusable environment worldbook containing environment schemas, grounded evidence, and induced behavioral knowledge. At runtime, the world model agent actively consults the worldbook together with persistent episodic state to infer each action's observation and lasting state effects. Across nine environments, Trace2Env improves both next-observation fidelity and long-horizon interaction consistency over conventional prompt-based LWMs. In multi-turn interaction, task agent actions generated against Trace2Env remain valid more often when replayed in the real environment, indicating that its simulated dynamics better preserve the consequences of earlier actions across successive turns. These results establish agentic language world modeling as an alternative direction for building realistic environment replicas without reconstructing the original executable system.

AI.tldr: 提出"agentic language world modeling"范式，用世界模型智能体充当环境。Trace2Env无需学习，从历史交互轨迹重建可复用worldbook，支持忠实且有状态的模拟。
AI.motivation: 真实环境副本对训练评估LLM智能体很有价值，但原系统常无法访问或难以复现。
AI.method: Trace2Env将历史轨迹重建为worldbook（含环境模式、证据、行为知识）；运行时世界模型智能体结合worldbook与持续情景状态推断动作的观测及状态影响。
AI.result: 在9个环境中，Trace2Env的下一观测保真度和长时程一致性优于传统基于提示的LWM；多轮交互中，动作在真实环境重放时有效比例更高。
AI.conclusion: 该范式为无需重建原系统的真实环境副本提供新方向。

title: SpecFold: Folding Multi-Branch Redundancy for Faster Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative block denoising, and multi-branch speculative decoding accelerates this process by verifying a main branch together with multiple draft branches in a single forward pass. While prior DLLM acceleration methods primarily exploit temporal redundancy across denoising steps, we identify a complementary redundancy axis within each speculative verification step: multi-branch computational redundancy. During speculative verification, draft branches inherit most tokens from their parents while unmasking a small set of additional positions, causing large portions of hidden states to remain highly similar across branches. We propose SpecFold, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this multi-branch redundancy to reduce the cost of multi-branch speculative verification. Algorithmically, SpecFold performs token-level residual gating and selectively reuses parent computation through folded attention and FFN while preserving residual hidden states. Systemically, a Triton kernel implementation translates this fine-grained reuse into end-to-end throughput gains through efficient sparse multi-branch execution. SpecFold is orthogonal to temporal caching and compatible with existing DLLM speculation strategies. Across two DLLM families, five models, and five standard benchmarks, SpecFold achieves up to 1.64x throughput over Spiffy and up to 1.99x over vanilla decoding, while maintaining comparable task performance.

AI.tldr: SpecFold利用多分支推测验证中的计算冗余，通过token级残差门控与折叠注意力/FFN复用父分支计算，配合Triton稀疏内核，实现DLLM加速最高1.64x（对比Spiffy）和1.99x（对比原版解码）。
AI.motivation: DLLM通过迭代块去噪生成文本，多分支推测解码可单次前向验证多个分支来加速。已有方法主要利用去噪步骤间的时间冗余，但作者发现验证步骤内还存在被忽视的冗余：多分支计算冗余——草稿分支继承了父分支大部分token，仅解掩少量位置，导致各分支隐藏状态高度相似。
AI.method: 提出SpecFold算法-系统协同设计。算法层面：token级残差门控，通过折叠式注意力与FFN选择性复用父分支计算，同时保留残差隐藏状态；系统层面：Triton内核实现，将细粒度复用转化为端到端吞吐提升，通过高效稀疏多分支执行实现。该方法与时间缓存正交，且兼容现有DLLM推测策略。
AI.result: 跨两个DLLM系列、五个模型、五个标准基准测试，SpecFold相对Spiffy最高达1.64x吞吐提升，相对原版解码最高1.99x，同时保持可比的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: SpecFold通过挖掘多分支推测验证中的计算冗余，实现算法与系统协同优化，为扩散大语言模型提供正交且通用的加速方案，兼顾吞吐与性能。

title: Multi-Agent Spectrum Sharing
summary: This project explores how multiple cognitive radars can learn to share limited wireless spectrum with other radio users without interfering with one another. Using machine learning (ML), each device independently decides where and how widely to transmit within a fixed 100 MHz band. The system analyzes real or simulated signal activity to detect which parts of the spectrum are currently in use and which are open. Based on this information, the devices adapt their transmission choices to avoid crowded frequencies while making efficient use of available space. The goal is to develop a flexible, scalable approach to spectrum sharing that could support future wireless communication systems. Experimental results using both over-the-air software-defined radio (SDR) recordings and simulated environments demonstrate that the proposed meta-learning approach consistently balances competing objectives better than conventional reinforcement learning (RL) methods in multi-agent spectrum-sharing scenarios. Across five multi-agent benchmark environments, our proposed method achieved the highest average reward among the primary baseline algorithms while simultaneously maintaining low collision rates and stable transmission behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究让多台认知雷达通过元学习（meta-learning）在固定100MHz频段内自主选择发射位置与带宽，避免相互干扰并与其他无线电用户共享频谱。在五种多智能体基准环境及SDR实测/仿真数据上，该方法在平均奖励、碰撞率和传输稳定性方面均优于传统强化学习方法。
AI.motivation: 无线频谱资源有限，多台认知雷达与其他无线电用户共享同一频段时容易产生干扰。需要一个灵活、可扩展的频谱共享方案，让每个设备能独立、智能地决定发射位置与带宽，在避开拥挤频段的同时高效利用空闲频谱，以支撑未来无线通信系统。
AI.method: 采用机器学习方法，尤其提出基于元学习（meta-learning）的方案。每台设备独立分析真实或仿真信号活动，检测频段占用情况，据此自适应选择发射频率与带宽。系统在固定100MHz频带内运行，并通过软件定义无线电（SDR）实测录音和仿真环境进行验证。
AI.result: 在五个多智能体基准环境中，所提元学习方法取得了高于主要基线算法的平均奖励，同时保持较低的碰撞率和稳定的传输行为；在SDR实测与仿真环境中，其平衡多重竞争目标的能力持续优于传统强化学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 元学习方法能够在多智能体频谱共享场景中更好地平衡奖励、碰撞与传输稳定性等竞争目标，优于传统强化学习，展现出作为未来无线通信系统灵活、可扩展频谱共享方案的潜力。

title: Introducing Code-Switched Contexts to Cognitively-Inspired Bilingual Model Training
summary: During language acquisition, bilingual children are regularly exposed to code-switched input and use it as a cognitive scaffold to accelerate vocabulary growth and cross-linguistic syntactic mapping. In contrast, computational bilingual models are conventionally pretrained on interleaved monolingual corpora. While introducing synthetic code-switching during pretraining has become a promising strategy to enhance cross-lingual alignment and downstream performance, the structural and developmental parameters governing the success remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the efficiency of training with synthetic code-switched data across two typologically distinct language pairs by controlling two key variables: the structural location of code-switches and the dynamic switching rate across training stages. Our results show that training with code-switched data improves cross-lingual alignment for typologically close languages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在双语模型预训练中使用合成语码转换数据的效果，通过控制语码转换的结构位置和动态切换率两个关键变量，在两种类型学差异不同的语言对上进行分析，发现语码转换训练对类型学相近的语言对能提升跨语言对齐。
AI.motivation: 儿童在语言习得中会接触语码转换输入并借此加速词汇增长和跨语言句法映射，而计算双语模型通常仅用交错单语语料预训练。虽然引入合成语码转换已成为增强跨语言对齐的潜在策略，但其成功背后的结构和发育参数仍缺乏理解。
AI.method: 控制两个关键变量：语码转换在结构上的位置分布，以及训练各阶段动态变化的切换率；在两种类型学差异不同的语言对上比较合成语码转换数据的训练效率。
AI.result: 使用语码转换数据训练能改善类型学相近语言对的跨语言对齐。
AI.conclusion: 合成语码转换的有效性受结构位置和切换率等参数调控，且其收益对语言类型学距离敏感，类型学相近的语言对受益更明显。

title: ForkPilot: Self-Evolving Policy for Retrospective Search in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Interactive language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through long-horizon, multi-call reasoning, where errors in beliefs or actions can compound across tool interactions. Retrospective search can recover from such failures but is prone to misallocation. Delayed outcomes obscure the contribution of intermediate search decisions, leading to Attribution Complexity, while evolving execution evidence leads to Adaptation Complexity, where previously learned estimates become stale. To address these challenges, we first introduce Search Value Dynamics (SVD), which characterizes the evolving trade-off between the gain and cost of retrospective search. Building on SVD, we propose ForkPilot, a self-evolving two-stage policy-learning framework. In the first stage, ForkPilot learns a search-value policy offline from completed trajectories through automatically constructed outcome comparisons. In the second stage, it makes search decisions based on current observations and then self-evolves by incorporating newly completed trajectories into subsequent policy updates. We evaluate ForkPilot across 6 diverse benchmarks and 7 widely used LLM backbone families, including four open-source families, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Opus 4.8 in a production agentic system, against 9 competitive baselines, including a real-world harness deployment used by hundreds of thousands of paid users. ForkPilot achieves comparable state-of-the-art performance while reducing token usage by up to 59.2%, demonstrating its efficacy.

AI.tldr: 提出ForkPilot自演化两阶段策略学习框架，基于搜索价值动态SVD解决回溯搜索中的归因复杂性与适应复杂性，在6个基准和7个LLM上达到SOTA性能并减少最多59.2%的token消耗。
AI.motivation: 长程多轮工具调用中错误会不断累积，回溯搜索虽可纠错但易出现分配错误：延迟结果使中间搜索决策贡献难以归因（归因复杂性），执行证据不断演变使已学估计失效（适应复杂性）。
AI.method: 先提出搜索价值动态（SVD），刻画回溯搜索收益与成本随时间的权衡；再基于SVD构建ForkPilot两阶段策略学习框架：第一阶段从已完成轨迹中通过自动构造的结果对比离线学习搜索价值策略，第二阶段基于当前观测做搜索决策，并将新完成轨迹纳入后续策略更新实现自演化。
AI.result: 在6个多样基准、7个主流LLM家族（含4个开源家族、GPT-5.6 Sol、Opus 4.8）及生产级智能体系统中，与9个竞争基线（含服务数十万付费用户的真实部署框架）对比，ForkPilot达到可比的SOTA性能，同时token用量最多减少59.2%。
AI.conclusion: ForkPilot通过SVD指导的两阶段自演化策略学习，有效缓解回溯搜索中的归因与适应复杂性，在保持SOTA性能的同时显著降低token开销，证明了其有效性。

title: Separating Decision Time from Decision Quality in the Real-Time Gap of Distilled Deciders: Evidence from a Game and a Conveyor Simulator
comment: 80 pages including supplementary material. Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems
summary: Real-time agents are often evaluated with the world paused, or with decision time rounded to whole ticks (tick conversion). Tick conversion predicts almost no loss for a learned decider whose hit accuracy falls by 14.8 percentage points (pp) on the same games in asynchronous play. We instead split the decider's gap to a zero-latency teacher into time and quality components. In ViZDoom, we train a small decider by imitating a scripted teacher, run the game on wall-clock time, and add a control in which the teacher waits for a call to the decider's server before deciding. On a Windows host, three preregistered studies put the time component at 6.5-8.7 pp and the quality component at 6.3-8.6 pp. On a Linux host that skips 0.08-0.09% of ticks, the time component disappeared (-0.1 pp; paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.4, 0.0]) while the quality component remained (5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]). Retraining on teacher-labelled states from the decider's own play (DAgger) improved it on new games on both hosts (2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9] and 3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]), a preregistered partial success. Imposing one delay schedule on every arm in live play left a quality component of 5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5] on 100 new games, and retraining cut the decider's disagreement with the teacher on its own states from 22.7% to 14.9%. In a conveyor simulator with a 400 ms deadline, delay past it erased the quality component. A latency-matched control whose delays match the decider's shows which remedy to try.

AI.tldr: 本文研究实时智能体中"决策延迟"造成的性能损失，将其拆分为时间成分与质量成分，并在ViZDoom和传送带模拟器上验证。
AI.motivation: 实时智能体常在暂停世界或整tick转换下评估，tick转换会低估异步播放中的损失（命中率实际下降14.8pp），需厘清延迟损失的真实来源。
AI.method: 在ViZDoom中用小decider模仿脚本教师，按真实时钟运行游戏，加入教师等待decider的对照；用零延迟教师拆分时间与质量成分；在Windows和Linux主机重复三组预注册实验；用DAgger重训练；在传送带模拟器（400ms截止）验证。
AI.result: Windows上时间成分6.5-8.7pp、质量成分6.3-8.6pp；Linux上时间成分消失(-0.1pp)，质量成分仍在(5.6pp)；DAgger提升2.6pp和3.1pp；新100局质量成分5.8pp；重训练使分歧从22.7%降至14.9%；传送带超时后质量成分消失。
AI.conclusion: 延迟损失可由时间与质量成分区分；延迟匹配对照可指示应采用的补救措施，DAgger重训练部分有效。

title: Cross-lingual Calibration of Pre-Generation Success Probes for Multilingual LLM Routing
summary: Pre-generation success probes estimate response correctness from a language model's hidden activations before decoding, enabling cost-aware routing. While prior work has demonstrated their utility primarily on English inputs, we study their reliability across languages along three dimensions: (1) whether they preserve the ranking of likely successes and failures (DISCRIMINATION); (2) whether they retain probabilities that match observed success frequencies (CALIBRATION); and (3) whether they produce scores comparable enough across candidate models for cost-aware multilingual routing (UTILITY). Using 3,000 MATH problems in 10 languages and 8 open-weight model configurations, we compare cross-lingual transfer from English-trained probes and equal-budget pooled multilingual probes. English-trained probes retain useful cross-lingual discrimination but become less well calibrated after transfer. Pooled multilingual supervision improves both properties and yields more reliable estimates of success. In routing experiments, the pooled router achieves a 0.7% higher test success rate while reducing modeled cost by 13.0% relative to always selecting the model with the highest average success. These results show that multilingual routing requires success estimates that remain well calibrated and comparable across languages and models.

AI.tldr: 研究预生成成功探针（pre-generation success probes）在多语言环境下的可靠性，从区分度、校准性和效用三个维度评估，发现池化多语言训练优于英语迁移。
AI.motivation: 预生成成功探针可在解码前估计模型回答正确性，用于成本感知路由，但此前主要在英语输入上验证，其跨语言可靠性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用10种语言的3,000道MATH题和8个开源权重模型配置，从三个维度（区分度、校准性、效用）比较两种方案：英语训练的探针跨语言迁移 vs 等预算的池化多语言探针。
AI.result: 英语训练探针在跨语言迁移后保留有用区分度但校准变差；池化多语言监督在区分度和校准两性上均更优。路由实验中，池化路由器测试成功率提高0.7%，建模成本相对"总是选平均成功率最高的模型"降低13.0%。
AI.conclusion: 多语言路由需要跨语言和跨模型都保持良好校准与可比性的成功估计，池化多语言训练是实现这一目标的有效途径。

title: Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents
summary: Recursive language-model agents decompose tasks and delegate subtasks to child instances of the same policy, forming a tree of work. Training them, however, is hard: the final outcome is verifiable, but the self-invented intermediate subtasks are numerous and carry no ground truth. Existing methods score each node with a verifier or judge, which is costly at scale and blind to decomposition quality. We argue that a recursive agent must learn three coupled capabilities within one set of weights: decomposing problems into subtasks, solving them, and evaluating the outcomes, each requiring its own training signal. SERA (Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents) turns evaluation into a learned capability of the policy itself. Before delegating, the parent writes a rubric of weighted success criteria for each child subtask; a ranking objective against verified outcomes then trains rubric generation so that the criteria track genuine subtask success. In addition, a complementary leaf-coverage signal provides direct credit for task decomposition. Our central finding is that \emph{training} the policy to generate aligned rubrics is what drives the gains: because the same weights both evaluate and execute, learning to judge subtasks sharpens the agent's ability to solve them. Notably, external supervision is also reduced: the judge is consulted only to train the rubric generator, while solving is trained against the agent's own rubric scores, which outperform direct use of the judge. Beyond training, the learned rubric doubles as an inference-time selector for tree search. On TextCraft-Synth and TextWorld-Sync, SERA improves over strong recursive-agent baselines by 5.38 and 13.14 points on average, and rubric-guided tree search at inference adds a further 2.43 points on TextWorld-Sync.

AI.tldr: SERA将"评估"变成递归语言模型智能体自身学习到的能力——父节点在委派子任务前生成加权评分标准(rubric)，通过排序目标对齐真实结果来训练rubric生成，同一个权重既评估又执行，从而提升分解、求解与评估三种能力，并减少对外部judge的依赖。
AI.motivation: 递归智能体把任务分解并委派给同类子实例，形成工作树。其训练难点在于：最终结果可验证，但自创的中间子任务数量庞大且没有ground truth。已有方法用verifier或judge给每个节点打分，既在大规模下成本高昂，又对分解质量不敏感（盲目）。因此需要一种能同时学习"分解、求解、评估"三种耦合能力、且不过度依赖外部监督的训练方式。
AI.method: 核心是把评估内化为策略自身的学习能力。1) 父节点在委派前为每个子任务写出带权成功标准的rubric；2) 用一个针对已验证结果的排序目标（ranking objective）训练rubric生成，使标准能追踪子任务真实成功；3) 额外的leaf-coverage信号为任务分解提供直接信用分配。由于同一套权重既评估又执行，学习评判子任务会反过来增强求解能力；外部judge仅用于训练rubric生成器，求解则针对智能体自身的rubric分数训练。推理时，学到的rubric还可用作树搜索的选择器。
