AI.result: 在TextCraft-Synth和TextWorld-Sync上，SERA相比强递归智能体基线平均分别提升5.38和13.14分；在TextWorld-Sync上，推理阶段的rubric引导树搜索再额外带来2.43分。同时，使用自身rubric分数训练求解的效果优于直接使用judge。
AI.conclusion: 训练策略生成对齐的rubric是性能提升的关键驱动力：同一权重兼顾评估与执行，使"学会评判"直接强化"学会求解"。该方法在降低外部监督（judge仅用于训练rubric生成器）的同时，还让学到的rubric在推理期兼具树搜索选择器的作用，形成训练与推理的双重收益。

title: GRAM: Correcting Frozen Time-Series Foundation Models via Graph-Retrieved Amplitude Memory
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) enable zero-shot forecasting through large-scale cross-domain pretraining, while retrieval augmentation further improves their performance by leveraging historical information. However, existing methods typically correct TSFM forecasts using the ground-truth futures of similar historical windows, which contain both predictive components already captured by the foundation model and sample-specific random fluctuation that is difficult to transfer. In contrast, recurring systematic model bias within prediction errors more directly characterizes the failure modes of a frozen TSFM and therefore provides more valuable correction signals. Effectively exploiting such model bias, however, poses two challenges: prediction errors at different numerical levels are difficult to compare due to scale differences, and the recurring bias must be extracted from prediction errors contaminated by random fluctuation. To address these challenges, we propose GRAM, a general retrieval-augmented framework for frozen TSFMs. GRAM first introduces an Amplitude Memory Module (AMM) that scales prediction errors by amplitude and aggregates them into retrievable prototypes. It then employs a Prototype Graph Module (PGM) to model relations among prototypes to aggregate consistent bias information while suppressing random fluctuation. During online forecasting, GRAM retrieves and expands prototypes relevant to the current query and generates per-horizon corrections to refine the original TSFM forecast. Experiments across multiple datasets and foundation models demonstrate consistent forecasting improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAM，一种面向冻结时序基础模型的通用检索增强框架，通过提取模型系统性偏差而非历史真值来校正预测，缓解尺度差异与随机波动干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强方法用相似历史窗口的真实未来来校正TSFM预测，但其中既含模型已捕捉的预测成分，又含难以迁移的样本特异随机波动。相比之下，预测误差中反复出现的系统性模型偏差更能刻画冻结TSFM的失效模式，是更有价值的校正信号。但利用该偏差面临两挑战：不同数值尺度下的预测误差难以比较；需从被随机波动污染的错误中提取反复偏差。
AI.method: GRAM包含：1）幅度记忆模块（AMM），按幅度缩放预测误差并聚合为可检索原型；2）原型图模块（PGM），建模原型间关系，聚合一致的偏差信息并抑制随机波动。在线预测时，检索并扩展与当前查询相关的原型，生成逐预测步（per-horizon）的校正量以精化原始TSFM预测。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种基础模型上实验，均取得一致的预测性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，聚焦于TSFM预测误差中的系统性模型偏差，并通过幅度归一化与原型图建模提取可利用的偏差信号，是提升冻结TSFM零样本预测的有效检索增强途径，且具备良好的通用性。

title: Shared Stopping Decisions Change Answers in HQQ Cache Quantization
summary: Language-model systems batch questions for throughput, but unrelated questions should not change a target's answer when its input and numerical execution are fixed. We study compression of the key and value cache, which stores attention representations reused during generation. With request-local groups, Transformers' Half-Quadratic Quantization (HQQ) backend updates compression parameters separately but uses a shared average error to decide when all updates stop. Replacing only the question batched with the target changes four-bit HQQ answers in 170/384 test comparisons across two models. Replaying the other execution's update counts reproduces its complete answer and cache fingerprints in every changed pair, in both directions. Computing the stopping mean in FP32 reduces cache differences but leaves answer changes. Native HQQ also changes confirmed numerical correctness in eight arithmetic pairs. Fixed iterations and request-local stopping remove observed companion dependence under matched controls. Request-local stopping remains sensitive to synthetic padding changes at the tensor level. Fixing the original iteration budget removes this decision path without tuning. Neither repair has an established quality advantage, and natural rebatching still changes answers. Request-independence audits must cover stopping decisions as well as quantization groups.

AI.tldr: 语言模型批处理中，目标问题的答案会因同批次其他无关问题而改变；根源在于HQQ压缩中共享的平均误差停止判据，改用请求局部停止或固定迭代可消除该依赖。
AI.motivation: 批处理提升吞吐量，但无关问题不应影响目标问题的答案。作者发现即使输入和数值执行固定，4-bit HQQ的答案仍会变化，因此需要审计这种"伴随依赖"。
AI.method: 研究KV缓存压缩中HQQ的行为：请求局部组虽单独更新压缩参数，但停止更新由共享平均误差决定。通过替换批次中陪跑问题、重放另一执行的更新次数、将停止均值改用FP32计算，以及对比固定迭代与请求局部停止等方案进行实验。
AI.result: 替换陪跑问题在170/384比较中改变4-bit HQQ答案（两个模型）。重放更新次数可完全复现答案和缓存指纹，双向成立。FP32停止均值减小缓存差异但仍改变答案。原生HQQ在8个算术对中改变数值正确性。固定迭代与请求局部停止在匹配对照下消除依赖，但请求局部停止对合成填充仍敏感。
AI.conclusion: 两种修复都无确定的质量优势，自然重批仍会改变答案。请求独立性审计必须同时覆盖停止决策与量化分组。

title: VideoResearchAgent: Grounded Task Synthesis and Sim-to-Real RL for Open-Web Video Research
summary: Existing deep research agents are designed primarily for text- and image-based web sources, while video reasoning systems typically assume that relevant videos are provided in advance. We study open-web video research, where an agent must autonomously discover relevant videos, navigate their temporal content, and ground answers in visual evidence. Training such agents at scale is challenging as live video interaction is slow and unreliable, whereas fixed local simulation can induce retrieval-specific shortcuts that fail to transfer to the open web. We introduce VideoResearchAgent, a scalable training framework to address these challenges. First, we introduce controllable task synthesis pipeline to synthesize multi-hop research tasks from timestamped visual evidence while filtering text-only shortcuts. Second, we build a field-aligned local video simulator that preserves deployment-facing search and watch interactions while accelerating video search by a factor of 34.5-64.6. Third, we introduce Retrieval-Domain-Randomized GRPO (RDR-GRPO), which diversifies candidate rankings, distractors, metadata, and result structure during training to reduce overfitting to simulated retrieval. On Video-BrowseComp, the VideoResearchAgent trained using Qwen3.5-4B achieves 40.48% accuracy, comparable to Gemini-3-Flash-Preview, while reducing cumulative API-token consumption by 74.9% relative to the untrained model. Together, these results establish an accurate and efficient training recipe for open-web video research.

AI.tldr: 提出VideoResearchAgent训练框架，让智能体自主发现视频、导航时间内容并以视觉证据作答，实现开放网络视频研究。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体主要面向文本和图像，视频推理系统则假设视频已提供；开放网络视频研究场景缺乏可扩展的训练方法，实时视频交互慢且不可靠，固定本地模拟又易导致检索捷径无法迁移。
AI.method: 三部分：1）可控任务合成流水线，从带时间戳的视觉证据合成多跳研究任务并过滤纯文本捷径；2）领域对齐的本地视频模拟器，保留部署式搜索与观看交互，视频搜索加速34.5-64.6倍；3）RDR-GRPO（检索域随机化GRPO），训练中多样化候选排序、干扰项、元数据与结果结构以减少对模拟检索的过拟合。
AI.result: 在Video-BrowseComp上，用Qwen3.5-4B训练的VideoResearchAgent达到40.48%准确率，与Gemini-3-Flash-Preview相当，同时相比未训练模型的累计API token消耗降低74.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开放网络视频研究建立了准确且高效的训练方案。

title: Which Preferences to Train On? End-to-End Multi-Objective Alignment with an Adversarial Preference Distribution
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values is important for safe, efficient, and beneficial AI deployment. However, human values are multifaceted: helpfulness, harmlessness and humor trade off against one another, and different users want different trade-offs. Multi-objective alignment (MOA) addresses this by training a policy that can provide any point of the Pareto front, but existing methods either train one model per preference, interpolate a few separately aligned experts post hoc, or train a single conditioned model without considering which preferences it should be trained on. Since the hard regions of the preference simplex depend on the objectives at hand, existing methods leave them under-trained and do not get the most out of a single model. Therefore, we propose MAESTRO (Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization), which formulates MOA as a minimax problem over preference distributions and trains a single prompt-conditioned policy end-to-end with RL against an adversarial preference distribution: a Dirichlet distribution updated by online mirror descent toward the preferences the current policy serves worst, rather than on a fixed one. On HH-RLHF, BeaverTails and a summarization task, with up to three objectives, MAESTRO attains the best Pareto front on most tasks in a single training run, at the lowest training cost among the compared methods. The largest margins appear in the hard regions that a fixed preference distribution leaves under-trained, confirming that a single prompt-conditioned model is capable of covering the objective trade-offs on its own.

AI.tldr: 提出MAESTRO，将多目标对齐建模为对偏好分布的极小极大问题，端到端训练单一prompt条件策略，覆盖Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 人类价值多元（有用性、无害性、幽默性等相互权衡），用户偏好各异。现有MOA方法要么每个偏好训一个模型，要么事后插值少数专家，要么用固定偏好分布训练单模型，导致偏好单纯形中的困难区域训练不足，未充分发挥单模型潜力。
AI.method: 将MOA形式化为偏好分布上的极小极大问题；用单一prompt条件策略结合RL端到端训练；对抗性偏好分布为Dirichlet分布，通过在线镜像下降（online mirror descent）向当前策略表现最差的偏好更新，而非固定分布。
AI.result: 在HH-RLHF、BeaverTails及摘要任务上（最多三个目标），单次训练即获得多数任务上最佳Pareto前沿，且训练成本为对比方法中最低；最大优势出现在固定偏好分布训练不足的困难区域。
AI.conclusion: 单一prompt条件模型能够自行覆盖目标间权衡，验证了对抗式偏好分布训练的MOA方法在效果与成本上的优越性。

title: Probabilistic Race and Ethnicity Prediction Using Group-Specific Name Lists
summary: Statistically valid estimation of racial and ethnic disparities often requires inferring the probability that an individual belongs to a particular racial or ethnic group given only their name and geographic location. The standard approach, Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG), relies on group population frequencies for each name. Although the U.S. Census Bureau provides such information for common names and a limited set of racial categories, comparable data do not exist for many racial and ethnic groups and are rarely available outside the U.S. We propose the list-powered BISG ($\ell$BISG) method, which can be used to derive calibrated group probabilities from group-specific name lists. These lists may be compiled based on expert knowledge or generated synthetically using large language models (LLMs), and thus may be subject to unknown biases. Representing names as embeddings, we treat list membership as a proxy prediction task and apply a correction based on proximal inference to recover the target group probabilities. We validate the method on U.S. voter files with self-reported race, on the full-count 1900 U.S. Census, and on the Lebanese voter registry. We find that LLM-generated name lists yield accurate and well-calibrated probabilities as well as precise disparity estimates comparable to those obtained using methods that require name-race data. Thus, $\ell$BISG substantially broadens the applicability of probabilistic race and ethnicity prediction to settings where name-race data are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 提出ℓBISG方法，利用群体特定姓名列表（可由专家或LLM生成）推断种族概率，通过嵌入和proximal inference校正偏差，在多数据集上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 标准BISG依赖美国人口普查的姓名-种族频率数据，但许多种族群体及美国以外地区缺乏此类数据，限制了种族差异统计推断的适用性。
AI.method: 将姓名表示为嵌入，把列表成员关系视为代理预测任务，应用proximal inference进行校正，从群体特定姓名列表（专家构建或LLM生成）中导出校准的群体概率。
AI.result: 在美国选民档案（含自我报告种族）、1900年全量人口普查及黎巴嫩选民登记册上验证；LLM生成的姓名列表可产生准确且良好校准的概率，差异估计精度与需要姓名-种族数据的方法相当。
AI.conclusion: ℓBISG大幅扩展了概率性种族/族裔预测的适用范围，可用于缺乏姓名-种族数据的场景。

title: Monitorability Disposition in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of large reasoning models (LRMs) is a common way to detect misbehavior in real-world practice. However, current monitoring is passive: a separate model inspects the session only after execution. This means harm may already have occurred before it is caught. An active alternative is to have the model self-report its misbehavior as it happens. Whether models are willing to do this, however, is unknown. We introduce "monitorability disposition": a model's willingness to make itself monitorable and stay monitored throughout inference when warranted. We measure it as the fraction of warranted cases in which a model self-reports its own misbehavior via tool calls to available monitoring channels. We evaluate four LRMs on three misbehaviors (sycophancy, reward hacking, and bias) while varying the available monitors (AI and human) and the pressure to use the monitoring tools. We find that when tool use is optional, models self-report in only about 16% of warranted cases on average. Increasing tool-use pressure does not improve reporting where it matters: high-severity misbehavior is never self-reported. Models also systematically select the monitor they perceive as least strict. Overall, we identify monitorability disposition as a new contributing factor to model monitorability: when sufficiently strong, it keeps models seeking monitorability throughout inference.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"可监控倾向"概念，衡量大推理模型在推理过程中主动自我报告不当行为的意愿，发现模型自我报告率仅约16%，高危行为从不自我报告。
AI.motivation: 当前对推理链的监控是被动的，需在执行后才由独立模型检查，此时危害可能已发生。主动方案是让模型实时自我报告不当行为，但模型是否愿意这样做尚不清楚。
AI.method: 定义"可监控倾向"为模型在应监控情形下通过工具调用自我报告的意愿比例。在四种大推理模型上评估三种不当行为（谄媚、奖励黑客、偏见），并变化监控器类型（AI与人类）和对使用监控工具的压力。
AI.result: 工具使用可选时，模型平均仅在约16%的应报告情形下自我报告；增加工具使用压力并未改善关键情形——高严重度不当行为从不自我报告；模型系统性选择其认为最宽松的监控器。
AI.conclusion: "可监控倾向"是影响模型可监控性的新因素：当其足够强时，能使模型在整个推理过程中持续寻求可监控性。

title: PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning
summary: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Vietoris-Rips filtration, and processes the resulting tokens with a structure aware Transformer in which pairwise Cα distances enter as a learned attention bias. A bidirectional cross attention module then performs latent space soft docking between the two per-protein representations, and the model is trained with a combined binary cross entropy and NT-Xent contrastive objective. On three binary interaction prediction benchmarks, general PPI on PPIRef, TCRpMHC binding on STAG, and whole chain pairs on PPB-Affinity, PIT-GCL outperforms representative sequence based, structure aware, and task specific baselines on general PPI under our evaluation, and is the only method above chance on PPB-Affinity; on TCR-pMHC it leads at a fixed decision threshold but is outranked by a task specific sequence model. Because each protein is encoded independently in the first phase, its representation can be precomputed and reused across candidate pairs, which is convenient for large scale screening.

AI.tldr: PIT-GCL是一个双塔结构感知框架，通过融合序列、Cα点云与持续同调拓扑描述符独立编码蛋白质，并用双向交叉注意力进行软对接来预测蛋白质结合。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质结合预测对靶点识别、结合剂设计和规模化筛选至关重要，但结合依赖序列、三维几何与全局结构组织，难度大。现有折叠模型（AlphaFold3、Boltz-2）的置信度输出（pLDDT、pTM、ipTM）并非为二分类结合预测设计，而专用结构感知预测器往往需要筛选规模下无法获得的结合复合物结构。
AI.method: 提出PIT-GCL，双塔结构感知框架：每个蛋白质独立由氨基酸序列、Cα点云和全局持续同调描述符编码。每塔将残基ESM-2嵌入与基于Vietoris-Rips过滤的H0、H1持续同调景观拓扑摘要结合，并用结构感知Transformer处理，其中成对Cα距离作为可学习注意力偏置。随后双向交叉注意力模块在两蛋白质表示间进行潜空间软对接，训练目标为二元交叉熵与NT-Xent对比损失的组合。
AI.result: 在三个二分类相互作用预测基准上（PPIRef上的通用PPI、STAG上的TCR-pMHC结合、PPB-Affinity上的全链对），PIT-GCL在通用PPI上优于代表性序列基、结构感知及任务专用基线，在PPB-Affinity上是唯一优于随机的方法；在TCR-pMHC上于固定决策阈值下领先，但被任务专用序列模型超越。
AI.conclusion: 由于第一阶段每个蛋白质独立编码，其表示可预计算并在候选对间复用，便于大规模筛选。

title: DeferKV: Rethinking Eviction Timing for One-Shot KV Cache Compression
summary: Long-context large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of tasks, but the growing KV cache introduces substantial memory and inference overhead. Existing one-shot KV cache compression methods typically commit to irreversible eviction immediately after prefill, before any signal from actual generation becomes available. Our quantitative analysis shows that early queries from the actual generation stage provide attention signals that are more consistent with subsequent decode attention, with the largest single-step gain occurring at the prefill-decode boundary. Based on this observation, we propose DeferKV, which moves the eviction decision from the end of prefill to the first real decoding step and temporally combines prompt-side and decode-side observations, thereby better aligning KV importance estimation with subsequent generation requirements. DeferKV requires no additional training, draft model, or future-query prediction module, making it simple and easy to deploy. Experiments on LongBench, RULER, and Needle-in-a-Haystack demonstrate that DeferKV consistently improves model performance under KV cache compression while maintaining low inference latency.

AI.tldr: 提出DeferKV，将KV缓存淘汰决策从prefill结束推迟到第一个真实解码步，融合prompt侧与decode侧观测，在无需训练的情况下提升长上下文压缩性能。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM的KV缓存带来显著内存与推理开销；现有一次性压缩方法在prefill后立即做不可逆淘汰，此时尚无真实生成信号，导致重要性估计与后续解码需求不匹配。
AI.method: 通过定量分析发现生成阶段早期query的注意力信号与后续解码更一致，且最大单步增益出现在prefill-decode边界；据此将淘汰决策延后至首个真实解码步，并时间上融合prompt侧与decode侧观测。无需额外训练、草稿模型或未来query预测模块。
AI.result: 在LongBench、RULER和Needle-in-a-Haystack上，DeferKV在KV缓存压缩下持续提升模型性能，同时保持低推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 简单易部署的DeferKV通过延后并融合观测信号，使KV重要性估计更好对齐生成需求，兼具性能与效率优势。

title: Are We Measuring Scientific Intelligence? Rethinking the Evaluation of AI Scientists
comment: [Oral] NeurIPS 2026 Agentic AI for Biological Discovery Workshop
summary: AI agents can now carry out data-driven scientific analyses end to end, and benchmarks assess them by giving an agent a question and a dataset and scoring its final answer against a fixed key. These benchmarks assume that a correct answer was derived from the supplied data, a property we call evidence grounding. However, an agent can also reach the key from prior knowledge or by ruling out the other options, and a score based on a single run cannot tell these cases apart. We show how to test this assumption and find that it often fails. For each question, we build versions of its data files in which the evidence for the answer is left intact, withdrawn or reversed, check each edit with a pre-registered reference statistic, and run the same agent on every version. We then measure evidence-grounded accuracy, which credits a correct answer only if the agent also responds when the evidence is withdrawn and follows it when it is reversed. We evaluate three agent scaffolds and five models on 18 single-cell questions from BAISBench and four synthetic problems from GeneBench-Pro. On the single-cell questions, the Claude agents are 95% accurate and answer 83% correctly without any data, but their evidence-grounded accuracy is only 41%. Hiding gene names raises the share of runs that follow reversed evidence from 58% to 93% on ten gene tasks, suggesting that prior knowledge competes with the supplied data. The benchmark score and LLM judges can also reward answers that ignore the changed evidence. Measuring scientific intelligence rather than recall therefore requires checking whether answers follow the evidence and whether scores reward them for it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"证据接地性"检验方法，通过撤回/反转数据证据重跑agent，揭示现有基准分数会高估agent真实科学分析能力。
AI.motivation: 当前AI agent科学分析基准仅用固定答案键评分，默认正确答案源自所给数据，但agent可能凭先验知识或排除法得出答案，单次运行分数无法区分这两种情况，导致能力被高估。
AI.method: 对每个问题构建证据保留、撤回、反转三种数据版本，用预注册参考统计量验证编辑，在同一agent上分别运行；提出"证据接地准确率"指标——仅当agent在证据撤回时不作答、在证据反转时跟随反转答案才计分。评估3种agent框架、5个模型，在BAISBench 18个单细胞问题和GeneBench-Pro 4个合成问题上测试。
AI.result: Claude agent在单细胞问题上准确率95%，无数据时仍有83%答对，但证据接地准确率仅41%；隐藏基因名后，10个基因任务中跟随反转证据的比例从58%升至93%，说明先验知识与所给数据竞争。基准分数和LLM评审也会奖励忽略被改变证据的答案。
AI.conclusion: 衡量科学智能而非记忆，必须检查答案是否跟随证据、评分是否奖励证据接地行为。

title: CURIO: Curiosity-Driven Test-Time Learning for Open-Ended Discovery
summary: Open-ended discovery requires learning from repeated attempts while continuing to explore directions whose value is not yet apparent. Search with a frozen large language model (LLM) can reuse previous solutions in context, but cannot update the model from its successes and failures on the test problem. Reinforcement learning (RL) enables such adaptation; however, strongly favoring high-reward trajectories may suppress low-reward yet potentially promising directions too early. We introduce CURIO, a curiosity-driven test-time learning framework that complements task feedback with an Intrinsic Curiosity World Model (ICWM). The ICWM learns transitions in the policy's hidden-state representation and supplies prediction-error bonuses at sampled tokens outside the policy's top-k choices. Epoch normalization and an annealed weight regulate their contribution to the policy update. On six mathematical discovery tasks and single-cell denoising with Qwen3 backbones from 8B to 235B, three-run means improve over a matched task-only RL control on five mathematical objectives, match the best reported performance on Circle Packing, and improve denoising Score and mean squared error (MSE) on both held-out corpora at every tested scale. Relative gains reach 18.3% on Hadamard and 10.8% on denoising Score. Code-diversity measurements show greater structural variation among generated programs, supporting curiosity as a complementary exploration signal for learning in open-ended discovery.

AI.tldr: CURIO：一种好奇心驱动的测试时学习框架，通过内在好奇心世界模型补充任务反馈，避免过早抑制低奖励但有前景的探索方向。
AI.motivation: 开放式发现需要从重复尝试中学习，同时继续探索价值尚不明确的方向。冻结LLM搜索可复用已有解但无法从成败中更新模型；RL能适应但强烈偏向高奖励轨迹会过早压制低奖励却有潜力的方向。
AI.method: 提出CURIO框架，加入Intrinsic Curiosity World Model（ICWM），学习策略隐藏状态表示的转移，并在策略top-k之外的采样token上提供预测误差奖励。通过epoch normalization和退火权重调节其对策略更新的贡献。
AI.result: 在六个数学发现任务和单细胞去噪任务上（Qwen3 8B至235B），五次数学目标中三次运行的均值优于仅任务反馈的RL对照，Circle Packing达到最佳已报告性能，去噪Score和MSE在所有测试规模上均有提升。Hadamard相对增益18.3%，去噪Score增益10.8%。代码多样性测量显示生成程序结构变化更大。
AI.conclusion: 好奇心可作为开放式发现中学习的互补探索信号，提升多样性与性能。

title: From Abusive Language Classification to Sequence Labeling Identification
summary: Industrial content moderation must process massive message streams under tight latency constraints, yet most abusive language (AL) detection systems rely on sentence-level classification (ALC), which neither localizes abusive spans nor identifies who is targeted. We define Abusive Language Identification (ALI) as a sequence-labeling task that jointly extracts AL spans and target mentions, and assess whether this approach can be used for text moderation. On a pilot corpus drawn from a production moderation pipeline, we compare ALI with ALC on cross-domain generalization and implicit abuse, and we also evaluate AL and target span detection. ALI remains competitive with ALC while providing localized outputs for moderators, with a modest and configuration-sensitive advantage on implicit abuse. Exact AL boundaries and target spans remain difficult to recover. We complement this comparison with a qualitative analysis and discuss perspectives on complete target--span linking and on structured benchmarks for ALI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Abusive Language Identification (ALI)序列标注任务，联合抽取辱骂片段和目标指代，并在生产审核语料上验证其用于文本审核的可行性。
AI.motivation: 工业内容审核需在严格延迟下处理海量消息，但现有辱骂语言检测多为句子级分类(ALC)，既不定位辱骂片段也不识别针对对象，无法满足审核需求。
AI.method: 将ALI定义为联合抽取辱骂语言片段与目标提及的序列标注任务，在来自生产审核流程的试点语料上，对比ALI与ALC的跨域泛化能力和隐式辱骂表现，并评估辱骂及目标片段的检测效果。
AI.result: ALI与ALC表现相当且具竞争力，同时能为审核员提供局部化输出；在隐式辱骂上具小幅且对配置敏感的优势；但精确的辱骂边界与目标片段仍难以恢复。
AI.conclusion: ALI可用于文本审核，补充了定性分析，并探讨完整目标-片段链接及面向ALI的结构化基准的未来方向。

title: Zero-Shot Time-Series Question Answering via Decoupled Perception and Reasoning
summary: Time-series question answering (TSQA) requires grounding linguistic queries and diverse answer formats in complex numerical observations. However, existing methods heavily overfit to specific datasets and struggle to generalize when input series, question contexts, and answer requirements shift simultaneously. To address this challenge, we propose TSHarness, an agentic framework that establishes a decoupled workflow for cross-dataset zero-shot TSQA. At its core, TSHarness divides and conquers numerical perception and contextual reasoning via a structured Time-Series Perception State (TPS). Guided by a reusable memory of analytical knowledge, a learned Tool Selector adaptively invokes numerical tools to extract salient statistical and temporal features into the TPS. The answering agent then performs semantic reasoning over the TPS to generate target outputs, triggering iterative re-perception through the feedback loop when evidence is deemed insufficient. By separating numerical feature extraction from question-specific reasoning, TSHarness eliminates the need for target-side training or answer feedback, providing a generalizable, cost-efficient foundation for zero-shot TSQA.

AI.tldr: 提出TSHarness智能体框架，通过解耦数值感知与上下文推理，实现跨数据集零样本时间序列问答。
AI.motivation: 现有TSQA方法严重过拟合特定数据集，当输入序列、问题上下文和答案要求同时变化时难以泛化。需要一种无需目标侧训练、可跨数据集零样本泛化的方案。
AI.method: 构建解耦工作流：通过结构化的时间序列感知状态(TPS)将数值感知与上下文推理分离。依靠可复用分析知识记忆，用学习型Tool Selector自适应调用数值工具，提取显著统计与时序特征存入TPS；作答智能体基于TPS进行语义推理生成答案，并在证据不足时通过反馈环路触发迭代重感知。
AI.result: 将数值特征提取与问题特定推理分离，消除了对目标侧训练或答案反馈的需求，为跨数据集零样本TSQA提供可泛化且高性价比的基础。
AI.conclusion: TSHarness通过解耦式智能体流程实现通用、成本高效的零样本时间序列问答，提升跨数据集泛化能力。

title: Greedy Local Learning for Language Model Pretraining: Gaps and Objective Design
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Collaborative, Open, and Decentralized Training of Foundation Models (CODEC-FM). 13 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Greedy block-wise local learning splits a network into gradient-isolated blocks trained by local auxiliary losses, deleting the backward pass between blocks: inter-stage communication becomes forward-only and every block can step its optimizer independently, properties directly relevant to decentralized model-parallel training. Local learning is competitive with end-to-end backpropagation on image classification, and on small Transformers it is known to trade a worse best loss for parallel speedup. How this loss gap behaves in autoregressive language model (LM) pretraining at larger scale, and which auxiliary designs reduce it, has not been measured. We present a token-budget-matched empirical study at 125M and 400M parameters with $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ blocks at Chinchilla-optimal budgets, factorizing the auxiliary design into network architecture and training objective. We observe: (i) the gap to end-to-end training more than doubles from $K=2$ to $K=4$, but at $K=4$ shrinks from 125M to 400M; (ii) replacing an MLP auxiliary with a Transformer-based one is a strong network-side intervention, recovering 22-41% of the gap; (iii) a multi-token-prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective helps at the first block boundary, whereas adding it at deeper boundaries hurts, and restricting it to the first block yields the best $K=4$ configuration ($+0.062$ vs. $+0.075$ nats at 400M); and (iv) deployment-style per-block execution reduces activation memory by up to $2.2\times$. We frame these results as an empirically grounded method direction rather than a finalized method: local objectives should apply future-predictive pressure selectively across boundaries while resisting shortcuts that bypass predictive content.

AI.tldr: 本文在125M/400M参数、K∈{1,2,4}块设置下，对自回归语言模型预训练中的贪心分块局部学习进行了token预算匹配的实证研究，分析辅助设计的网络架构与训练目标两方面，发现与端到端训练的损失差距随块数增加而扩大但在更大模型上缩小，并提出选择性施加未来预测压力的方法方向。
AI.motivation: 局部学习在图像分类上可与端到端反向传播竞争，在小Transformer上已知以更差的最终损失换取并行加速，但在更大规模自回归语言模型预训练中该损失差距如何表现、哪些辅助设计能缩小差距尚未被测量。
AI.method: 在125M和400M参数、K∈{1,2,4}块、Chinchilla最优预算下进行token预算匹配的实证研究，将辅助设计分解为网络架构和训练目标两方面进行对比实验。
AI.result: (i) 与端到端的差距从K=2到K=4扩大一倍以上，但K=4时从125M到400M缩小；(ii) 用Transformer辅助替换MLP辅助可恢复22-41%的差距；(iii) 多token预测(MTP)目标在首个块边界有帮助而在更深边界有害，仅限首块时K=4最优（400M时+0.062 vs +0.075 nats）；(iv) 部署式逐块执行减少激活内存最多2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 将这些结果定位为有实证依据的方法方向而非最终方法：局部目标应选择性地跨边界施加未来预测压力，同时抵抗绕过预测内容的捷径。

title: DialectSentEval 2026: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis and Swapping Shared Task
summary: Sentiment analysis is a fundamental problem in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Standard sentiment classification for the Arabic language remains challenging due to the high volume of dialectal Arabic. To advance research in this area, this paper proposes the Shared Task on Sentiment Analysis and Swapping in Arabic Dialects (DialectSentEval), hosted with the Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference (ArabicNLP 2026). This shared task consists of two subtasks: Subtask 1 focuses on multi-class and multi-dialect sentiment analysis, requiring models to identify sentiment polarity across various Arabic dialects. Subtask 2 introduces a generative task for Arabic sentiment swap, challenging models to invert sentiment polarity while preserving core semantics. In this overview paper, we present the motivation, dataset creation, and summarize the main findings from participating models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DialectSentEval共享任务，含阿拉伯方言情感分析（子任务1）和情感翻转生成（子任务2）。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语方言变体繁多，标准情感分类仍具挑战性，需推动相关研究。
AI.method: 依托ArabicNLP 2026举办共享任务，设计两个子任务并构建数据集：子任务1为多类别、多方言情感极性识别；子任务2为生成式情感翻转，要求反转极性同时保留核心语义。
AI.result: 本文作为综述论文，介绍了动机、数据集构建，并总结参赛模型的主要发现（未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 该任务旨在促进阿拉伯方言情感分析及可控文本生成研究。

title: BACAM: Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging for Multi-Turn Interaction
summary: Model merging offers a way to integrate the capabilities of specialized experts, but existing agent merging methods typically require all of them to be available at once. We study continual agent merging, which integrates incoming experts sequentially without retaining previously merged experts. Yet merging in parameter space or feature subspaces does not ensure that the merged model acquires an incoming expert's behavior on interaction trajectories. Moreover, updates toward a new expert can disrupt the merged model's previously integrated interactive behavior. Therefore, we propose Behavior-Aware Continual Agent Merging (BACAM), which learns parameter-wise merging gates from candidate-generated trajectories using expert-guided behavioral supervision. Task-level stability-plasticity control and tensor-level conflict-aware update budgets limit interference with existing capabilities while allowing new ones to be acquired. The learned gates are folded into the model weights without additional inference-time parameters. Across four interactive tasks - web shopping, tool use, information retrieval, and embodied interaction - BACAM achieves an average success rate of 62.82%, exceeding the strongest evaluated merging baseline by 21.69 percentage points. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/shuaitongli/BACAM.

AI.tldr: 提出BACAM方法，实现持续式的智能体模型合并，在四个交互任务上成功率平均达62.82%，超最强基线21.69个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体合并方法需一次性获取所有专家模型；而持续合并中，参数空间或特征子空间的合并无法保证模型习得新专家的交互行为，且更新新专家会破坏已整合的交互行为。
AI.method: 从候选轨迹中学习参数级的合并门控，采用专家引导的行为监督；引入任务级稳定性-可塑性控制和张量级冲突感知的更新预算，限制干扰；学到的门控折叠进模型权重，不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在网页购物、工具使用、信息检索、具身交互四个任务上，BACAM平均成功率62.82%，比最强评估基线高出21.69个百分点。
AI.conclusion: BACAM有效解决持续智能体合并中的行为习得与灾难性干扰问题，且不增加推理成本，代码已开源。

title: Your Temporal Link Predictor Is Blind to Who Is Active: A Missing Factor That Transfers Across Models
summary: An interaction has two parts: someone decides to act, and then chooses whom to act on. Temporal link prediction has concentrated on the second, and we show that it is blind to the first by construction: a standard negative keeps the real source and swaps the destination, and we prove that this cancels the source's activity exactly from the optimal score, so no model trained and evaluated this way is ever rewarded for learning it. Under the harder historical and inductive negatives, whose sources differ, the same factor becomes the dominant signal. We model it with Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM), a self-exciting event intensity fitted by an exact point-process likelihood to decayed interaction counts the history states already contain; it has fewer than 20 parameters. On their own, never looking at the destination, these parameters beat DyGFormer and TPNet on four of five datasets under historical negatives. Added to the frozen scores of TPNet, TGN, DyGFormer and DSRD, four models of different design, without retraining anything, they raise AP on almost every backbone-dataset pair in both settings, by up to 25 points. Our full model ranks first overall against eleven baselines on 13 datasets and three protocols, and on million-event streams trains an epoch 9-100x faster than TPNet and DyGFormer. We conclude that source activity is a blind spot of temporal link prediction, and a cheap, transferable one to close. Code is available at https://github.com/Erutaner/Your-Temporal-Link-Predictor-Is-Blind-to-Who-Is-Active.

AI.tldr: 时序链路预测忽略"谁决定行动"（源节点活跃度），标准负采样恰好抵消该信号；提出20参数以内的自激励活动模型SNAM，可即插即用地大幅提升多种模型性能。
AI.motivation: 交互包含两部分：谁决定行动、作用于谁。既有研究集中在后者（目标选择），而源节点活跃度被系统性忽视。
AI.method: 证明标准负采样（保留真实源、替换目标）会在最优得分中精确抵消源活跃度；用SNAM（自激励点过程强度模型，基于衰减交互计数，少于20参数）对源活跃度建模，作为加分项即插到冻结模型上。
AI.result: 单独SNAM在5个数据集中的4个上胜过DyGFormer和TPNet；加到TPNet、TGN、DyGFormer、DSRD上，几乎所有组合AP提升，最高25点；在13数据集3协议上总体第一；百万级事件流上训练快9-100倍。
AI.conclusion: 源活跃度是时序链路预测的盲点，且用低成本、可迁移的方法即可弥补。

title: Agentic schema-guided extraction of materials process knowledge from scientific literature
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, submitted for review to Nature Communications Materials
summary: Materials literature contains detailed experimental knowledge, but procedures, chemical entities and measurements remain difficult to aggregate because they are reported in heterogeneous forms and depend on process-specific context. We present SciKGExtract, a schema-guided framework that combines large-language-model extraction with chemical normalization and agent-based evaluation and refinement before knowledge-graph integration. We evaluate the framework on 176 atomic-layer-deposition papers describing zinc oxide (ZnO) and indium--gallium--zinc oxide (IGZO), together with an expert-annotated full-schema subset. PubChem normalization improves exact-match extraction F1 for every tested model. For ZnO, the best F1 increases from 0.591 for direct normalized extraction to 0.805 with agentic refinement, whereas the best IGZO result is 0.344, revealing the greater difficulty of multicomponent supercycle processes. Evaluation against a deeply nested schema containing 65 experimental properties and 155 quantitative measurement nodes further exposes errors in process segmentation and numerical assignment. These results show that chemical canonicalization and targeted agentic verification provide complementary controls for converting complex materials literature into reusable, machine-actionable experimental knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出SciKGExtract框架，结合大模型抽取、化学规范化与智能体评估精炼，将材料文献转化为知识图谱。
AI.motivation: 材料文献含丰富实验知识，但程序、化学实体与测量数据形式异构且依赖工艺语境，难以聚合。
AI.method: 模式引导框架：LLM抽取＋PubChem化学规范化＋基于智能体的评估与精炼，再整合入知识图谱；在176篇ALD论文（ZnO、IGZO）及专家标注子集上评测。
AI.result: PubChem规范化提升所有模型精确匹配F1；ZnO最佳F1由直接规范化抽取的0.591升至智能体精炼的0.805，IGZO仅0.344，显示多组分超循环工艺更难；嵌套模式（65个属性、155个测量节点）暴露工艺分段与数值分配错误。
AI.conclusion: 化学规范化与针对性智能体验证可互补，将复杂材料文献转化为可复用、机器可操作的实验知识。

title: Runtime Authorization of Self-Generated Subgoals in Long-Horizon Tool-Using AI Agents
summary:
Long-horizon tool-using AI agents create subgoals, replan, delegate work, and compose sibling results. Per-tool permission checks cannot establish that a changing goal graph remains within the principal-approved task. We address this authorization gap in a finite structured domain with one principal and one authorization root. Each proposed goal-graph mutation carries a version-bound witness that its continuation traces, resources, obligations, invariants, and closing condition refine the active root contract; every protected effect is rechecked at an atomic commit boundary. Free-form goal text supplies no authority.
  We prove trace-policy and modeled forbidden-state preservation under explicit mediation, abstraction, freshness, and atomicity assumptions, plus conditional root-success preservation, a separation result for memoryless allowlists, exact finite-domain decidability, and universal-safety monotonicity under sound abstraction refinement. An executable model explores 340 states and 419 transitions. Across 96 matched cases covering 25 structural schemas, the complete mechanism commits zero forbidden states in 48 drifted cases and completes all 48 benign counterparts. Two public upstream runtime paths execute 258 native dispatches across 32 cases, with every case-level decision and receipt chain matching. A frozen host-local study covers 129 synthetic one-factor-at-a-time cells, all matching fixed decisions and reasons. A history-aware continuation comparator blocks every modeled bad trace prefix but commits all operations in 11 cases whose violations lie in typed resources, freshness, or explicit-join evidence outside its trace projection. Within the registered structured domains, runtime authorization preserves useful replanning while preventing self-generated subgoals from becoming a source of new authority.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对长时程工具型AI智能体的授权缺口，提出一种基于版本绑定见证与原子提交边界的结构化授权机制，并给出理论证明与多组实验验证。
AI.motivation: 长时程工具型智能体会创建子目标、重规划、委派任务并组合结果，而逐工具的权限检查无法保证不断变化的目标图始终处于主体批准的任务范围内，形成授权缺口。
AI.method: 在单一主体、单一授权根的有限结构化域中，每个目标图突变都携带版本绑定的见证，证明其延续轨迹、资源、义务、不变量与关闭条件精化了活动根契约；每个受保护效果在原子提交边界被重新检查；自由形式目标文本不提供任何授权。
AI.result: 证明了轨迹策略与禁止状态保持（在显式中介、抽象、新鲜性与原子性假设下）、条件根成功保持、无记忆允许列表的分离结果、有限域精确可判定性，以及健全抽象精化下的通用安全单调性。可执行模型探索340状态、419转移；96组匹配案例（25种结构模式）中，48个漂移案例零禁止状态提交、48个良性对应全部完成；两条公开上游运行时路径在32案例中执行258次原生分派且逐案决策与收据链一致；冻结主机本地研究涵盖129个合成OFAT单元全部匹配；历史感知延续比较器阻断所有建模坏轨迹前缀，但对11个违规位于轨迹投影之外的案例仍提交全部操作。
AI.conclusion: 在注册的结构化域内，运行时授权在保留有用重规划的同时，阻止自生成子目标成为新授权来源。

title: ResOPD: Tail Residualization for Sparse On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on self-generated trajectories, but transmitting dense teacher distributions across long reasoning traces creates prohibitive communication and memory bottlenecks. Practical systems therefore rely on sparse teacher interfaces, typically transmitting either the sampled-token score or a small Top-$k$ distribution. However, this sparse setting faces a fundamental dilemma: sampled-token estimators are unbiased but suffer from severe gradient variance, whereas directly optimizing Top-$k$ objectives introduces systematic bias. To improve this trade-off, we propose ResOPD (On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization), which provides unbiased full-vocabulary reverse KL gradient estimation under on-policy sampling, with substantial variance reduction under the same sparse payload in the evaluated settings. ResOPD aggregates the unobserved vocabulary into an observable coarse tail event, computes its exact aggregate gradient, and samples only the fine-grained within-tail residual, which requires no additional teacher queries or forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResOPD substantially reduces gradient variance, stabilizes online training dynamics, and improves downstream performance across the evaluated settings. These results establish ResOPD as an efficient, plug-and-play variance reduction primitive for sparse on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: ResOPD提出一种稀疏on-policy蒸馏中无偏且低方差的梯度估计方法。
AI.motivation: on-policy蒸馏需传输教师分布，长推理轨迹造成通信与内存瓶颈，实际只能使用稀疏教师接口，面临有偏或无高方差的困境。
AI.method: 将未观测词表聚合成可观测的粗尾事件并计算其精确聚合梯度，仅对尾部内细粒度残差采样，无需额外教师查询或前向。
AI.result: 在相同稀疏负载下实现无偏全词表reverse KL梯度估计并显著降方差，稳定在线训练动态、提升下游性能。
AI.conclusion: ResOPD是高效、即插即用的稀疏on-policy蒸馏方差降低方法。

title: Breaking Bureaucracy: Evaluating open-source LLMs for legal document review
summary: In this paper, we evaluate open-source generative LLMs on legal Natural Language Inference (NLI). Legal inspectorial processes take place in specific domains and often deal with confidential data. This creates a need for working with local models that do not require labeled training data. We evaluate our models on the ContractNLI benchmark and two NLI4Wills datasets. We successfully reproduce the baseline for the task (Span NLI BERT) and we evaluate multiple open-source LLMs on the same task. We analyze the invalid rate of the models, and their stability across temperature settings and domains. Among the generative models, Gemma-4 26B performs the best, reaching an accuracy of 81.2%, even outperforming the supervised model on one metric. On accuracy, it is not possible to beat the supervised model with zero-shot approaches. Qwen-3.6 35B performs well on both ContractNLI and additional datasets in the legal wills domain. Our findings indicate that zero-shot, open-source, generative LLMs are a viable alternative for real-world legal NLI when no supervised data is available. Our code is available at https://github.com/fbaratov/contractnli-llms.

AI.tldr: 本文评估多个开源生成式LLM在法律自然语言推理任务上的表现，探索其作为无监督数据场景下可行替代方案的潜力。
AI.motivation: 法律审查过程发生在特定领域且常涉及机密数据，这要求使用本地模型且无需标注训练数据，因此需要评估开源生成式LLM的适用性。
AI.method: 在ContractNLI基准和两个NLI4Wills数据集上评估多个开源生成式LLM，复现Span NLI BERT基线，并分析模型的无效率及在不同温度和领域设置下的稳定性。
AI.result: Gemma-4 26B表现最佳，准确率达81.2%，在某一指标上甚至超过监督模型；但零样本方法整体上无法在准确率上超越监督模型。Qwen-3.6 35B在ContractNLI和法律遗嘱领域数据集上均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，当没有监督数据时，零样本开源生成式LLM是现实法律NLI任务的可行替代方案。

title: Do LLMs Understand Sequential Structure? A Controlled Study of Inference and Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as interactive agents and simulators, yet it remains unclear whether they can recover latent sequential structure beyond surface action frequencies. This distinction is critical for behavioral simulation, where actions are often shaped by prior context rather than marginal frequencies alone. We study this question using controlled two-player Rock--Paper--Scissors interactions and a one-player stochastic n-gram continuation task. Across these experiments, we test whether LLMs can identify latent strategies, follow simple Markov rules, and sustain higher-order conditional dependencies. Our framework separates distribution matching from conditional rule following. Results show that longer context does not improve identification, correct recognition does not ensure faithful simulation, and higher-order dependencies substantially degrade rule recovery. Apparent behavioral fidelity can therefore mask incorrect generative mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM能否恢复潜在序列结构（而非仅匹配表面动作频率），发现更长上下文不提升识别、正确识别不保证忠实模拟、高阶依赖显著降低规则恢复，表面行为保真度可能掩盖错误的生成机制。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作交互智能体与模拟器，但目前不清楚它们能否恢复潜在的序列结构，而非仅复制表面动作频率。这一区分对行为模拟至关重要，因为行为常由先前上下文塑造，而非仅由边缘频率决定。
AI.method: 采用受控的两人石头剪刀布交互任务，以及单人随机n-gram续接任务。实验测试LLM能否识别潜在策略、遵循简单马尔可夫规则、维持高阶条件依赖。框架将分布匹配与条件规则遵循区分开来。
AI.result: 更长的上下文并不能改善识别；正确识别不保证忠实的模拟；高阶依赖显著降低了规则恢复能力。
AI.conclusion: 表面上的行为保真度可能会掩盖错误的生成机制。

title: SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems
summary: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出SFlexRCA，一种无需拓扑的轻量级根因分析框架，将多元遥测转为紧凑正交表示并用共享线性建模，在IIoT数据集上实现高定位精度和边缘设备高效部署。
AI.motivation: IIoT系统产生高维传感器遥测数据，故障会跨组件传播，且边缘设备资源受限，现有因果/图方法存在参数增长与计算开销问题。
AI.method: 将多元遥测变换为紧凑正交表示，采用共享轻量线性建模，避免显式建图、消息传递及逐变量/逐滞后参数增长。
AI.result: 在BATADAL、SWaT、WADI三个数据集上与10种统计、因果及非因果基线对比，在准确性、训练效率、时延和内存上具优势；在树莓派3和5上验证推理效率与能耗；在训练数据有限时仍保持较强定位性能。
AI.conclusion: SFlexRCA以紧凑共享架构避免参数膨胀，适合资源受限的IIoT边缘设备部署，代码已开源。

title: Ontology Concept Overlap as a Training Signal: Knowledge-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Clinical Question Answering
summary: Reinforcement learning post-training for language models relies on two reward designs: human preferences (RLHF, DPO) and binary verifiers (RLVR). Clinical question answering fits neither. Near-correct answers differ by a single substituted entity, and no executable check decides clinical correctness. We instantiate a soft verifier from a maintained controlled vocabulary: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier overlap (via scispaCy, set-level F1) gives a graded, externally specified reward computed without a model in the loop. We combine it inside GRPO with an entropy-normalised LLM judge, which covers the safety and evidence axes overlap cannot see, and a small consistency penalty on padding and repetition that keeps early-training samples scorable. This three-term composite improves over SFT on Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding gains are 14% on EM and 35% on Token-F1. We report Token-F1 as the primary metric because it credits partially-correct clinical content that EM discards at this open-generation scale. Main-table results are means over 3 seeds with standard deviations below 0.005. The method transfers to PubMedQA, where training on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning. A reward ablation on Phi-3, varying the judge-ontology split at a fixed consistency weight, attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term, the contribution that catches entity substitutions the judge cannot. Three negative findings constrain the design: DPO under random negatives underperforms SFT for strong-prior models but helps the weakest-prior one; PPO under a sparse neural reward diverges; GRPO with KL-in-loss collapses at 7B.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种三部分复合奖励（UMLS概念重叠软验证器 + 熵归一化LLM评判器 + 一致性惩罚），在GRPO框架下对语言模型进行临床问答强化学习后训练，在两个模型和两个数据集上显著优于SFT。
AI.motivation: 临床问答既不适合RLHF（人类偏好），也不适合RLVR（二元可验证奖励）：近似正确的答案往往只差一个被替换的实体，且没有可执行检查能判定临床正确性，因此需要一种无需模型介入、可外部指定的分级奖励。
AI.method: 从受维护的受控词表UMLS实例化软验证器：用scispaCy计算概念唯一标识符重叠（集合级F1），得到分级、外部指定、无需模型介入的奖励；与熵归一化LLM评判器（覆盖安全与证据维度）及针对填充和重复的小一致性惩罚组合，在GRPO中训练。
AI.result: 在MedQA上，Phi-3-mini(3.8B)相对SFT提升EM 2.9%(0.700 vs 0.680)、Token-F1 39%(0.202 vs 0.145)；Llama-3.2-3B提升EM 14%、Token-F1 35%。方法无需调参迁移到PubMedQA（Token-F1相对SFT提升22%和17%）。奖励消融将3个EM点归因于本体项。负面发现：DPO随机负样本对强先验模型不如SFT；PPO稀疏神经奖励发散；GRPO在7B时KL-in-loss崩溃。
AI.conclusion: UMLS本体术语贡献了评判器无法捕捉的实体替换检测能力；Token-F1比EM更适合开放式生成下的临床评估；方法在两个模型和两个数据集上稳健迁移，但DPO、PPO及KL-in-loss等设计存在特定失败模式。

title: CIPO: Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization for Adaptive Tool Granularity Selection
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks through multi-step interactions with external tools. These interactions often contain recurring local tool sequences. Treating such sequences as composite "Skills" can shorten tool-use trajectories and reduce repeated low-level decisions. However, when atomic tools and composite skills coexist, skill use becomes a policy problem: the agent must decide whether the current state requires atomic fine control or skill-level abstraction. In this paper, we argue that effective skill use should be studied as adaptive tool granularity selection. The most direct training signal for this problem is to compare the consequences of atomic and skill choices available from the same state. Based on this view, we propose CIPO, a Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization framework for adaptive tool granularity. CIPO constructs executable skills through budget-constrained mining of successful tool-use trajectories and trains granularity decisions with counterfactual branch rollouts. For each base rollout, CIPO branches at the first eligible granularity decision and replaces the chosen action with a feasible atomic or skill alternative. The paired outcome difference serves as a supplementary reward for policy optimization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model backbones show that CIPO improves task success and decision efficiency over baselines. Further analyses show that CIPO learns effective skill use by improving the choice between atomic tools and composite skills based on the current state, without simply increasing skill frequency.

AI.tldr: 提出CIPO框架，将LLM智能体的技能使用建模为自适应工具粒度选择问题，通过反事实分支rollout生成对比信号来训练粒度决策。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体多步工具调用中存在大量重复的局部工具序列，将其抽象为复合"技能"可缩短轨迹、减少重复低级决策。但当原子工具与复合技能共存时，如何选择粒度成为一个策略问题：需要判断当前状态该用原子精细控制还是技能级抽象。作者主张应将有效技能使用研究为"自适应工具粒度选择"，并认为最直接的训练信号是同一状态下比较原子与技能选择的后果。
AI.method: 提出CIPO（Counterfactual Imagination Policy Optimization）框架：1）通过预算受限的挖掘从成功的工具使用轨迹中构建可执行技能；2）用反事实分支rollout训练粒度决策——对每条基础rollout，在第一个符合条件的粒度决策点分支，将所选动作替换为可行的原子或技能替代项；3）将配对结果差异作为补充奖励用于策略优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准和模型骨干上，CIPO在任务成功率和决策效率上均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 进一步分析表明，CIPO通过学习依据当前状态改进原子工具与复合技能之间的选择来实现有效技能使用，而非单纯提高技能使用频率。

title: ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.

AI.tldr: 提出 ScopeSAE，按 token 依据预测相关性选择建模子空间，学习更具行为意义的特征，并首次观察到"重建优于原始"现象。
AI.motivation: 现有 SAE 逐层训练，建模子空间由层身份固定，与真正驱动预测的 token-层状态无关，导致特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺乏行为基础。
AI.method: 通过归一化梯度归因，为每个预测定位最具影响力的 token-层状态，从而按 token 选择预测相关的建模子空间，并在该子空间上学习特征。
AI.result: 出现"重建优于原始"效应：SAE 写回重建的下一 token 交叉熵低于原始激活；经干预分析与 KL 微调对照实验证明该效应源于预测相关子空间本身而非架构改动；同时在有效特征数、可解释性、利用率与字典冗余上优于逐层基线。
AI.conclusion: 按预测相关性选择 SAE 建模子空间能带来更有用、更具行为意义的特征。

title: Do Speech Representations Preserve Regional Accent Across Read and Spontaneous Speech?
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Regional accent cues can be captured under matched conditions, but it remains unclear whether they persist between read and spontaneous speech. We study RVG1, with 500 German speakers from nine regions, comparing ten speech representations on regional classification and continuous geolocation under matched conditions and speaker-independent read--spontaneous transfer. Whisper performs best under matched conditions, reaching 0.489 nine-way UAR and 148 km median geolocation error, but drops to 0.11/0.18 UAR across transfer directions and 363 km geolocation error. Self-supervised models show a similar degradation, whereas speaker embeddings are less discriminative in-domain but more robust under transfer. This contrast is consistent across classification and geolocation. Across representations, robustness is associated with how little a representation shifts between styles (style-invariance), for which crossstyle speaker retrieval is an interpretable proxy. Age, sex, sentence-overlap, and duration controls do not account for the gap, although channel characteristics contribute. These results show that strong matched-condition performance does not indicate robust regional information.

AI.tldr: 论文研究区域口音线索在朗读与自发语音间是否能保持,发现匹配条件下表现优异的表示在跨风格迁移时性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 区域口音线索在匹配条件下可被捕捉,但其能否在朗读与自发语音之间持续存在尚不清楚,需要系统评估跨风格迁移下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建 RVG1 数据集,包含来自九个地区的500名德语说话人,在匹配条件及说话人无关的朗读-自发迁移下,比较十种语音表示在区域分类和连续地理定位任务上的表现。
AI.result: Whisper 在匹配条件下最佳(0.489 九分类 UAR,148 km 中位定位误差),但迁移后降至 0.11/0.18 UAR、363 km 误差;自监督模型类似退化,而说话人嵌入域内判别力较低但迁移更稳健。鲁棒性与风格不变性相关,跨风格说话人检索可作为可解释代理,年龄、性别、句子重叠和时长控制无法解释该差距,但信道特征有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 强匹配条件性能并不代表鲁棒的区域信息,跨风格迁移下区域口音线索的可靠性大幅下降。

title: EmoRSS: Mitigating Emotion-Induced Over-Refusal in Large Language Models
summary: Emotional expression can influence the safety decisions of large language models (LLMs), offering a potential avenue for improving safety alignment. Existing studies have mainly focused on how emotional expressions facilitate attacks under harmful requests, while overlooking their effects on benign requests. We find that emotional expression can also systematically increase refusal tendencies on benign requests, leading to unnecessary over-refusal. Based on this observation, we propose emotion-guided refusal subspace steering (EmoRSS), an activation-steering method that mitigates emotion-induced over-refusal while preserving refusal behaviour on harmful requests. Specifically, we first identify a refusal-sensitive layer using layer-wise linear probes and construct a refusal subspace from sparse autoencoder (SAE) features aligned with the probe direction. Next, we use paired regular and emotional requests with the same queries to estimate the mean activation shift in the features defining the refusal subspace. Finally, we decode this shift into an activation intervention vector and apply it in the reverse refusal direction during inference, without updating the backbone parameters. Experiments on two LLMs show that, when requests contain emotional expressions, our method achieves a more favourable trade-off between refusing harmful requests and answering benign ones than prior over-refusal mitigation baselines, while better preserving general task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM在良性请求上也会因情感表达而过度拒答，提出EmoRSS激活引导方法，在保留对有害请求拒答的同时缓解情感诱导的过度拒答。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注情感表达如何助长对有害请求的攻击，忽视了其对良性请求的影响。作者发现情感表达会系统性地提高对良性请求的拒答倾向，造成不必要的过度拒答。
AI.method: EmoRSS利用逐层线性探针定位拒答敏感层，基于与探针方向对齐的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征构建拒答子空间；用相同查询的成对常规与情感请求估计子空间特征的均值激活偏移；最后将该偏移解码为激活干预向量，在推理时沿拒答反向施加，无需更新主干参数。
AI.result: 在两个LLM上的实验表明，当请求含情感表达时，该方法在拒答有害请求与回答良性请求之间取得了优于既有过度拒答缓解基线的权衡，同时更好地保持了通用任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 情感表达会引发LLM的过度拒答问题，EmoRSS通过激活引导有效缓解该问题并保持安全性，为安全对齐提供了新思路。

title: Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery
summary: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"潜意识学习"（subliminal learning）为何需要海量载体样本，通过"潜意识引导"测试床发现：软监督（KL）能用几百个载体精确恢复教师特质向量，而硬监督（NLL）即使数万样本也远不及；该差距源于将引导向量蒸馏视为含噪线性逆问题——梯度指向 Fisher 矩阵扭曲后的方向，硬标签会放大采样噪声，故需更多数据抑制噪声。
AI.motivation: 已发表的潜意识学习演示通常需要数万个载体样本，作者想探究这一数据需求究竟从何而来，并厘清软监督与硬监督在特质迁移上的本质差异。
AI.method: 以"潜意识引导"为测试床，将教师特质设为已知的残差流向量Δ_T，使迁移可直接测量为参数恢复。在相同载体前缀下对比token级硬NLL监督与全分布软KL监督，并将引导向量蒸馏建模为含噪线性逆问题，借助Fisher矩阵F分析梯度方向与优化动态。
AI.result: 软监督从几百个载体几乎精确恢复Δ_T，硬监督即使数万载体仍远低于该水平。二者初始梯度近乎共线且与Δ_T对齐较差，但迭代后分化。Qwen2.5-7B和Gemma-2-9B实验证实四项预测：初始梯度的Fisher畸变、按陡峭到平坦方向的恢复顺序、随数据规模移动的最优逆深度，以及从固定提示池重采样补全与新增提示同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 大量载体数据集的作用与其说是揭示特质，不如说是抑制被Fisher逆放大后的标签噪声；软监督能更高效地恢复低曲率方向上的教师特质。

title: The Assistance Dilemma: Learning to Teach via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained to answer questions are natively poor at teaching. Reinforcement Learning (RL) against a simulated student is a promising approach to improve their pedagogy, but existing RL-trained tutors reward the student's success on the tutored problem with the tutor's words still in context. The reward is then easiest to raise by telling the student the answer, and a tuned penalty is needed to reduce telling. Drawing on learning sciences, we introduce a masked near-transfer post-test: the student is tested on an unseen variant of the tutored problem with the tutor's utterances masked, so the reward can rise only through what the student wrote in its own turns. This discourages cognitive offloading by the student and allows the continuous penalty to be replaced by two binary reward gates (factual correctness of tutor response, no solution handover). A leave-one-out ablation shows that the learning-gain reward on its own does not separate teaching from telling: the gates reduce solution handover while the near-transfer post-test improves out-of-domain transfer. Using these reward designs we develop Eduardo, a multi-turn RL recipe for training LLM tutors, and use it to train 4B, 9B, 14B and 27B models from two distinct LLM architectures. Our post-trained Eduardo-27B model matches Gemini-3.1-Pro on MathTutorBench and Claude Opus 4.8 on TutorMoments at 2.4-6.2x fewer thinking tokens than frontier models, which matters for interactive tutoring. Without being named in the reward, the model more than doubles its use of the push-for-justification teacher move while support fading (e.g., assigning independent work), whose payoff lies beyond a single-problem dialog episode, is trained out. We open-source our training environment, an 8,671-problem near-transfer dataset, and trained models for further development.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对LLM导师训练的奖励设计缺陷，提出"掩蔽近迁移后测"机制，让奖励只能通过学生自身作答提升，从而区分"教学"与"直接给答案"，并开发了多轮RL训练方案Eduardo。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM导师在RL训练中，奖励基于学生解题成功与否，但导师话语仍在上下文中，导致导师最易通过直接告知答案来刷高奖励，需依赖调参惩罚才能抑制"给答案"行为。论文希望从根本上解决该问题，避免认知卸载。
AI.method: 受学习科学启发，提出掩蔽近迁移后测：学生在被辅导问题的未见变体上受测，且导师话语被掩蔽，奖励只能来自学生自己写出的内容。用两个二元奖励门（导师回复的事实正确性、不直接给出解法）取代连续惩罚。通过leave-one-out消融验证各组件作用，并据此开发多轮RL配方Eduardo，训练4B、9B、14B、27B四种规模、两种架构的模型。
AI.result: 消融显示仅用学习增益奖励无法区分教学与告知：奖励门降低直接给答案，近迁移后测提升跨域迁移。Eduardo-27B在MathTutorBench上匹配Gemini-3.1-Pro，在TutorMoments上匹配Claude Opus 4.8，且思考token少2.4-6.2倍。模型未在奖励中指明，却将push-for-justification教学动作使用量翻倍以上；而支持性淡出（如布置独立作业）因收益超出单题对话而被训练掉。
AI.conclusion: 掩蔽近迁移后测与二元奖励门为LLM导师训练提供了更有效的奖励设计，避免认知卸载并实现高效、可迁移的辅导能力。论文开源了训练环境、包含8,671道题的近迁移数据集及训练好的模型。

title: How corner is a corner case? Percentile control for highway scenario generation
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables. Project page with videos: https://hhjj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/ Code: https://github.com/hhjj233/P-control-SG
summary:
Generating corner-case scenarios with appropriate adversity in a simulation environment is critical for testing an autonomous vehicle (AV) software stack's safety performance before deployment. Existing autonomous-driving scenario generators can enforce specific behavior, adversity, or feasibility conditions, but they provide limited control over how extreme a generated scenario is relative to plausible futures in the same traffic context. This study represents the adversity of a generated scenario as its percentile in the conditional distribution of future risk given the observed history. This view supports calibrated answers to two questions: how "corner" a generated corner-case scenario is and how its "cornerness" can be fine-tuned.
  To this end, we formulate history-conditioned risk-percentile requests and learn a reference risk distribution that maps each requested percentile to a physical risk target. We then use a percentile-conditioned joint diffusion model with sampling-time risk guidance to generate multi-agent futures, together with a reference-based criterion for evaluating percentile realization.
  Experiments use the minimum post-encroachment time (PET) between the ego and its surrounding vehicles as the risk surrogate on highD. On the primary evaluation set, our method realizes 1,422 of 1,440 requests within a 0.05 percentile tolerance (98.75%), with mean percentile error 0.00673 and PET-target error 0.00991 seconds. The resulting interface connects context-relative risk specification, physical realization, and evaluation through a common risk scale. Project website and videos of generated scenarios are available at https://hhj233.github.io/CornerPercentile/.

AI.tldr: 提出将自动驾驶场景的"极端程度"定义为给定历史下未来风险分布中的百分位，并用条件扩散模型生成可精调百分位的多智能体未来场景。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶场景生成器虽能施加特定行为、恶劣程度或可行性约束，但难以控制生成场景相对于同一交通情境下合理未来的极端程度。需要一种可标定"有多corner"并支持细调的度量与控制方式。
AI.method: 将场景恶劣程度表示为观测历史条件下未来风险的条件分布百分位；构建"历史条件下的风险百分位请求"，学习参考风险分布将请求百分位映射到物理风险目标；采用百分位条件联合扩散模型，配合采样时风险引导生成多智能体未来，并给出基于参考的百分位实现评估准则。以highD上的ego与周边车辆最小PET为风险代理。
AI.result: 在主评估集上，1440个请求中1422个在0.05百分位容差内实现（98.75%），平均百分位误差0.00673，PET目标误差0.00991秒。
AI.conclusion: 该接口通过统一风险尺度连接了情境相对的风险指定、物理实现与评估，实现了对corner-case极端程度的可标定、可细调生成。

title: Residual Visual Credit Optimization: Conserved Evidence Routing for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards scales multimodal reasoning, but an outcome reward says how much a trajectory is worth, not how that value should be spread over the decisions that produced it. We introduce Residual Visual Credit Optimization (RVCO), which treats token credit as a conserved routing problem. A controlled visual intervention yields a per-token evidence response; robust within-trajectory coordinates remove incidental scale; and a budgeted entropic router distributes a fixed amount of sequence utility according to perceptual dependence. A residual support path guarantees positive credit at every valid position, and an analytic correction restores the prescribed credit mass exactly. The resulting field is selective, bounded, full-support, and invariant to response-local score shifts, and recovers hard token selection as a limiting case. Across four model families and seven reasoning benchmarks, RVCO improves accuracy over strong RLVR baselines while maintaining late-stage optimization stability, corruption robustness, and competitive training cost. Rewards, rollouts, and the group-relative advantage estimator are unchanged; only the geometry of token-level credit differs.

AI.tldr: RVCO提出将token信用分配视为守恒路由问题，通过视觉干预和熵路由实现选择性、有界、全支撑的信用分布，在多个模型和推理基准上超越RLVR基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR的结果奖励只说明轨迹价值，无法说明价值应如何分配给各个决策步骤，导致token级信用分配不合理。
AI.method: 通过受控视觉干预获得逐token证据响应；用稳健的轨迹内坐标去除偶然尺度；用带预算的熵路由器按感知依赖分配固定序列效用；引入残差支撑路径保证有效位置正信用，并用解析校正精确恢复信用总量。
AI.result: 在四个模型家族和七个推理基准上，RVCO相比强RLVR基线提升准确率，同时保持后期优化稳定性、腐败鲁棒性和有竞争力的训练成本。
AI.conclusion: 仅改变token级信用的几何结构即可提升多模态推理，奖励、rollout和组相对优势估计器无需改动。

title: Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression
summary: KV caches are a major bottleneck in long-context inference and long-form generation with large language models. Existing training-free eviction policies largely rely on proxy importance signals, such as attention mass, to decide which past tokens to retain. We argue that cache compression should instead preserve the predictive behavior of the full-cache model, retaining entries whose removal would substantially change the model's output distribution. We propose Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression, a training-free framework that scores candidate evictions by estimating the compressed-cache logits induced by their removal and evaluating the resulting KL to the full-cache next-token distribution. Using pre-eviction forward statistics, the method avoids running separate masked forward passes for each candidate. Across diverse architectures and both prefill-time and generation-time compression, our method delivers substantial gains in downstream task quality over lightweight attention-based heuristics at matched retained-KV budgets, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. It achieves these gains with additional compression-time computation while retaining an end-to-end speedup over full-cache inference in our evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 提出行为保持的KV缓存压缩框架，用KL散度衡量逐出候选对输出分布的影响，实现无需训练且免多次前向的压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练KV缓存逐出策略多依赖注意力质量等代理重要度信号，未必能保持全缓存模型的预测行为。作者主张压缩应保留那些一旦移除会显著改变输出分布的条目。
AI.method: 通过估计移除候选后压缩缓存的logits，并计算其与全缓存下一token分布的KL散度来给逐出候选打分；利用逐出前的forward统计，避免对每个候选单独跑掩码前向。
AI.result: 在多种架构及prefill与生成阶段的压缩中，相同保留KV预算下，下游任务质量显著优于轻量注意力启发式方法，激进压缩下增益最大；虽增加压缩期计算，但仍保持相对全缓存推理的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: KV缓存压缩应以保持全缓存预测行为为目标，行为保持打分优于注意力代理信号，在质量与效率间取得更好权衡。

title: EVISKILL: Grounding Skill Evolution in Replayable Evidence
summary: Continual skill evolution enables LLM agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. Its effectiveness depends on determining not only what to change, but also why a change is justified and when it should become persistent guidance. However, existing experience-driven methods can lose the behavioral evidence and task contexts supporting edits. Moreover, a global validation outcome provides an incomplete judgment of its constituent changes: locally supported corrections may be discarded with a rejected revision, while evidence may require further experience to inform useful updates. To this end, we introduce EVISKILL, an evidence-driven framework that organizes execution observations into Replayable Evidence Cards and synthesizes edits with explicit links to their supporting contexts. Targeted replay verifies these edits through re-execution and provides feedback for correction. Across epochs, EVISKILL preserves evidence and provisionally retains supported edits for further refinement, while global validation governs their incorporation into the final skill. Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across six LLM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach.

AI.tldr: EVISKILL是一个证据驱动的框架，通过可回放证据卡组织执行观察并合成带证据链接的技能编辑，结合针对性回放验证与跨epoch的临时保留机制，实现LLM智能体的持续技能演化，在三个交互基准和六个LLM骨架上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 持续技能演化需要判断改什么、为何改、何时固化为持久指导。现有经验驱动方法会丢失支持编辑的行为证据和任务上下文；且全局验证结果无法完整评判各个组成性修改，局部有支持的修正可能因整体修订被拒而被丢弃，而某些证据需更多经验才能形成有用更新。
AI.method: EVISKILL将执行观察组织为可回放证据卡（Replayable Evidence Cards），在合成编辑时显式链接其支持性上下文；通过针对性回放（重新执行）验证编辑并提供纠正反馈；跨epoch保留证据并临时保留有支持的编辑以供进一步精炼，最终由全局验证决定是否将其纳入最终技能。
AI.result: 在三个交互式基准、六个LLM骨架上进行了实验，证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EVISKILL通过将证据保留、针对性回放验证与跨epoch的临时编辑保留相结合，解决了经验驱动技能演化中证据丢失和全局验证粒度不足的问题，提升了LLM智能体的持续技能演化效果。

title: TSAE: Structured Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Time-Series Forecasting Models
summary: Time-series forecasting informs critical decisions in energy dispatch, industrial operations, and environmental monitoring; understanding the patterns models rely on is essential for assessing reliability and identifying failures. Input attribution identifies important variables and time segments but offers limited insight into internal features, while standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not directly constrain cross-variable structure or temporal continuity. We introduce TSAE, a structured sparse autoencoder for forecasting representations that decomposes hidden states into individually inspectable features. TSAE organizes cross-variable structure through shared and variable-routed private dictionaries, separates feature detection from magnitude estimation with gated encoding, and constrains neighboring sparse-code changes according to raw-segment similarity. These mechanisms support analysis of variable context, activation strength, and temporal evolution. Forecast-consistency fine-tuning further improves preservation of the frozen forecaster's outputs. The accompanying TSEVAL protocol separately audits fidelity, feature coherence, and physical calibration to ground feature interpretation. In three-seed experiments with frozen PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTh2, and ETTm1, TSAE achieves the lowest hidden-state reconstruction error, normalized forecast-reconstruction error (NFRE), and feature transition rate among five SAEs at comparable per-token activity. NFRE decreases by 4.3-26.4% relative to the next-best mean. Dataset-dependent tradeoffs in selectivity, physical correlation, and calibration show that fidelity and temporal-stability gains require independent semantic validation to support feature interpretation.

AI.tldr: 提出TSAE结构化稀疏自编码器，将预测模型隐状态分解为可检查特征，并配TSEVAL协议评估，在ETT数据集上优于五种SAE基线。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测需理解模型依赖的模式以评估可靠性与失败。输入归因只能识别重要变量与时间段，无法洞察内部特征；标准SAE目标未直接约束跨变量结构或时间连续性。
AI.method: TSAE通过共享与变量路由的私有字典组织跨变量结构，用门控编码分离特征检测与幅度估计，并按原始片段相似性约束相邻稀疏码变化；辅以预测一致性微调保留冻结预测器输出；配套TSEVAL协议分别审计保真度、特征一致性与物理校准。
AI.result: 在PatchTST冻结、ETTh1/ETTh2/ETTm1三seed实验中，TSAE在五种SAE中隐状态重构误差、归一化预测重构误差(NFRE)与特征转移率最低；NFRE较次优均值下降4.3–26.4%。选择性、物理相关性与校准存在数据集相关权衡。
AI.conclusion: TSAE在保真度与时间稳定性上更优，但特征解释仍需独立的语义验证，因精度与语义质量之间存在数据集相关权衡。

title: AECP: Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol for Multi-Agent Code Generation
summary: As AI agents increasingly tackle complex repository-level coding tasks, distributing work across multiple agents is a natural way to scale beyond the capabilities of a single agent. To coordinate their interdependent work, these agents share findings and agree on interfaces between modules. However, exchanged information often serves only as context, leaving individual agents to interpret it and incorporate it into subsequent work. Consequently, shared findings may go unused and deviations from interface agreements may go undetected, undermining the reliability and efficiency of collaboration. This motivates moving part of the coordination responsibility from individual agents to the execution harness. To make shared information actionable during execution, we introduce the Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol (AECP). AECP requires agents to communicate exclusively through structured artifacts and specifies how the harness processes them. The harness supplies findings when agents access relevant code, screens implementations for mismatches with recorded interface commitments, and requires affected agents to revisit revised agreements. These coordination steps become part of harness execution rather than actions that agents must initiate from prior messages. Across Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, using closed- and open-source models including Opus-4.8 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, AECP improves average test pass rate by 28.2% and reduces average wall time by 16.5% relative to an agent team using free-form inter-agent messages. Artifact-exclusive communication also blocks the relay of malicious instructions between agents, reducing how often they reach other agents from 95% to 0% and how often those agents act on them from 40% to 0%.

AI.tldr: 提出产物独占通信协议(AECP)，将协调职责从智能体转移到执行框架，提升多智能体协作可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多智能体处理仓库级编码任务时，共享信息仅作上下文，易被忽视；接口协议偏差难被检测，削弱协作可靠性与效率。
AI.method: AECP要求智能体仅通过结构化产物通信，框架负责处理：访问相关代码时提供发现、筛查实现与接口承诺的偏差、要求受影响智能体重审修改后的协议。
AI.result: 在Doc2Repo、NL2Repo、CodeProjectEval上，用Opus-4.8、DeepSeek-V4-Flash等模型，测试通过率平均提升28.2%，墙钟时间减少16.5%；恶意指令传递率从95%降至0%，执行率从40%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 将部分协调责任移至执行框架，使协作步骤成为框架执行的一部分，既提升性能与效率，又增强安全性。

title: CI-JEPA: A Counterfactual Analysis of Latent Representations in Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Learning
comment: This article has been accepted for the International Symposium on Smart Systems, Algorithms & Applications 2026 (IS3A3 2026), Tezpur Central University, India
summary: Self-supervised visual representation learning learns useful features without manual annotations during representation training. The image-based joint-embedding predictive architecture (I-JEPA) predicts latent representations of masked image regions, but its objective does not explicitly model responses to specified visual interventions. We introduce CI-JEPA, a counterfactual intervention-aware extension that learns to predict the representation change $ΔZ = Z_{\mathrm{CF}} - Z$ between an original image and a modified counterpart. We assess representation robustness through selective sensitivity: stronger responses to task-relevant semantic changes than to nuisance changes. Experiments on Flowers102 use flower-center occlusion as a candidate semantic intervention and background blur and tint as candidate nuisance interventions. With frozen-encoder linear probing, CI-JEPA achieves a best validation accuracy of 78.14\%, compared with 77.55\% for both the pretrained ViT-B/16 and the I-JEPA baseline, a gain of 0.59 percentage points. The reported mean $L_2$ representation changes are 4.42 for center occlusion, 3.48 for background tint, and 2.83 for background blur. This ordering is consistent with relative semantic selectivity for the evaluated interventions, rather than complete nuisance invariance. The accuracy comparison is complementary and does not establish improved robustness over the baselines. These controlled image modifications provide a framework for studying intervention-induced changes in JEPA representations; they do not establish causal feature discovery or robustness to all visual changes.

AI.tldr: CI-JEPA在I-JEPA基础上引入反事实干预感知目标，预测原图与修改图之间的表征变化ΔZ。在Flowers102上，冻结编码器线性探测准确率达78.14%（超基线0.59个百分点），并通过L2表征变化评估表征对语义与干扰干预的选择性敏感度。
AI.motivation: 自监督视觉表征学习无需人工标注即可学习有用特征，但I-JEPA的目标未显式建模对指定视觉干预的响应。作者希望引入反事实干预感知，以评估表征是否对任务相关的语义变化更敏感、对无关干扰变化更鲁棒，即"选择性敏感"。
AI.method: 提出CI-JEPA，作为I-JEPA的反事实干预感知扩展，学习预测原图与修改图之间的表征变化ΔZ=Z_CF−Z。通过选择性敏感度评估表征鲁棒性，即对语义变化的响应应强于对干扰变化的响应。在Flowers102上使用花心遮挡作为语义干预候选，背景模糊和色调作为干扰干预候选，采用冻结编码器线性探测。
AI.result: 冻结编码器线性探测下，CI-JEPA最佳验证准确率为78.14%，而预训练ViT-B/16和I-JEPA基线均为77.55%，增益0.59个百分点。报告的平均L2表征变化为：中心遮挡4.42、背景色调3.48、背景模糊2.83。该排序与语义选择性一致，而非完全干扰不变性。
AI.conclusion: 准确性比较仅具补充性质，并不能证明相比基线提升了鲁棒性。这些受控图像修改为研究JEPA表征中的干预引发变化提供了框架，但并未建立因果特征发现或对所有视觉变化的鲁棒性。

title: Prompt Dominance and Asymmetric Verifier Costs: Empirical Ablations of GRPO at 1B Scale on GSM8K
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures. Code, run records, and figure scripts: https://github.com/Helios-YQH/llm-from-scratch
summary: This paper studies GRPO at 1B scale from both directions: what estimator choices do to the learning signal, and what a degraded reward signal does to what is learned. We train OLMo-2-0425-1B on GSM8K with a from-scratch implementation and measure both sides in controlled sweeps, including a verifier-quality experiment that degrades the training reward and the test-time selector identically. Four results stand out. The prompt is the first-order decision: the zero-shot prompt leaves the base model at 0.08% (its outputs are degenerate continuations, not wrong answers), so almost no group carries a gradient, and training succeeds because the 3-shot prompt reaches 18.3%. At this scale the estimator variants sit within seed noise, with Dr. GRPO ahead on both seeds. In the off-policy regime, clipping is the whole story: training on data without a clipped ratio loses 4-6 points relative to the on-policy reference, while GRPO-style clipping and GSPO recover the loss entirely. Finally, the same weak verifier is far cheaper in RL than in test-time selection: a 10%-flip verifier leaves RL's attainable gain intact (91% and 106% retained across two seeds) where selection retains 57%, and a format-only verifier leaves RL with 16-30% of its gain and selection with essentially nothing. Flip noise acts as an affine transform on the expected reward, and the group-normalized advantage with Adam's rescaling removes it exactly; the residual is a second-order variance effect that the matched-step comparison at a 30% flip rate tests.

AI.tldr: 本文从估计量选择与奖励信号退化两个方向研究1B规模的GRPO，发现提示词选择是关键决策，离策略下裁剪机制至关重要，且弱验证器对RL的损害远小于测试时选择。
AI.motivation: 当前对GRPO的理解在大规模下可能不适用，需要在小规模（1B）进行受控实验，分别考察估计量选择对学习信号的影响，以及退化奖励信号对学习内容的影响。
AI.method: 从头实现GRPO，在GSM8K上训练OLMo-2-0425-1B，进行受控扫描实验：比较不同提示词、估计量变体、离策略裁剪机制，并用验证器质量实验同时退化训练奖励和测试时选择器。
AI.result: 提示词是一阶决策：零样本提示仅0.08%，3-shot提示达18.3%训练才成功；估计量变体在种子噪声内（Dr. GRPO两seed均领先）；离策略下裁剪是关键：无裁剪比率损失4-6分，GRPO裁剪与GSPO可完全恢复；10%翻转验证器使RL保留91%/106%增益而选择仅57%，格式验证器使RL保留16-30%增益而选择几乎为零。翻转噪声对期望奖励是仿射变换，组归一化优势配合Adam重缩放可精确消除，残差为二阶方差效应。
AI.conclusion: 在1B规模上，提示词是首要因素，估计量选择影响较小，离策略训练中裁剪不可或缺，且弱验证器对RL的损害显著小于对测试时选择的影响。

title: Why, Where, How: Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding for Code Repair in NL2SQL
summary: SQL queries that large language models write from natural language questions can execute successfully yet produce incorrect results, so execution alone does not reveal what to fix. An error taxonomy says why the query is wrong, but not where to look or how to change it. Existing methods can guide SQL correction through feedback, error reports, or generated plans alongside an unmasked query. We introduce TEG(Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding), which turns a supplied diagnosis into a structured correction input for natural language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) correction. Type-specific rules map each error type to construct classes to reconsider and an edit operation to request. TEG masks the selected constructs in the query when applicable and states that operation in an edit instruction. TEG generates candidate corrections from this input, uses execution feedback to guide candidate selection, and repeats the process one annotation at a time for queries with several errors. On NL2SQL-BUGs, TEG reaches 47.3 single-error execution accuracy and 37.0 overall with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across the model sizes and thinking modes evaluated in the main comparison, TEG outperforms all evaluated baselines on single-error queries, even when the baselines receive the same error-type annotations. With predicted types, TEG stays above direct LLM correction and ErrorLLM on single-error queries.

AI.tldr: 提出TEG框架，将错误分类诊断转化为结构化纠错输入（掩码+编辑指令），迭代修正NL2SQL查询。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖反馈、错误报告或生成计划，但错误分类只说明"为什么错"，未指示"看哪里"和"怎么改"，导致纠错定位困难。
